2d7e9aba0103770f6b7a.description: Engineering Graduate Programme - September 2027 Contract Duration/Type: Permanent Location: Kilkenny Hybrid/Onsite: Hybrid (initially office based with potential move to hybrid) Working Pattern (Time/Hours): Monday-Friday, 8.30am-5.30pm * These roles will commence from September 2027 About the role Veolia Ireland is seeking Engineering Graduates to join our Technical and EICA division in Kilkenny. Our formalised Graduate Development Programme is based on the 70:20:10 learning model, combining on-the-job experience, feedback and observation, and formal education and training. Progress will be supported through weekly and quarterly check-ins with your manager, alongside biannual reviews with HR and the Learning & Development Manager. Depending on your engineering discipline, project requirements and level of experience, you may support one or more projects involving wastewater treatment plants and fresh water treatment plants. Your responsibilities will vary according to the scope, size and complexity of each project. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams and receive support and guidance from experienced Engineers. Day to Day of the Roles: Candidates will be considered for a role in one of the following teams: 1. Process Commissioning Engineering Provide process support and troubleshooting advice to clients and operational sites. Assist with concept designs and the evaluation of different treatment processes. Support the completion of detailed process designs for live projects. Help identify and implement operational-efficiency improvements at Veolia sites. Undertake water-chemistry analysis to support the evaluation of site processes. Work as part of an integrated design team covering process, mechanical, electrical, automation and civil engineering disciplines. Conduct site surveys and collect relevant technical information. Assist with the start-up and commissioning of new works at sites across Ireland. 2. Design Engineering Assist with the development of detailed engineering designs. Prepare drawings using CAD and Revit, with an emphasis on Building Information Modelling (BIM). Prepare design submissions under the guidance of Design Engineers and Senior Design Engineers. Liaise with mechanical and electrical designers, civil and structural designers, clients and other project stakeholders. Prepare pipework and valve take-offs. Assist with the preparation of procurement specifications. 3. Project Engineering Take ownership of delegated projects, work packages and project issues. Develop a thorough understanding of the contract requirements for assigned projects. Review and evaluate client specifications and liaise with clients and their representatives. Communicate effectively with the Project Manager, Design Leads and sub-consultants throughout project delivery. Work with multidisciplinary engineering teams on final design, equipment selection and procurement activities. Organise, coordinate and monitor design activities. Support the delivery of projects in accordance with Veolia's health and safety standards. Monitor project budgets, programmes and key milestones to support delivery within agreed timescales and financial limits. Follow Veolia's procedures for contract and project execution. 4. Electrical Design Engineering Assist Senior Engineers with ESB liaison and develop an understanding of utility-connection requirements. Review and interpret client specifications under appropriate supervision. Support the preparation of electrical designs, drawings and technical submissions. Develop knowledge of lighting, power distribution and auxiliary systems for water and wastewater facilities. Read and update single-line diagrams, schematics and wiring diagrams. Gain exposure to instrumentation selection and control-system design. Prepare cable schedules, I/O lists and basic electrical calculations. Assist with panel-layout designs, including MCCs, LCPs and MDBs, and support schematic reviews. Assist with procurement activities, including specification writing and quotation reviews. Attend Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) and develop an understanding of commissioning documentation requirements. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across design, contracts and automation. Build knowledge of relevant Irish, EN, IEC and WIMES standards. Participate in site visits to understand how designs are implemented during construction and commissioning. Required skills for this role; A minimum NFQ Level 8 degree in an engineering discipline. The ability to work on your own initiative and contribute effectively within a multidisciplinary team. Good organisational and time-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. A self-motivated, practical and solutions-focused approach. The ability to coordinate design and site activities effectively. Competence in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and, where relevant, Microsoft Project. A full driving licence and willingness to travel to project and operational sites across Ireland, if required. What we offer A permanent position with Veolia Ireland. Practical experience on water and wastewater infrastructure projects. Support and guidance from experienced engineering and project professionals. Opportunities for learning, professional development and career progression. The opportunity to work within a dynamic, collaborative and multidisciplinary environment. A competitive salary structure throughout the programme Health Insurance, Pension and other benefits available Enhanced Annual Leave Here at Veolia, we're proud to be known as an equal opportunities employer. We know how important it is to be fully committed to building and maintaining a diverse and inclusive place to work for every one of our colleagues. If you are an EU/EEA national, you will be asked to show proof of right to work in Ireland. If you are a non-EU/EEA national , you will require current and valid permission to work and reside in the Republic of Ireland. Information on legislation and guides to the procedures in relation to obtaining work permits, is available on the Department of Jobs, Enterprise and Innovation website.

Break down complex product requirements into clear technical designs and executable work, guiding teams from concept through delivery. Act as role model within the team, setting high standards for code quality, testing, reliability, and operational excellence. Partner closely with product managers and designers to influence roadmap decisions, balancing customer value, technical health, and long-term sustainability. Listen to the customer and elevate their experience. CSAT, NPS, feedback, and metrics are their voice — drive investigations, identify root causes, and lead impactful improvements. Optimise — champion effective use of AI tools across the team to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, and focus effort on the most complex engineering challenges. Lead by example — bring curiosity, accountability, and positivity, helping foster a culture of ownership, learning, and collaboration. Strong experience with unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including contract testing and test automation in CI/CD pipelines. Practical experience or strong interest in AI-assisted development, including hands-on use of LLM-based tools for design exploration, scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and improving developer productivity — with strong ownership of validated, production-ready solutions. Deep familiarity with Git, DevOps practices, continuous integration, and continuous delivery. Experience optimising applications across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web platforms and ecosystems. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Reinforcement learning is how Claude learns to reason, write code, and act autonomously over long horizons. At frontier scale, an RL run is a large distributed system: training, sampling, and environment execution run concurrently across a large fleet of accelerators and hosts. As an engineer in RL Engineering, you'll work on keeping that system secure as it scales.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll work in the RL codebase and the infrastructure underneath it, alongside the engineers and researchers who build and use it. The system is large and changes as fast as the research does, so security work here has to keep up with that pace without costing performance or velocity.

We're hiring from two backgrounds: security engineers who want to work on large-scale ML systems, and ML systems or research engineers who want to work on security. Strong candidates have depth in one and real interest in the other.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate security controls for RL training systems and the infrastructure they run on

  • Work across the stack (orchestration, environments, training, inference) wherever the work is needed

  • Review designs and code across the RL stack, find security problems, and fix them

  • Build shared libraries and tooling that other RL engineers and researchers build on

  • Build the observability needed to understand what these systems are doing

  • Work with researchers and performance engineers to make sure security changes preserve training correctness and performance

  • Write clear design documents for what you build

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or Go

  • Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or security systems in production

  • Strong understanding of security fundamentals

  • Working knowledge of Linux, containers, and cloud infrastructure

  • Experience debugging complex problems across many hosts and services

  • Ability to reason about tradeoffs between security, performance, and reliability

  • Strong written communication, including design documents

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience running ML training or inference infrastructure at scale

  • Experience with infrastructure security, such as isolation, access control, networking, or identity

  • Experience with container orchestration such as Kubernetes, and with sandboxed or virtualized code execution at scale

  • Experience building observability for large fleets

  • Experience supporting research teams or other fast-moving internal users

  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning or large language model training workloads

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 2f2415ac0878122d3826.description:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.

At MongoDB, our Account Development team works closely with our partners in both Sales and Marketing to build fanatical customer enthusiasm around MongoDB. ADR reps are responsible for identifying and qualifying new opportunities for our sales organization. 

We view our Account Development program as the best way to turbocharge a long and successful career in sales and view our Account Development Representatives (ADRs) as the next wave of Account Executives at MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

The Opportunity

Being an ADR is often a first step to jump-starting a career in sales. At MongoDB, we have a culture that celebrates diversity, fosters growth and enablement, and ensures that we provide our ADRs with the tools and the confidence that they need to grow their careers. We invest heavily in the training and development of our team. You will always have the support from our sales enablement org and managers that will maintain 1:1 coaching throughout your career here.

Our ADRs gain an understanding of our product, community, who we sell to, why they care, and what makes us relevant. They learn how to generate a pipeline quickly and effectively as well as how to achieve a good discovery and qualification. The team is a crucial resource for sales teams across MongoDB to get great talent from. This helps us scale our teams, as well as ensure that we have a culture of meritocracy.

Day to Day

  • Identify high-potential businesses that would be a good fit to work with MongoDB across your region
  • Work with the Sales team to develop and lead inbound and outbound campaigns from idea-generation through to qualified call
  • Develop strong sales and product knowledge
  • Interact with IT and business decision makers via telephone and email
  • Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management
  • Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team
  • Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential
  • Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota
  • Build strong relationships with our marketing team and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business
  • Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success

 

What You Will Bring to the Table

  • A self-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals
  • Outstanding communication skills in Italian (native level) and English (fluent)
  • Time management skills and ability to work either independently or through coaching
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced and high growth environment
  • Passionate about cutting-edge technology with the aptitude to learn new and exciting IT software products, as well as, understand business critical solutions quickly 

 

Things We Love

  • Strong and progressive academic background: Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Business or any related field
  • Proven track record of success in sales or business development or customer facing roles in a target driven environment, ideally in the tech industry
  • Familiarity with database, web server, and open source technology
  • Working experience with Salesforce.com

 

Why You Should Apply

  • Great Earning Potential 
  • Welcoming and inclusive workplace Meet MongoDB’s Employee Affinity Groups!
  • Continuous career development
  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Benefits include: 
    • Sales Bootcamp
    • Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

2fb8623003983f0050a1.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We're looking for a BDR Enablement Lead to own the curriculum and craft development of Anthropic's business development organization. Our BDRs are the front door to the pipeline and, for many of them, this is the first serious sales role of their career. What they learn here shapes how they sell for the next decade. This role owns that formation: the onboarding curriculum, sales foundations, the ongoing skill development, and the pipeline generation playbooks that turn effort into meetings. It is also a role with an unusual opportunity. Anthropic's BDRs should be the most AI-native prospecting team in the industry. You will build the workflows that make that true — using plugins, account research skills, and agentic tooling to change what a BDR can accomplish in a day. Doing this well requires someone who is genuinely excited about the craft of prospecting and about rebuilding it around what AI now makes possible. Key responsibilities Own the BDR onboarding curriculum, taking new hires from day one to first meeting booked as quickly as we responsibly can Enable BDRs on AI-native prospecting workflows, including plugins, account research skills, and agentic tooling that meaningfully change BDR productivity Develop and maintain pipeline generation playbooks across segments, personas, and motions Run ongoing skill development on sales fundamentals: cold calling, written outreach, objection handling, discovery, and qualification Certify BDRs on our products, our qualification criteria, and our messaging Partner with BDR leadership to identify where skill gaps are constraining pipeline, and build focused interventions Build the coaching and call-review infrastructure that gives BDRs specific, frequent feedback Measure enablement impact on ramp time, activity quality, meeting conversion, and pipeline contribution Create a clear development path from BDR into the next role, in partnership with sales leadership Minimum qualifications Experience in Enablement, including time as a high-performing BDR or BDR manager Have excelled in the role you are now enabling, and are passionate about mentorship and early-career development Are excited about rebuilding the prospecting motion around AI rather than bolting AI onto the old one Are hands-on with prospecting tooling and willing to build workflows yourself rather than specifying them for someone else Can teach the unglamorous fundamentals with energy, and can model them on a live call Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and enjoy building from 0 to 1 Care about the person as much as the number, and can hold both Are technically curious about AI and credible talking about our products with a technical audience Preferred qualifications Have 8+ years of experience in Enablement, including time as a high-performing BDR or BDR manager Hand-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and other Claude surfaces Experience collaborating across global and cross-functional teams Experience building 0-1 onboarding programs and discovery frameworks Experience designing or operating a BDR-to-AE promotion path Hands-on experience building prospecting automations, agents, or internal tooling Experience enabling BDRs across multiple segments or regions A track record connecting BDR enablement to measurable pipeline outcomes The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $270,000 — $310,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 2fc3b73548af038c5959.description: IT Graduate Development Programme 2027 - Cyber Security At ESB, technology plays a leading role in enabling and realising our purpose to deliver a brighter future for the customers and communities we serve. Today that means we are driven to make a difference – net zero by 2040 – and it’s our people who ensure we succeed. With almost 500 people working across our IT Delivery and CIO functions, together we design, build and support a broad range of technologies and services to deliver on our strategic objectives – decarbonised electricity, resilient infrastructure and empowered customers. To further enhance our capabilities and to transform ESB to a data driven and digital utility, we are looking for Graduates to join our highly motivated and skilled team of IT professionals where you will have the opportunity to deliver results in a fast-paced, innovative team environment. Our IT Graduate Development Programme is structured into six distinct career paths where you will be able to grow your experience, as well as develop the necessary skills to help you on your way to career success. At ESB, we operate one of the most advanced and critical technology landscapes in Ireland. We manage a vast array of Enterprise IT and Operational Technologies (OT) which reside in our state-of-the art data centres, power generation plants, and critical operations centres – all requiring the most advanced levels of cybersecurity to protect our businesses from cyber vulnerabilities. Together, these technologies support our critical national infrastructure, and ESB’s Cybersecurity teams are responsible for assuring the confidentiality, integrity and availability of ESB’s IT and Digital systems and data. As part of the Cyber team, you will help provide appropriate protection, response and risk mitigation for ESB. What to expect Our bespoke IT Graduate Development Programme includes: Structured Rotations: – Our graduate programme is typically structured into targetted rotations aligned with career paths and capability development where you will build your IT and business knowledge through challenging assignments, a diverse range of business activities, and the potential to work on projects. 303d4e8fb110d077f44c.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're hiring our first dedicated international tax professional in Asia-Pacific, based in Singapore. You'll be a key member of Anthropic's tax team, reporting to our Head of International Tax Operations / Business Advisory and working closely with tax colleagues in Dublin and our San Francisco headquarters.

As APAC Tax Lead, you'll own direct tax compliance and advisory across our Asia-Pacific entities and operations (Japan, Korea, India, Singapore, Australia, Taiwan) and help build tax infrastructure to support Anthropic's rapid international expansion.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead APAC direct tax compliance, working with external advisors (KPMG, PwC, Deloitte) to ensure timely and accurate filings across all jurisdictions
  • Support transfer pricing documentation and intercompany transactions for APAC entities, including cost-plus arrangements and intercompany service agreements
  • Manage withholding tax positions and treaty relief on cross-border flows, including customer receipts and vendor payments
  • Advise on permanent establishment risks, entity structuring, and operational tax considerations as Anthropic expands APAC commercial and infrastructure activities
  • Support the tax side of regional infrastructure expansion, including data center, colocation, and subsea cable arrangements and new entity formations
  • Partner with indirect tax personnel on VAT/GST and consumption tax matters to align on tax strategy and overall compliance requirements
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, and People teams on payroll taxes, equity compensation, and employee mobility matters
  • Build relationships with local tax authorities and manage any inquiries or audits
  • Contribute to global tax projects including public company readiness, SOX compliance, and tax technology implementations
  • Working with indirect tax team on advisory and compliance and audit assistance

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong technical knowledge of corporate tax in one or more major APAC jurisdictions and cross-border tax issues across the region
  • Deep experience with transfer pricing documentation, intercompany agreements, and withholding tax and treaty analysis
  • CPA, CA, CTA, or equivalent professional qualification
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work across time zones with US and European colleagues
  • Self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and can build processes from the ground up

Preferred qualifications

  • 12+ years of international tax experience, ideally with a mix of Big 4/advisory and in-house roles
  • Exposure to technology or high-growth company tax matters
  • Experience with the tax aspects of data center or infrastructure buildouts
  • Knowledge of Pillar Two/global minimum tax rules and digital services taxes
  • Experience with Indian direct tax matters, including permanent establishment and withholding tax issues
  • Experience supporting IPO readiness or public company tax compliance
  • Regional language skills
  • Experience with systems buildout or automation

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. Kubernetes Platform Engineer (Controllers) Sony Interactive Entertainment At PlayStation, we're leading the revolution in cloud gaming as we push the boundaries of what's possible! Would you like to use your skills, time, and passion for meaningful projects that are building the future? We're looking for a Platform Engineer who enjoys building Kubernetes-native systems and automation that operate reliably at global scale. If you're passionate about software engineering, Kubernetes, and solving challenging distributed systems problems, we'd love to hear from you. Come help us deliver a unique gaming experience to millions of players around the world. Responsibilities Design and develop Kubernetes controllers and operators that automate the lifecycle of platform services. Contribute to the development of our global workload placement system, enabling intelligent scheduling across Kubernetes clusters running in both public cloud and on-premises data centers. Develop Kubernetes APIs and Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) that provide clean, maintainable interfaces for platform capabilities. Build and maintain reconciliation logic that safely manages distributed system state. Develop controllers and operators that automate provisioning, configuration, upgrades, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes-based platform components deployed across hybrid cloud environments. Work closely with platform and service teams to build automation that simplifies operating large-scale distributed systems. Improve the reliability, scalability, observability, and maintainability of the platform through thoughtful engineering and continuous improvement. Investigate production issues and participate in root cause analysis to improve platform reliability. Requirements Solid understanding of Kubernetes architecture, lifecycle and core concepts, including workloads running across cloud and on-premises environments. Experience developing software in Go or another modern programming language, with an interest in Go development. Experience building software for Linux-based environments. Experience with Kubernetes development, including controllers, operators, or Kubernetes APIs. 3+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong problem-solving skills and a desire to learn new technologies. Skills & Knowledge Understanding of Kubernetes reconciliation patterns and declarative system design; especially understanding the principals of Communicating Sequential Processes (CSP). Experience using Kubernetes in production environments. Familiarity with controller-runtime, Kubebuilder, Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), Common Expression Language (CEL) rules, or Kubernetes API extension mechanisms. Experience building or operating distributed systems spanning public cloud and on-premises infrastructure. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps workflows. Experience working with bare metal infrastructure, hybrid cloud environments, or multi-cluster Kubernetes deployments is highly desirable. Experience with Cluster API (CAPI), SIG Multicluster, Karmada, or other Kubernetes ecosystem projects is a plus. Additional Attributes Strong communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable working as part of a distributed engineering team across multiple time zones. Takes ownership of assigned work and follows through to completion. Curious, pragmatic, and eager to learn from teammates while sharing knowledge with others. Enjoys solving the unique engineering challenges of operating software across globally distributed cloud and on-premises infrastructure. Passionate about building reliable systems and improving the user experience. Contributions to open source projects, particularly within the Kubernetes or CNCF ecosystem, are a plus. Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC - (EMEA Only)

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a Privacy Counsel to join our Legal team. You'll counsel on complex privacy issues and build the processes and programs that address privacy and data protection in a global context. This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team, where you will have the chance to shape the company's privacy and data protection strategy and compliance program.

You will work at the intersection of novel legal questions, fast-moving product development, and a high-profile regulatory environment, partnering cross-functionally with Legal, Integrity & Compliance, Safeguards, Security, Policy, Research and Product.

Key responsibilities

  • Counsel product, research and engineering teams across the model and product lifecycles, applying laws written before frontier AI with clarity and fresh thinking
  • Translate complex technical architecture into clear, actionable risk advice
  • Deliver integrated guidance on safety, security and data protection
  • Lead privacy on Anthropic's most strategic deals and partnerships, opening creative paths for novel technologies
  • Negotiate privacy and data protection terms in enterprise, platform and partnership commercial agreements, including DPAs, BAAs, data sharing agreements and cross-border transfer terms
  • Lead privacy diligence on mergers and acquisitions, and support corporate governance
  • Collaborate closely with counsel and privacy colleagues on joint analysis, bringing competing views together into a single, well-reasoned position

Minimum qualifications

  • Hold a law degree (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and meet the local licensing requirements to work as in-house counsel where you'll be based
  • Hands-on experience advising a technology business (in-house or at a leading law firm) on privacy and data protection
  • Experience drafting and negotiating data protection agreements, such as DPAs, BAAs and data sharing agreements
  • Working knowledge of key global privacy laws, including those of the Americas, EEA and APAC
  • Ability to read and engage with technical documentation, such as system designs and architecture diagrams
  • Excellent legal writing, including clear, concise advice

Preferred qualifications

  • At least 8 years of privacy and data protection legal experience
  • Deep familiarity with software and model development and architecture
  • Proven ability to build privacy processes, playbooks and templates that scale with a fast-growing business
  • Direct engagement with privacy regulators, including providing briefings and responding to inquiries
  • Privacy and data protection work on mergers, acquisitions, and similar transactions
  • Background advising safety, security or trust and safety teams, including on privacy incidents and notification decisions

Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 3 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$265,000—$335,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Back to jobs Data Operations Manager, Human Data San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role As Data Operations Manager, you'll build and scale data operations across research teams working on frontier AI capabilities. You'll partner with researchers to design and execute data strategies, manage vendor relationships, and own the entire data pipeline from requirements to production. This role requires operational excellence combined with technical depth to understand what makes high-quality training data, but your focus will be on strategy and execution. About the Impact The data operations you build will directly determine how well our models perform on critical capabilities—tool use accuracy, prompt injection robustness, long-horizon reasoning, and safety alignment. You'll work with world-class researchers advancing the frontier while building the operational infrastructure to scale these efforts. We're looking for someone who gets excited about the challenge of scaling quality across diverse research areas—someone who can understand nuanced technical requirements, build the right partnerships, and execute flawlessly. If you thrive at the intersection of operational excellence and cutting-edge AI research, we'd love to hear from you. Responsibilities: Own and execute data strategy for research teams advancing frontier AI capabilities across RLHF, safety, tool use, and agentic workflows Drive strategic vendor partnerships and build scalable frameworks for technical data collection at scale Design and implement operational systems that translate research requirements into high-quality data pipelines Build evaluation frameworks and quality standards that ensure data meets the bar for training state-of-the-art AI systems Lead cross-functional initiatives to optimize research velocity while maintaining rigorous quality standards Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness across data operations Partner with senior research leaders to align data operations with model development roadmaps and strategic priorities You may be a good fit if you: Have 3+ years in operations, consulting, product management, or program management roles Have exceptional project management skills with ability to handle multiple complex projects simultaneously Have strong communication skills and can engage effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders Are familiar with how LLMs work or have strong interest in understanding AI training methodologies Are highly organized and can navigate ambiguity effectively Have experience with data analysis tools (SQL, Python, Tableau, spreadsheets, or similar) Thrive in fast-paced research environments with shifting priorities Are passionate about AI safety and understand the critical importance of high-quality data Strong candidates may also have: Experience with data collection, labeling, or annotation operations for AI/ML systems Knowledge of RLHF, constitutional AI, or human-in-the-loop workflows Background working with research teams at AI companies or research-oriented organizations Experience managing vendor relationships or external contractors Consulting background with experience translating complex requirements into deliverables Track record of implementing process improvements or quality control systems at scale The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $270,000 - $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 31483150309277342ec3.description: Our client is a leading international organisation focused on digital transformation, customer experience and data-driven decision-making. We are seeking a Marketing Data & Insights Analyst with strong Adobe Analytics experience to support marketing measurement, reporting and channel intelligence. You will work across email, webinars, digital campaigns and lead-generation programmes, partnering with marketing, data and technology teams to turn data into actionable insight. Key Responsibilities Manage lead management, campaign reporting and marketing performance processes, ensuring accurate and timely delivery. Partner with Marketing, Salesforce and Enterprise Data teams to support reliable Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL) data flows. Analyse campaign and channel performance to identify trends, opportunities and optimisation areas. Develop and maintain reporting processes, documentation and business rules to ensure consistency and data quality. Support dashboards, benchmark reporting and ad hoc analysis across marketing activity. Translate stakeholder requirements into practical analytical and reporting solutions. Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve analytical efficiency. Future Development The role offers opportunities to contribute to strategic initiatives, including: Developing leading-indicator and performance frameworks. Analysing digital engagement to support personalisation and channel optimisation. Supporting AI-enabled measurement, reporting and insights . Helping shape the future direction of marketing analytics and channel intelligence. About You 3+ years' experience in marketing analytics, campaign reporting, marketing operations, BI or a related analytical discipline. Experience with marketing performance, CRM, lead management or campaign analytics. Strong analytical skills and experience working with complex datasets. Ability to manage recurring reporting processes independently and deliver accurate results to deadlines. Strong stakeholder management skills across marketing, data and technology teams. Technical Skills Essential: Hands-on Adobe Analytics experience and familiarity with the wider Adobe ecosystem. Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) experience is highly desirable. Strong SQL skills. Experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar BI tools . Salesforce, Marketo or other CRM/marketing technology experience is advantageous. Professional Skills Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills. Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. Excellent communication and documentation skills. Proactive, commercially aware and focused on continuous improvement, automation and efficiency. Why Consider This Opportunity? Join a high-profile organisation where marketing data, digital analytics and AI are increasingly central to decision-making. You will gain the opportunity to work across Adobe Analytics, marketing data, digital engagement and emerging AI-enabled analytics , while helping shape modern marketing measurement and reporting. Salary dependent on candidate experience. Benefits: Annual Bonus Scheme. Contributory Pension. Private Medical Insurance. Life Assurance & Long-Term Disability. Employee Assistance Programme. 22 days annual leave + 10 public holidays. Relocation package. Continuous Learning & Development. Access to extensive training & certification resources. Lunch & Learn sessions. Additional perks including company discounts, on-site parking, and bike-to-work scheme Permanent, full time role. 3 days a week on site in Letterkenny, Co. Donegal . You can work remotely the rest of the month, but within the island of Ireland. Candidates must be eligible to work in Ireland/EU. For more information, please contact David Coyle at 01 635 1748 or email david@methodius.com

31719a9549c066afce28.description: Description Developers all over the world rely on AWS Load Balancing services to ensure their applications and services are highly available. The success of AWS depends on our world-class network and server infrastructure; we’re handling massive scale and rapid integration of emerging technologies. We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join the Internal DNS team in support the onboarding of customer to AWS Load Balancing. The AWS Load Balancing team is looking for software engineers to join the Internal DNS team. This team builds services to allow safe DNS creation and management through our software load balancing solution. As a Software Engineer, you will play an integral role in building, maintaining and monitoring tools and services created to support our customers to manage effectively their network capabilities and ensure availability of their services by following the best practices. You’ll have a unique opportunity to build software that accelerates on-boarding of customers to AWS services, you’ll drive a step-change in Amazon’s ability to simplify our customer’s journey to AWS and build their confidence by creating Analytics to expose migration health insights. You’ll work on Amazon’s hardest problems, building high quality, architecturally sound systems that are aligned with our business needs. You’ll strive for simplicity, demonstrate significant creativity and high judgment, and contribute towards intellectual property through patents. AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. Key job responsibilities Solving problems at scale excites you. You don’t implement specs from analysts and architects – you talk to your customers and design solutions to their problems. You automate and innovate. You believe that the craft of software engineering is about writing code right the first time. For you, code reviews and automated testing are not chores – they’re a core part of writing great software. You like to deliver fast iterative solutions focused on deliver real customer value early. You don’t throw your code over the wall. You launch it, own it, support it and make it incrementally better for the benefit of your customers. You have high judgment and creativity; ability to decompose complex problems into simple solutions. You enjoy developing others, actively mentoring individuals and helping us develop as a team. You enjoy working in a flexible, fast-paced, collaborative team environment. About The Team About AWS Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer.
