31be15491b1591cde42e.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a world-class research group focused on making fundamental biological discoveries. The team combines cutting-edge AI with hands-on biological research, positioning Anthropic at the forefront of demonstrating how AI tools can accelerate scientific workflows and enable discovery.

About the role

We are hiring Research Associates: early-career bench scientists who will join a small team to help establish our biology research program. This is an entry-level role, great for individuals who have done some research during an undergrad or masters program and may be considering pursuing a PhD in Life Sciences in the future.

You'll work directly alongside senior scientists, executing and troubleshooting experiments at the bench while learning advanced techniques in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment. We value curiosity, careful hands, and the willingness to take ownership of a result. Our scientists are eager to teach; we're hiring for motivation and trajectory as much as for existing skill.

This is a fully hands-on bench role — while familiarity with computational biology and bioinformatics is welcome, the role does not involve AI/ML model development.

Key responsibilities

  • Execute molecular biology and biochemistry experiments at the bench under the direction of senior scientists
  • Maintain meticulous, reproducible records and contribute to shared protocols
  • Troubleshoot experiments, propose adjustments, and present results clearly in group meetings
  • Maintain mammalian and bacterial cell lines, materials stocks, and reagent inventories
  • Learn and adopt new techniques rapidly as projects evolve, with training provided

Minimum qualifications

  • Have hands-on research experience in molecular biology, biochemistry, or a closely related field
  • Are proficient with foundational molecular biology techniques: PCR, gel electrophoresis, molecular cloning, and plasmid preparation
  • Have experience with aseptic technique and bacterial or mammalian cell culture, and with nucleic acid extraction, purification, and quantification
  • Follow, document, and adapt experimental protocols with care and precision
  • Are highly motivated, eager to learn, and energized by hands-on bench work
  • Are practical and resourceful — you'd rather find a way through than a reason it can't be done
  • Listen carefully, take feedback well, ask good questions, and are comfortable when priorities shift quickly
  • Are excited to use AI models as a tool at the bench to plan experiments, interpret data, and decide what to try next

Preferred qualifications

  • A BS or MS in molecular biology, biochemistry, chemical biology, microbiology, bioengineering, or a related discipline
  • Protein expression and purification experience (e.g., affinity, SEC, IEX)
  • Mammalian cell culture experience, including transfection and stable line maintenance
  • Enzyme kinetics or quantitative biochemical assay development (fluorescence, absorbance, FRET)
  • Next-generation sequencing library preparation experience
  • Familiarity with common bioinformatics workflows and molecular biology software (e.g., sequence analysis, alignment, primer and construct design)
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude in a research setting — for literature review, protocol drafting, data interpretation, or experimental troubleshooting

This is a rare opportunity to help define how a frontier AI company does biology. You'll learn quickly, work closely with people who want to teach, and see your results feed directly into how the most capable AI models are evaluated and improved.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$95,000—$120,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. As a Data Scientist, you'll turn complex business challenges into scalable statistical and machine learning solutions that help us make smarter decisions across pricing, operations, product, and beyond. Working closely with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and other stakeholders, you'll combine advanced statistical thinking with commercial acumen to create measurable business impact while continuously raising the bar for data-driven decision-making. How you’ll be hosting with heart: Design, develop, and continuously improve our core pricing algorithms—our highest-impact analytical products—to maximize revenue, occupancy, and long-term profitability. Design, develop, and evaluate advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve complex business challenges and enable smarter decision-making. Apply rigorous statistical methodologies to quantify uncertainty, estimate business impact, and generate reliable recommendations for decision-making. Design experiments and define evaluation frameworks to measure the effectiveness of new products, pricing strategies, and business initiatives. Analyze large and complex datasets to uncover opportunities for growth, operational improvements, and enhanced customer experience. Partner with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, and BI to translate business questions into scalable analytical solutions and collaborate with Data Engineering to productionize, deploy, and monitor machine learning models. Stay at the forefront of AI, ML, and decision science to elevate our analytical capabilities, while clearly communicating complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. What you need to shoot for the stars: Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field combined with 3+ years of hands-on experience applying machine learning/statistics to real-world business problems. Strong foundation in probability theory, statistical inference, regression analysis, Bayesian statistics, experimentation, causal inference, and predictive modelling. Proven experience developing, validating, and improving machine learning models in business environments. Strong programming and modelling skills in Python and experience with modern data science libraries. Excellent SQL skills and experience working with large analytical datasets. Experience designing experiments and evaluating business initiatives, balancing statistical rigor with pragmatic decision-making to deliver simple, high-value solutions over unnecessary complexity. Strong commercial mindset with a passion for exploring new analytical methods/AI tech and translating complex findings into measurable business recommendations. Fluency in English with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills alongside the ability to explain complex concepts to audiences with varying technical backgrounds. We're designed to stay because: Hybrid Office Model: We offer a flexible and empowering work environment - you can choose to work 100% from our office or partially from home and the office. Visa & Language Support: We’ll support you during your visa process and with learning German on every language level after passing your probation period. Relocation Support : We'll financially support your move to Munich if you live further away than 300km from our office. Oneteam: We are #oneteam with a transparent company culture by staying up to date with each other through team stand-ups, regular All-Hands and suite events (Summer, Wiesn, Christmas). Growth and Development: We make sure that you keep growing - through constant feedback, peer reviews and exchanges with focus on your development. Limitless learning : We offer you the possibility to choose an external development format that will help you in reaching your full potential without any limits in budget. Workation: You have the chance to work twice per year for a duration of up to 4 weeks from a different country in the European Union. Our Limehomies love traveling so we want to give them the chance to work from inspiring new locations regularly. Sabbatical: After your 1.5 years with Limehome we offer the possibility for a 3-month sabbatical. You can use it for whatever you want: may it be traveling, spending time with your besties or volunteering. Everything for our Limehomies : We focus on your physical wellbeing (Urban Sports Club), to your mental wellbeing (Nilo.health), or even staycations in one of our beautiful Limehomes, and many more suite benefits. Join us and find out! 😉 Who we are: Limehome is a leading tech-enabled operator in the hospitality industry offering functional, design accommodations across Europe. Using proprietary technology, Limehome delivers comfortable and convenient stays with a seamless digital guest experience for business and leisure travellers. Our vision is to be the first choice in travel for everyone, everywhere. By now, our portfolio consists of more than 10,000 apartments and hotel rooms under contract across 150 cities in 13 European countries.

32a2b27ac88da8c8980c.description: Powering the world’s payments ecosystem ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. As a Associate Platform Engineer in Limerick, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem! This purpose of this Associate Platform Engineer is: ACI's Internal Developer Platform is the foundation every product and delivery team builds on — cloud-native infrastructure spanning Kubernetes/OpenShift and multiple cloud providers, CI/CD, observability, and the golden paths that let engineers ship payment software quickly and safely. As Associate Platform Engineer, you'll build and support well-scoped pieces of this platform under the guidance of senior engineers, learning the infrastructure-as-code, container orchestration, and observability practices that make it work — with AI-assisted tooling built into how you learn and work from day one. A typical day at ACI for a Associate Platform Engineer is: - Build and maintain well-defined pieces of the platform (CI/CD pipeline components, Kubernetes manifests, IaC modules) under the guidance of senior platform engineers - Learn and apply the platform's golden-path tooling and standards, and start noticing where the “right way” could be made easier for other engineers - Support observability and monitoring for the services you help build — instrumenting logs and metrics, and learning what “healthy” looks like for platform infrastructure - Participate in the platform's on-call rotation as a learning experience, shadowing senior engineers on incidents before taking on independent ownership - Use AI-assisted engineering tools daily to accelerate your own learning, and start noticing where AI-assisted tooling could help the platform's users, not just you - Write infrastructure-as-code for well-scoped components, learning Terraform/Kubernetes patterns from code review feedback - Participate in incident postmortems and learn the platform's reliability practices firsthand - Ask questions early and often about how pieces of the platform fit together — building foundational systems thinking about infrastructure at scale - Build working relationships with the engineering teams who depend on the platform, and start understanding their needs firsthand - Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics. Our Tech Stack that you will work with: - Gen AI infrastructure — curiosity about model-serving and vector database concepts; hands-on use of AI coding assistants - Container orchestration — foundational knowledge of Kubernetes/OpenShift concepts (pods, deployments, services) - Infrastructure as code — growing familiarity with Terraform (or equivalent), able to make small, guided changes to existing modules - Cloud platforms — foundational hands-on experience with Azure, Openshift or AWS - CI/CD & delivery — comfortable using existing pipelines (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent) - Observability — basic familiarity with instrumentation and dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent) - The Incident and Escalation Management team (IEM) is part of Datadog's Global Support Engineering (GSE) organization. The purpose of IEM is to continuously improve Datadog's overall customer experience during incidents and critical moments. Datadog Global Support Engineering (GSE) is looking for experts with a background in Incident Management and Escalations handling to join our team to provide fast incident response and stakeholder ownership. In this position, you will play a role in providing communication, technical engagement and incident management for our global customers. You will also implement processes based on the lessons learned from each incident to limit further occurrence.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Drive the resolution of incidents and escalations while providing response and/or management to customers
  • Design and implement real-time and proactive monitoring of customer's infrastructures
  • Prioritize, manage, and own customer issues from start to finish
  • Monitor and manage communications (sometimes public, sensitive and large scale) during incidents
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Datadog and its partners worldwide to enhance customer experience 
  • Lead projects to deliver operational improvements as Datadog evolves
  • Create and review documentation as well as incident and escalation training
  • Identify and troubleshoot recurring cloud infrastructure issues
  • Hire and mentor stakeholders and peers in incident and escalation management 

Who You Are:

  • 3+ years demonstrable Incident Manager experience (escalations is a plus)
  • 1+ year of experience in Support, Network, Solutions Architecture, or similar IT role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science/Technology, Engineering or equivalent experience
  • Familiarity with Cloud computing, experience with Python, JavaScript or shell scripting
  • Ability to correlate behaviors based on known interdependencies 
  • Experience driving projects from conception to delivery, demonstrated problem-solving experience, and ability to work in challenging fast-paced environments

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth:

  • New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing 
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking 
  • An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds
  • Generous global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Equity: stock options with meaningful upside as Humanoid scales.    30+ paid days off: 23 days annual leave, all UK bank holidays and a company shutdown between Christmas and New Year.    Private healthcare: fully funded, including virtual and in-person care.    Pension: 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings.    Daily food: free breakfast, catered lunch and snacks in the office.    Real ownership: direct access to founding leadership, real input on product direction and room to drive key initiatives from day one.    Visa sponsorship and relocation to London. To support our growth, we are looking for a  CAD & PLM Administration Intern  to join our team in Munich. In this hands-on role, you will help establish and maintain our CAD standard part library, provide first-level support to engineering users, and contribute to the documentation of CAD and PLM processes.    Role overview  As a CAD & PLM Administration Intern, you will work closely with our engineering, CAD, PLM, and IT teams to help keep our design data and product lifecycle processes organised, accessible, and efficient.  Your primary focus will be supporting the creation and continuous improvement of a standard part library for CAD users. You will also act as a first point of contact for basic user requests and help create clear, practical documentation that enables our engineering teams to work effectively in a fast-paced aerospace environment.  This is an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in CAD data management, PLM administration, engineering processes, and technical support while contributing to the development of a real space vehicle.    Key responsibilities    CAD and PLM administration    Support the creation, organisation, and maintenance of structured CAD and PLM data.    Support the setup and maintenance of CAD templates, standard part libraries, drafting standards, preferences, and other engineering environment settings.    Work with engineers and designers to identify opportunities to improve CAD workflows, data quality, reuse, and user experience.    Assist with testing and documenting changes to CAD and PLM processes, configurations, and system settings.    Gain hands-on experience with Siemens NX administration, including configuration concepts, customer defaults, role-based settings, templates, and environment configuration.    Learn about Siemens NX customization and automation possibilities under the guidance of experienced team members, for example through journals, reusable tools, interface settings, or workflow improvements.    Contribute to guidelines and best practices for CAD and PLM usage, including the appropriate use of standard parts and reusable engineering content.    Documentation and process support    Create and maintain user guides, how-to instructions, process descriptions, and FAQs.    Document CAD and PLM procedures in a clear and accessible way.    Support the preparation of training material for new and existing users.    General CAD and PLM administration and support    Assist with routine administration and monitoring tasks in the CAD and PLM environment under supervision.    Support users and create documentation based on frequent support requests    Work with engineering, PLM, CAD, and IT colleagues to improve data quality and user experience.      What we're looking for    Required    Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.    Good communication skills in English.    Basic experience with Siemens NX and strong interest in CAD, engineering data management, PLM, or technical systems administration.    Organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with structured data and technical information.    A proactive, hands-on attitude and willingness to learn.    Comfortable working collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.    Nice to have    Basic familiarity with PLM concepts or systems such as Siemens Teamcenter.    Experience with C# and .Net, Powershell    Basic understanding of engineering drawing standards, part numbering, metadata, or configuration management.    Some exposure to Linux, IT infrastructure, databases, or technical support processes.    Interest in aerospace, spacecraft, or other complex technical environments.       Why you should join us!   What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:      We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind     We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them      We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. Back to jobs Partnership Manager, AI for Science San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Beneficial Deployments Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences. We prioritize opportunities to make AI more accessible and raise the floor of what is possible in a given domain while also partnering with leaders to help expand the use of AI to new tasks that raise the ceiling of what is possible. About the role We're looking for a Partnership Manager to grow our AI for Science Program . You'll build and manage partnerships with individual labs from around the world. This program is the primary way that Anthropic’s life sciences efforts work with individual labs that have new and innovative ideas for how Claude can contribute to a growing set of scientific domains. In this role, you'll help build our approach to deploying Claude for Life Sciences across domains of research including the biomedical sciences, chemistry, and materials science. You'll work with incredibly interdisciplinary partners from academia as well as early stage companies. Your goal will be to develop relationships and goal directed partnerships that demonstrate or expand the capabilities of Claude in the sciences. You will focus both on individual projects but also building communities of practice that bring together scientists with similar interests or objectives. The right person will combine genuine curiosity and grounding in the sciences with an entrepreneurial and experimental drive to build something new at the frontier of AI. Responsibilities: Execute Anthropic's AI for Science API credit program, managing day-to-day partnerships with academic labs, small start-ups, and potentially foundations Identify, evaluate, and onboard new partners via our API credit application calls as well as targeted relationship building Serve as the primary relationship owner for AI for Science, coordinating with Anthropic’s Applied We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. 342e68fb7765f8ab0e93.description: About the role About the Role – Placements The Online Graduate Programme includes two placements: Stretch Placement: A role outside your academic discipline that enables you to build new skills and broaden your understanding of the wider business Core Placement: A role aligned to your interests within the Online function, allowing you to develop specialist knowledge and expertise Each placement is structured around clear objectives and measurable outcomes, giving you the opportunity to make a tangible impact while accelerating your development. Throughout the programme, you'll gain exposure to a variety of online and digital disciplines, including: E-commerce and Online Trading Digital Customer Experience Online Operations and Fulfilment Website and App Performance Customer Journey Optimisation Digital Marketing and Customer Engagement Data Analytics and Reporting Online Innovation and Future Retail Technology You’ll work with cross-functional teams to analyse customer behaviour, identify opportunities for improvement, support digital initiatives, and help deliver a best-in-class online shopping experience. By the end of the programme, you'll have developed a strong understanding of how online retail operates, how digital experiences influence customer loyalty, and how data-driven decisions help drive growth within Tesco’s online business. Salary: €35,000 Programme start date: 6 September 2027 You will be responsible for Alongside your day-to-day responsibilities, you’ll take part in a structured 18-month development programme that includes: Upskilling workshops focused on digital retail, e-commerce, data analytics, and customer experience Personal development sessions to build your confidence, communication, and leadership skills Store and fulfilment centre visits to understand how online orders are delivered from click to doorstep Networking opportunities with graduates and leaders across the business Mentoring and coaching from experienced colleagues who will support your career development At Tesco, graduates are given meaningful responsibility from the start, supported by a strong network of colleagues who are invested in helping you succeed. You will need A genuine curiosity and desire to learn, develop and grow both personally and professionally. An interest in e-commerce, digital innovation and understanding customer behaviour. A positive and adaptable mindset, with the ability to embrace change and approach challenges as opportunities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to share ideas and ask questions. A collaborative approach and a willingness to work effectively as part of a team. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in using data to support decision-making. Enthusiasm, initiative and a proactive attitude towards learning and continuous improvement. A strong team spirit, supporting colleagues and contributing to a positive working environment. Whats in it for you? Our Online Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who are passionate about digital innovation, e-commerce, and creating seamless online experiences for customers. If you're excited by technology, customer behaviour, and the ever-evolving world of online retail, this programme will give you the opportunity to develop your skills in one of the fastest-growing areas of Tesco Ireland. From day one, you'll be part of a dynamic team that helps deliver Tesco’s online shopping experience, ensuring our customers can shop wherever and whenever they choose. You’ll work on real projects that support the growth of our online business, from improving digital journeys and customer experience to driving online sales and operational efficiency. Annual Leave: Starting at 23 days per annum About Us Our core purpose, "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day" means we always keep customers at the heart of what we do, while also reflecting our responsibilities to the communities we serve and to society more broadly. At Tesco, inclusion means that Everyone’s Welcome. Everyone is treated fairly and with respect; by valuing individuality and uniqueness we create a sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion have always been at the heart of Tesco. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. Across the Tesco group we are building an inclusive workplace, a place to actively celebrate the cultures, personalities and preferences of our colleagues – who in turn help to build the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. Our office is based in Dun Laoghaire, Co. Dublin and Tesco has embraced hybrid working. We have open plan offices and informal breakout spaces so teams can collaborate together. We’ve a subsidised colleague restaurant for all breakfast, lunch and snack requirements. At the weekly “Team 5” update you'll get to hear about exciting events happening across our stores and any important business updates. We have stunning views of Dublin Bay from our office and are ideally located next to public transport options and lots of handy amenities in the local area.

34610fec954228df7927.description: Bij adesso geloven we dat AI pas echt impact maakt wanneer technologie, business en mensen samenkomen . Daarom zoeken we een AI Consultant die organisaties helpt om de mogelijkheden van AI te vertalen naar concrete businesswaarde. Als AI Consultant werk je samen met klanten aan uiteenlopende AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt bij het ontdekken en concretiseren van kansen, ontwikkelt use cases en roadmaps en begeleidt klanten bij het realiseren en adopteren van AI-oplossingen. Daarbij beweeg je tussen business en IT en weet je complexe technologie begrijpelijk en praktisch te maken. Je wordt onderdeel van onze internationale AI Task Force binnen adesso: een netwerk van consultants, experts en innovators dat kennis deelt, proposities ontwikkelt en samenwerkt aan internationale AI-initiatieven. Ook in Nederland bouwen we onze AI-praktijk verder uit. Je krijgt volop ruimte om daarin mee te denken, nieuwe ideeën aan te dragen, kennis te delen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen als AI Consultant. Wat ga je doen? Als AI Consultant help je klanten om AI op een praktische en waardevolle manier toe te passen. Afhankelijk van het vraagstuk werk je aan strategie en advies, maar ook aan het concretiseren en realiseren van oplossingen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Adviseren van klanten over AI en Generative AI Identificeren en uitwerken van kansrijke AI-use cases Meewerken aan AI-strategieën, roadmaps en business cases Vertalen van businessvraagstukken naar concrete AI-oplossingen Begeleiden van klanten van idee en discovery tot implementatie en adoptie Faciliteren van workshops, discovery-sessies en klantgesprekken Geven van presentaties en demo’s die AI begrijpelijk en tastbaar maken Werken met technologieën zoals Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate en Azure AI Services Meedenken over onderwerpen zoals AI Agents, governance en Responsible AI Samenwerken met technische specialisten, architecten en andere consultants Ondersteunen bij presales en klantvoorstellen Signaleren van nieuwe kansen en use cases bij klanten Delen van kennis en bijdragen aan de AI-community binnen adesso Samenwerken met onze internationale AI Task Force aan kennis, proposities en innovatieve toepassingen Wie ben jij? Je bent een consultant die enthousiast wordt van AI, innovatie en klantcontact . Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologie, maar kijkt verder dan de technologie alleen. Je wilt begrijpen wat een organisatie nodig heeft en hoe AI daar daadwerkelijk waarde kan toevoegen. Je kunt goed schakelen tussen business en IT, stelt de juiste vragen en vindt het leuk om samen met klanten nieuwe oplossingen te ontdekken en vorm te geven Daarnaast heb je: Enkele jaren relevante ervaring als consultant, business consultant, technology consultant of in een vergelijkbare klantgerichte rol Ervaring of aantoonbare affiniteit met AI, Generative AI, automation of digitale transformatie Het vermogen om klantvraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete use cases en oplossingen Sterke communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en klantcontact Een proactieve, nieuwsgierige en ondernemende houding Het vermogen om complexe technologie begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen Affiniteit met het Microsoft-ecosysteem Kennis van één of meerdere van onderstaande technologieën is mooi meegenomen: Microsoft Copilot en Copilot Studio Power Platform Power Automate Azure AI Services Generative AI en AI Agents Low-code- en automationoplossingen Pré: Ervaring met AI-strategieën, roadmaps of use-caseontwikkeling Ervaring met AI governance of Responsible AI Ervaring met presales Ervaring met het geven of faciliteren van workshops Wat bieden wij? Bij adesso krijg je de kans om aan uitdagende AI-vraagstukken te werken én mee te groeien met onze AI-praktijk. Je krijgt: Een veelzijdige consultancyrol op het snijvlak van business en AI De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan onze groeiende AI-praktijk in Nederland Samenwerking met de internationale adesso AI Task Force Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ideeën Afwisselende AI-projecten bij verschillende klanten en sectoren De mogelijkheid om zowel aan strategie en advies als aan concrete AI-oplossingen te werken Een sterk Microsoft-ecosysteem en toegang tot technische expertise Ruimte om je eigen AI-expertise verder te ontwikkelen Opleidingen, certificeringen en kennissessies Hybride werken en veel vrijheid in de invulling van je rol Een enthousiast team waarin samenwerken, kennis delen en innovatie centraal staan Je hoeft dus niet dé AI-expert te zijn die alles al heeft gezien. We zoeken vooral een sterke consultant die AI begrijpt, klanten weet mee te nemen en samen met ons verder wil groeien in dit vakgebied.

Back to jobs Lead, Data Center Security Delivery (Construction to Operations) Remote-Friendly (Travel Required) | San Francisco, CA Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is building data center campuses at a pace where several are under construction at once, each moving through design, construction, commissioning, and turnover to an operating partner. Security scope on those projects (the physical protections, the systems that enforce them, and the operational readiness of the company that will run the site) has to be delivered as deliberately as the buildings themselves. As Lead for Data Center Security Delivery, you will own security through that entire arc for every campus under construction: from groundbreaking, through construction-phase security, through commissioning and milestone acceptance, to a clean handover into full operation. You are the single point of accountability for "the site's security is actually ready", and you will verify that the operating partner has its people, processes, systems, and contractual security obligations genuinely in place before a site goes live. This is a delivery role, not a watch-the-dashboard role. You'll absorb the day-to-day noise of active construction sites (schedule slips, design changes, vendor coordination, escalations) so the rest of DCSE can stay focused on steady-state operations and systems. And where DCSE's requirements or processes don't survive contact with a real construction schedule, you will have the authority, and the expectation, to rewrite them. Role boundaries. This seat is distinct from DCSE's regional security operations leads and from the team's systems-engineering roles. The operations leads own steady-state regional programs (vendors, guard force, incident response) once a site is running; the systems roles build platforms and tooling. This role owns the delivery arc: every site's security scope from construction start through commissioning, acceptance, and handover, after which accountability transfers to operations. Key responsibilities You will own the security delivery program across every Anthropic campus under construction: concurrently, from groundbreaking to handover. Construction-phase security delivery: temporary site security, contractor vetting and access, protection of installed equipment, and coordination with general contractors and site teams on every active build. Milestone and commissioning acceptance: define and maintain the security acceptance criteria at each construction milestone and commissioning gate; run or attend acceptance events (FAT/SAT, punch lists); issue or withhold the security sign-off. Operator readiness verification: build and run a structured, evidence-based readiness process proving the operating company is genuinely ready before handover: staffing and guard force in place, SOPs adopted, security systems commissioned and monitored, contractual security obligations demonstrably met. Clean handover to operations: own the turnover package (as-builts, test records, credentials, punch-list closure, residual-risk register) and the defined transition from construction-phase to operational security ownership. Requirements and process authority: rewrite DCSE's construction-security requirements, delivery processes, and acceptance frameworks where they fail in the field, and codify what works, so each build is cleaner than the last. Representation and escalation: represent security in design reviews, owner-architect-contractor (OAC) meetings, and change management; coordinate integrators, general contractors, and operator counterparts on security system installation, testing, and commissioning; surface schedule and readiness risks early, with options, to DCSE leadership and cross-functional partners. Minimum qualifications Have personally delivered the physical security scope on new-build data center (or comparable critical-infrastructure) construction projects (design reviews through construction, commissioning, and turnover to operations) and can name the sites and your role on them. Have run milestone- or commissioning-acceptance processes: FAT/SAT, punch lists, turnover documentation, formal sign-off. Have held an operator, landlord, or vendor accountable to contractual security obligations, with evidence rather than assurances. Are comfortable being the person who says "not ready", and can do it in a way that produces a plan rather than a standoff. Can absorb the operational noise of multiple concurrent construction sites and still drive each one toward its handover date. Can author requirements, standards, and process documents that get adopted, and are willing to rewrite your own when they fail in the field. Work through influence with general contractors, integrators, operators, and internal partners; you shape decisions rather than block them. Preferred qualifications CPP (Certified Protection Professional) or PSP (Physical Security Professional) certification, or commissioning credentials. Hyperscaler or major colocation new-build delivery experience. Experience on both sides of an operator/tenant relationship. Construction management or owner's-representative background. Experience in regulated or high-assurance environments. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $290,000 - $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. 349aa19558a693ecd014.description: Arcadis|DPS Group provides full EPCMV (Engineering, Procurement, Construction Management, and Validation) services for its clients. Joining Arcadis|DPS Group as a Graduate Electrical Engineer would suit a motivated, practical, and adaptable individual who has the ambition to gain Chartered Engineer status and wishes to work in a progressive and innovative design consultancy. Working in Electrical and Instrumentation The Arcadis|DPS Group E&I department works as part of a multi-disciplinary practice that handles our client needs in the following areas: architectural, process, HVAC, mechanical, electrical, commissioning, validation, and construction management services. Working under the direct supervision of a Chartered Engineer, the graduate will support the delivery of a range of projects across the industrial and pharmaceutical sectors. The design work will include electrical power, instrumentation, and building services across a range of pharmaceutical and industrial projects. Day to day Working as a Graduate Electrical Engineer your day to day role could involve the activities/projects in the following areas; Design & develop single line, schematic diagrams, and protection schemes for site electrical power distribution equipment and systems. Prepare specifications & scope of work for electrical equipment such as power generators, MCC, transformers, switchgear, instrumentation, data systems, and building services, etc. Creating semi-conductor tool install design packages utilising AutoCad. Maintaining utility services matrix and/or database (MS Excel or MS Access) to ensure all electrical systems remain within capacities. Carry out design calculations for cable-sizing, short circuit calculations, lighting calculations, power balance studying, and arc flash for all electrical systems. Work with the project team to find optimum system sizing, routing, materials, and space management for complex electrical systems. Prepare sketches and perform all necessary field work to assist with creating design packages. Review of electrical layout drawings and MTO. Selection, specification, and design of process instrumentation and safety instrumented systems. Who Are We Looking For Degree Qualified in Electrical Engineering Computer literate including AutoCad proficiency. Team player, adaptable & practical. Excellent interpersonal, organisational, and communication skills. Strong attention to detail. Ability to work well on own initiative Flexibility required in terms of travelling to client facilities in Ireland and abroad. Projects can entail extended periods working on client sites as well as in our design office. Arcadis|DPS Group is a great company to work for and here are only some of the reasons why! Join a Team On joining Arcadis|DPS Group you will be part of a team from your first day, working closely with our existing graduate and senior engineers from your Department, you will start on a journey that will see you contribute to multiple international projects as part of a global team. One DPS Team working together - YouTube Accelerate Your Career Have the opportunity to work in a core design team, working on multiple projects for major clients - plus have an opportunity to spend at least 6 months on client sites - executing projects in real-time, as part of your graduate development. Investment in your continuous professional development is a commitment from Arcadis|DPS Group. You will participate in our structured and accredited graduate development programme, which is delivered in your first two years, where the focus is to equip you with the tools to realise your ambition and make a greater impact in your role. Achieve your Ambitions - YouTube Make a Difference As you will participate in projects for the world's leading Pharma, Biotech, and Advanced Technology companies, you can take pride in the fact that the facilities we create enable our clients to manufacture products that change lives. Reasons to Join DPS (Why Join DPS) - YouTube For further insight from our Graduates check out our YouTube Channel - DPS Group Global - YouTube

3506f19e2a029cc0fdde.description: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. About Futureforce University Recruiting Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. Job Category Sales Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. Fixed-term contract Duration: 12 months Start Date: August 2027 We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path . This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards. Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions. By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career . We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards. Who are we looking for? You are a 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds. You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business You are a creative problem-solver You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning You thrive in a team environment You have excellent interpersonal skills You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment You are fluent in English & another Language What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like? The Program Is Structured As Follows Introduction Month During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will: Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni Rotations During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles . The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path. If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales , you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond. Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments . You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion . Examples of what you can expect during the rotations Sales Graduate Rotation Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view What’s in it for you? A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment Access to our diverse internal employee groups A comprehensive benefits package Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model Map your future for the coming years With the EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path , you can continue to progress: After your Grad Program Rotations you can progress to Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative and then Account Executive, where you will position our solutions to potential customers. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. Posting Statement Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

35222fc60d736c6a5c7c.description: Job Description Why Start Your Career at S&W? Starting your career is about more than just a job. It's about the people you learn from, the relationships you build and the experiences that shape you. Whether that's passing an exam, achieving a personal milestone or celebrating success with your colleagues, you'll be part of a team that's invested in your growth, celebrates your achievements and supports you to be yourself. At S&W, you'll be given meaningful responsibility from the start, alongside the support and guidance needed to help you succeed. You'll learn from experienced colleagues, develop valuable professional skills and build confidence as your career progresses. As a growing accountancy and advisory firms, we offer a balance of opportunity and support. You'll learn from people at every level of the business, gain exposure to a variety of clients, industries and experiences, and develop the skills, knowledge and confidence needed to build a successful career. The Accountancy Team at S&W Our Business Outsourcing Services team helps businesses manage their finances, meet their reporting requirements and improve the effectiveness of their finance functions. Working with clients of different sizes, sectors and stages of growth, you'll gain first-hand experience of how businesses operate while helping them navigate day-to-day challenges and achieve their ambitions. What sets S&W apart is the breadth of experience you'll gain from the start. You'll work closely with a diverse range of businesses, gaining exposure to accounting, technology and advisory projects that go beyond traditional compliance work. This breadth of experience, combined with structured training and support, will help you build a strong foundation for a successful career in accountancy and business advisory. What Will You Be Doing? As part of our Business Outsourcing Services team, you'll work closely with clients and their finance teams, supporting them with everything from statutory accounts and management reporting to VAT, bookkeeping and cloud accounting solutions. By combining technical expertise with practical advice, you'll help businesses operate more effectively and make better-informed decisions. Alongside your work, you'll study towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification, combining professional training with hands-on experience across a diverse range of clients and industries. This blend of technical learning and practical responsibility will help you develop a deep understanding of accounting, finance and business, providing a strong foundation for a successful career in accountancy and advisory services. Your work will include: Working with a diverse range of clients, supporting the delivery of statutory accounts, management accounts, bookkeeping, VAT returns and cloud accounting solutions. Building an understanding of our clients, their businesses and the challenges and opportunities they face. Preparing financial information and contributing to the delivery of high-quality client service. Developing expertise in cloud accounting platforms and digital finance technologies. Supporting clients with accounting queries, providing practical advice and helping to identify effective solutions. Using technology and automation to help clients improve efficiency and enhance their finance processes. Supporting software implementation, system optimisation and finance transformation projects. Managing priorities across a portfolio of clients while developing strong organisational, commercial and relationship-building skills. To Be Successful in This Role You'll be someone who: Is curious, eager to learn and open to new challenges Enjoys working with others and building positive relationships Has a keen eye for detail and enjoys solving problems Is proactive and looks for ways to make a positive contribution Takes ownership of their development and is motivated to achieve their goals You'll also need to: Be committed to working towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification Have some accountancy experience, as part of your education or work experience Have obtained or be predicted a minimum 2:2 degree, in any discipline Minimum 400 Leaving Certificate points (or equivalent) Leaving Certificate O2 or H5 in Maths and English (or equivalent) Your Learning & Development We'll support you throughout your qualification journey with a leading UK training provider, dedicated study time and practical experience that complements your learning. You'll join as part of a cohort and benefit from a strong support network that includes experienced colleagues, a buddy and our Learning & Development team. From your first day, you'll have people around you to guide you, answer questions and help you make the most of every opportunity. As a Colleague at S&W, You'll Have Access to Benefits That Include Fully funded training towards professional qualifications Competitive salary Private medical insurance Life assurance Pension contribution Generous holiday package Option to purchase additional holiday Cycle to work scheme Season ticket loan Eye care support Shared parental leave Our Commitment to Inclusion We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients. At S&W we have a wide range of highly active employee resource groups and we’re delivering multiple diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives across the organisation. It is our commitment to provide a workspace where all colleagues, regardless of identity, background, or circumstance, feel respected as individuals and feel that they can achieve their full potential and work in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment. We are happy to make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate for your needs throughout the application process. Please let your Recruiter know. IMPORTANT NOTES FOR COMPLETING YOUR APPLICATION When you click on the 'I'm interested' button, you'll be taken to your profile page. We're currently updating it, but in the meantime: We can only accept one application to any of our programmes in a recruitment season. If you're unsuccessful, you'll need to wait until the following recruitment season to reapply. Under the Resume (CV) section, uploading a document is mandatory; however, it will not be formally reviewed.

3552e34ec17d782223c8.description: About Northern Trust As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. Role/ Department The Senior Consultant, within Custody Client Services is responsible for supporting the controlled migration of in scope custody and Banking clients to the Northern Trust Irish Branch. The role provides structure, pace and transparency across a complex, cross-functional program while maintaining a strong focus on client outcomes, operational readiness, risk management and regulatory delivery. Working as a highly collaborative individual contributor, the individual will coordinate multiple client migrations, workstreams and stakeholders across Client Services, Relationship Management, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product, Technology and other partner functions. The role ensures that plans, dependencies, decisions and client impacts are actively managed through to implementation and stabilisation. This role is ideal for a project management professional who enjoys bringing structure to complexity, partnering across functions and delivering meaningful change. It offers the opportunity to shape a significant client and operating model transition while strengthening expertise in custody, regulatory change and enterprise delivery. Coordinate and oversee Custody and Banking delivery activities associated with the Irish Branch migration project, ensuring effective alignment and execution in partnership with the Senior Project Manager. Develop and maintain an integrated migration plan covering client, operational, legal, regulatory, technology, data and change activities. Coordinate client-level and operational readiness and ensure migration requirements, decisions, risks and actions are clearly owned and progressed. Protect the client experience by aligning the future service operating model, communications, implementation activity and transition support. Provide clear governance, reporting and escalation to support timely decision-making and accountable delivery. Apply disciplined risk and control management throughout planning, execution, cutover and post-migration stabilisation. Client Migration Ownership and Readiness Support the end-to-end migration of impacted custody and banking clients to the Irish Branch. Maintain a client migration inventory and status view, including scope, complexity, key contacts, milestones, document requirements, dependencies, risks and readiness criteria. Partner with Relationship Managers, Client Service Delivery Managers, Service Managers and other client-facing teams to understand each client’s business, servicing requirements and migration impacts. Coordinate proactive, clear and consistent client communications, ensuring queries, concerns and decisions are addressed or escalated promptly. Support client due diligence, service reviews, implementation discussions and the preparation of relevant management information where required. Ensure the proposed service operating model is understood, documented and aligned across the client and internal delivery teams. Provide enhanced oversight for complex or strategic client migrations and support a seamless transition into the Irish Branch service model. Project Planning and Delivery Management Develop, maintain and control detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, actions, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies. Coordinate migration workstreams ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, sequencing, ownership and expected outcomes. Establish clear delivery standards, readiness criteria and evidence requirements for each migration stage. Monitor progress against agreed plans, identify potential roadblocks and proactively recommend solutions to keep delivery on track. Maintain decision, issue and action logs and ensure overdue or high-impact items are actively escalated. Coordinate implementation, cutover and post-migration support plans, including operational readiness, contingency arrangements and lessons learned. Track key deliverables, client outcomes and benefits realisation measures, reporting variances and recovery actions. Cross-Functional Coordination and Stakeholder Management Partner with business, operations, technology, data, product, legal, compliance, risk, tax and other functional teams to drive execution and alignment. Facilitate working sessions, workstream meetings, planning sessions and issue-resolution forums. Build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Act as a key point of coordination for migration-related questions, connecting the appropriate subject-matter experts and ensuring responses are tracked to closure. Governance, Reporting and Executive Communication Prepare accurate and concise governance materials, status reports, dashboards, executive summaries and decision papers for leadership stakeholders. Provide a clear view of overall program health, client readiness, milestone performance, key decisions, risks, issues, dependencies and required interventions. Ensure governance forums are purposeful, supported by quality materials and followed by timely actions and documented decisions. Use management information and trend analysis to identify emerging concerns, delivery bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Maintain project documentation and critical client information in agreed repositories, with appropriate version control and audit evidence. Risk, Control and Regulatory Delivery Embed a strong risk and control focus across all migration activity, ensuring client, operational, legal, regulatory and conduct risks are identified, assessed, owned and mitigated. Ensure migration activities comply with applicable policies, procedures, governance standards and risk management programs. Coordinate readiness assessments and evidence that required controls, procedures, access, data, documentation and operational arrangements are in place before migration. Escalate material risks, issues, control gaps or client impacts promptly and support the development of practical remediation plans. Change Management, Adoption and Continuous Improvement Support change impact assessments, stakeholder engagement, communications, training and adoption activities to embed new capabilities and processes. Facilitate knowledge transfer and on-the-job support for partners involved in the future-state service model. Identify opportunities to simplify migration activity, improve straight-through processing, reduce manual effort and strengthen the client service offering. Apply analytical thinking and problem-solving to address complex business challenges and support evidence-based decision-making. Capture lessons learned and convert them into repeatable standards, templates, controls and process improvements for subsequent migrations. Skills/Qualifications The successful candidate will benefit from having : Strong project management and/or business analysis capability, with the ability to manage multiple client migrations, workstreams and competing priorities concurrently. Demonstrated ability to coordinate and influence cross-functional teams in a complex and regulated environment. Excellent organisation, planning and attention to detail, combined with a practical focus on execution. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear, concise materials for executive audiences and communicate effectively with clients. Strong analytical, judgement and problem-solving capabilities, with confidence navigating ambiguity and resolving delivery challenges. A collaborative mindset with a strong focus on accountability, client experience, risk management and continuous improvement. Ability to build trusted relationships, challenge constructively and maintain momentum across stakeholders with competing priorities. Working knowledge of custody, asset servicing and the service operating model supporting institutional clients. Strong project management experience, preferably within financial services or another regulated environment. Experience supporting large-scale, cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders across various jurisdictions, clients and workstreams. Demonstrated experience managing project plans, risks, issues, dependencies, governance processes, readiness assessments and executive reporting. Financial services experience is preferred; custody, asset servicing, client onboarding, legal entity migration or regulatory change experience would be advantageous. Relevant project management qualification is desirable. Impacted clients progress through agreed migration milestones with ownership, evidence and governance. Client communications are timely, coordinated and aligned to the migration plan and future service model. Risks, issues and dependencies are identified early, escalated appropriately and resolved with minimal impact to clients or operations. Operational, control and stakeholder readiness criteria are met before implementation and managed closely post-migration. Leadership receives concise, accurate and decision-oriented reporting. Migration lessons are captured and used to improve the delivery approach for subsequent client waves. Work Authorization Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment. Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks. Working with Us As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. Reasonable Accommodation Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

This role combines cybersecurity knowledge, content creation, and employee engagement to drive secure behaviors across the organization.
