Support the design and implementation of cybersecurity awareness programs and campaigns aligned with organizational objectives. Create clear, engaging content that translates cybersecurity concepts for technical and non-technical audiences. Deliver employee training on phishing, social engineering, artificial intelligence, data protection, password security, multifactor authentication, and secure online behavior. Organize awareness events, workshops, lunch-and-learn sessions, roadshows, and Cybersecurity Awareness Month activities. Collaborate with cybersecurity subject matter experts, Communications, Learning & Development, and business stakeholders to develop and publish awareness materials. Experience developing employee communications, presentations, training materials, or awareness content. Strong written, verbal, proofreading, editing, and presentation skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Word and PowerPoint, working to intermediate proficiency in Excel, and experience using Microsoft 365 applications. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing cybersecurity awareness campaigns or security education programs. Experience creating newsletters, presentations, infographics, digital signage, articles, and employee communications. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We’re looking for a Solutions Marketing Manager to bring Claude to market across emerging industries and newer customer segments and personas, where enterprise AI demand is moving fastest. You’ll drive the strategic positioning and go-to-market approach for Claude for organizations ranging from small businesses to ecommerce to retailers, manufacturers, and energy companies, and more. You’ll develop messaging and positioning for nuanced sub-sectors that we have yet to build for and that need their own story, and also develop narratives for the professionals who do the work inside them. 

Working at the intersection of sales, product, and marketing, you'll develop segment-specific solutions that showcase Claude's transformative potential for industry-specific applications across our product portfolio. You bring deep customer empathy, technical acumen, and the ability to translate complex AI capabilities into clear, value-driven solutions that resonate with decision-makers across organizations. 

This role is built for a versatile product marketer who can go deep and pivot quickly from one industry to the next for a major launch, program, or industry moment. If you’re energized by range, learn new markets fast, and want to shape how entire industries adopt AI, this role is for you.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and execute solutions marketing strategy across a number of different priority industries and customer segments

  • Craft differentiated positioning and messaging for industries and their sub-sectors across solutions pages, campaign materials, and content

  • Lead go-to-market for industry product and solution launches, including sector-specific product offerings and relevant MCP integrations and skills

  • Partner with field marketing and sales leaders to build industry points of view, use cases, and programs around major launches and flagship industry events

  • Build persona-based solutions that speak to specific types of users across industries, such as finance, legal, customer support, and operations teams

  • Adapt industry and persona narratives for different customer segments, including Enterprise, Commercial, SMB, and Startups

  • Partner with the alliances team on joint go-to-market with industry partners, including shared positioning, launch coordination, and integrated campaign moments

  • Work with communications, social, and content teams on executive thought leadership, customer stories, and speaking opportunities relevant to each industry

  • Enable sales teams with compelling materials, outbound campaigns, and pipeline-driving initiatives for priority industry accounts

  • Report on which channels and campaigns are driving results and identify opportunities for iteration

Minimum qualifications

  • Direct experience marketing software products across multiple industries or customer segments in tandem, and know how to find what’s distinct in each and what can scale across them

  • Familiar with developing solutions that span both technical and business buyers, working closely with enterprise architecture teams or transformation offices

  • Track record of building solutions that significantly expand deal sizes and accelerate sales cycles

  • Quick learner who can absorb context on new industries, buyer dynamics, and regulatory considerations rapidly, and speak credibly with the customers and partners in them

  • Strategic and tactical operator, comfortable setting an industry strategy with senior leaders and rolling up your sleeves to ship

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to translate complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for technical and business audiences

  • Thrive in a 0-to-1 environment, can shift priorities quickly, and can build processes where none exist

  • Excel at cross-functional collaboration and are comfortable being the connective tissue between product, sales, partnerships, communications, and marketing teams

  • Passionate about AI’s potential to transform how industries work while maintaining focus on responsible, safe deployment

Preferred qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B product marketing or solutions marketing experience working inside of software companies

  • Demonstrated success in creating vertical-specific solutions for operationally intensive or regulated industries

  • Possess certifications or deep knowledge in cloud platforms, enterprise architecture - experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models strongly preferred

  • Experience marketing AI/ML products or emerging technology to enterprise buyers

  • Track record of building marketing programs from scratch at a growth-stage company

Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 2 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. 

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$320,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Anthropic's Corporate Systems team runs the core collaboration platforms everyone here works in and builds the tooling and automation behind IT. That responsibility extends to the companies we acquire. Their people, devices, and systems have to come into Anthropic securely.

You'll own the IT side of Anthropic's acquisitions: due diligence, integration planning, and integration. Before close, you'll assess a company's IT environment and give the deal team a clear read on risk and effort. You'll define the technical integration plan and its requirements: what moves, where it lands, in what order, what has to be ready on day one, and how each security gap gets closed. After close, you'll carry out that plan and bring the company's people, devices, and systems onto our stack. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll hold admin, write code, build automation, run the cutovers yourself and bring in other teams when the work calls for their expertise or support. You'll lead this work for IT Engineering and partner with Security, Corporate Development, Legal, People, and Finance at every stage.

M&A will be your primary focus and responsibility, but you'll be a full member of the Corporate Systems team;  taking part in planning and reviews, using and contributing to the team’s tooling, and contributing to the roadmap. Early on, M&A will be most of your work, including using Claude to automate the repeatable parts of diligence and integration. As that automation matures, and when M&A load is light, you'll contribute to other parts of the team’s roadmap.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical IT due diligence: assess a company's identity, applications, endpoints, and infrastructure, and brief the deal team on risk and effort before close
  • Find the gaps between an acquired environment and Anthropic's security model, rate them, and build the mitigations into the integration plan
  • Define the technical integration plan and its requirements: what moves, where it lands, in what order, and what has to be ready on day one
  • Run the integration: take over administration, migrate people, devices, and data, and retire what's no longer needed, with support from other IT Engineering teams as required.
  • Work with Business Technology, Client Platform, Corporate Network, IT Operations, and Security on their parts of each integration
  • Keep Corporate Development, Legal, People, Finance, and the acquired company's team clear on where IT stands
  • Build a repeatable IT M&A playbook and automate as much of it as possible with Claude
  • When M&A work is light, contribute to core Corporate Systems projects

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 8+ years as a hands-on engineer in corporate IT. You have designed and shipped systems, carried out migrations or integrations yourself, and owned at least one area end-to-end, with experience supporting other areas: identity, applications, endpoints, or corporate infrastructure
  • Experience administering enterprise identity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, and an SSO provider, and working code in Python or similar against their SaaS APIs
  • Working knowledge of endpoint management and security concepts, enough to lead diligence on an unfamiliar fleet
  • A proven ability to understand an unfamiliar IT environment quickly and deliver a prioritized view of risk to non-specialists
  • A record of leading technical projects that span several teams and run to a fixed date, while doing much of the engineering yourself
  • Comfort working autonomously, with ambiguity and confidential information
  • Clear communication with executives, legal and corporate development teams, and engineers at acquired companies

Strong candidates may also have

  • Prior M&A, carve-out, or company-to-company migration experience
  • Experience across the full stack: endpoints, systems, applications, and infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience managing a device fleet or running an MDM
  • Experience working in or alongside a security team
  • A record of building tooling that replaces manual IT work
  • Using Claude or similar tools as a core part of how you work

Representative projects

  • Assess an acquired company's IT environment that nobody here has seen and produce a prioritized integration plan within days
  • Design a way to size integration effort and risk for a company of any shape or size
  • Automate bringing acquired people and devices onto Anthropic's identity and device management
  • Write the IT risk memo for a live deal and present it to Corporate Development and Security leadership

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products. As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on. About fal fal is the generative media platform for developers. We give the world's most ambitious AI teams the fastest way to run image, video, audio and 3D models in production. We also provide the GPU infrastructure they need to train, fine-tune and serve models of their own. Our inference engine was built from the ground up for generative media. It has made fal the platform builders reach for when speed, scale and reliability matter. Our customers range from the fastest-growing AI companies in the world to the Fortune 500. More and more of them are coming to us for raw compute as well as inference and model APIs. We're a small, high-output team, and we're growing fast. If you want to be in the room while the infrastructure layer of generative AI gets built, this is that room. About the Role As an Account Executive on our Compute team, you'll own new-logo acquisition across AI-native startups and neolabs. You'll sell fal's full compute offering: dedicated GPU clusters, reserved and on-demand capacity, and the inference platform that developers already build on. This is a pure hunter role. You won't inherit a book. You'll build one, and with it you'll help define how fal takes compute to market. What You'll Do Build and own your pipeline Own all net-new logo acquisition across a defined set of AI-native startups, neolabs and research-driven model builders. Build pipeline from scratch through founder and investor networks, targeted outbound, community and events, and the market signals that tell you a team is about to need compute: a fresh fundraise, a new model release, a hiring spree in research. Use fal's product data to spot developers and teams already building on our platform whose usage shows they're ready for a larger compute commitment. Keep a focused, prioritized target list. Know which 30 companies matter most this quarter and why. Lead technical, consultative sales cycles Engage founders, CTOs, heads of research and infrastructure leads early, often before a formal buying process exists. Partner with Solutions Engineering on benchmarks, proofs of concept and architecture reviews that show fal's performance and reliability on the customer's own workloads. Translate technical requirements into a clear business case: time-to-cluster, price-performance, flexibility and total cost. Structure and close compute deals Design commercial agreements that fit how fast-growing AI companies actually operate: reserved clusters, on-demand and burst capacity, prepaid commitments, and blended platform agreements. Work with our capacity, finance and deal desk teams to secure supply and structure deals that work for both the customer and fal. Run the full cycle from first conversation through negotiation and signature, keeping momentum through commercial, technical and legal review. Grow with your customers Land with an initial workload, then expand as customers scale from experimentation to large training runs to production inference. Build multi-threaded relationships so fal is the first call when a customer's next capacity need appears. Hand off smoothly and stay aligned with Account Management and Customer Success as accounts mature. Shape the business Bring structured customer and market feedback to Product, Infrastructure and Leadership: what's winning, what's missing, and what competitors are doing. Help build the playbook. You'll be among the first sellers dedicated to this segment, and your input will shape how the motion scales. Keep forecasting accurate and pipeline up to date in Salesforce. You understand how funding cycles, runway and competitive pressure drive buying, and you know how to move at their pace. Technical credibility. You can hold a real conversation with an ML engineer or research lead about GPU generations, interconnect, cluster sizing, training vs. inference economics, and why utilization matters. You don't need to be an engineer, but engineers should be glad you're on the call. A builder's approach to pipeline. You've generated a large share of your own pipeline and you're energized, not intimidated, by a blank territory. Strong commercial judgment. You know when a long-term reservation is the right answer for a customer and when flexibility matters more. You structure deals that set customers up to grow. Low ego, high ownership. You collaborate closely with Solutions Engineering, Product and Finance, and you take accountability for outcomes. Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Payroll Tax and Compliance Analyst.

About the job

We are seeking a highly skilled Payroll Tax and Compliance Analyst to oversee payroll employment taxes, regulatory adherence, and mobility compliance across APJ and EMEA regions. As a fast-growing tech company, our workforce is highly mobile. You will serve as the subject matter expert on complex tax laws, social security frameworks, and multi-country remote worker regulations. Reporting directly to the Director, Global Payroll, you will suggest risk-mitigation strategies and ensure seamless compliance for a dynamic, global team. 

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Tax Oversight: Manage all payroll tax compliance, filings, and reconciliations across the APJ and EMEA regions, covering Australia, Singapore, India, Hong Kong, Japan, Sweden, Estonia, Spain, Ireland, UK, Germany, Belgium, France, Poland.
  • Mobility Tracking: Monitor employee movement across countries and international borders to ensure accurate tax withholding.
  • Nexus Assessment: Evaluate corporate tax footprint implications resulting from remote worker locations.
  • Social Security: Ensure correct application of local social security taxes and international totalization agreements.
  • Regulatory Research: Track changing tax laws, statutory rates, and local compliance requirements in all active jurisdictions.
  • Agency Management: Act as the primary point of contact for tax authorities, external auditors, and local payroll partners.
  • Year-End Reporting: Lead year-end tax reporting processes, for all countries in APJ & EMEA and follow local country statutory filings.
  • Process Optimization: Build scalable internal workflows to automate tax adjustments for mobile employees.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Experience: 3+ years of payroll tax and compliance experience, ideally within a high-growth technology company.
  • Geographic Scope: Proven expertise in APJ & EMEA local taxes & social security.
  • Mobility Expertise: Advanced knowledge of multi-country taxation, trailing liabilities, and cross-border remote work risks.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with global payroll platforms (e.g., Workday, Deel, etc).
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex statutory tax laws into clear, actionable corporate policies. 

Desired:

  • Expertise in APJ & EMEA payroll regulations (e.g., Australia, Singapore, India, Japan, Hong Kong, Sweden, UK, Spain, France, Germany, Ireland, Poland, Belgium)
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or equivalent international certification.
  • Experience navigating compliance for equity compensation (RSUs, stock options) across multiple tax jurisdictions. 

Location

 This role will be remote, and based in Ireland. 

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role:

You want to build and run elegant and thorough machine learning experiments to help us understand and steer the behavior of powerful AI systems. You care about making AI helpful, honest, and harmless, and are interested in the ways that this could be challenging in the context of human-level capabilities. You could describe yourself as both a scientist and an engineer. As a Research Engineer on Alignment Science, you'll contribute to exploratory experimental research on AI safety, with a focus on risks from powerful future systems (like those we would designate as ASL-3 or ASL-4 under our Responsible Scaling Policy), often in collaboration with other teams including Interpretability, Fine-Tuning, and the Frontier Red Team.

Our blog provides an overview of topics that the Alignment Science team is either currently exploring or has previously explored. For the London team, we are opportunistically hiring for the following research areas:

  • AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios.
  • Alignment Stress-testing: Creating model organisms of misalignment to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise.

Note: Currently, the team's hub is in San Francisco, so we require all candidates to be based at least 25% in London and travel to San Francisco occasionally. Additionally, we are prioritizing growing our San Francisco teams, so you may not hear back on your application to the London team unless we see an unusually strong fit. For this role, we conduct all interviews in Python.

Representative Projects:

  • Testing the robustness of our safety techniques by training language models to subvert our safety techniques, and seeing how effective they are at subverting our interventions.
  • Run multi-agent reinforcement learning experiments to test out techniques like AI Debate.
  • Build tooling to efficiently evaluate the effectiveness of novel LLM-generated jailbreaks.
  • Write scripts and prompts to efficiently produce evaluation questions to test models’ reasoning abilities in safety-relevant contexts.
  • Contribute ideas, figures, and writing to research papers, blog posts, and talks.
  • Run experiments that feed into key AI safety efforts at Anthropic, like the design and implementation of our Responsible Scaling Policy.

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have significant software, ML, or research engineering experience
  • Have some experience contributing to empirical AI research projects
  • Have some familiarity with technical AI safety research
  • Prefer fast-moving collaborative projects to extensive solo efforts
  • Pick up slack, even if it goes outside your job description
  • Care about the impacts of AI

Strong candidates may also:

  • Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety
  • Have experience with LLMs
  • Have experience with reinforcement learning
  • Have experience with Kubernetes clusters and complex shared codebases

Candidates need not have:

  • 100% of the skills needed to perform the job
  • Formal certifications or education credentials

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
£260,000—£370,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 3819535449b1053ec980.description: Line of Service Tax Industry/Sector Technology Specialism Technology Strategy Management Level Senior Associate Job Description & Summary Why Join PwC Ireland? At PwC Ireland, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organisation dedicated to building trust in society and solving our clients’ most complex challenges. Here, diverse teams collaborate across sectors and geographies to deliver innovative solutions that make a real difference. We invest in your growth through continuous learning, leadership development, and access to cutting-edge technology, empowering you to shape your career and impact the future of business and society. About the role: PwC Ireland’s Tax practice is growing; as demand for our services increase, and the complex nature of the tax landscape continues to evolve, now is the perfect time to explore opportunities and join our team of more than 700 tax professionals across Ireland. We are a dynamic Partner led team with diverse Tax, Finance and IT backgrounds. Our Tax Technology & Transformation team works with market leading clients in a broad range of industry sectors to maximise operational effectiveness within their tax functions by leveraging best in class approaches and solutions. We help clients design and execute the right tax technology strategies to manage tax risks, increase efficiency and take advantage of the opportunities enabled by technology. The tax landscape is changing and we are continuously expanding due to our clients’ growing demand to leverage more efficient processes and technology to support the tax function as the volume and complexity of global tax compliance and regulatory requirements continues to increase. Our work is increasingly varied and involves supporting organisations with all aspects of tax technology across all tax heads including: The development of long-term tax function tax technology strategies and alignment of same with wider business operating model objectives; The design, build and implementation of tax solutions using best-in-class artificial intelligence, robotics, data extraction, transformation and analytics functionality; The implementation of our market leading tax compliance and reporting solutions as well as tax workflow management and PwC hosted Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions; The optimisation of core Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to support the delivery of data in fit-for-purpose for tax process execution. What you will do : By combining tax technical expertise with technology and systems improvement opportunities, you will drive positive tax ground-breaking objectives and deliver a more efficient tax function for our clients. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to: Supporting go to market business development initiatives while continuing to research and integrate best in class emerging technologies. Interpretation and documentation of client's tax and business requirements to support the future state systems design ambition and appropriate mix of tax technology solutions. Working with project delivery teams in designing, building and integrating tax technology enabled solutions for clients. Building strong relationships and working across key client stakeholder groups (transfer pricing, corporate tax, indirect tax, finance, IT etc.) as well as working with PwC specialists internally and across PwC’s global network. Motivating more junior team members to perform at their best, make a difference and deliver results, while providing mentorship and guidance allowing them to stretch to their full potential. Who we are looking for : Minimum 3+ years experience in a tax or tax technology related role, ideally gained in a top tier accounting firm, corporate, business consulting or legal environment. Experience in tax or tax technology consultancy related roles working with tax related solutions in ERP systems and/or tax engines (SAP, Oracle, MSFT Dynamics, OneSource, Vertex or other). Certification or extensive experience in agile technology and analytic solutions preferable (MS VBA, SQL, MS Power Apps, Alteryx, Tableau, UiPath). Deep technical and project management capabilities from leading and delivering large and sophisticated tax transformation projects. Experience with a Big 4 firm, large ERP/consulting organisation multinational company with tax related experience preferable. Strong academic record (ACA/CTA or equivalent qualification preferable). Innovative and bold to develop business opportunities in order to generate growth within the tax technology and transformation offering and the firm. Superb communication skills both written and verbal. Leadership – commitment and experience to developing yourself, your clients and your business. Our commitment to you We’re committed to building an inclusive culture that empowers our people to thrive and feel a sense of belonging at PwC. We seek to attract talented people from different backgrounds with diverse perspectives who can bring innovation and creativity. At PwC, your hard work doesn't go unnoticed. We celebrate your achievements not just within the firm , but among your peers as well. Our rewards are designed to fit your unique lifestyle and needs . And because being part of PwC should be rewarding every day, you'll have access to PwC p erks a handpicked selection of exclusive discounts, experiences, and extras just for being part of our team. Application support We are committed to an inclusive recruitment experience. If you require any adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know (ie_experiencedhireteam@pwc.com) . All requests will be treated confidentially and supported wherever possible to help you showcase your strengths. 3907bbd09eea221c923f.description: monday.com  is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition.  Our team is growing and we are looking for a Forward Deployed Consultant to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will train, advise and consult, and build with customers to optimize their use of the  monday.com  AI work platform during the course of an AI transformation, implementation, or ongoing managed services engagement. You will design and build the AI-native solutions that get them there, from intelligent workflows and agents to the automations and reporting their business relies on. You will run engagements both independently and as a part of a delivery team collaborating with deployment strategists and engineers.  Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our  London  office.    About the Role    Lead AI transformation and implementation engagements for  monday.com  customers, designing and building tailored solutions using agents, vibe-coded applications, and other advanced capabilities of the monday AI work platform.    Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, running the discovery that uncovers their desired business outcomes, and ensure successful adoption of the solutions you deliver across their organization.    Consult on business process design, mapping how work moves through a customer's organization and recommending the process changes that should be made before the solution is built.    Design sophisticated workflows and relational data structures within the  monday.com  platform to solve complex business cases, partnering with technical resources for data conversions, integrations, and agentic engineering.    Actively leverage monday AI and external Generative/Agentic AI tools to accelerate solution design, automate complex business logic, and deliver intelligent workflows for our customers.    Act as the project manager on standalone engagements, building and executing on project plans that ensure deliverables stay on-time and on-budget, and delivering defined scope alongside a deployment strategist on larger ones.    Run online webinars, training sessions, consultations, and one-on-one demos that show customers how our product capabilities translate into business value.    Produce the documentation, walkthroughs, and exit artifacts for your engagements that allow customers to operate, maintain, and extend what you built independently.    Represent the voice of the customer by advocating for their needs and influencing the product development roadmap.    Contribute the patterns and reusable assets you develop in the field back to our shared asset library.      Requirements    3+ years of experience as a forward-deployed consultant, implementation consultant, solutions consultant, or technical project manager in enterprise software.    Experience leading software implementation or managed services projects that required hands-on build and system configuration in project management, CRM, service desk, or collaborative work management software.    Fluency in Generative and Agentic AI tools, with a strong understanding of how to leverage AI in streamlining work productivity and building intelligent workflows and agents.    Familiarity with what keeps AI reliable in production, including human review, checking outputs, and knowing when a deterministic automation is the better answer.    Strong problem solving skills, rooted in computational thinking, systems design, and an understanding of relational data structures.    Business process design and consulting experience, with the business acumen to frame an engagement around customer outcomes, and the judgment to read the implicit problem behind an explicit request.    Working knowledge of integration platforms ( make.com , Zapier) sufficient to configure lightweight integrations yourself, with foundational knowledge of APIs (GraphQL) and MCP a plus.    Strong customer-facing and presentation skills with the ability to establish credibility with client stakeholders and executives, and to clearly articulate technical topics to a non-technical audience.    Ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies across a changing set of customers and industries.    Detail-oriented with strong project management skills, comfortable running engagements independently and working across several at once.    Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a positive attitude, empathy, high energy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt.    Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time.    BA or BS degree preferred.      Please note that this role is hybrid.   Visa sponsorship for this role is currently not available.   monday.com  is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Back to jobs Full-Stack Software Engineer, Reinforcement Learning San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role As a Full-Stack Software Engineer in RL, you'll build the platforms, tools, and interfaces that power environment creation, data collection, and training observability. The quality of Claude's next generation depends on the quality of the data we train it on — and the systems you build are what make that data possible. You'll own product surfaces end-to-end — from backend services and APIs to the web UIs that researchers, external vendors, and thousands of data labelers use every day. You don't need a background in ML research. What matters is that you can take an ambiguous, high-stakes problem and ship a polished, reliable product against it, fast. This team moves very quickly. Claude writes a lot of the code we commit, which means the bottleneck isn't typing — it's judgment, taste, and the ability to react to what researchers need next. You'll iterate on data collection strategies to distill the knowledge of thousands of human experts around the world into our models, and you'll do it in a loop that closes in hours and days, not quarters or months. Anthropic's Reinforcement Learning organization leads the research and development that trains Claude to be capable, reliable, and safe. We've contributed to every Claude model, with significant impact on the autonomy and coding capabilities of our most advanced models. Our work spans teaching models to use computers effectively, advancing code generation through RL, pioneering fundamental RL research for large language models, and building the scalable training methodologies behind our frontier production models. The RL org is organized around four goals: solving the science of long-horizon tasks and continual learning, scaling RL data and environments to be comprehensive and diverse, automating software engineering end-to-end, and training the frontier production model. Our engineering teams build the environments, evaluation systems, data pipelines, and tooling that make all of this possible — from realistic agentic training environments and scalable code data generation to human data collection platforms and production training operations. What You'll Do Build and extend web platforms for RL environment creation, management, and quality review — including environment configuration, versioning, and validation workflows Develop vendor-facing interfaces and tooling that let external partners create, submit, and iterate on training environments with minimal friction Design and implement platforms for human data collection at scale, including labeling workflows, quality assurance systems, and feedback mechanisms that surface reward signal integrity issues early Build evaluation dashboards and observability UIs that give researchers real-time insight into environment quality, training run health, and reward hacking Create backend services and APIs that connect environment authoring tools, data collection systems, and RL training infrastructure Build and expand scalable code data generation pipelines, producing diverse programming tasks with robust reward signals across languages and difficulty levels Develop onboarding automation and documentation tooling so new vendors and internal users ramp up in hours, not weeks Partner closely with RL researchers, data operations, and vendor management to translate ambiguous requirements into well-scoped, well-designed products You May Be a Good Fit If You Have strong software engineering fundamentals and real full-stack range — you're comfortable owning a surface from database schema to frontend Are proficient in Python and a modern web stack (React, TypeScript, or similar) Have a track record of shipping systems that solved a hard problem , not just shipped on time — e.g. you built the thing that made your team 10x faster, or the internal tool nobody thought was possible Operate with high agency: you identify what needs to be done and drive it forward without waiting for a ticket Have found yourself wondering "why isn't this moving faster?" in previous roles — and then have done something about it Care about UX and can build interfaces that are intuitive for both technical researchers and non-technical labelers Communicate clearly with researchers, operations teams, and engineers, and can turn vague asks into well-scoped work Thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift, Claude is your pair programmer, and the next problem is often one nobody has solved before Care about Anthropic's mission to build safe, beneficial AI and want your work to contribute directly to it Strong Candidates May Also Have Built data collection, labeling, or annotation platforms — ideally ones that had to scale across many vendors or many task types Background building multi-tenant platforms with role-based access, audit trails, and vendor management workflows Experience with cloud infrastructure (GCP or AWS), Docker, and CI/CD pipelines Familiarity with LLM training, fine-tuning, or evaluation workflows Experience with async Python (Trio, asyncio) or high-throughput API design Background in dashboards, monitoring, or observability tooling Experience working directly with external vendors or partners on technical integrations A background that isn't a straight line — e.g. math or physics into SWE, competitive programming, research into engineering, or a side project that outgrew its scope Representative Projects Building a unified platform for human data collection that integrates labeling workflows, vendor management, and QA for complex agentic tasks Developing vendor onboarding automation that handles Docker registry access, API token management, and environment validation Creating evaluation and observability dashboards that catch reward hacks, measure environment difficulty, and give real-time feedback during production training Building environment quality review workflows that let researchers browse, grade, and provide feedback on training environments Developing automated environment quality pipelines that validate correctness and difficulty calibration before environments hit production training Building internal tools for browsing and analyzing training run results, environment statistics, and data collection progress The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 - $405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 395a568b137c0928d32a.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. About The Team The Voyager team at Anduril Industries is an engineering and design division with vast experience in developing innovative computing and communications solutions for the network edge. We specialize in integrating enterprise networking capabilities from global IT leaders with purpose-built hardware and software platforms designed to meet the most stringent environmental requirements. The Software Quality Engineering team champions quality across the entire product life cycle by embedding engineering-driven testing into the development process. As an SDET intern, you won't just execute test cases — you'll write code to test code, building the automation, tooling, and frameworks that guarantee our products work as intended. At Anduril, Software Quality Engineering is a development function: we actively build new products and projects while supporting production. You'll apply real software engineering skills — programming (Python), version control, and CI/CD — to bring the quality discipline directly into production, engineering, and supplier management workflows. What You’ll Do As an SDET engineer, you'll be part of one of our Agile Software Development teams responsible for a variety of projects. You may be working on: Design and build test automation frameworks for UI, API, and integration testing Write automated test suites and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines Develop test tooling — mocks, stubs, simulators, and data generators — to validate complex systems Perform performance, load, and reliability testing on mission-critical software Debug across the full stack, contributing fixes to both test and production code Advocate for testability, partnering with development teams to build quality in from the start Our engineering teams develop hardware and software platforms to support a variety of applications, such as: Data logging for self-driving cars Link aggregation technology for better connectivity on trains Government services such as emergency response, disaster recovery and security Hardware platforms used by AI/ML for object recognition – Deep learning inference engine using object detection networks like Faster R-CNN on Intel CPUs or the integrated Intel GPU Required Qualifications Completion of a bachelors or masters degree in a technical field such as Software engineering, math, or science. Must be available to work full time in our Dublin office Must be available to start full time in July 2027 Preferred Qualifications Previous internship experience within the Software Development Engineering in Test space Demonstrated ability to creatively problem solve issues related embedded software and electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills Personal experience with linux, Git-Lab/hub, embedded hardware systems A genuine interest in software testing, and thirst for learning Previous experience leading project and working with software development and/or testing, analysis, and driving improvements Software scripting experience in any language Benefits The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits. Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. Data Privacy To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

This is an excellent opportunity for recent Mechanical Engineering graduates who want to build a career with a leading international mechanical and electrical contractor. You will gain hands-on experience across live projects, working alongside experienced engineers, project teams, commercial teams and site leadership. As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer, you will support the delivery of mechanical building services across a range of projects, which may include commercial, industrial, pharmaceutical, data centre, residential, energy and infrastructure environments. You will be exposed to both office-based and site-based work, giving you a strong practical understanding of how mechanical systems are designed, coordinated, installed, tested and commissioned. Designer Group’s graduate programme is designed to support early-career professionals through practical project experience, mentoring, structured development and exposure to major engineering projects across Ireland, the UK and Europe. The existing graduate programme is positioned as a two-year programme providing hands-on experience across core teams and project environments. Key Responsibilities Will Include Supporting project teams with the delivery of mechanical services from early-stage planning through to installation, testing and commissioning. Assisting with technical reviews, drawings, specifications, submittals and project documentation. Working with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors and site teams to support safe and efficient project delivery. Supporting quality, safety and compliance requirements across mechanical works. Assisting with progress tracking, reporting, materials coordination and issue resolution. Developing practical knowledge of M&E contracting, construction sequencing, programme requirements and client expectations. Building your technical understanding of mechanical systems, site coordination, project delivery and engineering best practice. Participating in training, mentoring and continuous professional development as part of your graduate journey. Requirements Requirements Minimum Requirements Level 7 or Level 8 qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline. Strong interest in mechanical building services, M&E contracting and construction project delivery. Good communication, organisation and problem-solving skills. Ability to work well as part of a team and take direction from experienced engineers and project leaders. Proactive attitude, strong work ethic and willingness to learn. Comfortable working in both office and site-based environments. Available to start immediately or at short notice. Preferred But Not Essential Previous placement, internship or site experience within construction, M&E, building services, utilities, energy, pharma, commercial or data centre environments. Basic understanding of mechanical drawings, schematics, technical specifications or construction documentation. Exposure to AutoCAD, Revit, BIM, Microsoft Project, Excel or other engineering/project tools. Interest in progressing toward professional development, CPD and chartership. Benefits Benefits At Designer Group, our people are central to our continued growth. We invest in graduates through structured development, mentoring and exposure to real project delivery from the beginning of their careers. Benefits Include Full-time permanent employment. Travel and subsistence allowances where applicable. Bike to Work scheme. Social committee and employee events. Third-level education grant support. Designer Group is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Team

Foragers is a new Field Services team within our physical infrastructure organization. We're the boots on the ground for Anthropic's physical infrastructure: the people who get hardware into racks, gear commissioned, and sites handed over. The team is being stood up now, so early hires shape how we operate. This role is the lab-focused counterpart to our traveling field engineers. Instead of covering sites across the country, you own our Bay Area hardware labs from end to end.

About the Role

Your mission is to ensure our hardware labs are functional, useful, and ready to support the growing number of teams and projects that need access to physical hardware. You’d own what shows up, how it’s powered, cooled, cabled, tracked, set up, and made functional. This includes both standard hardware (think typical accelerator setups) and more specialized ones like ensuring our security teams have access to all the right headers and other hardware instrumentation on the machines.

Understanding and anticipating the needs of the various teams that rely on the labs will be another critical part of this role. You’ll be expected to take a lot of ownership and initiative over the lab and what’s in it, including reaching out to partner teams to figure out what they’d need in the future and making sure it’s there before it starts to block them. This will require you to collaborate closely with those partner teams, so a breadth of knowledge around hardware is extremely useful.

You’d be the first dedicated lab manager, so part of this role will include shaping it to scale from our current lab to much larger ones.

What You’ll Do

  • Run the physical lab across both sites: receiving and staging, rack-and-stack, cabling, power distribution and load planning, cooling, floor layout
  • Bring up new server and accelerator platforms as they arrive, from crate to a machine someone can SSH into: firmware and BIOS/UEFI setup, out-of-band management, OS install, network provisioning
  • Own hardware procurement for the lab: work with teams on what's coming, order ahead of need, chase quotes and lead times, keep receiving and inventory in order
  • Own RMA processes end-to-end for lab hardware: triage, swap, ship, track, close; drive vendor escalations
  • Build the one-off setups engineers ask for: debug and programming harnesses (JTAG/SWD/UART), remote power switching, console and KVM access, and the occasional improvised fix for hardware running outside the conditions it was designed for
  • Oversee smarthands and contractor work on-site (electricians, cabling crews, riggers, integrators, OEM field engineers): scope it, dispatch it, validate the quality
  • Handle physical access, asset auditing, and lifecycle tracking for hardware that is expensive and sometimes pre-release
  • Write it down: build the playbooks and lightweight tooling (inventory, remote power, console access) so remote teams can use the lab without pinging you for every step

Who You Are

  • Hands-on experience running a hardware, systems, or datacenter lab, or a similar physical compute environment: rack-and-stack, copper and fiber cabling, power distribution (PDUs, circuits, phase balancing)
  • Working knowledge of server hardware and its management plane: BMC/IPMI/Redfish, BIOS/UEFI configuration, serial console, PXE/network boot, firmware updates
  • Enough Linux and networking (VLANs, DHCP, DNS, basic switch config) to take a bare machine to a state a remote engineer can use
  • Have managed vendors, contractors, quotes, and freight for physical equipment
  • Comfortable and safe with power tools, bench power supplies, and a wiring or rack elevation diagram
  • Work independently with minimal supervision , and know when to ask
  • Bias toward action and comfort with ambiguity: you'd rather move and adjust than wait for perfect information
  • Communicate clearly and directly, especially when flagging risks or blockers

Strong Candidates May Also Have

  • Stood up a lab or datacenter room from empty: layout, power and cooling budget, first round of purchasing
  • Time around high-density accelerator systems (GPU/TPU-class racks), liquid cooling, or pre-release/NPI hardware bring-up
  • Electronics bench skills: soldering and rework, scope and multimeter, custom cable and debug harnesses, JTAG probes, light fabrication (3D printing, drilling, mounting)
  • Supported hardware security, firmware, or platform bring-up work
  • Experience with DCIM or asset-management tooling (NetBox, ServiceNow, etc.)
  • Bought hard-to-source or specialty hardware and dealt with the compliance and logistics that come with it

Location

This role is based in our San Francisco office (500 Howard St). Travel to nearby lab spaces is required so expect to be in-office more frequently than Anthropic's standard 25% hybrid baseline.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
