602a47dc4bdaced6c3ba.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive, Industries – Manufacturing to lead Anthropic’s go-to-market in Taiwan from our Singapore hub. You will bring Claude to Taiwan’s leading high-tech manufacturers in semiconductors, electronics, and the AI hardware supply chain, helping them apply AI across engineering, operations, supply chain, and corporate functions. You will own the full sales cycle with C-suite and senior technical stakeholders, working with Product, Engineering, Applied AI, and Partnerships to shape solutions that fit the market. As one of Anthropic’s first commercial presences covering Taiwan, you will also help define our regional strategy and build the foundation for long-term growth, in a way that reflects Anthropic’s mission to ensure the world safely makes the transition through transformative AI.

Key responsibilities

  • Meet and exceed revenue targets by winning new enterprise accounts and expanding existing ones, while landing flagship references across Taiwan’s semiconductor, electronics, and broader manufacturing sectors
  • Build and execute a territory plan that reflects Taiwan’s manufacturing landscape, including its buying behavior, regulatory environment, and data residency expectations
  • Lead consultative sales with C-suite and senior technical leaders, positioning AI as a driver of business transformation
  • Translate Claude’s technical capabilities into clear business value for manufacturing use cases
  • Run technical discovery with engineering leaders and speak credibly about security, IP protection, and deployment options with customers whose designs and process data are their most sensitive assets
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Applied AI, and Partnerships to design tailored solutions and support complex deals
  • Build co-sell motions with hyperscaler and system integrator partners, including joint customer engagements and marketplace procurement, to extend reach across the territory
  • Identify new use cases and feed customer and market insights back into the product roadmap
  • Represent Anthropic with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders in Taiwan, including conversations about the safe and responsible use of AI

Minimum qualifications

  • 10+ years in enterprise sales, business development, or account management, including selling to semiconductor, electronics, or other manufacturing customers in Taiwan
  • Deep understanding of Taiwan’s high-tech manufacturing ecosystem, including how leading companies organize engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain functions, and where AI creates measurable value
  • Track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals
  • Existing commercial network among Taiwan-based enterprises
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English, with strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving, early-stage market
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Singapore, with eligibility to work there and willingness to travel frequently to Taiwan
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling AI/ML, cloud, data platforms, or enterprise SaaS into manufacturing, semiconductor, electronics, or industrial sectors
  • Experience co-selling with hyperscaler, channel, or SI partners
  • Familiarity with regional data residency, AI governance, IP protection, and enterprise procurement requirements
  • Interest in or experience with advanced AI systems and their safe development
  • Understanding of Taiwan’s competitive and sovereign AI market, including hyperscaler presence, government-backed local models, and manufacturers building their own models

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics. At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond. We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo. If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you. In This Role You Will Design the mechanical center piece of our dexterous manipulation systems : structural components, joints, linkages, transmissions, end-effectors, and housings, with tight trade-offs between weight, stiffness, precision, and cost Own your designs end-to-end : from early concepts and mechanical architecture to series production: build and test prototypes in days, back them up with FEM, tolerance stack-ups, fatigue analysis, and lab testing until they’re production-ready Work closely with manufacturing partners: turn prototypes into reliable, manufacturable, cost-effective parts Build a fully vertically integrated robot: work hand in hand with electronics, controls, and AI teams to push what robotic manipulation can do What We’re Looking For Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in mechanical engineering or a related field 3+ years of work experience designing and developing complex mechanical systems Excellent CAD skills (e.g., Onshape) and experience with PDM and release workflows Solid experience with structural analysis (FEM) and tolerance analysis Deep understanding of design for manufacturing/assembly/cost Strong knowledge of manufacturing methods, including CNC machining, sheet metal, 3D printing, injection molding and other tooled parts, and precision assemblies Hands-on experience with rapid prototyping (3D printing, laser cutting), workshop tools, and prototype assembly/testing Fluency in English (spoken and written), with strong interpersonal and communication skills Bonus Points If You Have Hands-on development experience with high-DoF robotic systems (e.g., robotic arms, end-effectors, dexterous hands, or humanoids) Actuator and drivetrain design (frameless motors, gearboxes such as harmonic, cycloidal, or planetary, and housings) Thermal management and cooling design for compact, high-power assemblies Experience mechanically integrating sensors, PCBs, and cable harnesses into moving systems What we offer The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation

608fb4e225b785fa4345.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

As an AV Operations Specialist, you'll be accountable for how the AV spaces perform, how support requests get resolved, and how events land in the space you're responsible for. This role will help own all areas within the AV landscape. In a given week you might execute a preventative maintenance sweep across a floor of conference rooms, work the support queue and drive a recurring failure to root cause, and then run technical coverage for an all-hands or an executive presentation that evening. 

You'll be the regional presence our AV Engineering and Production teams build on — the person who catches problems before users report them, and who turns what you learn on the ground into standards the rest of the team can run from. Your work directly enables the collaboration and transparency that advance our AI safety mission.

Responsibilities

Site Ownership & Room Health

  • Serve as the AV owner for your office — accountable for the health, readiness, and performance of every room and event space in the building
  • Execute preventative maintenance programs and recurring room sweeps on a defined cadence, not only in response to tickets
  • Maintain accurate inventory of room systems, peripherals, wireless microphones, cameras, and portable production gear, including spares strategy and replacement cycles
  • Coordinate AV scope for office moves, room reconfigurations, and new-space readiness in partnership with Workplace and AV Engineering
  • Know your estate: maintain the room documentation, as-builts, and site-specific gotchas that make your office supportable by anyone on the team

Support Operations

  • Help own the AV support queue — triage, prioritization, resolution, and escalation with clear diagnostic context
  • Participate in the regional AV on-run rotation (West, East, or EMEA), covering AV issues during local business hours alongside the daily room-check discipline
  • Systematically isolate faults to a point in the signal chain rather than reaching for reboots and cable swaps
  • Drive recurring issues to root cause and surface them to AV Engineering as candidates for platform-level or design-level fixes
  • Contribute to runbooks, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base documentation that other technicians follow

Event Support & Production

  • Provide technical coverage for live and hybrid events in your office — from small executive presentations and team meetings through to all-hands and company-wide broadcasts
  • Operate event production systems including audio consoles, video switchers, camera systems, playback, and streaming encoders
  • Run pre-event readiness: walkthroughs, rehearsals, source checks, gear staging, and failover planning
  • Handle scoping conversations with requesters — translating what a stakeholder wants the event to feel like into an equipment and staffing plan that fits the team's SLA
  • Turn novel one-off events into repeatable standards — a template, runbook, or gear list that makes the next one easier for the whole team

Vendor Direction & Cross-functional Partnership

  • Direct AV integrators, contractors, and event labor on site, holding them to defined scope, SLAs, and quality standards
  • Partner with Workplace, Events, and IT on lead times, expectations, and readiness 
  • Act as the regional feedback loop to AV Engineering — what's failing, what's missing, and what the standard should be
  • Communicate status, risk, and resolution to non-technical stakeholders in clear, calm, jargon-free language

You May Be a Good Fit If You:

  • Have 8+ years of hands-on experience in AV operations, workplace technology, or technical event support
  • Have owned a standing estate — the same rooms, the same stakeholders, week over week — and were accountable for how those spaces performed over time
  • Bring working fluency across room systems, event audio, video, camera, and streaming, with enough depth to diagnose problems rather than only report them
  • Are comfortable being the only AV person in the building, and can prioritize independently across maintenance, support, and events
  • Bring structure to ambiguity — checklists, intake processes, maintenance cadences, and documentation
  • Are energized rather than drained by being the front-facing technical partner to executives, event producers, and everyone else who walks up to you in a hallway
  • Take ownership end-to-end, from noticing a recurring failure to getting it permanently fixed
  • Thrive in a fast-moving environment where standards are being written rather than inherited

Strong Candidates May Also Have Experience With:

  • Q-SYS DSP platforms — comfortable navigating and reasoning about existing audio/video routing and control designs
  • Logitech CollabOS and Sync, Google Meet hardware, Zoom Rooms, and enterprise room system administration
  • Preventative maintenance and room-sweep programs across a distributed room fleet
  • Broadcast video switchers such as Blackmagic ATEM, Ross Carbonite, or NewTek TriCaster
  • Digital audio mixing consoles such as Yamaha DM7 or CL/QL series, and Shure wireless systems
  • PTZ camera systems and multi-camera workflows
  • Ticketing and workflow systems such as Jira, and participation in an on-run rotation 
  • Coordinating AV contractors, integrators, and labor for site support and event coverage
  • CTS certification or equivalent demonstrated capability

Role Specific Location Policy:

  • This role will be based in our New York office
  • This role is expected to be in office 5 days per week
  • Occasional evening and early-morning coverage is expected around major events
  • 4-6 weeks of travel annually may be expected for this role for distributed support, office buildout support, and event coverage as needed

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$230,000—$285,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About the Role:

Anthropic's ML Performance and Scaling team trains our production pretrained models, work that directly shapes the company's future and our mission to build safe, beneficial AI systems. As a Research Engineer on this team, you'll ensure our frontier models train reliably, efficiently, and at scale. This is demanding, high-impact work that requires both deep technical expertise and a genuine passion for the craft of large-scale ML systems.

This role lives at the boundary between research and engineering. You'll work across our entire production training stack: performance optimization, hardware debugging, experimental design, and launch coordination. During launches, the team works in tight lockstep, responding to production issues that can't wait for tomorrow.

Responsibilities: 

  • Own critical aspects of our production pretraining pipeline, including model operations, performance optimization, observability, and reliability
  • Debug and resolve complex issues across the full stack—from hardware errors and networking to training dynamics and evaluation infrastructure
  • Design and run experiments to improve training efficiency, reduce step time, increase uptime, and enhance model performance
  • Respond to on-call incidents during model launches, diagnosing problems quickly and coordinating solutions across teams
  • Build and maintain production logging, monitoring dashboards, and evaluation infrastructure
  • Add new capabilities to the training codebase, such as long context support or novel architectures
  • Collaborate closely with teammates across SF and London, as well as with Tokens, Architectures, and Systems teams
  • Contribute to the team's institutional knowledge by documenting systems, debugging approaches, and lessons learned

You May Be a Good Fit If You:

  • Have hands-on experience training large language models, or deep expertise with JAX, TPU, PyTorch, or large-scale distributed systems
  • Genuinely enjoy both research and engineering work—you'd describe your ideal split as roughly 50/50 rather than heavily weighted toward one or the other
  • Are excited about being on-call for production systems, working long days during launches, and solving hard problems under pressure
  • Thrive when working on whatever is most impactful, even if that changes day-to-day based on what the production model needs
  • Excel at debugging complex, ambiguous problems across multiple layers of the stack
  • Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively, especially when coordinating across time zones or during high-stress incidents
  • Are passionate about the work itself and want to refine your craft as a research engineer
  • Care about the societal impacts of AI and responsible scaling

Strong Candidates May Also Have: 

  • Previous experience training LLM’s or working extensively with JAX/TPU, PyTorch, or other ML frameworks at scale
  • Contributed to open-source LLM frameworks (e.g., open_lm, llm-foundry, mesh-transformer-jax)
  • Published research on model training, scaling laws, or ML systems
  • Experience with production ML systems, observability tools, or evaluation infrastructure
  • Background as a systems engineer, quant, or in other roles requiring both technical depth and operational excellence

What Makes This Role Unique: 

This is not a typical research engineering role. The work is highly operational—you'll be deeply involved in keeping our production models training smoothly, which means being responsive to incidents, flexible about priorities, and comfortable with uncertainty. During launches, the team often works extended hours and may need to respond to issues on evenings and weekends.

However, this operational intensity comes with extraordinary learning opportunities. You'll gain hands-on experience with some of the largest, most sophisticated training runs in the industry. You'll work alongside world-class researchers and engineers, and the institutional knowledge you build will compound in ways that can't be easily transferred. For people who thrive on this type of work, it's uniquely rewarding.

We're building a close-knit team of people who genuinely care about doing excellent work together. If you're someone who wants to be part of training the models that will define the future of AI—and you're excited about the full reality of what that entails—we'd love to hear from you.

Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows. 

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. 

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

The Customer Success Manager role will play a critical part in the exciting growth trajectory of Tines. As an automation platform, the more the customer automates, the more value they see. Your role will be to drive adoption and expand the usage across the customer base, ensuring that our customers realise the full potential of the platform. Alongside expansion with existing teams, you will play a crucial part in our strategy to expand outside of security teams into other functions in our clients (IT, Engineering, Operations).

You will do this by supporting our customers from onboarding to ongoing support to expansion and renewals. You will become a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on the Tines product, helping foster champions within the customer who will identify automation opportunities across their organization. At the same time, you will provide feedback to our Product and Engineering teams, helping us shape the future of the product. The role will also partner closely with Sales, Support, Marketing, and other internal teams.

Location: This is a remote role that can be based anywhere in Ireland.

What you will be doing:

  • Supporting the key phases of the customer journey: onboarding, adoption/value conversations, business reviews and renewal.
  • Leading a first-class onboarding experience and ensuring customer use cases and requirements are met in the specified timeline
  • Translating technical customer needs to internal technical teams and delivering feedback to the Product team on new feature requests and enhancements to shape and improve the platform
  • Coordinating onboarding and business reviews to evaluate performance, learn about the customers priorities, and locate new opportunities to promote expansion within existing and new teams
  • Partnering with internal resources to build account plans and align customer needs with use cases to increase platform usage
  • Proactively identify risks to the customer achieving their stated goals, and work with the CSM / PM teams to develop and drive a comprehensive risk mitigation plan
  • Identifying issues that impact customers and/or challenges in the business and are able to provide thought leadership in finding a customer solution or assist in co-development of process improvement, programs and/or assets
  • Developing and driving a renewal plan and delivering a strategic message to analysts, management, and executive stakeholders on the value of Tines and next steps for the account
  • Review account dashboards, metrics, log-ins, and use cases to determine the health of the customer
  • Manage a book of business by evaluating data indicators and health of accounts to drive renewals and expansion strategies

What you bring with you:

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical account management, customer success, or post-sales role at a technology company
  • Experience with a SaaS solutions offering for technical teams (cybersecurity, DevOps, IT, other)
  • Experience asking questions to uncover problems, locate new opportunities, and translate technical requirements to internal teams and partners
  • Knowledge of how to solve complex problems by utilizing internal resources and when to engage management or leadership
  • Knowledge of API's + how they function
  • Knowledge of a second European language is an advantage, but not essential.

Octopus Centre for Heating Technology is the hardware division of the Octopus Energy Group, one of the UK's leading energy suppliers. Based in Portadown, we develop and manufacture the air source heat pumps and associated hardware that Octopus Energy installs in homes across the country.
We’re changing the energy system globally, spearheading the transition to greener, cheaper energy through the installation of in-home technologies. Our team brings together deep technical expertise, commercial focus and a drive to move from idea to real-world product quickly.
We’re looking for an R&D Manager to lead the team responsible for developing our next generation of heat pump technology. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role, with ownership of the full development process - from initial design through testing, compliance and productionisation. You’ll set the technical direction for R&D, manage a team of engineers and technicians, and work closely with product, commercial and manufacturing colleagues to bring new products to market. Lead a team of engineers and technicians working on air source heat pumps and associated components across the full development lifecycle. Define and maintain the technical roadmap for heat pump R&D, balancing short-term delivery with longer-term product strategy. Work closely with the platform, firmware, and design teams to ensure hardware development is well-integrated with wider product and system decisions. Oversee the design, testing, and validation of heat pump hardware, including refrigeration circuits, controls, heat exchangers, and system integration. Lead component selection across the product, working with suppliers to evaluate and qualify parts that meet performance, cost, and reliability requirements. Manage the lab and field testing programme, drawing on data from real-world installations to inform product decisions. Lead compliance testing to relevant standards (MCS, CE/UKCA, EN 14511, F-Gas, ErP, etc.) and manage relationships with test houses and certification bodies. Specify, commission, and maintain test rigs and laboratory facilities to support the team's development and validation work. Monitor residential heat pump market trends and emerging technologies, using that knowledge to inform product direction and identify opportunities. Identify and manage technical risk throughout the development process, keeping projects on schedule in a demanding, fast-paced environment. Support the professional development of engineers and technicians within the team. Essential: A graduate or postgraduate qualification in engineering (mechanical, electrical, or a closely related discipline). Proven experience managing an engineering team, including project delivery, workload planning, and team development. Substantial experience in heat pump, HVAC, or refrigeration product development, with a strong working knowledge of thermodynamics, system components, and design tradeoffs. A demonstrable track record of taking hardware products from concept through to market. Strong systems-level thinking, with the ability to work across mechanical, electrical, controls, and software domains. Experience working in a fast-paced development environment, with the ability to manage competing priorities and maintain delivery momentum. Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to present technical information to non-technical audiences. Desirable: Experience with field-deployed products and using operational data to drive iterative improvement. Familiarity with UK and EU regulatory requirements for heat pumps and low-carbon heating. Background in design for manufacture, particularly for volume consumer hardware. We're very excited about this opportunity. We're looking for the passion, skills and experience to help shape and define the future of energy and business at a global scale. If you're reading this and grinning and want to bring this technology to the market at scale and speed, then we would love to hear from you.

63465ec80bf7536fb933.description: We are seeking an experienced Red Hat OpenShift Platform Associate Manager to join our Digital Core team and contribute to large-scale transformation initiatives across enterprise technology platforms. Digital Core focuses on the technology foundations that enable organisations to adapt and reinvent, bringing together modern digital platforms, cloud-first infrastructure, data and AI capabilities, and security by design. In this role, you will help engineer and evolve secure, resilient and scalable OpenShift platforms that underpin critical enterprise workloads. Responsibilities: As a Red Hat OpenShift Platform Associate Manager, you will be responsible for engineering, evolving and supporting enterprise-grade OpenShift Container Platform environments. You will work across platform build, automation, lifecycle management, security, reliability and operational readiness, helping to provide a secure and resilient container platform for critical workloads. Your day-to-day activities will include hands-on platform engineering, troubleshooting and automation, working with architects, infrastructure teams, application teams and operations to deliver consistent platform services. You will contribute technical expertise to platform design decisions, lead complex engineering activities within your area, and help establish standards and reusable patterns for OpenShift adoption. Key Responsibilities Include: Design, build, configure and continuously improve Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform environments across enterprise on-premises and hybrid infrastructure. Own and execute OpenShift platform lifecycle activities including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, capacity management and cluster health management. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code and platform automation using tools such as Terraform and Ansible, with a focus on repeatability, standardisation and reduced manual effort. Implement and support GitOps-based platform and application deployment patterns using technologies such as Argo CD and enterprise CI/CD tooling. Engineer secure platform capabilities including RBAC, network policies, secrets and certificate management, image security, policy enforcement and integration with enterprise identity and security services. Support and optimise core OpenShift services and ecosystem components such as cluster networking, storage, registries, ingress, operators and service mesh. Apply Site Reliability Engineering principles to improve availability, resilience, observability, performance and operational supportability of the platform. Implement and enhance monitoring, logging and alerting, and use platform telemetry to identify risks, bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Lead diagnosis and resolution of complex platform incidents and recurring problems, including root-cause analysis and implementation of preventative actions. Work closely with Red Hat and other technology vendors where required to resolve product issues and support platform roadmap decisions. Produce and maintain technical documentation, engineering standards, operational runbooks and reusable platform patterns. Provide technical guidance to engineers and delivery teams adopting OpenShift, sharing knowledge and promoting strong cloud-native, DevSecOps and platform engineering practices. Skills & Experience: Strong hands-on experience engineering and operating Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform in production enterprise environments. Deep understanding of Kubernetes administration and container platform concepts, including scheduling, networking, storage, security, operators and cluster lifecycle management. Strong Linux / Red Hat Enterprise Linux administration and troubleshooting capability. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation, particularly Terraform and Ansible. Practical experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD approaches for platform engineering, with tools such as Argo CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Tekton or Azure DevOps. Strong understanding of platform security, including RBAC, network segmentation, certificate management, secrets, vulnerability management and secure container supply chains. Experience with observability and operational tooling for container platforms, including monitoring, logging, alerting and performance analysis. Strong troubleshooting skills across the OpenShift stack, with the ability to diagnose complex issues spanning platform, network, storage, security and application integration. Experience working within large enterprise environments where availability, resilience, auditability and controlled change are important. Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and work effectively across engineering, architecture and operations teams. Preferred Experience: Experience deploying or operating OpenShift on bare-metal or virtualised on-premises infrastructure. Experience with Red Hat platform technologies such as Advanced Cluster Management (RHACM), Advanced Cluster Security (RHACS), OpenShift Data Foundation (ODF), Quay, Service Mesh, Keycloak or Satellite. Experience supporting highly available, multi-cluster or disaster-recovery OpenShift architectures. Exposure to public cloud and hybrid platform services, particularly Azure and/or AWS. Experience in financial services, critical national infrastructure or another highly regulated environment. Experience coaching other engineers, leading technical workstreams or acting as a subject matter expert within a platform engineering team. Preferred Certifications: Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration. Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or relevant Red Hat automation certification. Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA). HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate or equivalent infrastructure automation certification.

63b00bf7ef82c3807136.description: Company Description Element Six has an exciting opportunity for a Cost Accountant to join our Global Costing Finance Team, reporting to the Cost Accounting Manager. This is a key role providing high-quality cost accounting, inventory and operational finance support across our High Pressure High Temperature (HPHT) and Chemical Vapour Deposition (CVD) businesses. Based at our production site in Shannon, you will play an important part in supporting operational and commercial decision-making. Working closely with colleagues across production, finance and commercial teams, you will ensure that costing information is accurate, timely and well controlled. Your responsibilities will include cost accounting for both HPHT and CVD operations, budgeting and forecasting, costing scenarios, manufacturing variance analysis and operational performance reporting. You will also have the opportunity to use digital tools, including Power BI and AI-enabled solutions, to improve the efficiency, quality and insight of financial analysis and reporting. Job Description Manage and maintain standard costing processes, including product standards, purchased material costs, bills of material, routing times, work centre rates and key costing assumptions. Deliver accurate and timely month-end activities, including work order management, closure and reporting of manufacturing variances. Maintain accurate costing data within JDE and other ERP systems, including item creation, cost roll-ups, standard cost freezes, inventory records and financial reporting attributes. Calculate, monitor and analyse manufacturing recoveries, work order, price and currency variances, inventory revaluations, and under- or over-absorption. Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

 

The Role:

We are looking for a visionary and strategic Field CTO with a "learn-it-all" mindset to serve as a high-impact technical advisor for our most strategic prospects and customers. In this role, you will act as a peer to client executives, translating complex business transformations into scalable technical strategies. You will drive innovation by championing Process Intelligence ,Agentic AI and Enterprise Modernization, ensuring our technology aligns with the evolving needs of the global market.

The work you’ll do:

  • Executive Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to C-level executives, aligning their long-term strategic goals with the Celonis technical vision.
  • Strategic Architecture & Roadmap: Lead the overarching data, cloud, and innovation strategy for our largest global accounts, utilizing methodologies like Capability Mapping to identify high-value opportunities.
  • Innovation Leadership: Architect "first-of-a-kind" solutions using emergent technologies like Agentic AI to solve complex enterprise challenges.
  • Sales & Business Impact: Partner with Sales and Value Engineering driving revenue through new customer acquisition and strategic up-selling.
  • Product Advocacy: Act as a critical feedback loop between our Product & Engineering teams and the market, ensuring the voice of the customer shapes our future offerings.
  • Thought Leadership: Develop and deliver customer-facing position papers, assets, and presentations that establish our brand as a leader in architecture and innovation.

The qualifications you need:

  • Experience: 15 to 20 years of relevant experience, ideally having served as a CTO at a consulting firm, as Field CTO at a software vendor, or Director/VP of Enterprise Architecture within a major corporation.
  • Strategic Communication: Proven track record of presenting complex technical visions to C-suite stakeholders in a way that emphasizes business value.
  • Modernization Expertise: Deep experience in Enterprise Modernization, EA Methodologies, and a robust understanding of Agentic AI.
  • Technical Versatility: Ability to pivot from high-level architecture diagrams to hands-on demo.
  • Technical Foundation: Excellent background in Data Architecture, API ecosystems, and cloud-native SaaS solutions like Salesforce and ServiceNow. 
  • ERP/Domain: Strong knowledge of Oracle
  • Education: MSc degree in Computer Science or an equivalent IT-related field.

Preferred:

  • Tech Stack: Celonis, OCPM and Case Centric Data Pipelines.
  • Certifications: TOGAF/Zachmann , AWS/Azure/GCP , and ESB/ETL certifications (e.g., Mulesoft, Informatica).
  • Industry Breadth: Experience across at least two domains (e.g., Finance, Supply Chain) and two industries (e.g., Pharma, Banking, Aerospace)

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

$204,000—$272,000 USD

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist to support the development and implementation of AI-driven solutions, intelligent automation and digital workforce initiatives across the organisation. The successful candidate will play a key role in translating business challenges into practical AI solutions, supporting the development of LLM-based applications and intelligent digital coworkers, and identifying opportunities to improve business processes through data science, advanced analytics and AI technologies. Working across enterprise-level AI programmes and business-led initiatives, the Data Scientist will contribute to the design, development, testing and deployment of AI capabilities, helping move solutions from proof of concept into production. The role will also support the development of robust AI governance frameworks, data models and reusable technical capabilities to enable the responsible and scalable adoption of AI. This is an opportunity to join a growing AI function at an early stage of its maturity, with significant scope to influence the organisation’s AI strategy, technical capabilities and approach to intelligent automation. Key Responsibilities AI & Machine Learning Development Design, develop and implement AI and machine learning solutions to address business challenges and improve operational efficiency. Develop LLM-based applications, AI agents and intelligent workflows using technologies such as LangGraph and other relevant large language model frameworks. Support the development of digital coworkers and AI-powered assistants as part of enterprise-wide AI programmes. Build and enhance business-led AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and associated Microsoft technologies. Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions, evaluating their feasibility, performance and potential business value before production deployment. Support the transition of successful AI use cases into production, including testing, performance monitoring and continuous improvement. AI Use Case Identification & Delivery Work with business stakeholders to identify, assess and prioritise AI opportunities across functions and processes. Translate business requirements into technical designs, AI models and practical solutions. Evaluate potential use cases based on business value, technical feasibility, implementation complexity, risk and scalability. With over 7,000 colleagues across our stores, warehouses and offices in Ireland and Northern Ireland we are a big and ambitious team. We know our people are our greatest asset and our success is down to the commitment and dedication of our team. Training and Development At Lidl, your career isn’t just a job - it’s an investment. We’re big on growth, and we give you all the support, structure, and hands-on experience you need to level up both personally and professionally. As the only City & Guilds/ILM Accredited Graduate Programme in Ireland , our 18-month Graduate Management Development Programme is built entirely around you . What makes it different? Tailored To You: Enjoy a bespoke training plan mapped to your unique skills and long-term career goals. Real-World Experience: Get stuck into our stores and distribution centers to learn the heart of our business from the ground up. Blended Learning: Experience dynamic, structured on-the-job training combined with industry-leading modules. We don't just hire graduates—we build future leaders. Ready to launch yours? Store Layouts, In-Store Experience & Technology Ready to shape the future of retail? Sales graduates will gain experience in two distinct teams within the Sales Head Office Department: Store Layouts & Experience and Sales Systems & Solutions. The Sales department is focussed on in-store experience and technology and is responsible for improving how millions of customers shop and navigate in our 230+ stores. As part of the programme, graduates will spend time working in store at the start of their programme to gain an in-depth experience of how our stores operate. The Store Layout & Experience team is responsible for creating engaging, intuitive store layouts that maximise space and allow customers to find their favourite products easily. The team leads projects to continually test and refine layouts and works alongside commercial teams to place new and exciting products on Lidl shelves each week. Sales Systems & Solutions drives the technology customers rely on, including shelf checkouts, electronic shelf labels, and traditional checkouts. The team analyzes customer touchpoints and implements next-generation payment innovations to simplify the customer experience. What you'll need An expected or attained 2.1 Honours Level 8 degree Full driver’s license is required An innovative and creative approach to problem solving. Customer First: a genuine passion for customer satisfaction. Strong personal, communication and presentation skills that will allow you to work and communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders. Motivated and eager to learn Once your store training is complete, you will be based in our head office and must be able to commute to Dublin What you'll receive We offer a competitive and transparent salary system, that ensures pay equality across all positions at Lidl €45,500 per annum pro rata 20 days holidays per annum pro rata Private employee medical insurance Flexible start and finish times City & Guilds/ILM assured programme Initial training and on-going development from an experienced team member Responsibility for and involvement in projects with real business impact Excellent opportunities for career progression Bespoke training plan depending on current skills and career path One-to-one coaching available from a qualified coach in the business A vast array of training and development opportunities from our in-house training catalogue including Leadership Development Programmes Masterclasses with renowned business experts Director and graduate mentorship programme Modern office facility with free parking On-site gym and canteen Up to 2 days remote working per week Mobile and broadband discounts with Three network Unlock a flex pot allowance to spend on a selection of benefits after 6 months of service Lidl is an equal opportunities employer. We value diversity and inclusion in our workplace and want to ensure that all applicants have the same opportunity regardless of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, age, disability, race, religious belief, political opinion or membership of the traveller community.

646f991f40874c03e9f5.description: DESCRIPTION Important â Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying. Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary team to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers â from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. Your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide. Each day, you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will help prioritize activities that support data center capacity, availability, and safety, focusing on the actions that are most impactful â and you will have the opportunity to work on projects both locally and globally. If this sounds exciting to you, come build the future with us! This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time engineering position, subject to available roles and business needs. Who Should Apply We welcome applications from: Students in the last year of their Bachelor's or Master's degree (graduating 2027) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline, who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career. About the Role As an intern, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers, from design through operation. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will build your subject matter expertise and serve as an engineering resource for your region, applying what you learn to real technical challenges. You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. What You Will Do Perform design and equipment submittal reviews for new data centers in your region Troubleshoot issues, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site and equipment failures Support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews (including for critical equipment), and event support Collaborate with the internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, and environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered Work on concurrent projects, sometimes across multiple geographical regions Internship Structure Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday to Friday. Please note that full-time engineering roles may operate on a rotating shift pattern, which could include days, evenings, weekends, and public holidays, as well as on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying. Your Career at Amazon â A Universe of Opportunity At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go. From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help design, troubleshoot, and support the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed â and you will see your work come to life at massive scale. Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you help support power it all. Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains â they get tested, refined, and put into practice. Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon. Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape. About the Team AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS In the last year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or another equivalent technical discipline, graduating in 2027/2028 Knowledge of Power Systems, Fluid Dynamics, and/or Thermodynamics Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Knowledge of Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems Coursework in commercial or industrial power systems and/or mechanical systems Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.

64886d4ba06122080fa4.description: Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges. At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We  believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation. Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do. Who You'll Work With Going far beyond the standard call center or tiered support position, the Technical Solutions Engineer at Arista Networks is a top level engineer, equivalent to a Tier 3 or Escalation Engineer in most support organizations. The TSE works in a non-silo environment, supporting all of Arista’s products and the many network protocols and features covered by EOS. He or she will work directly with both the customer and (when needed) the software and hardware development teams. The TSE team also performs all their own recreates in a dedicated lab environment. Giving customers direct access to a high-level engineer streamlines the support process and raises customer satisfaction. What You'll Do Respond to customer product inquiries via telephone or in written, internet-based email. Resolve customer concerns raised during installation, operation, maintenance or product application or compatibility matters. Interpersonal skills and product knowledge and expertise are critical to responding to daily customer-centric activities. Troubleshoot problems with hardware equipment and software applications and recommends corrective action. Document customer communication and recurring technical issues to support product quality programs and product development. Required Product Knowledge and Technical Skills: Working knowledge of networking industry, products, and protocols Minimum of 1-5 years hands-on experience and a combination of the following; designing, deploying, configuring, supporting, trouble shooting, debugging and administering the following network protocols and technologies: AAA/TACACS, ACL, ARP, BGP (RFC 4271), DHCP, 1G/10G Ethernet (IEEE 802.3ab & IEEE 802.3ae), Flow Control, ICMP, IGMP, IPv4 & IPv6, LACP, LLDP, MPLS, NAT, Open Flow, OSPF (RFC 2328), PIM, QOS, RIP, Sflow, SNMP, STP/RSTP/MST (IEEE 802.1d), VARP/VRRP, VLAN (IEEE 802.1q), VRF Experience with troubleshooting tools such as IXIA, tcpdump, and Wireshark (or similar packet generation and analysis tools) is highly desired A strong comfort level with Linux is highly desired Familiarity with programming/scripting (C++, Java, Python, Perl, JavaScript, shell) a plus #LI-EO1 Desired Skills: The ideal candidate possesses the ability to troubleshooting complex and dynamic customer environments while balancing the communications needs of each case. A strong analytical mind is required, as is the ability to triage. As we are continually releasing new features and products, a high aptitude for both learning and teaching are required. Our engineers work closely with other members of Customer Engineering as well as both Software and Hardware development—both in diagnosing problems as well as communicating them in multiple technical contexts. Thus, excellent written and verbal communication skills are a must, as is a collaborative approach. Education: Minimum education is a MS in a technical field (CS/EE/ITP preferred). Industry certifications preferred. Prior TAC experience preferred.

Back to jobs Software Engineer, Business Technology New York City, NY | Seattle, WA; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is looking for product engineers to build internal products. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and design—you'll own outcomes, not just tasks. You'll work directly with users to understand their needs, identify the patterns behind their requests, and build the right abstractions that unlock capabilities for everyone. What you'll do: Rapidly design, prototype, and ship full-stack features across backend, frontend, and infrastructure Consult with users and stakeholders to understand workflows and identify the highest-impact opportunities Spot patterns across user requests and reduce them into primitives, platforms, or middleware that support a variety of use cases—not just one-off features Build tools that maximize autonomy and creative freedom for less-technical users Make product and prioritization decisions, not just execute on specs handed to you Iterate quickly based on feedback to continuously improve the user experience Pick up new tools, frameworks, and domains as the product evolves You may be a good fit if you: Have 6+ years of experience building production software, ideally full-stack Can operate as a team of one when needed—you're independently capable of taking a product from idea to shipped, even if you won't always work that way Think in systems and abstractions—you see the platform behind the feature request Care about empowering users, not just building for them Own outcomes, not just code—you care whether the thing you built actually solved the problem Are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and operating with ambiguity Hold yourself to a high bar without needing external pressure Strong candidates will have: Proficiency across the stack (we use Python, TypeScript, React) Experience building platforms, primitives, or internal tools that others build on top of A track record of shipping products independently—not just contributing to larger efforts Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 - $405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!. Job Description At Version 1, we are passionate about delivering impactful digital transformation solutions for our customers. We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer (Java & Angular) to join our team. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining modern, scalable web applications, working across both front-end and back-end technologies. This role offers the opportunity to work in an agile environment using modern technologies, cloud platforms, and engineering best practices while contributing to mission-critical services used by thousands of users. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot and Angular. Build responsive, accessible and user-centric web applications. Develop and consume RESTful APIs and microservices. Contribute to solution design, technical architecture and estimation activities. Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code following engineering best practices. Perform unit, integration and system testing to ensure solution quality. Collaborate with cross-functional agile teams to deliver high-quality software solutions. Participate in code reviews and promote a culture of continuous improvement. Support CI/CD pipelines and DevOps ways of working. Contribute to technical discussions, innovation initiatives and knowledge-sharing activities. Qualifications Essential Skills & Experience Proven commercial experience as a Full Stack Developer. Strong experience developing applications using Java and the Spring Boot/Spring Framework ecosystem. Strong experience developing modern web applications using Angular.
