71d420875aa718432ce8.description: Overview Susquehanna is seeking talented graduates to join their growing Dublin office in August 2027. As a quantitative strategy developer at Susquehanna , you'll be part of a high-performing team that builds some of the most powerful trading systems in the finance industry. This is a computationally intensive role that will allow you to utilize both your data analysis and technology skills. You will have the chance to work on challenging projects related to systems that support both active trading and quantitative analysis. You'll tackle complex problems for our trading strategy development teams in areas such as signal creation and detection, quantitative strategy analysis, and low-latency C++ strategy development. You'll also work desk-side, alongside senior developers who understand the nuances of building complex trading strategies. What we're looking for Class of 2027: You are a master’s or bachelor’s student in their final year of study, majoring in a quantitative and/or STEM discipline such as computer science, computer engineering, mathematics or data science for example. Clear C ommunicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others . Ambitious: You’re someone that enjoys setting personal goals and giving your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics, or another passion; you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential. Technically Proficient: Strong software development skills in (Python and a compiled language) . Experience and comfort working with data using libraries such as Pandas, Polars, or NumPy . You will have exceptional quantitative, logical reasoning, and analytical skills. Problem Solver : When it comes to solving problems, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions. What's in it for you: Education: We are renowned for our market-leading education and training programmes . You will start off in a multiweek education program designed to give you a broad understanding of the spaces where quantitative strategy developers add value. Once you complete education, you’ll be placed on a trading team that aligns with your interests and background. This will give you the best preparation possible for a career in quantitative strategy development. Collaboration : You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology. Culture : We are not your typical trading firm  - o ur non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive , and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long y ou’ve been in Susquehanna. Perks : We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our graduates . Located in Ireland's Financial Services Centre, in the heart of Dublin's city centre , our office features free onsite catering, a games room, and a fully equipped in-house gym. Throughout the summer, interns enjoy weekly social events. For those joining us from outside Dublin, we also provide accommodation for the duration of the internship. About Susquehanna Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. Additional details The interview process for this role will be a series of interviews including coding, mathematics, system design and behavioural interviews. Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us. If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com . Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.

71dc6f4bb80897d7170f.description: Wij zijn op zoek naar een dynamische en veelzijdige Data Consultant om ons team te versterken. De ideale kandidaat beschikt over een unieke combinatie van consultancyvaardigheden, projectmanagementexpertise en een verkoopgerichte mentaliteit, samen met een diepgaand begrip van datamanagement en datastrategieprincipes. Deze rol vereist een individu die zich moeiteloos kan aanpassen aan diverse projecten en klantbehoeften, en zakelijke successen kan stimuleren door middel van effectieve datastrategieën. Als Data & Strategy Consultant bij adesso speel je een cruciale rol in het helpen van onze klanten om het volledige potentieel van hun data te benutten. Deze functie vraagt om een professional die niet alleen de fijne kneepjes van datamanagement begrijpt, maar ook uitblinkt in projectmanagement en business development. Jouw primaire verantwoordelijkheid zal zijn om de kloof te overbruggen tussen technische data-oplossingen en zakelijke doelstellingen, zodat onze klanten weloverwogen, data-gedreven beslissingen kunnen nemen. Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden: Consultancy & Klantbetrokkenheid: Fungeren als een vertrouwde adviseur voor klanten, waarbij je hun zakelijke behoeften begrijpt en op maat gemaakte datamanagement- en strategische oplossingen biedt. Workshops en bijeenkomsten faciliteren om eisen te verzamelen, bevindingen te presenteren en actiegerichte strategieën aan te bevelen. Sterke klantrelaties opbouwen en onderhouden om nieuwe zakelijke kansen te identificeren en te benutten. Projectmanagement: Leiding geven aan en beheren van datamanagementprojecten van start tot finish, waarbij je zorgt voor tijdige levering en naleving van budget- en kwaliteitsnormen. Projectplannen ontwikkelen, middelen toewijzen en de voortgang bewaken om projectdoelen te bereiken. Coördineren met multifunctionele teams, waaronder data-ingenieurs, analisten en andere consultants, om uitgebreide data-oplossingen te leveren. Expertise in Datamanagement: Inzichten en begeleiding bieden over datagovernance, datastrategie en data-architectuur om ervoor te zorgen dat best practices worden gevolgd. Beoordelingen uitvoeren van bestaande datamanagementprocessen en verbeteringen aanbevelen. Op de hoogte blijven van trends en ontwikkelingen in de sector om de dienstverlening voortdurend te verbeteren. Verkoop & Business Development: Potentiële use cases identificeren en leads genereren door middel van strategisch netwerken. Overtuigende presentaties en voorstellen voorbereiden en leveren om nieuwe klanten te werven. Samenwerken met het verkoopteam om verkoopstrategieën te ontwikkelen en uit te voeren die aansluiten bij de bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Flexibiliteit & Aanpassingsvermogen: Aanpassen aan verschillende projectvereisten en klantomgevingen, met flexibiliteit in aanpak en uitvoering. Een continue leermentaliteit omarmen om effectief in te spelen op evoluerende zakelijke uitdagingen. Bachelor- of Masterdiploma in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Computerwetenschappen of een gerelateerd vakgebied. Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in een dataomgeving in een rol zoals data-analist, consultant met een focus op datamanagement of soortgelijk. Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring bij een top consultancybureau in Nederland in rollen zoals Consultant, Projectmanager of soortgelijk. Vloeiend in Nederlands en Engels, zowel geschreven als gesproken. Sterke projectmanagementvaardigheden, met een bewezen staat van dienst in het succesvol leiden en opleveren van complexe projecten. Verkoopvaardigheden met het vermogen om zakelijke groei te stimuleren. Diepgaand begrip van datamanagementconcepten, waaronder datagovernance en datastrategie. Uitzonderlijke communicatie- en interpersoonlijke vaardigheden, met het vermogen om belanghebbenden op alle niveaus te betrekken en te beïnvloeden. Hoge mate van flexibiliteit en aanpassingsvermogen. Binnen adesso Nederland maak jij deel uit van een gedreven en gepassioneerd team. Je komt te werken in een klein en hecht team binnen een scale-up cultuur. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat jij je kan ontwikkelen zowel zakelijk als op persoonlijk vlak. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Onbepaaldetijds contract Fulltime/Parttime (32/40 uur) 27 vakantiedagen. Kansen voor verdere ontwikkeling en leren met een uitstekend trainings- en persoonlijk ontwikkelingsbudget van 3600 euro per jaar, waar jezelf eigenaar van bent. Studiedagen. Een mobilteitsregeling waarin je de keuze hebt uit een leaseauto of OV jaarkaart met een riante mobiliteits vergoeding. Thuiswerk faciliteiten. Vrijheid om je werkdag in te vullen. Een pensioenregeling en overige wettelijke regelingen. Aanvullende werknemersverzekeringen. Een open cultuur die kennisdeling en ervaring aanmoedigt. Aantrekkelijke carrièreperspectieven, zowel nationaal als internationaal.

71f4d44afe57c41914f1.description: Scope   automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.  Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.  Dave is an inspector. Today he's climbing through one of Europe's biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he'll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.  We're building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we're building the world's largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.  It's a $2T market and we're just getting started, with ambitions. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.  We've assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.  Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by   Index Ventures  , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with 100+ unicorns backed to date.     About the role   We're hiring our first Product Designer.  Every engineer at Scope is a product engineer: they talk to users, decide what to build and ship it themselves. You'll work the same way, with design as your edge, and help the engineers around you to build a better product. That covers the whole experience, not just the surface: which problem we solve, how the flow works, what happens when things go wrong, and how it all looks. You'll work closely with the engineers, with Ish our Product Manager, and with Jakob the CTO.  We work in person five days a week from our office in Farringdon.     What you'll work on   Some examples of surfaces in our product that will need your help:    Our mobile app gets used inside tanks and on top of pressure vessels. People wear thick gloves, there's usually no signal, and one hand is often holding on to something. Most of what makes a normal app pleasant doesn't apply there, so a big part of the job is figuring out what does.    Then there's the report. How AI and the inspector will work together to produce 40 page reports and review them is something nobody has designed well yet.    Inspectors but also decision makers should be able to ask things like "Which tanks were over the corrosion limit last year?". Sometimes the right interface will be a chat but often it isn't.     What you'll do     Go on site with inspectors and test your designs there, gloves and all.    Own the design of every launch, down to the empty states.    Prototype fast, in code when it helps.    Work next to engineers while they build, so the details come out right.    Decide with Ish and Jakob which problems are worth solving.    Build the design system that lets engineers ship great work without waiting on you.     Who you are     Minimum 3 years designing products that were shipped.    A portfolio that shows the messy middle, not just the final screens.    You sweat the mobile details: touch targets, offline, errors.    You have opinions on where AI helps and where it gets in the way.    You'd happily put on a hard hat to understand a problem.    Bonus if you've designed for industrial or field work, or prototype in code.       Interview process     Intro call.    Portfolio deep dive with Ish and an engineer: one project, including what went wrong.    Interview with a cofounder: Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO and CPO).    Onsite: a real Scope design problem, worked on with the team, then a short presentation.    Offer!     What we offer     £70k to £100k base + significant equity, so you have a stake in what you are building    Full visa sponsorship, giving us access to global talent and an international, diverse team    Tools to do your job, including a brand new MacBook and Scope merch    Generous above-market annual leave allowance    Bupa private medical (0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered) + Bupa dental    Employee pension through NEST    Flexible parental leave (including adoption leave)    Healthy meal-prep lunch and dinners, a fully stocked fridge, and team lunches on Fridays    Regular events including off-sites     We value diverse perspectives. If you don't match every point above but this is the kind of problem you want to work on, we strongly encourage you to apply.   Find more  English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom  on Arbeitnow

721d77cf5ef8922c25da.description: Description **This is a 6 month internship starting in April 2027** We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow. Would you like to use the latest cloud computing technologies? Do you have an interest in helping customers understand application architectures and integration approaches? Are you familiar with best practices for applications, servers, and networks? Do you want to be part of a customer facing technology team helping to ensure the success of AWS as a leading technology organization? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the market leader and technology forerunner in the cloud business. As a member of the AWS support team you will be at the forefront of this transformational technology, assisting a global list of companies and developers that are taking advantage of a growing set of services and features to run their mission-critical applications. As an Amazon intern, you will be interacting with your peers and the AWS global team of full-time professionals as part of our AWS Cloud Support team. You will benefit from the opportunity to gain experience on our cloud services, hands on training, and learning as you go. If you fit the description, you could be the person we are looking for. We are a group of smart people, passionate about cloud computing, and believe that world-class support is critical to customer success. Come build the future with us. Key job responsibilities Each day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you: Learn and use ground-breaking technologies. Complete AWS certifications. Work on projects that improve support-related processes with fellow interns in other locations. Design, build and deploy tools/applications for AWS Support Engineers. Interact with leading engineers around the world. Partner with AWS teams. A day in the life Why us? The Cloud Support Associate Internship Program provides interns with the technical and functional skills training based on Cloud Support Builder standards. On a typical day, a Cloud Support Builder will be primarily responsible for solving customer’s cases through customer contact channels (e.g., telephone, email, and web/live chat). They apply troubleshooting techniques to provide solutions for our customers by thoughtfully working with customers to dive deep into the root cause of an issue. A Cloud Support Builder may also develop, train, partner with development teams on complex issues or contact deflection initiatives, participate in new hiring, write tools/script to help the team, or work with leadership on process improvement and strategic initiatives. About The Team If you’re insatiably curious and always want to learn more, then you’ve come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you as an intern. Competitive pay Impactful project and internship/role deliverables Networking opportunities with fellow interns Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions. Mentorship and career development The internship is a fixed term program, the start date will be April 2027 for a duration of 6 months. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and leveraging our unique perspectives to scale our impact and grow. Amazon has 13 affinity groups (https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups), sometimes known as employee resource groups, which bring employees together across businesses and locations around the world. With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work. If you have a disability and need an adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT): https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/uk Basic Qualifications Currently enrolled in or will receive a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Tech with a graduation date in 2028 Basic knowledge of at least one functional scripting language (e.g., Perl, Python, Ruby, shell scripting). Basic knowledge of Networking and Databases. Basic knowledge of Operation Systems Windows and/or Linux. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of internet fundamentals and cloud computing concepts. Familiarity with Database, Storage, & Big Data concepts. Knowledge of Networking fundamentals like CIDR notations, OSI model, DNS, HTTP, TCP/UDP, DHCP, routing, switching, subnets, NAT. Comfortable working in a Linux/Unix environment. Customer facing work experience. Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. 721e4d32729eff5fa462.description: Responsibilities About the Team TikTok's Scaled Growth team aims to help businesses and brands of all sizes unleash their creative side, connect with our audience, or perhaps be discovered! From executing scaled sales and service delivery programs to ensuring our customers have best-in-class tools and products at their fingertips, our Scaled Growth team combines operational expertise and sales acumen with a customer-centric mindset to help businesses achieve their marketing goals on TikTok. We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume. Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early. Responsibilities Be responsible for EMEA large Indie Agency acquisition and onboarding. Achieve sales targets and execute efficiently to achieve pipeline goals. Drive new Large Indie Agency partnerships through navigating through agency's complex organization. Proactively build and maintain good relationships with Large Indie Agencies and platform partners to help enhance the company’s brand and industry influence. Take the initiative to identify new cooperation opportunities in the industry and promote business development. Keep abreast of industry trends to ensure that business development aligns with the cutting-edge direction of AI technology and user acquisition strategies. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's degree. Experience in business development experience in Indie Agency or digital advertising business. English speaker with excellent communication and expression skills. Strong ability to develop new customers and markets, with successful cases preferred. Strong resistance and ability to adapt to a dynamic, fast-paced working environment. Strong self-motivation, result-oriented, and focused on achieving measurable outcomes. 7227b7ed958fa6a01a5c.description: About the Role Imagine pioneering the mathematical and logical foundations that enable AI to fly safely in real-world, safety-critical aviation. As a Machine Learning Certification Researcher, you will address one of the most fundamental challenges in modern AI: proving that ML models are safe, reliable, and mathematically sound for deployment in autonomous flight. Your work will bridge the gap between cutting-edge statistical learning theory and formal aviation certification frameworks, building upon previous work (EASA CoDANN I and II, and FAA report DOT/FAA/TC-21/48), and putting real-world systems to the test. At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision—developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most. What You'll Do • AI Certification Strategy: Analyze our existing AI certification strategy and help adapt it—or pioneer entirely new strategies—to certify different supervised ML. • EASA Framework Alignment: Connect mathematical guarantees, technical arguments, and model evaluations to the EASA W-shaped process for AI certification in aviation, ensuring our research aligns with the latest regulatory guidelines. • Theoretical Foundation & Modeling: Conduct research into statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and mathematical guarantees for deep neural networks operating under dynamic real-world conditions. • Uncertainty Quantification: Apply statistics and stochastic processes to model environmental uncertainties and sensor noise, and to quantify confidence in performance metrics. • Literature & Proof Evaluation: Critically evaluate academic literature, mathematical proofs, and engineering assumptions with peer-review rigor to identify safety limitations and theoretical gaps in state-of-the-art AI. • Regulatory & Audit Justification: Construct robust, logical arguments and technical justifications that translate complex, high-dimensional empirical data into structured evidence for safety audits and certification frameworks. • Algorithmic Validation: Write clean, reproducible code in Python to test theoretical hypotheses, validate certification mechanisms, and benchmark model safety frameworks. Requirements What You'll Need Machine Learning Theory & Mathematics • ML Theory & Statistical Learning: Deep understanding of statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and the mathematical foundations of deep neural networks. • Statistics & Stochastic Processes: Strong background in advanced probability, statistical modeling, and stochastic processes. • Python Engineering: Proficiency in Python with the ability to write clean, reproducible code (can also be learned on the job provided strong theoretical foundations and basic Python coding). Research Rigor • Scientific Research Methodology: Demonstrated capability or background in conducting comprehensive literature reviews, identifying gaps in current state-ofthe-art AI, and synthesizing complex academic concepts into actionable engineering frameworks (can also be learned on the job if you possess a strong quantitative baseline). • Peer Review Expertise: Ability or experience in the peer-review process—capable of critically evaluating mathematical proofs, algorithmic assumptions, and research papers to assess their validity and limitations. Education • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Theoretical Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative research field. Who You Are • Critical Thinking & Healthy Skepticism: You possess a strong spirit of questioning everything. You naturally challenge conventional ML assumptions, probe for hidden edge cases, and refuse to take empirical accuracy at face value without rigorous proof. • Logical Argument Building: You have an exceptional ability to construct robust, airtight logical arguments and technical justifications. You can translate complex empirical observations into structured, defensible evidence that satisfies strict engineering and regulatory scrutiny. • Thrives in Ambiguity: You are motivated by hard, unsolved mathematical problems at the intersection of theoretical computer science, safety engineering, and real-world flight operations

Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Support Engineer 2.

About the job

This position is needed for you to join the Support team and provide excellent technical support to users of the Email platform. Wearing the customer’s shoes is one of the core values of our company and excellent Support is what our customers have come to expect and love about Twilio. If you are a technically savvy individual who enjoys mentoring and raising the bar, and is also customer-focused with excellent communication skills, keep reading!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Provide product support for a wide range of customer inquiries received via telephone, email, social media and chat.
  • Assess the nature of product or service issues and resolve a variety of complex  support problems. 
  • Log customer interactions and tag/categorize issues accordingly. 
  • Resolve a monthly volume of tickets consistent 
  • Be the point of escalation for middle complex issues within support, and escalate to Product and Engineering teams as necessary.
  • Identify ways to improve existing processes and procedures.
  • Mentor  newer members of the Customer Support team with customer issues.
  • Contribute content to knowledge base to support team and customer enablement
  • Ensure Support SLAs and CSAT goals are consistently met and ticket queues are well managed
  • Other duties as required
  • Incident report and Oncall

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 3+ years experience in a client-facing customer/technical support role, supporting Email, Communications, SaaS or related technologies
  • A demonstrated history of customer focus, empathy, active listening, and the ability to diplomatically address customer concerns and provide feedback
  • Experience communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone or email
  • Strong, creative problem solving skills
  • Quick learner, willing to take initiative, and has great follow through
  • A demonstrated ability to remain calm and effective at higher workloads as well as excelling at prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency
  • A high-energy, optimistic outlook and positive attitude
  • An empathetic approach to troubleshooting and customer service
  • A demonstrated attention to detail, with the ability to quickly ramp up on new products, new technologies, and evolving customer or business needs
  • Accountability - Being willing to answer for the outcomes resulting from their own choices, behaviors, and actions. Take ownership of situations that they're involved in
  • Self Motivation - Motivated to do or achieve something because of one's own enthusiasm or interest, without needing pressure from others
  • Focus - Achieve what they set out to do before launching new initiatives. Complete company-linked goals and tasks, not simply to be busy and active
  • Experience with the following:
  • Willing to work from 8.00 AM to 5.00 PM Ireland Local time Tuesday - Saturday.

Desired:

  • Reading/Debugging HTML (a plus)
  • SQL (a plus)
  • Experience with SFDC, QuickBooks, Zuora or other financial management software and financial principles a plus for some roles (Billing)
  • Postman or other APIs client

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a threat intel manager to build and run our Model Exploitation & Fraud team within Threat Intelligence. This team detects, investigates, and disrupts the large-scale exploitation of Anthropic's AI systems. Model distillation,  unauthorized access, account farming and reseller abuse, and fraud and scam operations.

You will set the strategy for the mission area, hire and lead a small team of technical investigators, and build the systems, processes, and partnerships that let the team scale. The team includes established senior investigators who own our deepest technical casework,  tracing distillation networks, reseller and proxy ecosystems, and financially motivated actors across first-party surfaces and third-party platforms; your job is to direct, resource, and amplify that work, not duplicate it. This area carries regular U.S. government engagement and requires deeply understanding external black market ecosystems and how they interact with our systems.

Important context: In this position you may be exposed to explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. This role may require responding to escalations during weekends and holidays.

Key responsibilities

  • Own strategy, priorities, and outcomes for the Model Exploitation & Fraud mission area; define what we detect, investigate, action, and share
  • Hire, manage, and develop a team of technical threat investigators; set the quality bar for casework and intelligence reporting
  • Design clear lanes between this role and the team's senior individual contributors: strategy, people leadership, and program ownership sit with you, while ownership of the deepest technical investigations and tradecraft stays with the senior experts closest to the work
  • Capable of independently leading complex investigations. 
  • Direct, prioritize, and resource complex investigations into model distillation, unauthorized AI R&D usage, unauthorized access, coordinated account abuse, and fraud/scam networks, partnering with the senior investigators who lead the deepest technical casework and clearing blockers from their path
  • Drive the redesign of triage for a very high-volume detection pipeline: partner with investigators and engineering to build abuse signals, clustering, and agentic investigation workflows that separate sophisticated actors from noise
  • Expand the team's coverage into fraud and scams, building the detection and investigation playbooks from the ground up
  • Own the external engagement program for the area, including regular intelligence sharing with U.S. government partners and industry peers, ensuring the investigators driving the work are visible in those channels
  • Anticipate how resellers, proxies, and third-party platforms change the abuse surface, and shape coverage accordingly
  • Work with policy, enforcement, and engineering to convert findings into bans, product mitigations, and safety-by-design improvements
  • Define and report the team's metrics; brief Safeguards and company leadership on the threat landscape

Minimum qualifications

  • Have led and managed investigative, fraud, platform integrity, or threat intelligence teams, ideally ones built around senior, deeply specialized individual contributors
  • Have strong domain fluency in scaled abuse — fraud patterns, account abuse, unauthorized access, or platform exploitation economics — sufficient to set priorities, pressure-test findings, and earn the confidence of expert investigators
  • Are proficient enough in SQL and Python to review data-heavy casework, pressure-test conclusions, and provide surge capacity when the team needs it
  • Have experience overseeing investigations that track threat actors across surface, deep, and dark web environments, including reseller and access-broker communities
  • Have working familiarity with large language models and a strong grasp of how models can be distilled, extracted, or exploited at scale
  • Have built processes, detection systems, or programs from scratch and can show what changed because of them
  • Communicate crisply with executives, engineers, and external partners alike

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience at a major technology platform on trust and safety, fraud, or abuse investigations at scale
  • Background in financial crime investigation or fraud analytics
  • Experience working directly with U.S. government stakeholders on threat reporting
  • A track record of partnering with, growing, and retaining senior technical specialists, including defining clear scope between management and senior IC tracks
  • Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and/or Russian with nuanced regional and geopolitical context
  • Active Top Secret security clearance

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$375,000—$455,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. You will join a team where quality, innovation and practical problem solving are central to everyday work. As a Graduate Developer, you would join our technical team. Depending on project needs, you may work with JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Oracle Integration Cloud and Oracle Fusion Cloud applications. With support from experienced developers, consultants and architects, you will contribute to customer projects and internal development activities while building your technical skills. This is an entry-level opportunity for someone who enjoys problem solving, coding and learning how business systems work. The programme is expected to start in September 2027 and is open to recent graduates as well as final-year students preparing to begin their careers. Over 12 months, you will take part in formal training, internal development modules and project-based learning designed to help you: Work effectively with others in technical and project teams Build confidence as a self-directed learner and apply new knowledge in day-to-day work Use critical thinking to solve practical technical problems The role is initially office-based in Limerick, with the opportunity to move to a hybrid working structure and/or client-based work depending on project requirements. Learn the JD Edwards development environment and support applications, reports and technical extensions where relevant. Investigate defects, troubleshoot issues and work with the team to implement and document fixes. Prepare clear technical documentation, setup notes and handover materials. An understanding of databases and SQL, with an interest in how applications exchange data. An interest in web development and some familiarity with HTML, CSS or front-end frameworks through coursework or personal projects. A methodical approach to problem solving, testing and learning unfamiliar systems. Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work well with colleagues in local and remote teams. Awareness of the software development life cycle and object-oriented design principles. Mentorship and progression: You will be supported by experienced developers, consultants and technical leads who will help you build confidence, understand customer environments and develop good engineering practices. Through regular feedback, coaching and project exposure, you will have the opportunity to progress from supported graduate work towards more independent technical delivery. What we offer: Career growth within an expanding global Oracle Partner. Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship. Competitive salary and benefits package. Flexible working arrangements, including remote options where suitable, to support a healthy work-life balance. Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. To apply: Please submit your CV via LinkedIn or send your CV to careers@redfaire.com with your name and “Graduate Developer” in the subject line.

75dea92f3d56c9c2a913.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Investor Relations team manages our relationships with shareholders, prospective investors, and the broader financial community, and helps educate investors on Anthropic's mission, strategy, and financial performance. As the Operations Lead for the team, you'll own the administrative and operational backbone that keeps IR running smoothly, from coordinating investor meetings and preparing the team for them to managing the vendors and logistics behind high-profile events and visits. 

You'll work directly with the Head of Investor Relations and the IR team, and cross-functionally with Finance leadership, Finance & Strategy, Capital Markets, Accounting, Corporate Legal, Communications, and Workplace, to make sure every investor touchpoint reflects well on Anthropic. Because the function is still being built, you will often be creating the process rather than following one. This role suits someone who is highly proactive, thrives on structure, anticipates needs before they arise, and enjoys being the person who makes complex logistics look effortless.

Key responsibilities

  • Schedule and coordinate investor calls, meetings, and briefings, managing calendars across multiple stakeholders and time zones, and helping the team prioritize when investor demand exceeds our capacity
  • Partner with internal teams and on-site staff to plan and execute investor events, visits, and other in-person engagements
  • Prepare the team and executives for investor conversations and capturing follow-ups afterward
  • Own vendor relationships for IR-related services, from sourcing through ongoing management of scope, budget, and performance
  • Help the team set agendas and priorities, tracking deliverables and following up to ensure commitments are met on time
  • Maintain and organize IR records, the investor contact database and interaction history, and shared materials so information stays easy to find and current, and help select and run the tools the team uses to track shareholder engagement
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and external partners on logistical and administrative questions
  • Build and document the recurring processes a growing IR function needs, from meeting request intake through post-meeting follow-up, and keep improving how the team operates day to day
  • Partner with Corporate Legal and Communications on the handling and review of investor-facing materials, so information moves through the right checks
  • Support ad hoc projects as investor relations priorities evolve

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience coordinating complex calendars, meetings, or events across multiple stakeholders
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including scope, budget, and performance tracking
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated judgment handling sensitive, confidential, and market-sensitive information with discretion
  • Comfort operating autonomously in a newly formed team, including building processes and systems that do not exist yet

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting an investor relations, capital markets, or finance leadership function, ideally in a company that was growing quickly
  • Familiarity with the needs of external-facing, high-stakes engagements
  • Experience operating in a fast-paced, high-growth company environment
  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach to identifying and solving problems before they become issues
  • Familiarity with investor relations or CRM tools for tracking shareholder engagement, and comfort using AI tools to work faster
  • Curiosity about financial markets, technology, and AI, and interest in how a research-driven company explains itself to investors

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$200,000—$265,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 763bc12b1041bb604795.description: Dublin (hybrid), with candidates elsewhere in Ireland considered. Full-time, permanent. The Role We're looking for an engineer who builds with AI daily, can make technical calls with confidence, and brings strong leadership and clear thinking to the work. Coastline Gaming operates 11 venues across Ireland plus Slotbox online casino, and bring a startup mindset to building an established and growing business. The directors use Claude Code in their own work—you won't be persuading anyone that AI-assisted building is worth doing. You'll be joining people already doing it and expected to push it further than they have. Working across online gaming and physical venues gives you an unusual mix of product and engineering challenges. You'll help build the digital customer experience and the software used on the ground, with access to the people using both. You'll have a hand in the early decisions on new builds as well as improving existing products. The role gives you room to take responsibility for projects while staying involved in the engineering yourself. What You'll Do • Build customer-facing applications and new frontends for our online casino brands. • Develop APIs and integrations that connect our customer products and business systems. • Work with staff to find where better software would help, then build internal tools that solve those problems. • Help set technical direction: how systems fit together, which architecture makes sense, and when to build, adapt or buy. • Manage several projects at once, agree priorities with the directors and give engineers clear ownership of the work. • Help other engineers work through difficult problems, review code and improve how the team builds with AI. What We're Looking For • You build with AI daily. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent tools are central to how you work. You try new approaches, know where they help and can show us what you've built. • You get to grips with unfamiliar systems quickly. You ask useful questions, test your assumptions and know when to ask someone who knows more. • You can challenge a brief. You work out whether it solves the right problem and can explain a simpler approach when there is one. • You've managed people and several projects while continuing to build yourself. You can explain what needed your attention, what you delegated and how you handled problems. Managing a small team counts. • You've earned broader responsibility within an organisation and can show what changed as you took on more. Experience building and leading in a startup or smaller team is particularly relevant. • You can make technical decisions and explain the trade-offs. You understand what a change means for the users and the other systems involved. • You judge your own work. You check AI-generated changes, look for what could fail and change your approach when the evidence calls for it. Working Here Compensation is open for the right person. You must already be based in Ireland and have the right to work in the Republic of Ireland. The main office is in Dublin and the role is hybrid; we'll consider the right person elsewhere in Ireland. How to Apply Apply directly using the "Apply" button It is essential that you send a link or attachment showing something you've built with AI alongside your CV. It can be a system, workflow, app or tool, from work or a personal project. Send a working link, repo, short video demo, write-up or presentation that shows what you built. Please add a few lines explaining what it does, your contribution or something to give us a bit of context as to what we are looking at. For confidential work, send a redacted demo or write-up that shows the build without sharing your employer's code or data.

Deliver change  alongside day-to-day People services by contributing to People Ops projects such as system enhancements, process redesign, and embedding AI-enabled solutions, while balancing inbox SLAs, operational deadlines, and project work through effective planning and prioritisation to ensure reliable delivery.       Work with People Business Partners to support cyclical People processes  and document and implement employee lifecycle changes, including personal and contractual updates.       Support the preparation, validation, and processing of the monthly UK payroll,  ensuring accurate and timely data inputs and alignment between HiBob and payroll workflows.       Deliver day-to-day benefits administration,  managing enrolments and changes accurately and resolving benefit-related issues efficiently.       Manage employee lifecycle administration,  including pre-boarding, contracts, background checks, Right to Work documentation, and visa sponsorship, ensuring employee data is accurate across systems and workflows.       Process People-related invoices and purchase orders accurately,  partnering with accounts payable and supporting effective financial administration.       Support and manage the improvement, implementation, and documentation of People policies,  processes, and templates, ensuring they remain up to date, user-friendly, and aligned with a tech-first, self-service culture. Back to jobs Technical Program Manager, Data Center Infrastructure San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role You'll drive cross-functional execution of Anthropic's data center programs from construction through commissioning and day-to-day operations. Partnering with our Data Center and Compute teams, you'll own the program management that delivers buildings on time ready for production workloads. As we scale beyond our first sites, you'll focus on accelerating construction and deployment, building repeatable playbooks, and driving continuous improvement across our growing footprint. Responsibilities: Manage and develop the DC infrastructure TPM team; hire and build out the function as we scale Lead program reviews and executive communications on delivery status, risks, and blockers Drive construction-to-production execution across multiple sites, coordinating with partners, contractors, and internal teams Own overall schedule tracking, risk identification, and mitigation; creating clear visibility for leadership Align with energy and location strategy and support site selection and due diligence criteria to facilitate scaling well in advance of aggressive compute demand Manage long pole dependencies and long-lead time development & procurement across a dynamically changing global marketplace Partner with DC and Compute teams to drive handover criteria between site completion, equipment deployment, and operations Coordinate with Infrastructure, Security, and Compliance teams on evolving requirements; versioning, optimization, and expansion across sites Drive partner accountability on contractual milestones and commercial commitments Coordinate equipment delivery and manage vendor accountability on schedules; tracking production and shipping milestones while maintaining productive partnerships Build repeatable processes and playbooks that scale across multiple concurrent site deployments Travel (20%) to sites to validate progress and build contractor relationships You may be a good fit if you: Have 7+ years in data center construction, operations, or infrastructure program management at hyperscale or critical infrastructure companies Have management experience building and leading TPM or program management teams Have led multi-site infrastructure programs with compressed timelines and complex cross-functional dependencies among multiple partners and vendors Excel at aligning multiple partners, vendors, and internal engineering teams around shared deliverables Can bridge physical infrastructure and software/security teams Thrive in ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete information under schedule pressure Communicate complex program status clearly to executives Deadline to apply: None applications will be received on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $365,000 - $435,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 77e4f970576232682395.description: Bouw dataplatformen die klaar zijn voor wat er morgen met data en AI gebeurt. Bij adesso zoeken we een Data Engineer die verder kijkt dan alleen het bouwen van pipelines. Iemand die nadenkt over hoe data wordt verzameld, gemodelleerd, ontsloten en gebruikt en die graag werkt aan moderne data-oplossingen binnen Microsoft Azure en Snowflake. Je werkt aan dataplatformen die organisaties daadwerkelijk gebruiken. Als basis voor reporting en analytics, maar steeds vaker ook voor machine learning, AI en agentic toepassingen. Jouw rol Als Data Engineer ontwerp en bouw je schaalbare data-oplossingen voor onze klanten. Je werkt aan het hele traject: van databron en architectuur tot een betrouwbaar platform waarop data daadwerkelijk gebruikt kan worden. Daarbij werk je voornamelijk binnen het Azure-ecosysteem en denk je mee over keuzes rondom architectuur, datamodellering, performance en schaalbaarheid. Je bent niet alleen degene die bouwt. Je begrijpt waarom bepaalde keuzes worden gemaakt, kunt hierover sparren met klanten en collega's en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van de oplossing. Wat ga je doen? ·       Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van schaalbare data pipelines en dataplatformen; ·       Ontwikkelen van cloud-native data-oplossingen; ·       Integreren, transformeren en ontsluiten van data uit verschillende bronnen; ·       Ontwerpen en implementeren van moderne Data Warehouse- en Lakehouse-architecturen; ·       Toepassen van datamodelleringsmethodieken zoals Kimball en Data Vault; ·       Bouwen van betrouwbare datasets voor analytics, dashboards, machine learning en AI-toepassingen; ·       Werken met technologieën zoals Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory en Snowflake; ·       Optimaliseren van performance, schaalbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid en datakwaliteit; ·       Inrichten en verbeteren van CI/CD-processen en toepassen van DataOps-principes; ·       Meedenken met klanten over data-architectuur, integraties en technische keuzes; ·       Samenwerken met Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Architects en andere specialisten binnen ons Data & AI-team. We zoeken niet iemand die ieder vinkje op een technologielijst kan zetten. We zoeken vooral een Data Engineer die een stevig technisch fundament heeft, nieuwsgierig blijft en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor wat hij of zij bouwt. Je hebt: ·       Minimaal 4 jaar relevante ervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol; ·       Sterke kennis van SQL en Python; ·       Ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van ETL/ELT-processen en data pipelines; ·       Ervaring met Microsoft Azure en relevante Azure-datadiensten, zoals Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake; ·       Ervaring met datamodellering en moderne data-architecturen, bijvoorbeeld Kimball en Data Vault; ·       Kennis van Data Warehouse- en/of Lakehouse-concepten; ·       Ervaring met CI/CD, DevOps en bij voorkeur Infrastructure as Code; ·       Oog voor datakwaliteit, performance, schaalbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid; ·       Het vermogen om technische keuzes uit te leggen en hierover met klanten en collega's te sparren; ·       Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Mooi meegenomen Heb je daarnaast ervaring met een aantal van onderstaande technologieën of onderwerpen? Mooi. Maar we verwachten niet dat je alles al hebt gedaan. ·       Microsoft Fabric; ·       Azure Databricks; ·       Azure Data Factory; ·       Snowflake; ·       Apache Spark / PySpark; ·       Delta Lake; ·       Power BI; ·       Collibra of andere data governance-oplossingen; ·       Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry of andere AI-services binnen Azure; ·       Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Terraform of Bicep. Data & AI bij adesso Data is bij ons geen losstaand onderdeel van een project. Het is steeds vaker de basis waarop nieuwe digitale oplossingen worden gebouwd. Binnen ons Data & AI-team werken Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers en andere specialisten samen aan oplossingen die verder gaan dan alleen dashboards of losse modellen. Van moderne dataplatformen en machine learning tot generative AI en agentic AI: we willen technologie niet alleen interessant vinden, maar vooral werkend krijgen bij onze klanten. Dat betekent dat je bij ons de ruimte krijgt om nieuwe technologie te ontdekken, maar ook wordt uitgedaagd om deze naar productie te brengen. Waarom adesso? Je komt terecht in een groeiend Data & AI-team waarin veel ruimte is om mee te bouwen. Aan projecten, maar ook aan onze technische richting, kennis en manier van werken. Je krijgt bij ons: ·       Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid in je projecten; ·       De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan onze Data & AI-propositie; ·       Collega's met wie je inhoudelijk kunt sparren over data, cloud en AI; ·       Ruimte om nieuwe technologie te onderzoeken én daadwerkelijk toe te passen; ·       Een internationale organisatie achter je, gecombineerd met een relatief klein en persoonlijk team in Nederland; ·       Een opleidingsbudget van €3.600 per jaar; ·       Hybride werken; ·       Een mobiliteitsregeling; ·       Een goede pensioenregeling; ·       27 vakantiedagen + 4 studie-dagen. En nu? Misschien voldoe je niet aan ieder technisch punt hierboven. Dat hoeft ook niet. Als jij sterk bent in data engineering, ervaring hebt binnen Azure en enthousiast wordt van het bouwen van moderne dataplatformen, dan maken we graag kennis.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a partnerships leader to own the tri-party motion for public sector and nonprofit partnerships selling through AWS. Public sector and nonprofit-focused partners are how Claude reaches government agencies, educational institutions, and mission-driven organizations at scale, and AWS is the surface most of that work runs on. You will own the intersection of those two ecosystems.

In this role, you will build the go-to-market motion that turns partner interest into joint pipeline and closed revenue, working across AWS's public sector partner organization and the AWS practices inside the partners that serve government and nonprofit customers. You will define how Claude is positioned inside AWS public sector partner programs, design the commercial mechanics that let partners transact and get rewarded through procurement vehicles and contract structures specific to this segment, and build the joint plays that partners take to their customers.

This is a build role. The partner ecosystem is early, the programs are still being designed, and you will be operating across three organizations whose incentives on any given deal don't always line up. You will help shape how frontier AI technology reaches the public sector and nonprofit community through the partner ecosystem, including in classified environments where required.

You will report directly to the Head of AWS GTM Partnerships and work closely with our Global Public Sector Leader.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the GTM strategy for our public sector and nonprofit partnerships through AWS, including co-selling motions, joint business plans, events, and segment-specific plays across federal, state and local, education, and nonprofit
  • Own forecasting, pipeline development, and revenue targets for partner-sourced and partner-influenced business
  • Design the commercial mechanics that make the partner motion work, including deal registration, marketplace program structure, procurement and contract vehicle alignment, and incentives
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships across AWS's public sector partner organization and across partner AWS practice leadership
  • Work with partners to develop repeatable, mission-specific solutions built on Claude, and help them build the delivery capability to take those solutions to public sector and nonprofit customers
  • Partner cross-functionally with Anthropic's alliances, public sector sales, partner marketing, policy, and regional cloud teams to keep the motion consistent while regions and segments execute locally

Anthropic sells Claude through partners as well as directly. In the public sector, those partners matter more than anywhere else. Your time will be split roughly evenly between two kinds of work. The first is partner management. As a Product Support Specialist, you’ll be at the front lines of safely delivering AI to the world, providing high-touch support to the businesses building on Claude. You’ll take the cases that need more than a help article: understanding how a customer has built on our platform (their integrations, their authentication and identity setup, their use of the models) and then investigating, diagnosing, and resolving their most complex technical needs. You’ll partner with engineers to get to the bottom of things, and with account teams to keep the customer’s trust while you do.

Additionally, you’ll help us identify and close gaps in our team’s technical knowledge, turning what you learn from each case into documentation, tooling, and product feedback so the whole team gets sharper. This is a role for someone who wants their technical depth to matter to real businesses, and who cares as much about how we systematically support customers at scale as about the case in front of them.

Responsibilities

  • Provide high-touch support to our most strategic customers, communicating clearly and empathetically with a wide range of user personas, context-switching between guiding an executive through an incident and providing critical product knowledge to an admin in need of help within the same hour
  • Serve as an escalation point for our most complex technical issues: reproducing customer issues, utilizing logs and traces, and providing solutions alongside engineers
  • Troubleshoot SSO, SAML, and OAuth authentication flows, and the integration surface where our products meet a customer’s infrastructure
  • Partner with engineers, teammates, and other internal stakeholders to diagnose and resolve user issues, both individually and at scale
  • Manage on-call tasks for high-urgency user issues with extreme ownership
  • Respond to user support cases with a variety of complexity, from questions from individuals to complex API debugging for large businesses
  • Become an expert in all Anthropic products, and delight in the hunt when something doesn’t behave as expected
  • Uplevel our team’s technical knowledge by scoping gaps, working with cross-functional partners to deeply understand relevant nuances, and building resources that grow with our products
  • Suggest and drive improvements to increase user satisfaction through support processes, as well as own initiatives that increase efficiency and drive down contact rates
  • Operate in ambiguity, making informed decisions even in never-before-seen situations
