Bridging digital design and physical automation, our multidisciplinary team transforms advanced robotics research into robust, production-ready industrial systems deployed globally. Tasks Role description We are looking for a Robotics Software Engineer to develop and productize software across the full robotics stack from perception and motion planning to control and system integration. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. You will take ownership of the engineering work required to turn promising research and algorithms into robust and mature capabilities that can be deployed and maintained in real-world robotic systems. What You Will Work On You will contribute across the full robotics software stack, including: Perception: 2D/3D sensing, point-cloud processing, object and feature detection, pose estimation, calibration. Motion Planning: collision checking, trajectory generation and optimization, kinematics, robot/world modeling, and integration of planning algorithms. Robot Control: integration with industrial robot controllers, HAL layers, trajectory execution, real-time or near-real-time control interfaces, state monitoring, and coordination of multi-robotic systems. System Integration: connecting robotics SW, application logic, hardware, and external systems into reliable end-to-end robotic applications. Robotics Infrastructure: reusable software components, interfaces, configuration, logging, diagnostics, testing, simulation, and deployment infrastructure. Your Responsibilities Design, implement, test, and maintain robotics software primarily in C++ and Python. Develop and integrate components across the full robotics SW stack. Take algorithms and prototypes and mature them into reliable software components. Build automated tests, simulation-based tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, and system-level validation where appropriate. Work with industrial robots, sensors, cameras, external axes, and other automation hardware. Develop clean interfaces between robotics algorithms, hardware drivers, application software, and higher-level systems. Diagnose complex problems that span software, algorithms, networking, robot controllers, sensors, and hardware. Improve observability through structured logging, diagnostics, error reporting, and system health monitoring. Support deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validation of robotic systems. Requirements What We Are Looking For Required Masters degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Strong software engineering skills in C++, with working knowledge of Python. Experience developing software for robotic or other complex hardware systems. Good understanding of several areas of robotics, such as, motion and trajectory planning, robot control, vision, sensor and robot calibration. Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2 or similar Comfortable working with Linux and modern software development workflows using Git, code reviews, build systems, debugging tools, and automated testing. Ability to debug problems across multiple layers of a robotic system rather than treating individual components in isolation. Strong understanding of software architecture, modularity, interfaces, and maintainability. Experience in one or more of the following would be an advantage: 3D perception using point clouds, depth cameras, stereo systems. Libraries such as Eigen, PCL, OpenCV, or similar. Collision detection, robot/world modeling, trajectory optimization, or numerical optimization. Real-time or high-performance robot communication and control. Profiling, performance optimization, concurrency, and multithreaded C++. Deploying and supporting robotic systems outside a controlled R&D environment. CI/CD and automated testing for robotics software. Experience working with industrial robotic arms such as ABB We do not expect you to be an expert in every part of the robotics stack. We are looking for strong software engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more robotics areas, and the ability and interest to work across subsystem boundaries. Eligibility Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Switzerland or be eligible to obtain the required Swiss work authorization without employer-sponsored visa support. Why Join MESH? At MESH, you will work on robotics problems where advanced R&D meets real-world industrial deployment. Our goal is not only to develop new robotics capabilities, but to turn them into systems that solve challenging problems in real world deployments. You will have opportunities to work across the full robotics SW stack including system integration, and the software architecture connecting them rather than being restricted to a narrow subsystem. You will work directly on the engineering challenges that take robotics from promising prototypes to robust, repeatable, and deployable solutions. Solve challenging real-world robotics problems. Work with industrial robots, 3D vision systems, complex environments, and applications where conventional automation approaches reach their limits. See your work operate on real hardware. Develop software that moves beyond simulation and demos and becomes part of robotic systems deployed in real production environments. Have impact across the system. As part of a small, multidisciplinary engineering team, you will work closely across robotics, software, and hardware, with the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and how our robotics platform evolves.

The worldwide data management software market is massive, forecasted to grow from approximately $82 billion in 2023 to approximately $137 billion in 2027. At MongoDB, we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading developer data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.

We are looking for a Technical Services Engineer to join our team in Dublin for a dedicated Tuesday through Saturday shift. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

About the Team

MongoDB Technical Services Engineers (TSEs) use their exceptional problem-solving and customer service skills, along with deep technical experience, to advise customers and solve complex MongoDB problems. TSEs are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem, including the database server, drivers, and services like Atlas and Cloud Manager. Our engineers combine MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, and teamwork to achieve exceptional results.

Cool Things You’ll Do

  • Work alongside our largest customers and partners to solve complex issues involving architecture, performance, recovery, and security
  • Serve as an expert resource on standard methodologies for running MongoDB at scale
  • Act as an advocate for customer and partner needs by collaborating with product management and development teams
  • Contribute to internal projects, such as the software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics
  • Mentor and ramp up new team members while building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem
  • Work with top ISV partners to ensure excellence for joint customers

What You Need

  • Solid hands-on experience with systems engineering, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, and troubleshooting
  • A strong understanding of networking concepts and protocols such as DNS, TCP/IP, and SSL/TLS
  • Experience building and maintaining complex mission-critical production database systems (RDBMS or NoSQL)
  • Basic coding or scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, JavaScript, Node.js, or Go
  • Experience analyzing and troubleshooting issues holistically, from the application tier through the database down to storage
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to think on your feet while remaining calm under pressure
  • A genuine desire to help people and a passion for rapidly learning new technical skills

Bonus Points

  • Experience using or managing MongoDB
  • Experience using cloud services stacks such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Strong understanding of authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, or Active Directory
  • Experience with Kubernetes or other orchestration systems using vendor-specific Enterprise operators
  • Familiarity with distributed version control systems, particularly Git
  • Understanding of the GenAI landscape and technology companies in this space

Success Measures

  • In 3 months: You will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its partner ecosystem and completed New Hire Training
  • In 6 months: You will be comfortable working frontline with customers and partners and will complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
  • In 12 months: You will be a technical specialist within MongoDB, helping peer engineers with advanced diagnostics and handling technical escalations independently

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. 7a56613768d52534bf6d.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

You will run the external audit calendar for our SOX 404 program as we scale toward an IPO. That means coordinating with our external auditors across the year, aligning testing windows with control owners, educating our control owners, and keeping requests and deliverables on schedule. You will also own SOX scoping and risk assessment cycles, deficiency tracking, and status reporting, and help roll out our GRC platform so the program runs from one system of record instead of spreadsheets. You will scale the program through AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort and speed up our SOX program.

This role reports to the Head of Business Controls and works closely with everyone on the SOX and Internal Audit team. This is an individual contributor role for someone who keeps a complex program on schedule, writes clearly, and makes the program simpler each cycle.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the annual SOX audit calendar, including interim and year-end testing windows, walkthrough schedules, and key deliverable dates agreed with external auditors.
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for external auditor requests. Triage, route, and track each request to closure, including PBC (provided-by-client) lists and evidence deliveries.
  • Coordinate auditor walkthroughs and fieldwork with process owners, control owners, and the SOX Testing team, so each control owner is asked for the same evidence once.
  • Track auditor findings, management responses, and deficiency follow-ups, and report status to Internal Audit leadership.
  • Prepare control owners and process owners for auditor sessions, and get evidence delivered on time without direct authority over them.
  • Lead the annual SOX scoping and risk assessment, including quarterly refreshes, and support the annual Fraud Risk Assessment, so the program has appropriate scope and coverage under COSO.
  • Monitor BP and IT SOX testing and report status to leadership and share status with external auditors
  • Lead work with the business to improve control documentation, including education of templates and SOX guidance.
  • Find optimization and automation opportunities across the SOX lifecycle through the use of AI.
  • Support the rollout of the GRC tool for SOX, including control libraries, workflows, evidence requests, and testing templates.
  • Define the data and reporting requirements the platform must meet, and test that it produces what the program needs.
  • Run the quarterly sub-certification process and report results to leadership
  • Own SOX program status reporting: dashboards and metrics for leadership, audit calendar progress, and deficiency and remediation status.
  • Own status reporting for the full SOX lifecycle: scoping and risk assessment, testing, deficiencies and remediation, segregation of duties (SOD), SOC 1 report reviews, the fraud risk assessment, and audit calendar progress.

Minimum qualifications

  • Big 4 audit firm experience on SOX 404 or ICFR engagements, including managing audit calendars, PBC requests, and fieldwork with external audit teams.
  • Experience working directly with external auditor teams on requests, testing schedules, and findings, from the company side.
  • Several years of hands-on SOX 404 experience, including scoping, risk assessment, control documentation, testing, and deficiency evaluation.
  • Working knowledge of the COSO framework, ICFR, and PCAOB standards.
  • Experience developing or maintaining Risk and Control Matrices and process documentation or flowcharts.
  • Experience implementing or administering a GRC systems
  • Experience reporting program status, metrics, and issues to senior leadership.
  • Ability to get control owners to deliver on time without authority over them.
  • Clear writing and calm coordination under deadline pressure.
  • A Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • In-house SOX experience at a pre-IPO or newly public company.
  • Experience running a fraud risk assessment.
  • CPA, CISA, or similar certification.
  • Comfort with SQL or data tools for reporting, and experience building lightweight automations, including with Claude.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$230,000—$300,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Build AI-powered product experiences. Work with product teams to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can transform the user experience for millions—and then build these transformative solutions. Drive the process from possibility to production, delivering code that’s robust, reproducible, and built for scale. Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability. Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends. Build software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale. Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain. What we look for Reasoning ability. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time. Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland). The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Backend Engineer (Python) Jobgether Ireland Apply Backend Engineer (Python) Jobgether Ireland 1 day ago 72 applicants See who Jobgether has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Engineer (Python) based in Ireland. As a Backend Engineer, you will help develop and scale an AI-powered voice platform designed to improve healthcare access and support for adults aged 65 and older. You will build the Python services and backend workflows that enable intelligent patient conversations, coordinate follow-up care, and connect patients with the right clinical resources. Working at the intersection of backend engineering, applied AI, and healthcare technology, you will contribute to features such as appointment scheduling, medication refill requests, and post-discharge support. You will take ownership of well-defined projects from technical design through deployment, collaborating closely with engineers, product specialists, designers, and clinical operations teams. Within a small, distributed European engineering team, you will have the opportunity to influence product reliability, data security, and the quality of patient experiences. This role offers meaningful technical challenges, hands-on exposure to modern AI technologies, and the chance to build software with a tangible impact on people's health and well-being. Accountabilities Develop and maintain backend services: Build and extend Python-based APIs, data models, and background workflows supporting patient enrollment, call scheduling, communication preferences, and follow-up processes. Enhance AI-powered voice workflows: Improve the backend systems that support an AI voice agent, enabling personalized patient conversations, access to relevant context, and integration with appropriate tools across multiple languages and care programs. Integrate healthcare systems: Connect voice workflows with electronic health records and clinical data platforms, ensuring conversations are informed by relevant patient information and that patient requests reach the appropriate care teams. Automate patient care coordination: Develop reliable workflows that help patients schedule appointments, request medication refills, and receive appropriate follow-up, with clear handoffs and visibility into subsequent actions. Build resilient distributed systems: Design backend processes that handle interrupted calls, duplicate webhooks, external service failures, timeouts, retries, and other operational edge cases without compromising data integrity. Improve system reliability and performance: Write automated tests, participate in code reviews, investigate production issues, and use logs and metrics to identify and resolve technical problems. Support cloud deployment and service integration: Deploy and maintain containerized services in a cloud environment, ensuring compatibility across independently deployed components and supporting safe, incremental releases. Protect sensitive patient information: Incorporate privacy, security, and responsible data handling into everyday engineering decisions, particularly when working with healthcare records and personal information. Collaborate across distributed teams: Work with engineering, product, design, and clinical operations colleagues to understand requirements, communicate technical decisions, and deliver improvements aligned with patient and care-team needs. Contribute to continuous improvement: Take ownership of defined features from technical planning through production deployment, incorporating feedback and refining existing workflows to improve reliability and usability. Requirements Production engineering experience: Demonstrated experience building, shipping, and maintaining backend services in production. Practical ownership and the quality of your work matter more than a specific number of years of experience. Strong Python skills: Proficiency in Python and experience developing HTTP APIs with FastAPI or a comparable framework, including comfort working with asynchronous programming. Database expertise: Practical experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including data modeling, schema design, migrations, and maintaining data integrity. API and integration experience: Experience integrating third-party services and developing background jobs or queue-based workflows, with an understanding of timeouts, retries, duplicate events, and partial failures. Sound engineering practices: Ability to write readable, maintainable code, create useful automated tests, participate in code reviews, and debug issues using logs, metrics, and other observability tools. Cloud and deployment knowledge: Experience deploying containerized applications to a cloud platform and understanding the operational considerations involved in running production services. End-to-end ownership: Ability to take a clearly defined problem from initial design through implementation, testing, and release, while recognizing when to seek feedback or technical support. Communication and collaboration: Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical decisions, communicate progress, and collaborate effectively with colleagues across distributed teams and time zones. Adaptability and problem-solving: A practical, proactive approach to engineering, with a willingness to investigate unfamiliar systems, learn new technologies, and improve existing solutions collaboratively. Availability for cross-time-zone collaboration: Ability to be available from 14:00 to 18:00 Central European local time (CET/CEST) on working days to collaborate with colleagues in the United States. Additional technical experience (a plus): Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Terraform, or OpenTelemetry is advantageous. Applied AI and voice technology (a plus): Experience with LiveKit, telephony systems, voice agents, large language model (LLM) integrations, or evaluating AI-powered features is beneficial. Healthcare technology experience (a plus): Familiarity with healthcare systems, sensitive personal information, or workflows requiring dependable follow-through is an advantage. Additional language skills (a plus): Spanish or Portuguese proficiency can be useful when reviewing and improving multilingual voice-agent conversations. Location eligibility: Candidates must be based in Germany, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Poland, or Greece and be able to work under a local employment contract through an employer of record. Previous experience in healthcare or voice AI is not required, and candidates do not need experience with every technology in the existing stack. The role is suited to engineers with strong backend fundamentals who are eager to learn and contribute to meaningful AI-powered products. Benefits Competitive salary: Annual gross salary ranging from €65,000 to €90,000, depending on experience and location. Full-time, permanent employment: A permanent local employment contract facilitated through an employer of record. Remote work: Work remotely from an eligible European country. Meaningful product impact: Contribute to a live healthcare product that supports older adults, improves access to care, and helps care teams provide timely follow-up. Technical ownership: Take responsibility for backend features from design through deployment within a small, collaborative engineering team. Professional development: Deepen your expertise in Python, asynchronous systems, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI technologies. Modern technology stack: Work with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Platform, Terraform, LiveKit Agents, speech recognition, large language models, and text-to-speech technologies. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with engineering, product, design, and clinical operations colleagues across Europe and the United States. Structured collaboration time: Dedicated daily collaboration hours with US-based colleagues, balanced with asynchronous communication and focused individual work. No on-call responsibilities: Focus on building and improving reliable software without a scheduled on-call requirement. Purpose-driven environment: Contribute to a healthcare model centered on prevention, patient well-being, and stronger relationships between patients and care providers. 7ba2c11e311ba1eba33c.description: Bring your talent. Learn new skills. Make a positive impact. At PwC Ireland, we uncover hidden talents, build lifelong relationships, and turn challenges into opportunities. We redefine possibilities for our clients and communities, empowering you to make a meaningful impact that extends far beyond our firm. As part of our team—whether in Assurance, Tax, Specialised Assurance Services, or Consulting & Deals—you’ll engage in impactful projects with leading clients across diverse industries, contributing to the shaping of tomorrow. From your first day, you’ll be immersed in a collaborative and inclusive culture where your ideas lead to real-world solutions. Our graduate programme supports your growth at every stage, combining hands-on experience with structured learning, professional qualifications, and mentorship. This is your chance to grow, innovate, and contribute meaningfully as we work towards excellence together. Application deadline: This role will be closed at 2pm on 30th October 2026 Role Overview: Strategy& is a global strategy consulting firm that is part of the professional services network of PwC. Strategy& has a network of 75+ offices with 4500+ consultants around the world. Strategy& benefits from the broad expertise and international reach of the wider PwC network. The Strategy& Dublin practice helps organisations develop and implement effective strategies to achieve their goals and objectives. We address key CEO questions on issues such as growth strategy, market entry, mergers and acquisitions, organisation design, performance improvement and value creation. The Strategy& Graduate Programme provides a structured learning environment to help you develop the skills and capabilities required of a top-tier strategy consultant. Our programme includes on-the-job learning (via hands-on project experience), learning from others (via Buddy, Coach and Mentor), and formal learning (via induction and regular training sessions). Your first two weeks are induction, which teaches you the basics and develops your network with the Strategy& and PwC intakes. After the initial two weeks training, you will join project teams and become a core contributor. You will take ownership of defined pieces of analysis and project deliverables, with guidance and support from experienced team members. You will have the opportunity to contribute to discussions in internal meetings with senior team members and will have your voice and opinions valued. Your responsibilities will grow as your experience develops, giving you the opportunity to make meaningful contributions from an early stage in your career. Day-to-day, you will work closely with colleagues across different levels of experience, combining analytical thinking, structured problem solving and effective communication to help solve complex client challenges. You will contribute to team discussions, share your perspectives and learn how to translate data and qualitative insights into practical recommendations that create real client impact. Typical Graduate responsibilities include: Taking ownership of defined workstreams and project deliverables, while receiving coaching, feedback and support from experienced members of the project team. Identifying relevant data sources and collecting, interpreting and analysing data to generate insights that support strategic recommendations. Conducting interviews and deriving insight from qualitative inputs. Working with project teams to break down complex business problems, test potential solutions and develop practical recommendations for clients Supporting the development of client-ready presentations and communicating findings to colleagues, clients and senior stakeholders as your confidence and experience grow. Building commercial awareness and developing an understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing organisations across a broad range of industries. Contributing to the wider Strategy& team through internal initiatives, collaboration, knowledge-sharing and other activities that support the growth and success of the business. All new joiners are each assigned a buddy who will be responsible for helping you settle in and be there to answer any questions you may have. Alongside this, you will also have a career coach, who will serve as a mentor and support you to ensure you get the opportunities to develop and progress your career at Strategy&. Who We’re Looking For: Our Graduates join us from a range of backgrounds, but all are intellectually curious and highly motivated. We also look for people who bring something more to our work than their academic credentials. For example, the self-discipline and team-working skills or leadership qualities gained through work, sporting and volunteering experience. You have a strong academic record and good analytical and problem-solving skills (minimum 2.1 degree or equivalent) As a Graduate, you’ll be able to exercise commercial awareness, analytical and interpersonal skills in your day-to-day work. Over time, you’ll build the confidence and credibility to present your opinions to clients and senior stakeholders. Our commitment to you! At PwC, we recognise that every graduate's journey is unique, and we're committed to supporting your professional growth with benefits that align with your lifestyle and aspirations. Our flexible benefits plan enables you to customise your package, ensuring it meets your individual needs. Whether you're looking to enhance your skills, maintain a healthy work-life balance, or prepare for the future, we provide the tools and resources to help you succeed. Find out more here. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact us at ie_ireland.graduate@pwc.com. Grow your career with PwC Ireland.

Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows. 

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. 

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

As a key member of our Customer Success organization, the Professional Services Engineer serves as a technical authority in the Tines platform, specializing in integrating and optimizing workflow automation solutions across customer enterprises.

In this role, you will guide customers through scoping out automation Stories to suit their individual requirements and design, build, & deploy these solutions in the customer tenant. These Stories will be instrumental in kick-starting the customer’s automation journey and ensuring that they and their team feel the benefits of smart, secure workflows.

You will partner with our Engagement Management and Project Management Teams to align on project goals and timelines, guaranteeing that client implementations are successful and meet predefined success criteria.

Professional Services Engineers at Tines engage with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Sales, and Labs. This collaboration ensures that our service offerings and product enhancements align well with evolving customer requirements. The ideal candidate for this role will be deeply committed to enhancing customer productivity through advanced automation solutions, leveraging their technical expertise to transform client operations without the necessity for manual coding.

This role reports to the Senior Manager, Professional Services Engineering who is based in Boston, Massachusetts.

What you will be doing:

  • Shape the future of our Professional Services organization and contribute to the development of processes and procedures.
  • Tackle challenging Story and workflow builds to power our customers’ most important workflows.
  • Scope automation Stories based on customer requirements, identifying any blockers and research areas needed.
  • Analyze customer tools, processes, and pain points to guide them in establishing an automation roadmap.
  • Identify and highlight what is, and what isn’t, suitable for an automation workflow.
  • Work with the Project Manager and Engagement Manager to verify and validate services, project plans, and timelines.
  • Demonstrate Stories and workflows to illustrate concepts and ideas to the customer, including wire-framing out Stories and workflows live on calls with customers.
  • Design and develop Automation Stories and workflows in the customer Tines tenant, connecting tools together using their APIs.
  • Partner closely with customers to ensure that the Stories and workflows meet their requirements and provide guidance on test plans.
  • Review and suggest optimizations for customer stories and workflows.
  • Deliver documented, production-ready stories and workflows to customers and ensure the customer is set up for success in maintaining those long-term.
  • Act as a resident automation engineer for customers, working as a member of the customer team to help them plan their automation roadmap and achieve their automation goals.
  • Advocate for the Professional Services Team within Tines, working with Sales teams to ensure they can speak to our capabilities and achievements.

What you bring with you:

  • 5+ years of experience in delivering Professional Services and implementing SOAR platforms or similar automation solutions.
  • Strong customer-facing skills and experience.
  • A passion for becoming an expert in a Tines.
  • Proficient in assessing and understanding customer workflows to tailor solutions that meet their specific needs.
  • Experience interpreting and applying API documentation.
  • Experience with a range of API authentication methods including OAuth2 and JWT.
  • Experience using and troubleshooting APIs to connect to a variety of security and/or IT tools.
  • Passionate about supporting our customers and helping them automate their repetitive and manual workflows.

 

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation.

You'll assist in building and maintaining data pipelines, ensure data quality, and support analytics initiatives. Ideal for recent graduates with foundational SQL and Python skills eager to grow in a collaborative environment. Full Description Hiredbuddy is looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our dynamic engineering team. This is a remote, entry-level position perfect for recent graduates or early-career professionals who are passionate about building robust data infrastructure. You will work closely with senior engineers, data scientists, and business analysts to support the company's data-driven initiatives. Your primary focus will be on designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver high-quality data to downstream systems. In this role, you will gain hands-on experience with modern data analyst tools and cloud platforms. You will be responsible for writing efficient SQL queries, developing Python scripts for data processing, and orchestrating workflows using tools like Apache Airflow. You will also contribute to the maintenance of our data warehouse, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and availability. As you grow, you will participate in code reviews, collaborate on data modeling decisions, and help optimize pipeline performance. We believe in a learning-first culture. You will receive mentorship from experienced engineers, have access to internal training resources, and be encouraged to experiment with new technologies. You will learn how to troubleshoot issues, monitor data quality, and implement best practices for data governance and security. Your work will directly impact business decisions, from product analytics to financial reporting. Key responsibilities include: building and maintaining ETL/ELT processes; writing and optimizing SQL queries; developing Python scripts for data cleaning and transformation; designing and maintaining data schemas; assisting with the implementation of data quality checks; documenting pipeline logic and data lineage; and collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements. We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive, and eager to learn. A strong foundation in SQL and Python is essential, along with a basic understanding of data modeling and database concepts. Familiarity with cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and tools like Airflow or dbt is a plus, but not required. Most importantly, you should have a problem-solving mindset and a willingness to take ownership of your work. If you are ready to launch your career in data analyst and work on meaningful projects, we would love to hear from you. 7da07965f63b14262c0f.description: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and open up new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a lot of work ahead. That gives you an unusual opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Startup SaaS Platforms team works with European startups in one of Stripe’s must-win segments. SaaS platforms are companies that use Stripe to embed payments and make financial services a core part of their products, such as Shopify, Mindbody, and Lightspeed. For these companies, their partnership with Stripe is vital to the success of their businesses. SaaS platforms are a global priority for Stripe, and our team finds and wins Stripe’s future strategic accounts in Europe. We partner with high-potential companies early and help them use Stripe’s solutions to better support their users, scale globally, and create new revenue streams by monetising payments and financial services. What you’ll do We’re hiring an Account Executive to win new business with pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platform startups across the United Kingdom and Ireland. This is a new-logo role. Your job is to find the most promising founders building platforms today, win their business for Stripe before they choose another provider, and get them live with the right integration from day one. You’ll work alongside our SaaS Platform Account Executives as the team’s dedicated hunter for the earliest stage of the market. You’ll own the pre-revenue and early-revenue segment end to end, from generating pipeline and handling inbound demand to closing deals and getting each new platform activated. Early-stage platforms make their payments decisions early and rarely revisit them. They also often need several products from the start, including embedded payments, connected-account onboarding, payouts, and monetisation. Winning them early and selling the right solution gives Stripe a lasting position with the platforms that will scale fastest. This is a high-velocity sales role with short cycles, a high volume of opportunities, and plenty of competitive deals. Responsibilities Build and run your own pipeline. Prospect high-potential pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platforms across the United Kingdom and Ireland, and turn inbound interest from early-stage platforms into qualified opportunities. Win new logos. Run fast, consultative sales cycles from discovery to close and win competitive evaluations against other payments providers. Sell the right solution from the start. Understand each founder’s business model and position the right Stripe Connect integration and payments monetisation strategy so that new platforms are set up to scale. Close and activate. Negotiate and close deals, then work with Solutions Architects, Product, Risk, and Operations to get new platforms live quickly. You’ll be measured on new business won and activated. Source new business through the ecosystem. Build relationships with founders, venture capital firms, accelerators, and startup communities across the United Kingdom and Ireland to create pipeline and grow Stripe’s presence among early-stage founders. Work with the SaaS Platform Account Executive team. Share market intelligence on emerging platforms and pass on accounts that have moved beyond the early stage so that each seller can focus on the opportunities where they can have the greatest impact. Bring what you learn from the market back to Product and go-to-market teams to sharpen how Stripe wins early-stage platforms. Who you are You’re a self-starting hunter who enjoys finding and winning new business. You like working with founders, you’re comfortable leading technical conversations, and you can run many deals at once without compromising quality. You know how to qualify quickly, create urgency, and close. You’re competitive, resilient, and keen to build your skills in a fast-changing environment. We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 2+ years of experience in a new-business sales role, such as a closing Account Executive role or a Sales or Business Development Representative role, with a track record of progression and pipeline generation A proven record of meeting or exceeding new-business targets Strong prospecting skills, with experience building your own pipeline through outbound and inbound channels Experience running high-velocity sales cycles from the first conversation through to close The ability to understand technical products and explain their value clearly to technical and non-technical buyers Comfort with rejection, competitive deals, and ambiguous, fast-moving environments A bias towards team success, collaboration, and knowledge sharing Proficiency in written and spoken English Preferred qualifications Experience selling to early-stage or venture-backed startups, ideally in the United Kingdom and Ireland An established network in the United Kingdom and Ireland startup ecosystem, including founders, venture capital firms, and accelerators Experience selling at a high-growth technology company Comfort with API-first products and technical sales conversations Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS platform sales

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for research engineers to build the safety and oversight mechanisms that govern how our models handle biological knowledge. As a bio safety researcher, you will spend your time: designing and running capability evaluations against frontier models, generating and curating training data for our safety classifiers, training and iterating on those classifiers alongside our ML engineers, and measuring how they hold up against adversarial pressure in production traffic.

This work sits at the intersection of applied ML and biosecurity. You will help define what responsible AI safety looks like in the biological domain, translating threat models into evals, datasets, and deployed systems. The core technical tension you will own is precision: safeguards need to be robust against sophisticated actors while staying out of the way of the far larger population of legitimate researchers using Claude to accelerate life sciences work. Getting that tradeoff right is an empirical problem, and you will be the person measuring it.

You do not need to be an ML researcher today. We are looking for strong scientific programmers with real depth in modern biology who want to bring that depth to bear on model evaluation and classifier development.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and run capability evaluations to assess what new models can do in the biological domain, and turn results into concrete deployment recommendations
  • Develop training and evaluation datasets for our safety classifiers, working with internal and external threat modeling experts to ground them in realistic risk
  • Train, tune, and iterate on safety classifiers with ML engineers, optimizing jointly for adversarial robustness and low false-positive rates
  • Build the tooling and pipelines that make evaluation and classifier development fast and repeatable
  • Analyze classifier and eval performance against production traffic, identify gaps, and prioritize improvements
  • Design and run red-teaming and stress-testing of safeguards as threats, models, and product surfaces evolve
  • Partner with Research, Product, and Policy teams to embed biological safety throughout the model development lifecycle
  • Contribute to external communications including model cards, blog posts, and policy documents
  • Track developments in biology, ML, and biosecurity for their potential to create new risks or enable new mitigations

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and extensive background in scientific programming and data analysis skills
  • Excellent grasp of ML fundamentals and an ability to rapidly adopt ML development practices
  • Excellent knowledge of modern biology across both measurement and engineering: high-throughput assays and functional characterization, as well as gene synthesis, genome editing, strain construction, and protein engineering
  • Ability to build and maintain your own tooling rather than relying on others to implement your ideas
  • Experience designing quantitative experiments or evaluations and drawing defensible conclusions from noisy results
  • Strong analytical and writing skills, and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Familiarity with dual-use research concerns and biosecurity frameworks, such as select agent regulations, the Biological Weapons Convention, or Australia Group guidelines
  • Comfort with ambiguity and with shifting priorities as AI capabilities change
  • Can work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with cross-functional teams
  • Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact
  • Thrive in a fast-paced research environment where you balance rigorous scientific standards with rapid iteration

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working with large language models, including prompting, fine-tuning, or evaluation
  • Experience training or deploying classifiers or other ML systems in production
  • Experience developing ML methods for biological systems or biological data
  • Familiarity with adversarial robustness, red-teaming, or safety evaluation of ML systems
  • Have at least 8 years of hands-on experience in life sciences, with deep expertise in areas such as molecular biology, drug discovery, or computational biology
  • Experience leading complex technical projects across multiple stakeholder groups

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$300,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 7e01740184bc98e44ca9.description: About Zinkworks Zinkworks partners with leading Telecommunications and Financial Services organizations to modernize legacy systems, migrate mission-critical platforms to the cloud, and engineer AI-driven automation. From OSS transformation to rApp development and network intelligence, our teams simplify complexity and turn it into competitive advantage. Based in Ireland and operating across the EU, UK, and US, Zinkworks combines deep domain expertise with delivery excellence to help clients modernize faster and operate smarter. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Scrum Master to help our agile teams, working directly with clients in telecoms and financial services, achieve better business outcomes. This role is about improving the delivery system and the team, not managing delivery through it. You build trust quickly with teams, Product Owners and clients, and you are comfortable challenging the status quo when it gets in the way of good outcomes. Key Responsibilities Primary Responsibility Enable the Scrum Team and surrounding organisation to consistently deliver small, valuable, Done increments each Sprint by improving team practices, engineering flow, backlog quality, collaboration and the organisational conditions needed to make that possible. Supporting Responsibilities Coach self-management: Help teams take ownership of their planning, commitments and ways of working, so they depend less on the Scrum Master over time. Improve flow: Make work visible, limit WIP, help slice Product Backlog Items smaller, and reduce carryover and long-lived items. Strengthen the Definition of Done: Work with the team to build quality and testing into the sprint, so work is genuinely Done and defects are found early rather than late. Reduce hand-offs: Grow cross-functional skills and collaboration so work does not queue between specialists. Remove systemic impediments: Look beyond day-to-day blockers to their recurring causes, and work with leadership to address organisational constraints teams cannot resolve alone. Make Scrum events effective: Ensure Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review and Retrospective happen consistently and are used to inspect and adapt, not as status meetings. Coach Product Owners: Help Product Owners set clear Sprint Goals, keep a well-ordered Product Backlog and focus decisions on value. Partner with clients: Work closely with client stakeholders to build transparency, use Sprint Reviews to gather feedback and align on outcomes. Measuring Success The Real Measure Of Success Is Whether The Team Becomes Better At Delivering Usable Value Frequently And Predictably. Running The Scrum Events Is a Baseline, Not The Measure. Progress Is Shown By Sprint Goal achievement: Sprint Goals are met more consistently. Work reaching Done: More work meets the Definition of Done within the sprint. Lower carryover and WIP: Fewer items roll over between sprints and fewer long-lived PBIs. Fewer late defects: Testing happens within the sprint, so fewer defects are found late. Stronger predictability: Teams forecast reliably and clients can plan with confidence. Team Support Model Capacity is based on team maturity, not a fixed number of teams, and is reviewed as teams mature: New or less mature teams: Dedicated Scrum Master support to build good practice and flow. Mature, self-managing teams: May share a Scrum Master, focused on coaching and systemic improvement. 7e44ea2b9253505624d0.description: IT Graduate Development Programme 2027 - Infrastruction & Application Operations At ESB, technology plays a leading role in enabling and realising our purpose to deliver a brighter future for the customers and communities we serve. Today that means we are driven to make a difference – net zero by 2040 – and it’s our people who ensure we succeed. With almost 500 people working across our IT Delivery and CIO functions, together we design, build and support a broad range of technologies and services to deliver on our strategic objectives – decarbonised electricity, resilient infrastructure and empowered customers. To further enhance our capabilities and to transform ESB to a data driven and digital utility, we are looking for Graduates to join our highly motivated and skilled team of IT professionals where you will have the opportunity to deliver results in a fast-paced, innovative team environment. Our IT Graduate Development Programme is structured into six distinct career paths where you will be able to grow your experience, as well as develop the necessary skills to help you on your way to career success. Infrastructure Operations As an IT Graduate within ESB's Infrastructure Operations team, you'll gain hands-on experience working with the cloud, platform, and data centre technologies that power one of Ireland's largest and most critical energy networks. Working alongside experienced engineers and technology specialists, you'll help deliver secure, resilient, and high-performing IT services that support ESB's day-to-day operations and enable its Net Zero 2040 ambitions. This is an exciting opportunity to build practical expertise across cloud infrastructure, platform management, service reliability, automation, and operational excellence within a large-scale enterprise environment. You'll develop a strong foundation in modern infrastructure technologies while contributing to projects that have a real impact on how ESB delivers energy for Ireland. As part of the team, you'll support the management, maintenance, and continuous improvement of core IT infrastructure services. You'll gain exposure to proactive monitoring, infrastructure lifecycle management, security best practices, and digital transformation initiatives, while working in a collaborative and inclusive environment that encourages innovation, learning, and professional growth. Application Operations As an IT Graduate within ESB's Application Operations team, you'll play a key role in supporting the applications that enable critical business processes across the organisation. From enterprise platforms and bespoke business systems to mobile applications, you'll gain valuable experience in ensuring applications remain reliable, secure, and high-performing for thousands of users across ESB. Working closely with technology teams and business stakeholders, you'll develop an understanding of how digital services support ESB's operations while building practical skills in application support, service management, performance optimization, and continuous improvement. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to innovative technology solutions that help drive operational excellence and support ESB's Net Zero 2040 strategy. As part of the team, you'll help enhance and optimize a diverse portfolio of Enterprise, Custom-Built, and Mobile applications. You'll gain exposure to service delivery, stakeholder engagement, incident and problem management, service improvement initiatives, and future technology planning. Along the way, you'll develop the technical and professional skills needed to build a successful career in IT while helping shape the future of digital services within ESB. What to expect Our bespoke IT Graduate Development Programme includes: Structured Rotations: – Our graduate programme is typically structured into targetted rotations aligned with career paths and capability development where you will build your IT and business knowledge through challenging assignments, a diverse range of business activities, and the potential to work on projects. Learning & Development: – Central to our programme is your learning and development. Structured leadership development, training opportunities, innovation programmes. on-the-job learning and work-shadowing are complemented with personal development programmes and supports designed to help you grow professionally and personally. Performance Orientated: – At the start of each of your rotations, you will agree with your Line Manager the goals of the assignment and put in place the steps to help achieve them. Ongoing one-to-one conversations and management reviews will ensure that you are constantly working towards achieving your professional status and position you for a career with ESB. Supportive Working Environment: – In addition to your immediate support network of Line Manager, Middle Manager, Team Colleagues and Graduate Peers, you will also be assigned a Buddy and a Mentor. Social Networking: – Our Graduates are encouraged to get involved in all sorts of Sports and Social activities. Anything from Tag Rugby, Cricket, Soccer and GAA to language classes, team building challenges, charity work and graduate social events. Our clubs, societies and networks are a great way to build your contacts and of course make new connections. Why work with us? We offer a competitive graduate salary and a comprehensive benefits package built on four pillars of Reward, Career, Community, and Well-being: Progressive, hybrid working model Career development through mentoring and training Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities Sports and Social Clubs Credit Union access Pension Scheme Employee well-being programmes Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion Great team environment with our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Trusted, and Driven Location This position will be based in ESB Head Office, F27, 2 Fitzwilliam Street, Dublin 4. Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business. What We Look For? You should have (or be working towards) a minimum 2.1 Honours Degree in IT, Computer Sciences, Business Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Finance or an equivalent course where IT was a component. Proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced team environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Excellent analytical skills, combined with the ability to learn quickly. Essential Criteria Currently hold a minimum grade 2.1 level 8 degree, or working towards same Completed a work placement during undergraduate degree - either as part of the degree programme itself, or during a summer period Completed a module in computer networks, operating systems, or IT infrastructure (e.g., cloud computing) Your CV should be no longer than 2 pages and clearly outline the following: Title of your Degree, and Masters (if applicable) Your results to date Your final year subjects The title of your Final Year project Any relevant work experience A contact telephone number (please ensure a voicemail function is activated on your phone) Closing Date: 19th October 2026

7f500636f804de99a475.description: AI & Data Graduate Programme FY28 Application Deadline: 25 October 2026 Department: Strategy & Consulting Ireland Employment Type: Permanent - Full Time Location: Dublin Compensation: €40,000 / year Description Technology is changing the world faster than ever before – and at the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team. Every day around the world, we work with exceptional people, the latest and greatest tech and leading companies across industries. You'll learn, grow and advance in a diverse culture of shared success, where we’ll empower you to bring your skills, your curiosity and your best true self to your work. Join us and do extraordinary things. The question every major organisation is working on right now is the same: how do we get real value from AI, serve our customers better and change how our business operates? That is the work our AI and Data practice does. As a graduate, you will work directly with clients on that question. You will join project teams taking AI from strategy through to delivery, help organisations understand what their data can do, and build the confidence to advise senior stakeholders on decisions that matter. The technical depth you bring will be put to work on real problems from the start. This role is for people who want to understand a business, shape a solution and help make it happen. Here is a taster of the diverse work our AI & Data analysts do: Radically reimagine a client process with AI and be at the heart of the delivery Scale AI solutions for the world's largest companies as an AI engineer Define the most valuable commercial use cases for a client as an AI strategist Drive enterprise AI adoption, from frontier AI tools to AI-native software delivery Surface insights that executives can act on as a data scientist What We're Looking For We are looking for graduates who combine strong analytical and technical ability with the confidence to work directly with clients. The role requires both: people who can get into the detail of the latest frontier AI model, and people who can step back and explain what it means to a business audience. We are looking for graduates who are familiar with any number of the following: Knowledge of how data and AI can be used to solve business problems Experience with generative AI and agentic AI technologies Cloud data platform experience/knowledge (AWS, MS Azure, Google Cloud Platform) Data science knowledge with any of Python, SAS, R, Scala, PySpark or other relevant coding language Knowledge of machine learning modelling techniques Knowledge of data warehouse tools and database technologies e.g., SQL, ETL, No-SQL and other big data technologies Experience in or knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Qlik, Looker or Power BI Familiarity across all technical areas is not expected. As well as technical ability, you should be able to demonstrate: Structured thinking & the ability to break a complex problem into clear components Genuine curiosity about how organisations operate & where technology can help Strong verbal/written communication & presentation skills Ability to adapt and learn in a continuously changing environment Experience in team or leadership roles in extra-curricular activities Creativity, initiative, and a growth mindset All candidates will have a minimum 2:1 degree, obtained or predicted. What's In It For You? Training & Development We’ll invest in your development from your first day and ensure you have all the training you need to hit the ground running. We provide a structured and detailed induction programme with our supportive graduate community. You can also look forward to mentorship from some of our most successful leaders. You will have dedicated training, project and research assignments in areas like Data Analysis, Gen AI and Analytics strategy. This training will help you build the all-round skills needed for success, but your project experience is where your learning will really come to life. The variety of live client work you take on will help you develop skills that stay with you throughout your career, while virtual classrooms and on-demand learning will keep you close to the latest technologies, industry trends and new ways of working. Rewards & Benefits At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package. You can read up about some of these benefits here . Where You'll Work Accenture is a people first business which thrives on collaboration, knowledge sharing and building strong connections. As a dynamic and constantly evolving business, we love the flexibility of a hybrid working model. However, due to the nature of our work, you may be delivering projects on client sites anywhere in the Ireland and sometimes outside of Ireland. You will be expected to work on client site or in your assigned office for a minimum of 1-2 days a week (but up to 5 depending on business and client requirements). There is an expectation for all graduates to be based within a commutable distance of your assigned office which will be Dublin . Does this appeal to you? If so, we want to hear from you! All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as applicable by law. Job candidates will not be obligated to disclose sealed or expunged records of conviction or arrest as part of the hiring process. Please read Accenture’s Recruiting and Hiring Statement for more information on how we process your data during the Recruiting and Hiring process.
