7fa7eb9ace100142f8e1.description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. 12-month fixed-term contract | Global Revenue Systems and AI Team | About the Role Our reps spend most of their day in Salesforce, and how it feels to use directly affects how much they sell. We're hiring a Salesforce Developer with a UI/UX focus to redesign the rep experience across our Sales and Revenue teams. You'll join the global Salesforce team for 12 months to make the CRM faster, clearer and more intuitive. This is a hands-on build role. You'll design the experience and code it in Lightning Web Components, working with Sales, RevOps, Marketing and Data, and directly with the reps who use the result. What You Will Do Redesign the rep experience Audit the current Lightning experience (record pages, console apps, list views, home pages) and find where reps lose time to clicks, clutter and missing context. Turn what you find into a prioritised roadmap of UI improvements tied to rep productivity and adoption. Design and prototype improved layouts, workflows and components, and validate them with reps before building. Build with LWC Develop custom Lightning Web Components (and supporting Apex where needed) that replace clunky standard layouts with focused, usable interfaces. Configure and extend Lightning App Builder pages, Dynamic Forms, Dynamic Actions and console apps to deliver a consistent experience across teams and regions. Build reusable components and follow SLDS conventions so the UI stays consistent and maintainable after your contract ends. Make it stick Run feedback sessions, usability tests and pilots with reps and managers, and iterate on the results. Track adoption, page performance and user satisfaction to show what each release changed. Create release notes, short walkthroughs and handover documentation so changes land well and the team can maintain what you build. Work as part of the global team Work within the global team's standards for source control, code review, sandboxes and release management. Partner with admins, architects and data teams so UI changes fit the wider data model, security model and automation. Pass on what you learn about Lightning UX patterns and LWC best practices to the wider team. What You Will Need Must have Strong, demonstrable experience building Lightning Web Components in production. Solid Apex, SOQL and Salesforce data model knowledge to support your components. Deep knowledge of Lightning Experience customisation: App Builder, Dynamic Forms, page layouts, console apps and Flows. Experience with Salesforce DX, Git and a CI/CD or deployment process. A UX mindset: you start from user problems, can explain design decisions, and can take feedback from non-technical users. Clear communication and the ability to work independently across time zones in a global team. Nice to have Portfolio or examples of Salesforce UI work you've shipped (screenshots or demos are ideal). Experience with SLDS, Figma or similar prototyping tools, and accessibility (WCAG) principles. Experience in Sales Cloud, especially rep-facing workflows such as opportunity management, account planning and pipeline views. Jest testing for LWC, and Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I, Platform App Builder). Experience with performance profiling and optimisation in Lightning pages. What Success Looks Like (12 Months) Month 3: UX audit complete and a prioritised roadmap agreed with Sales leadership. Month 6: First wave of redesigned pages and components live for a pilot group, with adoption and feedback baselined. Month 12: Redesigned experience rolled out to target teams, a maintained component library in place, and full documentation handed to the global team. What we offer 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays. Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket. Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk. Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party. Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones. Flexible compensation options to help your money go further. 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year. 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about. Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected. A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk. Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs. AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate. #LI-Hybrid

Facilitate the co-ordination role of the PSDP for live projects with internal and external designers. Lead the team in the procurement of supplies and sub-contracts on time and within budget. Manage cashflow on projects and work with the Contracts Manager/ Commercial Manager to ensure interim payment applications are submitted on-time to the client. Build and promote industry-leading teams by providing training and mentoring of staff including setting out development plans for your team. Provide assistance, oversight and guidance from time to time on tendering opportunities for new upcoming projects. Respond to and address any client and stakeholder complaints in a timely manner. Obtain client satisfaction surveys and provide any feedback on how to improve our client satisfaction. Seek to improve the project delivery process by providing lessons learned feedback and innovative solutions for adoption on future projects. Keep appraised of the latest standards and technology through continuous professional development (CPD). Other duties as required from time to time. Minimum of a Level 8 Honours Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Environmental Engineering or Level 8 Honours Degree in Environmental Science or Chemistry with extensive industry experience. Extensive working knowledge of the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work (Construction) Regulations 2013. Holder of a certificate in Managing Safely for Construction Managers preferable but not essential. Experienced in MEICA engineering works such as process systems mechanical installation, control panels, electrical installations, commissioning and process proving activities. Ability to engage with the customer as well as suppliers and sub-contractors in financial negotiations and final account agreements. Good working knowledge of programme management software such as Microsoft Project. Ability to prepare baseline programmes and programme updates. Ability to use own initiative, problem solve and adjust as issues arise during project delivery. Working knowledge of MS packages such as Word, Excel and Powerpoint. Strong communication skills with a high level of motivation. Full Driving License. What we offer you: The opportunity to join an ambitious and growing organization. Back to jobs Data Scientist, Policy New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY; Washington, DC Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As one of our first Data Scientists dedicated to policy work, you will play a key role in ensuring Anthropic's work is understood by policymakers around the world. You'll sit at the intersection of data science and public affairs, transforming internal product usage and survey data into clear, accurate, and consistent evidence the Policy team can use to inform its positions, demonstrate Anthropic’s relevance to policymakers, and measure the impact of its work. Your analyses will directly inform how legislators, regulators, and the public understand Anthropic's footprint and contribution. This is a highly cross-functional role that is foundational to Anthropic's mission of bringing powerful AI to the world in a way that benefits humanity. Key responsibilities Partner with product and business teams across the company to produce supporting analyses and data collateral for specific policy position papers and partnership conversations Determine which metrics faithfully represent our company to legislators, regulators, and the public Own the dashboards and pipelines that keep externally-shared numbers consistent, so the Policy team can move quickly without creating discrepancies Use AI tools to aggregate news, policy developments, and other public data sources to track trends and provide a clear picture of the evolving regulatory landscape Develop measurement frameworks for policy communications, paid media, and public-affairs campaigns Design and implement policy analyses to support internal position development or measure the impact of policy implementation for external audiences Minimum qualifications Proficiency in Python, SQL, and data analysis tools, with experience working with external and public data sources Experience producing analysis that reaches external audiences such as policy, communications, investor relations, public affairs, or published research Applied causal inference using quasi-experimental designs (e.g., difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, synthetic control, instrumental variables, or matching) to measure policy or program impact from observational data Demonstrated ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for audiences with differing levels of technical fluency Preferred qualifications 6+ years of hands-on data science experience Direct experience supporting a policy, government affairs, or regulatory team with data and analysis Familiarity with investor-relations or financial-disclosure data standards and the consistency requirements they entail Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where creating clarity and driving progress is part of the role A genuine interest in Anthropic's mission of building safe and beneficial AI Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $285,000 - $380,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Serving as the EMEA anchor for MongoDB's Global Enterprise Technology (GET) team, this position acts as a primary technical DRI for enterprise user support, office technology, and regional incident escalation in the GMT/IST time zone. You hold end-to-end operational responsibility for delivering high-touch, reliable IT services—from onboarding hardware provisioning and daily ticket triage to AV room management and high-visibility regional event support.

This role prioritizes proactive support over passive ticketing. By monitoring system health, verifying endpoint configurations, and identifying friction points early, you ensure business continuity for teams across the EMEA region. You combine strong technical diagnostics across macOS, Windows, identity, and SaaS tooling with hands-on AV expertise for Dublin meeting spaces, acting as a trusted partner to local leaders and cross-functional teams.

The operational foundation of GET relies on intelligent automation, structured workflows, and data-informed decision-making. Routine health checks, diagnostics, and repetitive provisioning tasks are streamlined through intelligent tooling, freeing your focus for complex technical problem-solving, live event execution, and relationship building. In this environment, you are encouraged to leverage emerging AI productivity tools and automation scripts to continuously optimize service delivery.

Success in this role requires technical versatility, disciplined execution in shared team queues, discreet handling of sensitive data, and clear communication across a globally distributed IT organization.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise Support & Technical Ownership

  • Queue Ownership: Ownership of the regional end-user support queue. Deliver rapid, high-quality resolution for macOS, Windows, identity, mobile, and SaaS software issues across the EMEA region
  • Relationship Management: Partner closely with regional department heads, office administrators, and local stakeholders to maintain strong alignment between IT services and business needs
  • Proactive Resolution: Monitor endpoint health and system alerts to remediate device, network, or security issues before they impact productivity
  • SLA & Workflow Tracking: Keep structured ticket workflows updated with clear diagnostic notes, tracking work against key SLAs (MTTR, FTTR, and CSAT)

2. Lifecycle Management & Onboarding

  • Hardware Provisioning: Manage procurement, device configuration, endpoint deployment, and asset tracking for laptops, mobile devices, and peripherals
  • Onboarding Execution: Ensure new hires receive fully configured hardware and role-based application entitlements prior to their start date
  • Offboarding & Asset Recovery: Execute secure, compliant offboarding workflows, ensuring timely hardware collection, account deprovisioning, and data destruction standards
  • Confidentiality & Data Governance: Handle all employee data, sensitive operational context, and security entitlements in strict compliance with company confidentiality standards and NDA requirements

3. Global Handoffs & Incident Response

  • Follow-the-Sun Operational Coverage: Participate in the global 24/7 handoff standard—APAC → EMEA → AMERICAS—passing overnight incidents, open risks, and active escalation threads at shift boundaries
  • Escalation Coordination: Hand specialized infrastructure or security elements to L3/Engineering teams while retaining ownership of user-impacting regional threads
  • On-Call Rotation: Participate in the regional after-hours or weekend incident rotation, applying quick diagnostic workarounds and escalating according to severity matrices

4. AV Systems, Office Infrastructure & Events

  • Conference Room Maintenance: Maintain operational readiness for Dublin office Zoom Rooms, Teams rooms, microphones, displays, and control systems
  • Event Support: Lead technical preparation and live support for EMEA All Hands, town halls, quarterly business reviews, and regional leadership meetings
  • Network & Workplace Collaboration: Partner with Network/AV Engineering and Facilities teams to resolve physical office connectivity issues, room remediation, and hardware upgrades

5. Process Discipline & AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Structured Ticket Hygiene: Maintain accurate ticket estimates, DRI tags, and clear definitions of done in Jira or similar enterprise service desk tooling
  • Automation & Toil Reduction: Utilize AI agent-assist tools, virtual assistants, and workflow scripting (Python, PowerShell, or API integrations) to eliminate manual tasks
  • Knowledge Management: Author and update internal technical runbooks and end-user self-service documentation in Confluence

Success Measures & Expectations

In this role, success is measured by concrete operational outcomes and your ability to scale regional IT support alongside enterprise growth:

  • Service Excellence & SLA Rigor: Maintain a consistent track record of hitting target SLAs (≥95%) across regional queues with flat-to-up CSAT scores, shifting the operational ratio decisively from reactive ticket firefighting to proactive, automated issue resolution
  • Day-One Readiness: Achieve 100% on-time hardware and identity provisioning for new hires across EMEA prior to day one, with zero role-based entitlement gaps and auditable asset tracking across all regional inventory
  • Global Incident Discipline: Execute seamless follow-the-sun handoffs (APAC → EMEA → AMERICAS) and maintain zero unacknowledged critical incidents during regional on-call shifts, owning incident communication end-to-end
  • Flawless Executive & Event Delivery: Deliver zero preventable AV or operational failures during regional All Hands, town halls, and executive QBRs through structured pre-flight checks and continuous conference room testing
  • Operational Leverage: Deliver at least one measurable toil-reduction or automation initiative per quarter (leveraging scripts, API integrations, or AI tooling) that tangibly reduces repetitive operational overhead

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Experience Level: 3+ years of experience in an IT Support or Systems Specialist role within a modern SaaS or tech enterprise environment
  • Tooling Expertise: Strong hands-on experience administration tools including Okta, JAMF, Meraki, Confluence, Jira, and Slack
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Demonstrated experience troubleshooting hardware, identity management (SSO/MFA), network connectivity, and cloud software applications
  • AV & Event Operations: Proven capability in supporting meeting room AV infrastructures and live company events
  • Automation & AI Integration: Experience working with workflow automation platforms, scripting tools (Python, PowerShell, or Bash), or AI agent-assist platforms
  • Operational Flexibility: Flexibility to participate in an on-call rotation and occasional early morning / late evening coverage for global events or shift handoffs

Nice to Have

  • Certifications: Relevant industry certifications (Okta Administrator, Jamf Certified Tech, CompTIA Network+/Security+)
  • Global Operations: Prior experience with enterprise follow-the-sun global handoff models
  • Integrations & Development: Exposure to REST APIs for building custom IT service integrations

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

Leveraging the power of our platform and our peerless intelligence across sectors, strategies, and geographies, we help identify the advantages and the answers our clients need to succeed. Position Overview The Senior Associate will be part of the StepStone Portfolio Analytics & Reporting (SPAR) team, supporting the delivery of portfolio analytics, reporting and data management services for the Firm's private debt and multi-asset client portfolios. The role requires strong technical expertise in private markets data, performance reporting, portfolio analysis and data quality management. The successful candidate will work closely with Investment, Fund Accounting, Research, Investor Relations and other internal teams to deliver accurate, insightful and timely reporting while contributing to the continued enhancement of reporting processes, analytics and data infrastructure. Responsibilities Produce, review and deliver private debt portfolio reporting and analytics for institutional clients and internal stakeholders Own the day-to-day execution of the reporting cycle for assigned client portfolios, ensuring accuracy, consistency and timely delivery Analyze portfolio performance, exposures, cash flows, and other key private markets metrics. Investigate and resolve data discrepancies across multiple internal and external data sources. Continuously monitor and improve data quality across assigned client portfolios and reporting outputs. Support the development and enhancement of portfolio analytics, reporting methodologies and reporting frameworks. Partner with Investment, Research, Fund Accounting and Investor Relations teams to ensure accurate interpretation and presentation of portfolio information. Support reporting automation initiatives and process improvement projects, including the use of reporting and visualization tools. Contribute to the ongoing development and maintenance of StepStone's private markets data universe. Provide technical guidance and training to Analysts and Associates and support their professional development. Contribute to strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing reporting capabilities, scalability and operational efficiency. Education And/or Work Experience Requirements Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related field. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience, preferably within Private Markets, Asset Management or Investment Reporting. Strong understanding of private debt and private markets investment structures, cash flows, portfolio monitoring and performance reporting. Experience working with large financial datasets and performing complex data analysis and reconciliations. Working knowledge of financial reporting, accounting principles and portfolio reporting frameworks. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the Microsoft Office suite; experience with reporting and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) is considered an asset. Experience with portfolio management, reporting or performance measurement systems is preferred. CFA, CAIA or other relevant professional designation is a plus. Proficiency in English is required; proficiency in German is a plus. Other Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to identify, investigate and resolve complex data and reporting issues. Strong technical aptitude and interest in financial data and reporting systems. Ability to manage multiple deliverables and competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment. Self-starter with demonstrated initiative, ownership and accountability. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Collaborative and team-oriented mindset. Interest in private debt, private markets and global financial markets At StepStone, we believe that our people are our most important asset and crucial to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that strives to create an environment that empowers our employees and allows them to be heard, regardless of title or tenure. Our organizational community features multiple Employment Resource Groups as well as mentorship programs to enhance the employee experience for all. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, StepStone does not discriminate on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. Candidates must be at least 18 years old to apply. Developing People at StepStone

80a797090329906bcabb.description: Job Summary Are you ready to join a game-changing open-source AI platform that harnesses the power of hybrid cloud to drive innovation? The Agent Operations team within Red Hat AI (RHAI) is looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join us in Ireland. Our team builds the infrastructure that allows AI agents to run securely and reliably on Kubernetes and OpenShift, including the OpenShell project, an open-source platform for agent orchestration, identity, and sandboxing. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, cloud-native infrastructure, and security, contributing to technology that defines how autonomous agents are deployed, governed, and trusted in production. As an intern you will be part of a fast-paced and diverse group of engineers working worldwide to create value for our customers and partners while also being part of open source communities. You will be assigned a mentor for the duration of the internship; they will assist you in anything you require, from engineering to personnel issues. You will pair-program with experienced engineers which will significantly help your growth as a developer. You will have free access to the acclaimed Red Hat University courses and Udemy. You will attend all the same training events and presentations as that of a full-time employee. At Red Hat, our commitment to open source innovation extends beyond our products - it's embedded in how we work and grow. Red Hatters embrace change - especially in our fast-moving technological landscape - and have a strong growth mindset. That's why we encourage our teams to proactively, thoughtfully, and ethically use AI to simplify their workflows, cut complexity, and boost efficiency. This empowers our associates to focus on higher-impact work, creating smart, more innovative solutions that solve our customers' most pressing challenges. What You Will Do Perform engineering tasks under the direction of an experienced engineer Become an active member of an agile development team, both scrum and kanban Learn to collaborate and innovate with other engineers in your team Troubleshoot technical issues and help deliver creative solutions Work both on your own, remotely, and collaboratively with others in your team Help mentor a transition year student, transferring your learned skills to the younger students Contribute to the open-source community Present a topic, not always technical, to the Cloud Services team at one or more of our Lunch & Learn events Proactively utilize AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) for code generation, auto-completion, and intelligent suggestions to accelerate development cycles and enhance code quality. What You Will Bring Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline Growth mindset; willingness to learn and challenge yourself Ability to give and receive feedback in a meaningful manner Passion for problem-solving and debugging technical issues Written and verbal communication skills in English Some working knowledge/understanding of Git usage and workflows (Git workshops are provided for all interns when they join). A good understanding of scripting and programming with languages such Python, Golang, Rust A basic understanding or knowledge of Linux operating systems Some understanding of configuration management, automation tools, and containerisation technologies. Active online presence (e.g. GitHub) with interest in community development is a plus. About Red Hat Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. Inclusion at Red Hat Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO) Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee. Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

80b134f0bc88be4d2ad2.description: Software Engineer II, Security Location: Belfast, NI / Hybrid (This role requires working in-office 3 days per week.) About us: EverQuote is a leading AI-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share. Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real-world impact and do the best work of your career, you’ve found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you. About the role: EverQuote NI is seeking a Software Engineer II, Security to join our team! In this role, you will join a team that bridges the gap between Security Engineering and Compliance to streamline vulnerability management. You will work proactively to maintain a security testing process that enables Product and Engineering teams to provide business value in a secure environment. As a senior engineer, you will be an important member of the team and instrumental in the design and delivery of key business applications and solutions. You will have input in architecture decision-making within the team and ensure we build scalable, performant, easy to maintain and cost-optimised solutions. What you'll do: Identifying and trialling new security tooling for our SDLC, particularly in the AI space. Coding solutions to engineering challenges in the security space, primarily using Python and SQL. Advocating and consulting with other engineers on security best practices and secure-by-design methodologies. Maintaining security data products such as SBOM, asset inventory, cloud infrastructure, and SIEM. Monitoring, logging, triaging and escalating cyber security threats, as well as documenting security events including IoC (Indicators of compromise). Conducting and collating security assessments through a variety of methods as appropriate. Creating reports and working collaboratively with engineering teams to remediate identified issues. Providing support and training for teams where needed. What you bring to the team: 2+ years work experience as a Security Analyst, Security Engineer, or in a similar role. Degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. Experienced in programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, and / or SQL. Proficiency with AWS cloud platforms and particularly their security tools such as Security Hub, IAM, etc. Strong knowledge of principles such as risk assessment, threat modelling, the OWASP Top 10, information security practices, and encryption theory. Possess a clear understanding of secure development best practices. Continuous integration and deployment tools. Proficient with Linux environments. Entrepreneurial mindset, want to grow a business, and love working with a team. Comfortable using data to support and validate your concepts. Thrive in a fast-paced work environment where everyday contributions have a big impact. Ability to quickly diagnose and solve code problems, as well as help others unblock themselves. Passionate about sharing knowledge and mentoring teammates. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in variable cash bonus programs, equity, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility which are designated by role. Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE range for your role during the hiring process. Statement on Fair Employment and Equal Opportunities EverQuote NI is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for all job applicants and employees. We will not discriminate on the grounds of religious belief, political opinion, race, gender (including gender reassignment), sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, age, or disability. As a registered employer in Northern Ireland, EverQuote NI complies with the Fair Employment and Treatment (Northern Ireland) Order 1998. As part of the application process, you will be asked to complete a fair employment monitoring form; this information is used solely for monitoring purposes and does not form part of the shortlisting or selection decision. EverQuote NI carries out background checks on all candidates offered a position. A criminal record will not automatically disqualify you from working with EverQuote NI Limited; each case is considered on its individual merits in line with our fair recruitment practices. Reasonable Adjustments We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations at any stage of the interview process, please let us know and we will work with you to arrange them. Back to jobs Software Engineer, Research Productivity San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Research Productivity organization builds the infrastructure and systems that accelerate research across Anthropic, including the tools that help our research process get faster and more effective over time. We're looking for an experienced software engineer to join us as we scale this infrastructure at a moment when both demand and scope are growing extremely quickly. This team operates like a startup within a startup. You'll be a strong fit if you like thinking from first principles, iterating fast on infrastructure, and tackling reliability and scalability challenges head-on as the products built on top of your systems evolve underneath you. You'll independently scope complex, multi-month projects, drive cross-org alignment through ambiguous problem spaces, and make the architectural decisions that shape how the infrastructure behind our research tooling gets built. You'll partner directly with research teams to understand their workflows, anticipate how their requirements will change, and design and scale infrastructure that can keep pace. Responsibilities Design, build, and scale infrastructure and systems that support rapidly increasing usage, where requirements and workload continue to evolve as the products built on top of them evolve Independently scope and lead complex, multi-month engineering projects, from an ambiguous starting point through to a production system Drive cross-organizational alignment on technical direction, working through ambiguous problem spaces with multiple stakeholders and teams Make architectural decisions that shape the foundation of research infrastructure and tooling across Anthropic Partner directly with researchers to deeply understand their workflows, then anticipate and design for how those needs will change Iterate quickly, favoring pragmatic, first-principles solutions and fast feedback loops over heavy upfront design Take ownership of the reliability and scalability of critical systems as load, usage, and complexity increase Help set technical standards and best practices for the team, and mentor other engineers Minimum Qualifications Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or infrastructure in production A track record of independently scoping and delivering complex, ambiguous, multi-month technical projects Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on coding ability Experience making architectural decisions that other engineers and teams build on top of Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience driving alignment across multiple teams or stakeholders Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing environments Strong candidates may also have Experience building infrastructure or platforms specifically for research or machine learning workflows Direct experience navigating the reliability and architectural challenges that come with rapidly scaling systems Experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and infrastructure-as-code Familiarity with the compute, tooling, and workflow needs of large-scale machine learning research Experience operating in a startup or startup-like environment, i.e. a small, fast-moving team with high autonomy Prior experience as a technical lead or mentor for other engineers The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 - $625,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. About the role

Anthropic's Business Risk & Insurance (BRI) team, part of Treasury, safeguards the company's balance sheet, people and physical assets. We are the financial and operational safety net for a company building some of the world's most advanced AI systems, from large-scale compute and data center infrastructure to our offices and the products we put in customers' hands. The team is scaling quickly as Anthropic grows.

As a Risk & Insurance Specialist, you'll build operational excellence across contracts, claims, and day-to-day insurance operations, using AI and automation to streamline processes wherever you can. You'll work closely with Compute, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Security, Product and Payroll to spot emerging risks early, help structure global insurance programs, support our risk-financing strategy and drive loss prevention. This is a rare chance to insure one of the fastest-growing companies, where parts of the risk landscape are still being defined, and to help Anthropic pursue its mission boldly by keeping our operations resilient and protected.

Key responsibilities

  • Insurance review of contracts: Review insurance and indemnity requirements in customer, vendor, lease, and compute agreements, and advise Legal and business partners on compliant, practical positions.
  • Insurance operations: Manage claims intake and tracking, certificates of insurance, broker coordination, and policy administration. Build a data warehouse / repository and repeatable processes as volume scales.
  • Data gathering and reporting: Collect and maintain exposure data (property values, payroll, revenue, headcount, etc.) for renewals, audits, and underwriting submissions.
  • Actuarial and quantitative analysis: Support limit-adequacy, loss, and retention analyses to inform program structure and decisions.
  • Captive operations: Support captive formation and ongoing operations, including fronting and reinsurance coordination.
  • Automation: Identify and implement ways to automate manual insurance workflows using AI and workflow tools.
  • Cross-functional support: Partner with Compute, Finance, Legal, and Payroll on insurance questions across the business.

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience in insurance, corporate risk management, brokerage, underwriting, or risk consulting.
  • Hands-on experience supporting a multi-line commercial insurance program (property, casualty, cyber/tech E&O, D&O/management liability, and similar).

Preferred qualifications

  • 8–12 years in insurance, corporate risk management, brokerage, underwriting, or risk consulting
  • At least 4 years on the corporate (buyer) side, or in a broker or carrier role serving corporate clients
  • Experience at, or insuring, a technology company or other fast-growing, complex organization
  • Property insurance experience, including large or complex property, construction, or data center exposures
  • Captive insurance experience (formation, management, fronting, or reinsurance)
  • Experience insuring emerging technology risks, such as AI or technology liability and cyber
  • Background at a major broker, carrier, or large technology company risk team
  • Actuarial training or credentials, or experience with actuarial analysis
  • Familiarity with insurance management systems, SQL or Python, or building workflow automation
  • Experience building processes from scratch in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment

Here, we develop company-wide IT and digitalisation strategies that exploit ground-breaking technologies and strategically advise our Fortune 500 CIO clients on how to reinvent their IT operating models, enterprise and data architectures, take advantage of cloud, and improve the value they are getting from their IT investments. Our practice has been consistently rated as the best team in the industry by the Financial Times based on client ratings and was key for Accenture to be named a leader by Forrester. The Opportunity for You We are looking for an experienced individual to join our vibrant Technology Strategy and Transformation practice. We are looking for people who can help clients shape and deliver technology-led reinvention across the Digital Core. This role is suited to candidates who bring a strong consulting foundation and experience across several areas of technology strategy, architecture, AI enablement, digital foundations, technology effectiveness, and transformation delivery. We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every area; we value thoughtful generalists who can connect business priorities, technology choices, delivery realities, and measurable value outcomes while continuing to be curious about learning. In this role, you will help clients define, shape and deliver technology products, platforms, operating models and transformation programmes that unlock business value, improve agility and accelerate outcomes. You will work closely with senior client stakeholders, business and industry specialists, engineering teams, architects, designers, analysts, partner vendors and delivery teams to create practical, high-quality outcomes. What you will help clients do: Lead strategic advisory projects, programmes and workstreams from shaping through to delivery, keeping stakeholders aligned, informed and focused on outcomes. Help clients define how technology functions can create business value through effective operating models, product and platform structures, governance, organisation design and ways of working. Shape transformation strategies, business cases, roadmaps, target states, frameworks and recommendations that are pragmatic, actionable and linked to measurable value. Assess current-state maturity across areas such as architecture, agile delivery, modern engineering, operating models, governance, AI readiness and technology ways of working. Advise clients on how AI and emerging technologies may change IT operating models, workforce capability, governance and client value. Guide practical adoption of AI in the software development lifecycle, helping teams reduce delivery cost, improve engineering effectiveness and accelerate time to value. Own practical delivery plans, timelines, budgets, risks, dependencies, resources, quality and commercial reporting. Facilitate workshops, planning sessions and governance forums in a clear, inclusive and structured way. Work with cross-functional teams including engineers, designers, analysts, architects, clients, vendors and delivery partners to deliver high-quality outcomes. Provide clear updates on progress, risks, issues, actions and dependencies to support effective decision-making. Lead, coach and mentor client and internal teams through change, embedding new ways of working and building a positive, inclusive, high-performing delivery culture. What you will do: Work with senior business and technology leaders to define technology strategies, future-state roadmaps, and practical transformation plans. Help clients build AI-ready digital foundations across data, cloud, infrastructure, platforms, enterprise architecture, and modern delivery practices. Assess technology estates, operating models, delivery capabilities, resilience, cost, and value to identify opportunities for improvement. Support complex transformation programmes by helping teams establish governance, manage risk, track value, and maintain delivery momentum. Collaborate across business, technology, data, engineering, infrastructure, managed services, and ecosystem partners to create joined-up solutions. Experience Requirements: Significant experience in consulting, technology strategy or technology transformation teams (typically 6+ years). Proven track record driving technology transformation programmes. Experience managing client relationships at senior levels. Demonstrated success contributing to business development, proposal development and sales pursuits. Good commercial acumen with experience managing project financials. Core skills we expect everyone to bring: AI awareness and curiosity: a practical understanding of how AI, data, and automation are changing businesses, technology functions, and delivery methods. Strong communication and storytelling: the ability to explain complex ideas clearly, tailor messages for different audiences, and build confidence with stakeholders. Project and change skills: experience helping teams plan, organise, govern, and deliver change in complex environments. Business and technology judgement: the ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes, value, risk, cost, and feasibility. Collaboration and adaptability: comfort working across multidisciplinary teams, learning new domains quickly, and contributing beyond a narrow specialism. Structured problem solving: the ability to break down ambiguity, identify options, build evidence-based recommendations, and move work forward. Experience across several of these areas: Candidates should bring skills or experience across several of the areas below. These are the kinds of things our teams do; they are not all mandatory requirements for every candidate. Technology strategy and architecture: shaping technology vision, business technology strategy, enterprise architecture, future-state roadmaps, and investment cases. AI, data, and digital foundations: supporting AI adoption, data strategy, agentic or AI-enabled platforms, cloud and infrastructure strategies, enterprise SaaS, and modern digital core design. Technology modernisation and resilience: assessing legacy estates, defining modernisation pathways, improving resilience, and sequencing practical architecture roadmaps. Technology effectiveness and value: improving technology operating models, FinOps, cost optimisation, AI-enabled software delivery, engineering productivity, and value tracking. Transformation delivery: supporting large-scale technology programmes, transformation offices, governance, planning, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and benefits realisation. Ecosystem and platform collaboration: working with major technology platforms, cloud providers, software vendors, and cross-functional delivery teams to shape integrated solutions. Who will thrive in this role: Generalists who enjoy connecting ideas across strategy, architecture, delivery, AI, data, operating model, and business value. People who are comfortable with ambiguity and can help clients move from broad ambition to practical next steps. Consultants who can build trusted relationships, communicate clearly, and bring teams together around a shared direction. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Program Manager on Anthropic's Safeguards team, you'll help make sure we meet our obligations under AI safety laws and regulations around the world. Working closely with Legal, you'll turn new and emerging requirements into programs, controls, and deliverables. This requires a detailed understanding of how our models and products are built, evaluated and safeguarded. Your work will support Anthropic's commitment to developing AI safely and beneficially as the regulatory landscape evolves.

The responsibilities listed below are some examples of areas that someone in this role could own, depending on their experience and the team's needs.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage and drive complex safety initiatives that identify, assess and mitigate risks from frontier models, from initial risk assessment through to the deployment of safeguards

  • Partner with the Safeguards incident management team to strengthen incident response and reporting processes, including the policies that determine how incidents are escalated and when they must be reported externally

  • Conduct post-incident reviews, and work with the subject matter experts for each harm area to incorporate the findings into model and product safeguards

  • Own the safety strategy and deliverables for AI systems used in high-risk settings, including risk assessments, technical documentation, and the information that deploying customers need to use those systems safely

  • Define the safety and risk controls that our models and products require, ensure that each control has an owner and a documented procedure, and confirm that it operates as intended

  • Partner closely with the owners of each risk area to develop a deep understanding of AI risks, safety evaluations and mitigation strategies, and use that understanding to prepare safety documentation, transparency reports and regulatory submissions

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience in trust and safety, AI safety or a related field, including designing and implementing safeguards against misuse or harm

  • Understanding of AI safety, including the principal risk areas and the evaluations and safeguards used to address them, well enough to engage substantively with the technical experts responsible for them

  • Experience running risk assessment or harm mitigation programs from identification through to resolution

  • Experience translating policy or regulatory requirements into practical operational processes

  • Ability to drive complex, cross-functional programs to completion in a fast-moving environment, including with technical teams outside your own discipline

  • Clear written communication, including documentation for technical, legal and external audiences

  • Strong attention to detail, and the judgment to recognize when work is at risk and raise it early

  • Commitment to the safe development and deployment of AI

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with AI-specific regulation, such as the EU AI Act

  • Experience leading incident response programs, including escalation paths and external reporting obligations

  • Experience preparing safety documentation, transparency reports or regulatory submissions

  • Experience working with technical and research teams on safety evaluations

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$245,000—$285,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Overview Ask a model to brief a motion and it hands back something that reads like a real filing, then cites three cases that do not exist and misstates the standard of review on a fourth. The procedural posture drifts, the deadline math is off, and the local rules are ignored. A litigator like you is who catches it before it reaches a judge. As a Litigation Attorney you'll evaluate AI work on pleadings, discovery, and motion practice, check every citation and holding against the record, and rewrite the argument the way a careful advocate would frame it. What you’ll actually do Draft prompts that test how models handle pleadings, discovery disputes, motions, and litigation strategy across jurisdictions. Review AI output for invented citations, misread holdings, wrong standards of review, and blown procedural deadlines, and rate the reasoning. Write the correct filing when the model falls short, with the precision a court would expect. Roles this fits Common backgrounds: Litigation Associate, Litigation Paralegal. What we look for Hands-on litigation experience: motion practice, discovery, or trial work in civil or criminal matters. Sharp legal research and writing, with a firm grasp of procedure and evidence. Clear written English: your explanations are the training signal. No degree required. We care about what you can do, not where you learned it. Compensation Up to $125+/hr depending on task difficulty and specialization. Many contributors add $100k–$200k a year; some make it their full-time income. About DataAnnotation DataAnnotation is where 1M+ experts train the world’s leading AI models. Hundreds of millions paid to contributors to date, and the average contributor stays 5+ years. 840f9f3d01284d532290.description: Global Operations, Operations Summer Analyst Dublin, UK About Us At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities, and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognising, and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! The team: Global Operations (GO) teams manage the critical systems and multiple platforms needed to maintain the enterprise's market-leading positions in key segments. By performing vital functions throughout the end-to-end lifecycle of products, services, and client transactions, we help deliver seamless client outcomes while maintaining a strong risk and control environment. These activities include client onboarding, trade validation, settlement, servicing, reporting, reconciliations, risk management, process improvement and change delivery. Programme Overview Our Summer Analyst Programme in Dublin is designed to provide you with a unique experience within Global Operations. Opportunities are available in the following teams, with alignment based on your interests, development opportunities, and current business needs: Global Markets Operations (GMO) – Provides end-to-end operational support for Global Markets sales, trading and underwriting activities across securities, loans, and derivative products. Our teams manage critical activities throughout the trade lifecycle, including trade processing, settlement, reconciliation, collateral management, and client servicing, helping deliver seamless market execution. Training and Development Your training and development is our top priority with extensive formal training offered at the start of the programme in addition to on‑the‑job training, virtual spotlight sessions, Executive Speaker Series, networking events, and hands‑on project work, with mentorship throughout. Responsibilities: As a Summer Analyst, you will be aligned to one team based on your interests and current business needs. Your key tasks and responsibilities may include but are not limited to: Develop an understanding of client, account, and product reference data management processes. Support settlement, clearing, and reconciliation activities across a range of products and services. Build knowledge of trade lifecycle processes, including trade validation, maintenance, exception management, and reconciliation. Build knowledge of the products, services and operational processes that support the bank and its clients Analyse data, identify trends and contribute to business insights, process reviews, and operational excellence initiatives Develop an understanding of risk management, controls, governance and regulatory requirements Support project delivery, business analysis and stakeholder engagement activities Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations and updates for business partners and senior stakeholders Eligibility Candidates are required to be pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited college or university with a completion time frame between September 2027 and July 2028. Completion means that you have completed all final exams, coursework, and have no outstanding requirements for graduation. Please note that we reserve the right to request evidence of this completion date before extending an offer. On track for a minimum 2:2 degree classification (or equivalent) Must be available to join the programme from June 2027 to August 2027 Candidates who perform well during the internship may be offered full time employment to commence in July 2028; some lines of business may also offer the opportunity of a January or April start date. You must be available to join on one of these start dates if offered, unfortunately we are unable to offer deferrals What We Are Looking For Essential: Clear motivation for exploring an Operations career within financial services Evidence of self-learning outside of studies, and efforts to advance technical skills Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to solve problems and positively challenge existing processes Effective communication and interpersonal skills, and ability to interact with a variety of people Display evidence of strong teamwork, leadership, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities Demonstrate integrity and ethics by earning other’s trust and respect through consistent honesty and professionalism in all interactions Fluency in written and spoken English is a pre-requisite Most importantly, we are looking for individuals with a growth mindset who are keen to learn, embrace challenges and contribute fresh perspectives while delivering an exceptional experience for our clients and teammates. 852ee6dc50792e576856.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.  As a Fluidic Components Technical Owner, you will own the technical follow-up of suppliers providing assigned Nyx Earth fluid-control equipment, including the technical baseline, evidence path, supplier development and qualification path, delivery readiness, integration support, and operations feedback loop.  You will work closely with propulsion system engineering, equipment owners, program management, procurement, quality, PA, supplier quality, AIT/MAIT, test, M&P, safety, operations, and suppliers or manufacturing partners providing the assigned components. The reporting line is to be confirmed by Propulsion leadership.    Key Responsibilities    Own the assigned fluidic-component technical baseline, including requirements, interfaces, verification methods, qualification logic, review data, and acceptance criteria.    Maintain a system-level view of fluidic, mechanical, thermal, electrical, command, cleanliness, materials-compatibility, safety, operations, and integration interfaces.    Follow supplier development, qualification, acceptance, integration, and operations-support logic for assigned valves, regulators, fill/drain equipment, pressure-control equipment, or related fluidic components.    Keep TEC's technical position clear when following suppliers, manufacturing partners, special processes, or test houses.    Review supplier deliverables, drawings where available, analyses, procedures, inspection evidence, test results, review packages, deviations, and non-conformance inputs.    Make leakage, response, cleanliness, compatibility, lifetime, production repeatability, evidence gaps, delivery risks, and recovery options visible early.    Support MAIT/AIT preparation, integration, test procedures, acceptance evidence, flight-operations preparation, flight-data review, and abnormal-behaviour treatment for assigned fluidic equipment.    What We Would Love To See From You    Strong aerospace, mechanical, propulsion, fluids, or related engineering background.    Experience with spacecraft propulsion fluidic components such as valves, regulators, fill/drain equipment, pressure-control equipment, or related fluid-control hardware.    Practical understanding of requirements, verification, cleanliness, materials compatibility, leakage, actuation, testing, qualification, manufacturing support, and failure modes.    Ability to own technical supplier follow-up for complex hardware across requirements, interfaces, qualification, delivery, integration, and anomaly support.    Strong communication with propulsion, procurement, quality, MAIT/AIT, test, program, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and operations stakeholders.    Fluency in English; French and/or German are useful assets.    Skills And Behaviours    You keep the technical position clear even when ownership, supplier evidence, schedule, or integration constraints are messy.    You judge component decisions by spacecraft, mission, safety, integration, cost, and schedule impact.    You make evidence gaps, assumptions, weak test results, open points, and deviations visible early.    You balance fast development with configuration, cleanliness, verification, and qualification discipline.    You build trust with suppliers, partners, engineers, and leadership through facts and follow-through.     Why you should join us! 856edc6b02c650224bc6.description: Our Mission   At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts:  procurement  – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger  50+ emails , and pull in  Finance, Legal, Security, and IT  just to get something approved.  We’ve raised  $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners,  and  Accel  to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.   The opportunity is massive.  Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the    4th fastest growing startup    in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.   Our team previously scaled Tessian  ( cybersecurity tech,  backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel ,  acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like    Ben   ,    Abs   ,    Sabrina   , and    Rebe   .    Find out more about the team and life at Omnea    here   .    The Role  AI is changing what it means to deploy enterprise software. Configuring a customer's procurement workflows used to mean weeks of manual setup, integration by integration, edge case by edge case.
