9fda9b6a3b836a933c6d.description: At ESB, technology plays a leading role in enabling and realising our purpose to deliver a brighter future for the customers and communities we serve. Today that means we are driven to make a difference – net zero by 2040 – and it’s our people who ensure we succeed. With circa 500 people working across our IT Delivery and CIO functions, together we design, build and support a broad range of technologies and services to deliver on our strategic objectives – decarbonised electricity, resilient infrastructure and empowered customers. To further enhance our capabilities and to transform ESB to a data driven and digital utility, we are looking for Graduates to join our highly motivated and skilled team of IT professionals where you will have the opportunity to deliver results in a fast-paced, innovative team environment. Our IT Graduate Development Programme is structured into six distinct career paths where you will be able to grow your experience, as well as develop the necessary skills to help you on your way to career success. The Digital Delivery, including Project Management, Business & Technology stream is designed for graduates who are interested in the business side of delivering technology and change, rather than software development or programming. At ESB, IT Delivery is responsible for the IT Investment Portfolio of Projects and Products, in a sustainable, value driven way. It is a dynamic, high performing function with a mix of strategic and operational activities across a broad range of activities. Working within ESB's IT function, you will help shape and deliver strategic initiatives that improve how the organisation operates, serves customers and delivers value. You will work with a broad range of stakeholders across the business, supporting projects, products and change initiatives that enable ESB's digital transformation. Graduates will be developed in a suitable career path from: Project and Programme Management (Waterfall & Agile) Agile Business Analysis Change Management Test Management and Quality Assurance Product and Portfolio Management IT Service Management Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management Software Asset Management and Compliance Strategic Resourcing and Capability Development Solution Architecture Throughout the programme, you will develop skills in stakeholder engagement, problem solving, planning, governance, delivery management and organisational change. What To Expect Our bespoke IT Graduate Development Programme includes: Structured Rotations – Our graduate programme is typically structured into targetted rotations aligned with career paths and capability development where you will build your IT and business knowledge through challenging assignments, a diverse range of business activities, and the potential to work on projects. Learning & Development – Central to our programme is your learning and development. Structured leadership development, training opportunities, innovation programmes. on-the-job learning and work-shadowing are complemented with personal development programmes and supports designed to help you grow professionally and personally. Performance Orientated – At the start of each of your rotations, you will agree with your Line Manager the goals of the assignment and put in place the steps to help achieve them. Ongoing one-to-one conversations and management reviews will ensure that you are constantly working towards achieving your professional status and position you for a career with ESB. Supportive Working Environment – In addition to your immediate support network of Line Manager, Middle Manager, Team Colleagues and Graduate Peers, you will also be assigned a Buddy and a Mentor. Social Networking – Over the last few years our Graduates have been involved in all sorts of Sports and Social activities. Anything from Tag Rugby, Cricket, Soccer and GAA to language classes, team building challenges, charity work and graduate social events. Our clubs, societies and networks are a great way to build your contacts and of course make new connections. Why work with us? We offer a competitive graduate salary and a comprehensive benefits package built on four pillars of Reward, Career, Community, and Well-being: Progressive, hybrid working model Career development through mentoring and training Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities Sports and Social Clubs Credit Union access Pension Scheme Employee well-being programmes Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion Great team environment with our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Trusted, and Driven Location This position will be based in ESB Head Office, F27, 2 Fitzwilliam Street, Dublin 4. Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business. What We Look For? You should have (or be working towards) a minimum 2.1 Honours Degree in any of the following type of degrees: Business Management, Business & Technology, Business, Innovation, IT & technology related degrees, Computer Sciences, Business Information Systems, Engineering, or an equivalent course where IT was a component. Proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced team environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Excellent analytical skills, combined with the ability to learn quickly. Essential Criteria Currently hold a minimum grade 2.1 level 8 degree, or working towards same Completed a work placement during undergraduate degree - either as part of the degree programme itself, or during a summer period Your CV should be no longer than 2 pages and clearly outline the following: Title of your Degree, and Masters (if applicable) Your results to date Your final year subjects The title of your Final Year project Any relevant work experience A contact telephone number (please ensure a voicemail function is activated on your phone) Closing Date: 19th October 2026

9ffaee7b16ce911b868f.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies (from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups) use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Stripe is one of the fastest growing technology companies in the world, and we’re scaling in every dimension: users, revenue, people, technology, processes, and more. The API Platform team is building the systems that support Stripe’s API. We’re looking for people passionate about distilling complexity across a breadth of problems, caring deeply about both our infrastructure and the experience of using our platform. We are major contributors to the latency, reliability, and efficiency of Stripe’s API, and you’ll be responsible for ensuring we maintain a reliable and secure platform. What you’ll do The API Platform is a unique environment where you’ll be working on the business-critical infrastructure and constructs that are behind Stripe’s products. This team owns the backbone that powers Stripe’s APIs, Developer, and User Experiences. If making systems efficient, scalable, and reliable in a highly fast-paced environment is your bread and butter, then this job is for you. Responsibilities Lead technical delivery and innovation for a team of talented engineers with a wide breadth of mission-critical ownership Lead technical vision for core code across Stripe APIs and webhooks, used by all developers at Stripe. Focus on efficiency, usability, and product partner happiness. Lead technical vision for deep infrastructure challenges across complex systems, ensuring best-in-class scaling, reliability, and efficiency. Coach a team of talented engineers, providing technical mentorship and support to ensure their success. Our staff engineers frequently find clever solutions to make the impossible possible, and to supercharge those around them to hit aggressive deadlines. Own highly impactful projects independently and end-to-end, working across teams, organizations, and stakeholders to support the Infrastructure’s key engineering initiatives. Interact directly with users and partner teams to understand key pain points, and apply your understanding to infrastructure’s hardest problems. Ensure our APIs are secure, reliable, and performant for our partners in product, while strategically solving for their problems. Build and ship amazing end-to-end APIs. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum Requirements 10+ years of technical experience ideally in the infrastructure / platform engineering field. 5+ years in a (>senior) strategic technical leadership role. Experience leading engineering team(s) building APIs and working on infrastructure efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Hands-on experience working across teams and stakeholders to build infrastructure and products for internal customers. Proven track record of delivering pragmatic solutions that demonstrate business impact. Proven track record of shipping code at an accelerated pace. Ability to adjust conversations from high-level discussions to detailed coding. Thrives on a high level of autonomy and responsibility. Clear and persuasive writing and in-person communication. Strong problem-solving skills, critical thinking, determination, and a growth mindset. Ability to work effectively with a diverse group of people, genuinely caring for each other and contributing to a high level of psychological safety for all team members and partners. Proficient in at least one of the programming languages (Java, Ruby, Python, Go). Comfortable participating in rigorous incident response processes and on call rotations. Comfortable working across timezones (particularly PST). Preferred qualifications Strong written and verbal communication skills for different audiences (leadership, users, company-wide). Experience with a variety of common infrastructure platforms (webhook delivery, databases, logging, event streams, metrics, caching, etc). Generally enjoys an in-office culture. Experience developing sustainable, in-house framework and abstraction ecosystems in large engineering orgs. Experience building serverless platforms.

a0a369d682e3e5e30480.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.    We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.    Here’s what this particular role covers.     🛠️ About our Network & Infrastructure Teams   Our team owns the network and site infrastructure that keeps Wayve connected across offices, garages, labs and test facilities in six countries. We’re a growing team of seven engineers across the UK, US, Japan and Israel, delivering a multi-year network upgrade and supporting new sites as Wayve expands. As Network & Infrastructure Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the team, partnering with a staff-level network engineer who sets architecture and standards, and with our Security, Cloud and Workplace teams.      🧠 Your day-to-day     Lead, hire and develop a distributed team, helping engineers grow into domain owners.    Own the roadmap, delivery priorities and vendor relationships for our network and site infrastructure.    Work with our staff-level network engineer to turn technical direction into reliable delivery.    Stay hands-on for roughly 20% of your week, reviewing designs, setting engineering standards and improving automation.    Take part in the network on-call rotation, own P1 escalations and drive corrective actions after incidents.    Partner with Security, Cloud and Workplace colleagues, with regular travel to our sites in Europe, the US and Japan.⁠        🧩 What you’ll be working on     Delivering an approved, multi-year network replacement across our sites, including hardware standards, vendor coordination and safe cutovers.    Building and operating local and wide area networks, wireless, firewalls, certificate-based 802.1X network access control, monitoring and out-of-band management.    Shaping new sites end to end: network connectivity, audio-visual systems, meeting rooms, desk technology and fit-out IT.    Improving connectivity between our sites and cloud platforms, in partnership with the team that owns those platforms.    Turning manual infrastructure work into repeatable automation and infrastructure as code.    Delivering network security controls and evidence that support customer requirements and security assessments.        🙌 You should apply if     You’ve led a network or infrastructure team across sites and time zones, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers.    You bring deep hands-on enterprise networking experience across local and wide area networks, wireless, firewalls and certificate-based 802.1X.    You’ve owned site infrastructure beyond the network, such as AV, meeting rooms, fit-outs or new-site builds.    You’re comfortable with infrastructure as code and network automation, and can set standards and review your team’s work.    You’ve owned major network incidents and delivered multi-site hardware programmes with vendors and resellers.    You’ve delivered network controls and evidence for TISAX, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or an equivalent security assessment.    You want a people-leadership role that still includes hands-on engineering, on-call responsibilities and regular travel—not a network-only or purely strategic position.    Experience with Juniper SRX and Mist, Azure or AWS hybrid connectivity, RADIUS and certificate infrastructure, or automotive supplier-security assessments would be a plus.⁠     🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.      More about Wayve:   🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.  Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.      How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:   Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.      🔍 The Interview Process:   Our process is clear and respectful of your time:     Initial call / recruiter screen  (30 mins): motivation, experience, role fit and practical details.     Competency interview  (1 hour): leadership and people management with the hiring manager, including leading a distributed team and partnering with a staff engineer.     Deep-dive technical interviews  (3 hours total): network domain expertise, end-to-end site design, and network security controls and evidence.     Final interview  (1 hour): mission and values alignment, judgement and communicating riskWe’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.        What’s in it for you (Location dependant):   💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more  A quick, honest note before you apply.  Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.    If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.  At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.   For more information visit  Careers at Wayve.  To learn more about what drives us, visit  Values at Wayve   DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. We are looking for an exceptional commercial lawyer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and isn't afraid of lofty goals and challenges. To succeed in this position, you must be able to work independently and efficiently. We also make sure to have fun while we resolve issues. You will handle contract negotiations and advise on a range of commercial issues important to MongoDB’s business. MongoDB is growing rapidly, and every person we hire has the opportunity to help shape the business and grow with the company. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities

  • Draft and negotiate cloud and licensing agreements, and other technology contracts
  • Provide strategic legal and business advice on contract-related issues to a rapidly-growing and high-performing sales organization and other teams within the sales ecosystem
  • Identify and implement process improvements to streamline negotiations and scale legal resources
  • Develop training resources to enable our sales team to navigate the contracting process effectively
  • Tackle other interesting legal projects and assist team members on others as needed

Requirements

  • Smart, passionate and driven
  • 3+ years of commercial transactions experience, preferably including technology licensing and cloud agreements
  • Proven record of success in-house and/or at a top law firm
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to understand complex contractual issues, assess risk while exercising strong business judgment, and provide clear legal advice
  • Curious and enthusiastic about technology
  • Enjoy working hard and overcoming challenges
  • Great leadership and teamwork skills, and willingness to take on new responsibility
  • Experience advancing projects in a multi-stakeholder environment and handling and prioritizing multiple projects
  • Licensed in an appropriate jurisdiction
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese language skills preferred

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

This is a good opportunity for someone who's interested in technology, enjoys figuring out how things work and wants to build a career in IT support. You'll get exposure to a broad range of technologies, from laptops and office hardware to networking, meeting room systems and software support. If you're looking to get started in IT and this sounds like something you'd enjoy, drop me a message or apply and we'll chat.

Problem Solving : Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — ability to break down complex business requirements into clean technical solutions, debug across the full stack, and propose pragmatic approaches under time constraints. Testing : Comfortable writing unit and integration tests using pytest, with an understanding of test coverage for workflow and state transition logic. DevOps : Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps), containerization (Docker), and deploying Python services to cloud environments including Azure App Service or Azure Functions. Security : Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 / JWT-based authentication, Azure Active Directory (Entra ID), role-based access control, and securing APIs in regulated enterprise environments

We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The IT Operations team keeps Anthropic running. We make sure every employee can do their best work without friction. We're hiring an IT Operations Engineer to develop our global asset management and hardware lifecycle program across our offices in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, London, Dublin and Sydney. You will bring program expertise to how we track hardware as inventory through its whole life: procurement and receiving, the inventory of record, assignment, refresh, collection and recovery, e-waste and secure disposal, and reseller relationships, iterating and scaling practices as we mature. The same person runs day-to-day operations for our corporate mobile program in addition to expertise in management of laptop and workstation lifecycle operations. You'll partner with several teams within the IT, Security and business operations organizations: IT Hardware Ops runs procurement, fleet logistics, onboarding and offboarding, the storage room, and physical intake. The Endpoint pod owns MDM, device policy and enrollment. Finance owns the budget and vendor contracts. Hardware requests that come through the IT Support queue land with the IT Support team, and you'll help define how they are handled. Responsibilities Strategy and Tooling Develop the global asset management strategy: the lifecycle model, the data we keep on every device, and how each office executes against it Select, implement and administer the asset management tool, define its data model and integrations, and partner with IT Engineering where the work needs platform-level access Contribute to and develop the processes on-site engineers in each office execute against, including the storage room process Support the evaluation and onboarding of a hardware lifecycle services vendor and, once in place, run the day-to-day relationship Inventory and Assignment Establish the inventory of record across systems and keep it accurate, from receiving through disposal: every device, its state, its location, and who has it Run audits of who-has-what and reconcile physical counts against the system of record Manage demo, loaner, and travel device inventories, ensuring devices are accurately tracked through complex logistical deployments Maintain up-to-date inventory counts and make strategic purchasing decisions in support new hire onboarding and peripherals stock levels Procurement and Refresh Support hardware purchasing through our reseller and vendor relationships, working from the refresh calendar Build out the refresh calendar and advance it across offices Reconcile purchase orders, deliveries and invoices with Accounting and vendors so that what was ordered, received, and billed line up Collection, E-waste and Disposal Develop device collection and recovery workflows: offboarding returns, refresh swaps, remote-employee returns and the BPO fleet, including the shipping and tracking that goes with them Build the e-waste program: certified recycling and secure disposal partners in each region, data destruction records, and the chain of custody from collection to certificate Handle equipment under legal hold or other chain-of-custody requirements BPO and Contingent Fleet Provision, track and recover the device fleet for our BPO partners, and be the day-to-day hardware contact for those vendors Corporate Mobile Run day-to-day operations for the corporate mobile program and write its runbook Manage deployment, break-fix, and carrier relationships associated with a mobile device fleet Automation Identify repetitive work throughout the operation and automate it with the tools at hand (scripts, systems integrations / connectors, AI tools) You may be a good fit if you Have implemented an asset management and lifecycle program for a multi-office fleet, not only run one: taken it from spreadsheets or nothing to a system of record and defined the processes around it (procurement, inventory, assignment, refresh, collection and disposal), ideally in a fast-paced or high-growth environment Have selected or implemented an asset management platform such as Jira Assets, Snipe-IT or similar, and developed the data model Have run an e-waste or secure disposal program with certified partners and chain-of-custody records Have managed reseller or vendor relationships for hardware purchasing and asset disposal Write things down: runbooks, how-to guides and knowledge base articles Recognize when a request reaches past this role and route platform work to IT Engineering, policy to the Endpoint pod, and budget to Finance Strong candidates may also Have supported a corporate mobile program or carrier account Have basic scripting experience (Bash or Python) for inventory or reporting automation Have experience using AI tools to improve personal or team productivity Have been the hands-on asset contact for an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit: pulled extracts from the register, produced disposal certificates and evidence of returned assets Deadline to apply: Annual Salary: $180,000 - $230,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. a22611c95787656b8002.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic is growing quickly across EMEA, and we need recruiters who can help us hire exceptional people into the teams that keep the company running and bring our work to customers. We’re looking for a Recruiter to join our Talent team in London to own full-cycle recruiting for either our G&A functions (Finance, Legal, People, and related areas) and our Go-To-Market organization (Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer-facing roles), depending on business need and your background.

This is a full-cycle individual-contributor role for a strong recruiter who can run an excellent process end to end—sourcing, screening, managing stakeholders, and closing. You’ll partner with hiring managers across EMEA to understand what great looks like, build healthy pipelines, and deliver a candidate experience that reflects Anthropic’s values. You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift, and you’ll have real ownership over the roles you run.

We’re open to candidates whose strength is in G&A recruiting or in GTM recruiting; in your application, tell us where your experience is deepest.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of G&A or GTM roles across EMEA—from intake through offer and close
  • Partner with hiring managers to scope roles, calibrate the bar, and build effective sourcing strategies
  • Source and engage high-quality active and passive candidates, building diverse and competitive pipelines
  • Run structured, rigorous, and candidate-centric interview processes that uphold Anthropic’s hiring bar
  • Manage candidates through the process with clear communication and a great experience at every stage
  • Collaborate with the broader Talent team, People Partners, and Compensation to structure offers and guide candidates to close
  • Use data to track pipeline health and share insight that helps hiring managers make good decisions

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in either G&A (Finance, Legal, People) or GTM (Sales, Marketing, Partnerships) hiring
  • Track record of closing strong candidates in competitive markets
  • Familiarity with the EMEA talent landscape and comfort recruiting across multiple countries
  • Strong stakeholder management—you build trust and partnership with hiring managers
  • Excellent organization and the ability to manage multiple searches at once without dropping details
  • Clear, direct communication style and a bias toward action
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment
  • Genuine interest in Anthropic’s mission and the role recruiting plays in achieving it

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting at a high-growth technology, AI, or machine learning company
  • Experience recruiting across both G&A and GTM functions
  • Experience hiring across multiple EMEA markets, including the UK and Ireland
  • Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms
  • Additional European language skills relevant to hiring across the region

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
£105,000—£145,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

On the Business Development Team you will be on the front lines of our growth, helping to expand our market presence by identifying and engaging with key decision-makers at the largest and most complex organizations in the world.

The Role:

Our Business Development Representative's main focus is to identify, develop, and create new enterprise business opportunities in new and existing accounts for 1-2 Account Executives in specific verticals within the US.

The work you’ll do:

  • Evangelize the Platform: Act as a champion for the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform, showcasing its transformative capabilities and articulating its value proposition to both new and existing customers.
  • Strategically Prospect: Use modern tools and creative strategies to connect with prospective clients via cold calls, email, and social channels.
  • Generate Pipeline: Drive sales growth by setting up qualified meetings and creating a robust pipeline for our Account Executives.
  • Own Your Territory: Be responsible for a defined territory, developing new accounts and expanding our relationships with existing customers to maximize market potential.
  • Partner with Sales & Marketing: Collaborate with sales to define and execute account-based strategies, and partner with marketing to promote campaigns and events while following up on new leads.
  • Support Complex Sales Cycles: Effectively multithread different lines of business within complex enterprise accounts to build broad support and consensus.

The qualifications you need:

  • Have a BA/BS from a top university or equivalent
  • 1-3 Years of sales experience or business development experience in a SaaS organization a plus
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to engage senior stakeholders and tell a compelling story
  • You adapt quickly and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • A results-driven attitude with a strong desire to compete & exceed targets
  • A natural curiosity. You are also highly coachable and eager to learn.

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role. 

This is a hybrid role. Employees are expected to be in-office 3 days per week.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

a30834778c154ed31f07.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.  You will own the functional architecture and performance of the propellant feed system for a storable bipropellant propulsion system (MON3-MMH system). You will be responsible for ensuring the feed system delivers propellants to the thrusters within required specifications across the full mission envelope — from ground fill through operation, and recovery.    Role Overview  System Architecture    Define and maintain the functional architecture of the feed system including propellant tanks, lines, valves, filters, thrusters and instrumentation.    Perform system-level sizing, sensitivity analyses and functional simulations    System Development    Define functional requirements for subsystems based on propellant system analyses    Identify key verification and validation steps required at the system and subsystem level to demonstrate compliance with specification    Modeling & Analysis    Develop and maintain fluid system models (steady-state and transient) to predict pressure drop, flow rates, water hammer, thruster cross-coupling, and priming behavior.    Verify compliance between system nominal and off-nominal operation with subsystem operational domains (such as thruster envelope).    Analyze failure modes (leakage, contamination, cavitation, fluid hammer) and define mitigation strategies and design margins.    Verification & Test    Lead functional and performance verification: cold-flow, functional and hot-fire tests from component to assembly level .    Correlate test data against predictive models and update margins/requirements accordingly.     Integration Support    Support integration, qualification, and operations reviews (design reviews, FMEA, test readiness reviews).    Interface across design, test, and operations functions throughout the vehicle lifecycle.      Location  You will perform your duties principally at the Company's premises in Bordeaux and may be required to travel from time to time to our company’s premises in Munich in the course of your duties.    What we would love to see from you    Master’s and/or PhD degree in Aerospace Engineering or a related field    Proven experience with python and 0D - 1D fluid simulation tools (model development and analyses) - (e.g., EcosimPro or equivalent)    Hands-on experience in propulsion system design for launch vehicles, spacecraft, or space capsules, with direct exposure to liquid propulsion architectures.    Proven experience in version control systems and tools (e.g., Git or SVN)    Deep understanding of fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and compressible flow    Experience with storable propulsion system is a plus    Fluency in English    German or French are an asset    Skills and Behaviours:    A hands-on approach to problem-solving, combined with a collaborative mindset to work across multidisciplinary teams    Excellent organizational skills and ability to multitask    Capability of working autonomously whilst collaborating productively with remote teams    Positive and flexible attitude in a constantly evolving environment    Grit to get the job done    Ability to communicate effectively with a wide variety of audiences    Behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Commitment, Innovation, Trust, Quality, and Teamwork       Why you should join us!   What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:      We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind     We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them      We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?      We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.     The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.       All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.   If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc. a38257708ce87927afce.description: Graduate - Cybersecurity See it differently You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future. Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities. The Opportunity The Cybersecurity team embodies Arup’s Total Design philosophy by integrating people, processes, technology and physical assets into cohesive cybersecurity strategies that are embedded from concept through to implementation. The team works with a variety of public sector organisations, including Transport Infrastructure Ireland. With reference to our Cybersecurity service within Digital Services, it exemplifies Arup’s Total Design by embedding cybersecurity and resilience governance frameworks, proactive cybersecurity risk intelligence and compliance assurance into the design, implementation and operational phase of projects—ensuring that systems, processes and people are holistically protected from cybersecurity threats. Arup is at the forefront of smart and connected building, city and transport technology and our cyber-advisory specialists have expertise in Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Automation Control Systems (IACS) and IoT technology. We advise clients on risk and vulnerability analysis and propose mitigation strategies that enhance infrastructure resilience and safety. This is an office-based role, with successful candidates expected to work 5 days per week in the Arup office in Cork or Dublin The Candidate Will Be Expected To Deliver high-quality cyber advisory services to Arup projects and clients Support cybersecurity risk, gap and assurance assessments across digital, cloud, system, application, AI, Data Contribute to Operational Technology /Industrial Automation Control System security requirements, architectures and governance outputs Engage with stakeholders to understand risks and provide clear recommendations Support supplier assurance, documentation reviews and audit readiness Produce structured deliverables (risk registers, requirements, reports, roadmaps, specifications) Support proposals, scope development and delivery planning Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to embed cybersecurity into project outcomes Is this role right for you? Arup is looking for a technically capable cybersecurity Graduate with experience in cybersecurity risk-based advisory and assurance, who communicates clearly and enjoys working in multidisciplinary teams supporting the built environment and connected infrastructure For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes: A Minimum Undergraduate / Bachelor's Level (or Equivalent) In Computer Science (incl. Cybersecurity); Data Science / Engineering Risk Management; Threat & Vulnerability Management; Security Design; Network Security; Infrastructure Security; Application Security; Data Security; Cloud Security (AWS; Azure; Google Cloud); Network Design; Application Design; Cybersecurity Management; NIST CSF; ISA/IEC 62443; ISO 19650; CompTIA Security+; CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst+, CompTIA Network+; Problem Solving; Technical Excellence; Communication (written and verbal) https://www.arup.com/en-us/services/technology-and-cybersecurity-consulting/ https://www.arup.com/services/resilience-security-and-risk/ To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria: Full working rights in the country of application No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts. Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes; Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key. Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo. Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working. Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way. Closing date: 12 November 2026 Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended. Eligibility We're able to consider candidates who require an employment permit to work in Ireland, where the role and offered salary meet the Irish Government's eligibility criteria (for example, under the Critical Skills or General Employment Permit schemes). All Employment Permits are granted at the discretion of the Deciding Officer with offers contingent to obtaining the correct immigration to work and reside in Ireland. What we offer you At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together. Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts. We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates. Different people, shared values Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence. Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. Candidates may inform us of any disability, learning difference, or other circumstance that may require reasonable adjustments for interviews or assessments. Any information provided will be used only to make appropriate arrangements and will not be considered in any other aspect of your application or selection process. #IRELAND_GRADS

a3b427f9615afc15b4ba.description: Summary Do you want to have a significant impact on how work is done at Apple? Radar is used by every major organization across Apple to help teams organize and track their work. As Apple’s primary tool for defining, tracking, and testing issues, Radar has been used for decades across various teams, including hardware and software engineering. It serves as a unified platform for bug tracking, test case management, and product management, facilitating seamless coordination among team members. The Radar Engineering team at Apple seeks an early-career DevOps Engineer to help build the pipelines and infrastructure that ship Radar. Description As a DevOps Engineer for Radar, you will help build and run the pipelines that take Radar’scode from commit to production. Radar is Apple’s platform for product development, bugtracking, and work management, a high-traffic, business-critical system used by teams across all of Apple. Fast, safe releases are what let it keep pace with the company. You will join a growing team distributed across California, Texas, and Ireland. In our highly collaborative environment, you will work closely with a team of passionate builders to deliver end-to-end features critical to Apple’s engineering workflows. You will receive structured mentorship, comprehensive training in Apple’s development practices, and the support to learn and develop your skills quickly. Back to jobs Applied AI Engineer, Beneficial Deployments (Life Sciences) San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Beneficial Deployments: Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most. About the Role: We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments team, focused on maximizing the impact of Claude in the life sciences. Our goal is ambitious: accelerate scientific progress from R&D through translation by an order of magnitude. That means making Claude the go-to tool for the life sciences ecosystem from early discovery in academia to paradigm shifting biotech to reimaging pharma pipelines  — and building the technical infrastructure to back that up. You'll work directly with flagship research partners like Howard Hughes Medical Institute and The Allen Institute, embedded in their scientific workflows. This isn't consulting from the outside — you'll be building alongside their engineers, prototyping agents that fit into real research pipelines, and developing the ecosystem-level tooling (MCP servers, benchmarks, reusable agent skills) that extends Claude's usefulness across the broader life sciences community. This role will be part of the founding Beneficial Deployments applied AI team focused on bringing more of life sciences closer to the frontier and be responsible for building with our partners. Responsibilities: Partner deeply with flagship life sciences research institutions — understand their scientific workflows end-to-end, build hands-on with their engineering teams, and help take projects from early exploration to production systems integrated into how they do science day-to-day. Develop reusable ecosystem infrastructure, like MCP servers for domain-specific data sources (genomics platforms, literature databases, experimental repositories), instruments, scientifically-grounded benchmarks, and agent skills that other institutions can adopt without starting from scratch. Identify what's actually hard about deploying AI in life sciences (heterogeneous data, auditability requirements, the prototype-to-trust gap) and feed those findings back to product, engineering, and research. Create technical content and documentation that lets partners self-serve, so what works for one institution can scale globally without the same level of hand-holding. You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have: 4+ years as a Software Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder — with production experience shipping systems that real users depend on. Deep research experience in life sciences, biomedical research, or scientific computing. Bonus if you've studied genomics, neuroscience, or drug discovery specifically and are comfortable getting deeply technical with academics. Experience building LLM-powered tools or applications: prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks. Builder credibility from shipping production code as a software engineer, forward-deployed engineer, or technical founder. A scrappy mentality–comfortable wearing multiple hats, building from scratch, driving clarity in ambiguous situations, and doing whatever it takes to further the mission. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $280,000 - $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. a594f0b78a16fe11515c.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's production models undergo sophisticated post-training processes to enhance their capabilities, alignment, and safety. As a Research Engineer on our Post-Training team, you'll train our base models through the complete post-training stack to deliver the production Claude models that users interact with.

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and production engineering, implementing, scaling, and improving post-training techniques like Constitutional AI, RLHF, and other alignment methodologies. Your work will directly impact the quality, safety, and capabilities of our production models.

Note: For this role, we conduct all interviews in Python. This role may require responding to incidents on short-notice, including on weekends.

Responsibilities:

  • Implement and optimize post-training techniques at scale on frontier models

  • Conduct research to develop and optimize post-training recipes that directly improve production model quality

  • Design, build, and run robust, efficient pipelines for model fine-tuning and evaluation

  • Develop tools to measure and improve model performance across various dimensions

  • Collaborate with research teams to translate emerging techniques into production-ready implementations

  • Debug complex issues in training pipelines and model behavior

  • Help establish best practices for reliable, reproducible model post-training

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Thrive in controlled chaos and are energised, rather than overwhelmed, when juggling multiple urgent priorities

  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities

  • Maintain clarity when debugging complex, time-sensitive issues

  • Have strong software engineering skills with experience building complex ML systems

  • Are comfortable working with large-scale distributed systems and high-performance computing

  • Have experience with training, fine-tuning, or evaluating large language models

  • Can balance research exploration with engineering rigor and operational reliability

  • Are adept at analyzing and debugging model training processes

  • Enjoy collaborating across research and engineering disciplines

  • Can navigate ambiguity and make progress in fast-moving research environments

Strong candidates may also:

  • Have experience with LLMs

  • Have a keen interest in AI safety and responsible deployment

We welcome candidates at various experience levels, with a preference for senior engineers who have hands-on experience with frontier AI systems. However, proficiency in Python, deep learning frameworks, and distributed computing is required for this role.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
