b1c22192eee3ec444571.description: Because you can see how we can be better. Innovate, your way. Supply Chain at Primark Our supply chain team is the backbone of our operational efficiency. Dive into the intricacies of supply chain management, contributing to the seamless flow of our products from production to delivery around the globe. Collaborate with a team dedicated to optimising our supply chain processes and bring your logistical expertise to our organisation. What You’ll Do Primark is embarking on an exciting period of growth and transformation, and this role will play a pivotal part in ensuring that supply chain is ready to meet both current and future demands, to high standards for both online fulfilment (through Click and Collect) and retail distribution design. This newly created position will lead the creation and establishment of a solutions design programme. They will optimize our existing logistics facilities, define our buildings of the future and collaborate with others to deliver on optimization and growth across the end-to-end supply chain. This role sets the strategy and vision for an efficient, omnichannel operation which is resilient, cost efficient, scalable and sustainable. Reporting to the Head of Supply Chain Development, the Supply Chain Solutions Programme Manager is a key member of the SC Development Leadership Team, responsible for driving end-to-end omnichannel solutions excellence. The role will focus on charting the growth strategy, collaborating with partners in Digital Retail, Finance, Inbound, Logistics, Procurement and Technology amongst others! The individual will be responsible to lead the Innovation and Automation programme alongside scaling our existing eCommerce offering. We are seeking a distribution and fulfilment expert, with process, commercial and data-driven experience and deep expertise in logistics and global stakeholder management. We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities: Lead the development of long-term e-commerce supply chain strategies that support business growth, customer experience, service levels and cost objectives. Evaluate and optimise fulfilment network capacity, throughput, resilience and operational efficiency to support future growth. Develop business cases and strategic recommendations for network expansion, automation investments and operational improvements. Lead the design and implementation of scalable fulfilment solutions across warehousing, distribution, click & collect and reverse logistics operations. Manage complex cross-functional programmes from concept through implementation, ensuring delivery of operational, financial and customer benefits. Use data, modelling and forecasting to identify opportunities for productivity improvement, cost reduction and enhanced service performance. Build strong partnerships across operations, technology, finance, property and retail teams, influencing key strategic decisions through robust analysis and clear recommendations. Define and drive the automation and innovation roadmap, leveraging emerging technologies to improve efficiency, scalability and customer availability. What You’ll Bring At Primark, we focus on assisting you in developing your mindset and skillset to you reach your potential. Here’s a more detailed breakdown of the experience you’ll need: Educated to degree level or equivalent experience. Extensive experience (6+ years) in solutions design and project management within the fulfilment and logistics industry. Strong understanding of automation technology and engineering. Proven track record of driving operational excellence and project delivery. Experienced leading others and in leading large-scale programmes. Working knowledge of AutoCAD or similar AEC design packages. Excellent relationship-building and influencing skills, both internally and externally. Strong commercial awareness with experience managing budgets and cost optimisation What You’ll Get People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle: Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria. Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours. About Primark Primark was founded on a mission that everyone deserves to look and feel good – without paying more. We stand for great value without compromise, offering affordable fashion and everyday essentials that are made to last. Founded in Ireland in 1969, Primark is now an international fashion retailer with more than 470 stores across 18 countries in Europe, the US and the Middle East, employing more than 80,000 colleagues. Millions of shopper’s trust Primark every week for everything from everyday essentials like t-shirts and socks, to the latest fashion trends – all at unbeatable prices. Primark is built on a belief and passion for physical stores – helping to bring high streets and retail centres to life and creating joyful, social experiences. The company is focused on driving positive change by giving clothing a longer life, protecting life on the planet and supporting the livelihoods of the people who make Primark clothes. You do not need to be an expert on day one. Through our Launch Programme and on-the-job learning, you will build analytical, communication, problem-solving and client advisory skills. As a Broker, you will build the skills, confidence and market knowledge needed to translate complex risk exposures into structured insurance programmes and serve as a credible intermediary between clients and insurers. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organisation, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What is Risk Capital and Financial & Professional Services Risk Capital Aon’s Risk Capital advisors combine expertise, relationships and analytics to help organisations understand, mitigate and transfer risk, access capital and support growth. Financial Lines & Professional Services The Financial Lines & Professional Services team works with firms across financial institutions, life sciences, professions, construction and other industries. The team provides exposure to Financial Lines and Cyber solutions, building the knowledge required for a career in these specialist areas. What You Will Do As a Broker in Financial & Professional Services, you will support the wider Commercial Risk team in delivering high-quality client service while gaining experience across Financial Lines and Cyber risk. Analyse Risk and Build Market Insight Carry out premium and claims reporting and analysis. Develop an analytical understanding of Financial Lines and Cyber risks across a variety of industries. Support Market Strategy and Placements Help prepare market submissions, renewal materials, placement documentation and client deliverables. Participate in insurer market meetings and calls and support insurance policy renewals. Build Client Relationships And Advisory Skills Liaise with clients and participate in discovery meetings. Communicate clearly and professionally with clients and colleagues at all business levels. Coordinate Projects And Improve How Work Gets Done Collaborate with Actuarial, Finance, Compliance and other Aon functions. Work closely with third-party service providers, including loss adjusters, brokers, auditors and actuaries. Review client and market materials for accuracy, consistency and quality. The Launch Development Programme Launch Is a Structured 10-month Early Career Development Programme That Combines Meaningful Work, Business Learning, Professional Development And Relationship-building Across Aon. The Programme Helps You Build a Strong Foundation For a Long-term Broking And Advisory Career Through On-the-job learning with brokers, client teams, account managers and solution line specialists. Business and professional development in Commercial Risk, client service, communication, collaboration, problem solving and commercial awareness. Exposure to data, analytics and technology that support risk assessment, market analysis, workflow coordination and client-ready recommendations. Networking, mentorship and coaching opportunities to build relationships across Aon and develop your career path. What Will Help You Succeed and Grow Skills We are looking for candidates who are curious, motivated and excited to learn. Through the Launch Programme, you will continue developing the skills and capabilities that support a successful broking and advisory career, including: Interest in business, risk, insurance, analytics, finance, economics, client service or global markets. Career interest in Risk Capital and Commercial Risk Broking. Growth Mindset - Drive to develop, welcome feedback and learn from challenges. Curiosity & Innovation - Curiosity, adaptability and willingness to question and improve ways of working. Resilience - Stay composed, optimistic and focused under pressure; know when to persist or adapt. Proactive ownership and accountability for tasks, progress and quality outcomes. b22e73bea9bd27229015.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude is available to enterprises through Microsoft Foundry, and the Microsoft partnership has become one of our most important paths to market. Many of the largest enterprises in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and the public sector buy Microsoft first, and we want Claude to be the obvious choice when they do.

As Partner Manager for Microsoft Co-Sell, you will turn that partnership into pipeline and closed revenue. You will build and run joint sales plays with Microsoft's field organization, connect Anthropic account executives with their Microsoft counterparts on shared target accounts, and make sure deals that start in a co-sell conversation actually close through Azure Marketplace. You will own your work end to end, from the details of a single stuck deal to the executive readout on how the partnership is performing.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the co-sell engine day to day: design joint sales plays with Microsoft around the strongest enterprise use cases, run account mapping with Microsoft sellers, and turn introductions into working groups and joint opportunities that show up as pipeline
  • Keep deals moving through Azure Marketplace, including private offers, billing setup, and partner attribution; track every opportunity through that process, know where it is stuck and who needs to act, and work with both sides until it closes
  • Run the regular pipeline and escalation rhythm with Microsoft
  • Give Anthropic and Microsoft leaders a clear view of what is working and what is blocked
  • Bring field insight back to our product and go-to-market teams
  • Own at least one major joint initiative with Microsoft, such as a flagship event, a product workstream, or deal operations

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience owning a revenue or pipeline number through a partner or co-sell motion, with results you can point to
  • Working knowledge of how enterprise deals transact through a cloud marketplace, including hands-on experience unblocking stuck deals
  • Strong attention to detail and operational rigor, with the ability to turn that detail into a clear, concise story for executives
  • A record of taking full ownership of your work: closing loops and keeping stakeholders informed proactively
  • Ability to keep a stalled deal or program moving through repeated blockers until it is resolved
  • Ability to build trust across a large, matrixed partner organization, with field sellers and their leaders alike

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling or partnering around AI, ML, or developer platform products
  • Direct experience with Microsoft's partner ecosystem, such as Partner Center, Azure Marketplace, and the co-sell program
  • Experience selling into financial services, healthcare and life sciences, or the public sector

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$215,000—$300,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

b2912ef71fdbbc660af1.description: Description Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account. AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it. You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver. Key job responsibilities Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified. Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil. Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work. Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes. Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability. Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers. Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices. A day in the life You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place. You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written. On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur. You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back. You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap. About The Team Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Training & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. Led by CEO Chrissy Taylor, the third generation of the Taylor family, we’re built on a legacy that gives us the stability to focus on the long-term success of our people, our customers and our business. Why join the Graduate Management Training Programme? As a Graduate Management Trainee, you'll have the freedom and support to explore your leadership potential - and the opportunity to become a branch manager in one of our retail operations in as little as two years. In fact, most of our senior leaders began their careers in this very role - including our current CEO. From day one, we’ll invest in you. You’ll be in a supportive environment where you’ll take on real responsibilities and gain invaluable hands-on experience in customer service, sales, marketing, finance, operations, and more. We work hard and reward hard work Your work will be recognised with performance-based incentives and opportunities for continued promotion. Our unique promote-from-within culture means you can keep your career moving forward without having to change organisations. Award-winning training and development Whether you’re building on existing strengths or developing new ones, your growth is our priority. Through classroom learning, on-the-job training, and mentorship, you’ll have the tools and support to take the next step – and the one after that. Our doors are open As a Graduate Management Trainee, your experience at Enterprise Mobility will be as unique as you because you shape who we are as much as we shape your skills, path and potential. We pride ourselves on opening our doors to a variety of voices, giving way to an experience that’s both inclusive and that inspires diversity of thought. Responsibilities From your very first day, you’ll be trusted with real responsibility and exposed to all areas of our business. You’ll develop skills in: Customer Service: deliver exceptional experiences by confidently handling reservations, resolving enquiries, and building rapport with a diverse range of customers. Sales and Marketing: connect with local business partners, grow your network and develop lasting relationships. Financial Control and Profitability: understand the financial mechanics of a successful business, including cost control and interpreting profit and loss statements. Operations and Logistics: learn how to manage a fleet, plan strategically, and drive performance. Leadership and Development: take the lead in mentoring, training, and developing your own team - with the opportunity to manage and promote others as you grow. Qualifications A Bachelor’s degree is preferred; however, professional experience can be substituted if applicable. You must have a full manual Republic of Ireland, UK or EU driving licence, but we do make accommodations for applicants who don’t drive due to a disability. No drug or alcohol related offence on driving record within the last five years is permitted. Additional Information In accordance with current employment permit regulations, we are unable to support an employment permit application for this role, as it is not eligible under the current system. Regardless of your socio-economic background, university attended, subject studied, and degree attained, we will always look at how you perform against our competencies and will judge you on that alone. Please let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in our recruitment process. Please limit your application to only one job posting based on where you live and/or plan to work. Applying to multiple locations will delay your application being processed. This job posting is for applications within the following location(s): Sligo

b3733d200175335d0c5a.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic has an ambitious mission with high stakes and tight timelines. In some cases, the talent we need to achieve our vision can't be accessed through traditional recruiting alone. That's where M&A comes in, and this role is what keeps it running smoothly.

We're looking for a Recruiting M&A Program Specialist to join our Talent team and coordinate the interview experience behind our acquisition hiring. You'll be a key point of contact across Corporate Development, Legal, People, and the technical organization, coordinating interviews and guiding candidates and incoming employees from first conversation through to their start date. Your work will be challenging and unique, and it directly supports Anthropic's efforts to remain on the frontier.

Role required to work out of the Anthropic San Francisco Office - Relocation available.

Responsibilities

  • Program manage recruiting activities across Corporate Development, Legal, People, and technical leadership, keeping everyone informed, bringing solutions on what needs attention, and keeping the process moving.
  • Educate and enable deal sponsors and cross functional partners on standard approaches for M&A recruiting, interviewing and processes.
  • Operationalize the playbooks and processes that keep acquisition hiring organized and consistent, and partner closely with recruiting systems and analytics to evolve the program over time.
  • Scope and run the recruiting workstream for each deal, from first conversation through start dates. 
  • Be a primary point of contact for candidates, delivering a warm, high-touch, and discreet experience from first conversation through their start date. Make sure people going through a sensitive transition feel supported and informed at every step.
  • Use AI tools (e.g., Claude) as a core part of your daily workflow as we build toward a more automated way of recruiting.
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information and conversations with discretion.
  • Take on other high-priority recruiting and operations projects as needed and grow within the role over time.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 4+ years of program management, recruiting coordination or high-volume scheduling experience, ideally including confidential, executive, or M&A/acquihire hiring, and familiarity with modern recruiting systems
  • Track record of creating, documenting and educating on evolving hiring approaches - proven experience in building and developing these over time.
  • A track record of delivering an excellent candidate experience and partnering closely with recruiters
  • Experience with confidential or sensitive work where discretion, trust, and sound judgment are essential
  • Strong organizational instincts and comfort creating structure in ambiguous, fast-moving situations
  • Comfort working efficiently with AI tools; experience with Claude
  • A genuine interest in Anthropic's mission and the role M&A plays in supporting it
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$120,640—$145,600 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

b42c197ee88fa0913628.description: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer. About the job This position is to design and engineer AI powered features that makes every customer conversation smarter. As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Conversation Intelligence team, you'll develop and deploy solutions that extract meaning from voice and messaging data at Twilio scale. You'll work alongside experienced ML practitioners to ship real features - from model pipelines to production inference - that directly shape how businesses understand their customers. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Design and development of machine learning solutions, ensuring accuracy, performance, security, and scalability. Implement and maintain end-to-end AI/ML pipelines - from data ingestion and feature engineering through to model development, validation, and deployment with guidance from senior engineers on complex architectural decisions Instrument AI/ML services with appropriate metrics, logging, and telemetry to monitor model performance and operational health against defined SLOs Participate in on-call rotations, executing progressive rollouts and applying standard mitigation strategies to keep production inference services healthy Collaborate across planning, design, and code review phases contributing to product and technical discussions, while helping raise overall code quality through thoughtful review feedback Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! *Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience 2+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or applied ML, with demonstrated proficiency in Python and at least one ML framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX) and familiarity with NLP libraries such as Hugging Face Transformers, NLTK, or SpaCy. Experience developing, testing, and deploying small-to-medium scoped ML services or features in a collaborative engineering environment, including model versioning, experiment tracking, and cloud-based infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) Proficiency in Python (preferred) or similar OO language. Experience utilizing Large (or Small) Language Models within software systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Desired: Hands-on experience with conversational AI, or LLM fine-tuning and prompt engineering in a production  context Exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling related to maintaining models in production such as testing, versioning, model registry, retraining, and monitoring. Location This role will be remote from Ireland. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. . Stay alert to recruitment fraud We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. . Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Dublin office and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model. Primary Responsibilities Solid focus on NLP, information retrieval, AI Architectures, and Document Analysis Optimize models for performance, scalability and efficiency Ability to take research whitepapers to production. Solid technical leadership to drive the Document Analysis team, which includes both data scientists and AI engineers Drives excellence and standardization across the data science team with a focus on skills development, training and career progression Provide strategic and technical direction aligned to analytic efforts around AI/ML Stay current on internal and external technological advances in AI and advanced analytics that can be applied to document processing Drive inclusion and diversity as part of enhancing continued development of a solid diverse team culture You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in. b46713fe68b2aa548ad3.description: Meet the Team Acacia Communications, part of Cisco, is a market leader in high-speed coherent optical transceivers and optical engines, pioneering the development of coherent pluggable transceivers (400ZR, 800ZR, 1.6T) and Component Business Model (CBM) architectures. You will work with a versatile and upbeat team of sales operations analysts based in Ireland and the US in an environment where team members experience mutual enhancement and improvement. You will have the opportunity to collaborate cross-functionally across global time zones with our sales, product management, engineering, supply chain planning, finance, and customer fulfillment partner teams. Your Impact The Sales Operations role is critical to Acacia’s ability to deliver world-class service to our customers and internal partners. Touching every stage of the “order-to-cash” cycle—from order receipt and backlog execution through shipments, invoicing, and RMA processing—this role is central to our operational success. You will specialize in account and backlog management for key Tier-1 accounts, collaborating cross-functionally on critical NPI rollouts and shipment execution to ensure seamless revenue recognition and bookings integrity. We are looking for a dynamic problem-solver who thrives on building strong relationships with diverse stakeholders across the business. Responsibilities Receive, review, and process revenue, internal CBM, and RMA orders in an accurate and efficient manner in accordance with company policies and procedures: Strategic Account Management & Voice of the Customer: Serve as the dedicated 'Voice of the Customer' within Cisco by developing a comprehensive understanding of customer operational requirements, business priorities, and project milestones; actively champion customer needs internally across Supply Chain, Planning, and Product Management, providing authoritative guidance and advocacy during product allocation reviews, supply-constrained environments, and critical commit alignments. Hands-on Customer Engagement & Backlog Management: Work hands-on directly with customer procurement and supply chain teams on regular reschedule cadences—aligning on MRP schedules, lead-time verifications, delivery commits/decommits, and expedite/pull-in/push-out requests—while maintaining strict backlog hygiene, delivering weekly open order reports, updating customer portals within SLA, resolving operational holds (credit, tax, pricing, shipping), and ensuring disciplined FIFO scheduling. Order Processing, Clean PO Validation & Acknowledgements: Orchestrate end-to-end sales order processing in Oracle ensuring alignment to best practices and Sox compliance Sales Liaison: Facilitate timely and informative communication with our sales team ensuring data accuracy and timely reports, while serving as their direct operations and planning liaison for quoting, allocation queries, and order processing requirements. Issue & Dispute Resolution: Proactively resolve customer order issues, partnering with Finance to resolve short-shipment claims via supplier portals, address customer deductions, and process approved credits promptly. Other Duties Process Improvement & Documentation: Help document and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), and workflows that deliver world class service to our customers. Audit Readiness: Compile comprehensive audit sample packages for quarterly internal SOX reviews and external substantive testing. Team Coverage & Floating Desk Support: Provide cover for vacation time for team members and participate in a floating schedule for different areas of Sales Operations activities. Quarter-End & Critical Close Coverage: Provide dedicated operational coverage and active support during fiscal quarter-end close cycles, ensuring prioritized shipment execution, hold resolution, and billing alignment to achieve critical revenue targets. Pricing Management: Manage and validate quarterly, annual and volume customer price changes and contractual price adjustments with uncompromising accuracy and attention to detail, preventing billing discrepancies and downstream invoice holds. AI Integration & Utilization: Actively engage with and adopt AI capabilities into daily routines. User Acceptance Testing (UAT) & System Testing: Participate when needed in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), applying end-to-end operational knowledge of business logic and system workflows-beyond basic transactional steps to ensure OM needs are met. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Finance, or equivalent practical experience. Must have 5+ years relevant Inside Sales or Sales Operations experience preferably in a high-tech hardware, networking, or semiconductor environment. Must have considerable experience with order entry, shipments, hold resolution, and backlog management. Competent in Tier-1 sales order entry systems and processes (Oracle) Must have strong Excel experience – proficiency in VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, and multi-source file reconciliations. Must be PC Literate – Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Teams / Webex, etc. Knowledge and experience of logistics, carriers, shipping terms (Incoterms), and export compliance an advantage. Analytical, detail-oriented, with an emphasis on data integrity, accuracy, and revenue recognition compliance. Preferred Qualifications Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as excellent interpersonal skills across global time zones (Ireland, US West/East Coast, APAC/Thailand). Passion to provide a world class, professional service and support to both internal and external customers. Direct experience collaborating with customer procurement teams, supply chain partners, and B2B vendor portals. Experience supporting internal SOX controls and external audit sampling workflows (e.g., PwC substantive test packages). Demonstrated ability to work in a flexible environment that is constantly changing. Demonstrated ability to multi-task and follow through on commitments on/before they are due. Must be team oriented and simultaneously assertive with capacity to work with minimal supervision. Ability to organize and prioritise work is a must. A talent to succeed in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment with ability to multitask and deliver results. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Together we build products and services people once couldn’t have envisioned - and now can’t imagine living without. Are you excited by the idea of making a real impact? Are you prepared to dream big? Then a career with Apple might be your dream job. Our team manages operational support of Wallet and Payment products ensuring a quality execution and best-in-class deployment at all points of interaction in our 3rd party channels. As we grow, we need to maintain operational excellence and monitor the program health consistently and efficiently. We are seeking a Graduate Project Manager to support operational work streams across programs. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role The IT Operations team keeps Anthropic running — we make sure every employee can do their best work without friction. We're seeking an IT Support Engineer who combines deep technical skills with a genuine service mindset and sound judgment. Anthropic is growing fast, and our IT operations need to keep pace. That means onboarding at scale, automating repetitive processes (including with Claude), and continuously improving the employee experience. You'll handle support challenges across our primarily macOS environment while contributing to the operational improvements that help us scale. You'll work closely with IT Engineering and Security, with opportunities to grow into more technical infrastructure work over time. Responsibilities End-User Support Triage and resolve issues across hardware, software, networking, and accounts — primarily through our ticketing system, with additional support via Slack and in-person Diagnose and resolve issues across macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, and our core SaaS platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Atlassian) Troubleshoot device issues, including enrollment, configuration profiles, and policy enforcement Support access management and employee lifecycle workflows (onboarding, offboarding, reorgs) Handle escalations requiring cross-team coordination Communicate clearly with users of all technical levels Write and maintain internal documentation including runbooks, how-to guides, and knowledge base articles Identify patterns in support requests, troubleshooting skills and are methodical, curious, and persistent Demonstrated experience supporting macOS endpoints and comfortable supporting ChromeOS, iOS, and Android Have significant experience with Google Workspace administration Have experience with Slack administration — workspace management, permissions, and troubleshooting Have substantial experience supporting and administering additional SaaS tools Understand identity and access fundamentals — SSO, MFA, directory services Are familiar with MDM fundamentals and endpoint management concepts Have experience with basic scripting (Bash or Python) for automation Take ownership of problems and follow through until they're resolved Think beyond the immediate fix — you ask "why did this happen?" and "how do we prevent it?" Are organized enough to manage competing priorities without things falling through the cracks Propose solutions when you see a process that doesn't scale Are looking to develop deeper technical skills and take on more complex systems administration challenges over time Strong candidates may also Be familiar with zero-trust security concepts and endpoint security tooling Have experience with networking basics — DNS, DHCP, VPNs, networking fundamentals Have contributed to IT projects beyond day-to-day support (migrations, tool rollouts, process redesigns) Have experience using AI tools to improve personal or team productivity Location This role is based in our San Francisco, Seattle, New York or Washington DC office and there is a 4 day/week in office expectation. What Makes This Role Unique You'll be joining a high-impact IT team supporting some of the world's leading AI researchers and engineers. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for an experienced G&A Recruiter to help build the business functions that keep our company running smoothly. You'll partner directly with hiring managers across our General & Administrative teams, owning searches that range from high-volume pipelines to highly strategic, hard-to-fill roles — and you'll be expected to context-switch between them without dropping quality.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership across a diverse portfolio. You'll manage a high req load across multiple hiring managers, use data and systems to prioritize and surface issues early, and build repeatable processes that scale. We're also looking for someone who actively leverages AI and automation to increase throughput while protecting a great candidate experience.

Beyond execution, you'll bring genuine recruiting expertise to your stakeholders: calibrating profiles, sharing market insight, improving processes, and pushing back constructively when patterns aren't working. As Anthropic grows quickly, this role will be key to scaling the teams that support our mission.

Key responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across G&A functions, adapting candidate profiles, comp benchmarks, and assessment criteria to each segment and level

  • Context-switch between high-volume hiring and strategic, senior searches while maintaining consistent quality and candidate experience

  • Manage a high req load across multiple hiring managers without becoming a bottleneck — using data and systems to prioritize, surface issues early, and keep pipelines healthy

  • Build repeatable, scalable processes, and leverage AI and automation to increase throughput across your portfolio

  • Integrate into existing hiring rhythms while bringing recruiting expertise — calibration, market insight, and process improvement — and pushing back constructively when patterns aren't working

  • Own outcomes across a diverse portfolio, holding yourself accountable for hiring results rather than activity

  • Protect Anthropic's culture by deeply understanding our mission and screening for alignment alongside capability

Minimum qualifications

  • Have demonstrated success recruiting across G&A role types and segments (e.g., Finance, Legal, People, Operations) and understand how profiles, comp, and assessment criteria differ across levels

  • Can show examples of moving fluidly between high-volume pipelines and strategic searches without sacrificing quality or candidate experience

  • Have managed heavy req loads across multiple hiring managers, and use data to prioritize, spot bottlenecks, and surface issues before they become problems

  • Build repeatable processes and are actively experimenting with AI and automation tools to increase your throughput

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you integrate into existing hiring rhythms, add value beyond execution, and push back constructively when something isn't working

  • Bring an ownership mentality across a diverse portfolio, with a continuous improvement mindset

  • Are deeply curious about Anthropic's mission and passionate about AI's potential to positively impact the world

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

How we're different

And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

b4e2d8c34aa8c3e05372.description: Description Designer Group is seeking an experienced Electrical Project Manager to join our operations team in Dublin, supporting the delivery of a major live data centre project for a leading global technology client. This is a site-based delivery role, suited to someone with strong electrical project management experience in M&E contracting, mission critical, industrial, pharmaceutical, or large-scale commercial environments. The successful candidate will take ownership of electrical project delivery, working closely with site management, engineering, commercial, procurement, quality, safety, subcontractors and client-side stakeholders to ensure works are delivered safely, on programme, within budget and to the required technical standard. As Electrical Project Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating and driving the electrical scope from planning and procurement through installation, testing, commissioning and handover. You will manage project teams, oversee subcontractor performance, monitor progress against programme, resolve technical and commercial issues, and ensure that all work is delivered in line with Designer Group standards, client requirements and project specifications. Drive programme delivery, ensuring milestones are achieved and risks are identified early. Work closely with the Project QS to manage commercial performance, cost control, variations and project reporting. Support procurement planning, technical submittals, RFIs, material approvals and subcontractor coordination. Review design information and work with engineering teams to resolve buildability, coordination and installation issues. Chair and attend project meetings with internal teams, subcontractors, consultants and client representatives. Monitor labour, materials, plant and resources to ensure efficient project delivery. Ensure works are completed in line with quality standards, commissioning requirements and handover expectations. Maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Promote and uphold Designer Group’s health, safety, quality and environmental standards at all times. This role is ideal for an Electrical Project Manager who enjoys fast-paced site delivery, strong stakeholder engagement and the challenge of delivering complex electrical systems in a highly technical environment. The structure and responsibilities are aligned with the existing Electrical Project Manager role framework used by Designer Group. Requirements Minimum requirements: 5+ years’ experience in electrical project management, ideally within an M&E contractor or specialist electrical contractor environment. Proven experience delivering large-scale electrical projects from construction through commissioning and handover. Strong understanding of electrical building services, site installation, technical coordination and project delivery. Experience managing subcontractors, supervisors, engineers and site-based project teams. Ability to manage programme, procurement, RFIs, technical submittals, progress reporting and project risks. Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to work closely with quantity surveying and commercial teams. Good knowledge of health and safety requirements within a live construction environment. Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, delivery-led site environment. High attention to detail, strong problem-solving ability and a proactive approach to issue resolution. Ability to live and work in Ireland without requiring sponsorship Preferred Requirements Experience working on data centre, mission critical, pharmaceutical, industrial, semiconductor, life sciences or high-value commercial projects. Previous experience working on live client sites with strict safety, access, quality and programme controls. Experience with testing, commissioning, handover and system completion processes. Experience working with BIM, coordinated services drawings, technical submittals and design review processes. Electrical trade background, engineering qualification or construction management qualification would be advantageous. Experience working within a principal contractor, M&E contractor or major subcontractor delivery environment. Soft Skills Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive performance through site teams and subcontractors. Clear communicator who can engage confidently with clients, consultants, internal stakeholders and delivery teams. Commercially aware, practical and solutions-focused. Comfortable working under pressure and managing competing priorities. Collaborative, organised and accountable. Strong commitment to safety, quality and right-first-time delivery. Performance-related bonus. Health cover. Employer pension contribution. Commercial vehicle. Career development and progression opportunities. Supportive team environment. Opportunity to work on high-profile projects across Ireland, the UK and Europe. Continuous professional development and training support. Access to a growing international business with a strong project pipeline. b576397c29c0a42f2ea9.description:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows. 

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. 

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

We're looking for a sales compensation leader to own how we pay our go-to-market organisation, and how that changes as our commercial model changes. You will run the engine that pays roughly 350 GTM people accurately and on time, own the design of the plans, quotas and incentives behind it, and lead a small team of analysts.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will manage and coach a small team, and you will also be in the model, in CaptivateIQ, and in the plan documents yourself.

What you'll do

Run the compensation engine

  • Own the monthly and quarterly compensation cycle end to end: crediting, calculation, review, approval and payout, delivered accurately and on time
  • Own CaptivateIQ as our system of record for incentive compensation, including plan build, rule logic, testing and release
  • Own crediting and comp data integrity across Salesforce and downstream systems, and work with Systems and Deal Desk to fix problems at source rather than in spreadsheets
  • Oversee inquiry management ensuring clear SLAs and report on trends to improve overall processes
  • Document and keep policies and process up to date for stakeholders and your team

Design the plans, quotas and incentives

  • Own annual plan design in partnership with your Senior compensation analyst, GTM leadership, FP&A and People for all commissioned roles
  • Collaborate with Revops business partners on the quota setting process for each function to ensure it aligns with broader compensation strategy and benchmarks
  • Model attainment distribution, benchmarks and support finance in ad-hoc cost reporting
  • Own and build SPIFFs and non-cash incentive programmes, including President's Club,
  • Own plan communication and enablement, so reps and managers understand what they are paid for and can self-serve where needed

Evolve the compensation strategy as we grow

  • Build the compensation approach for an evolving pricing model and mulit-product business in partnership with the Head of Revenue Operations and VP of Finance
  • Represent compensation requirements during larger CPQ and CRM enhancements or changes
  • Enhance our approach based compensation reporting: attainment by role and segment, payout curves, quota coverage and programme effectiveness

Lead and grow the team

  • Manage, coach and develop a small team of compensation analysts, and set the standard and what good looks like
  • Prioritise the team's work, capacity and quarterly OKRs to ensure a balance of reactiveness and impactful projects
  • Stay hands-on. This is a doing and leading role, not a management-only role

What you'll bring

Required experience

  • 6+ years in sales compensation, revenue operations, sales finance or a closely related field, with experience managing or formally mentoring analysts
  • 2-3 years direct management experience
  • Proven ownership of a full incentive compensation cycle for a distributed GTM team, including crediting, calculation, payout and dispute resolution
  • Hands-on administration of an ICM platform, ideally CaptivateIQ, including building and testing plan logic yourself
  • Demonstrated plan design experience: pay mix, leverage, accelerators and quota setting, with the modelling to back the recommendation
  • Strong Salesforce data fluency, and the ability to translate commercial requirements into system and crediting logic
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modelling, including capacity, attainment and cost of sale models
  • Excellent stakeholder management, with the credibility to hold a position with Sales leaders and the judgement to know when to flex
  • You can communicate simply, clearly, and directly, especially with senior leaders, and your written work is polished enough to go straight to an executive audience

Bonus points

  • Experience with consumption, usage-based or hybrid pricing models and their compensation implications
  • Experience through a CPQ or quote-to-cash migration, ideally Salesforce CPQ or Dealhub
  • Experience in cybersecurity, IT or AI markets
  • Familiarity with ASC 606 commission capitalisation and audit requirements
  • Experience compensating post-sales and partner roles, not just AEs

Desirable Experience building reports and dashboards using Power BI. Knowledge of ISO 55000 Asset Management principles. Understanding of maintenance and reliability methodologies. b6005a2252098c701d60.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic is at the forefront of AI research, dedicated to developing safe, ethical, and powerful artificial intelligence. Our mission is to ensure that transformative AI systems are aligned with human interests. We are seeking a Research Engineer to join our Pre-training team, responsible for developing the next generation of large language models. In this role, you will work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical engineering, contributing to the development of safe, steerable, and trustworthy AI systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct research and implement solutions in areas such as model architecture, algorithms, data processing, and optimizer development
  • Independently lead small research projects while collaborating with team members on larger initiatives
  • Design, run, and analyze scientific experiments to advance our understanding of large language models
  • Optimize and scale our training infrastructure to improve efficiency and reliability
  • Develop and improve dev tooling to enhance team productivity
  • Contribute to the entire stack, from low-level optimizations to high-level model design

Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
  • Strong software engineering skills with a proven track record of building complex systems
  • Expertise in Python and experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred)
  • Familiarity with large-scale machine learning, particularly in the context of language models
  • Ability to balance research goals with practical engineering constraints
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment
  • Care about the societal impacts of your work

Preferred Experience:

  • Work on high-performance, large-scale ML systems
  • Familiarity with GPUs, Kubernetes, and OS internals
  • Experience with language modeling using transformer architectures
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning techniques
  • Background in large-scale ETL processes

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have significant software engineering experience
  • Are results-oriented with a bias towards flexibility and impact
  • Willingly take on tasks outside your job description to support the team
  • Enjoy pair programming and collaborative work
  • Are eager to learn more about machine learning research
  • Are enthusiastic to work at an organization that functions as a single, cohesive team pursuing large-scale AI research projects
  • Are working to align state of the art models with human values and preferences, understand and interpret deep neural networks, or develop new models to support these areas of research
  • View research and engineering as two sides of the same coin, and seek to understand all aspects of our research program as well as possible, to maximize the impact of your insights
  • Have ambitious goals for AI safety and general progress in the next few years, and you’re working to create the best outcomes over the long-term.

Sample Projects:

  • Optimizing the throughput of novel attention mechanisms
  • Comparing compute efficiency of different Transformer variants
  • Preparing large-scale datasets for efficient model consumption
  • Scaling distributed training jobs to thousands of GPUs
  • Designing fault tolerance strategies for our training infrastructure
  • Creating interactive visualizations of model internals, such as attention patterns

At Anthropic, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those from underrepresented groups in tech.

If you're excited about pushing the boundaries of AI while prioritizing safety and ethics, we want to hear from you!

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$350,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security and control commitments. We're building toward continuous assurance, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits.

As Anthropic scales to meet public-company standards, the Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) control environment over our technology stack is one of the most consequential things this team owns. As part of Security GRC's technical controls assurance function, you will be the voice on what the IT general controls must achieve to support SOX 404 compliance. In partnership with Internal Audit, you will define control requirements and acceptance criteria for the in-scope engineering systems and infrastructure that underpin financial reporting. You will pair with engineering as they design and implement against those requirements, and validate that what ships actually meets the bar before Internal Audit and our external auditors test it. You are the product owner for control design methodology and continuous control monitoring, initially around ITGCs, but extending into other areas of security and compliance to drive visibility where and when we need it.

As financially significant systems are built, migrated, or replaced, define what the system must provide (auditability, segregation of duties, change control, immutable logging, evidence retention) before go-live, so controls are not retrofitted after the fact.

  • Pressure-test changes for SOX impact during design. Review major infrastructure, system, and agent framework changes for control impact while decisions are still cheap, and maintain a clear view of which changes alter the SOX scope, key control population, or evidence requirements.

  • Own second-line control monitoring and evidence readiness. Stand up continuous controls monitoring and automated evidence collection for ITGCs (control testing, walkthrough preparation, population and completeness validation, and mapping to the common controls framework). Materially raise automated evidence coverage and cut audit prep time.

  • Drive control deficiency remediation with cross functional partners. Track and root-cause ITGC deficiencies surfaced by monitoring, Internal Audit, or external audit; partner with engineering owners on remediation design; and assess whether remediation actually closes the gap before re-testing.

  • Assess scope changes through a SOX lens. When new products, entities, systems, or integrations come into scope, provide technical and compliance assessment of their impact on control design, evidence requirements, and engineering effort before commitments are made.

  • Maintain alignment with the broader compliance portfolio. Where SOX ITGCs overlap with SOC 2, ISO 27001/42001, or other frameworks, ensure controls are designed once and evidenced once, and that changes made for one framework do not silently break another.

Minimum qualifications

  • Thrive at the pace of a hypergrowth company. You're comfortable making calls with incomplete information and reprioritizing as scope shifts.

  • Have led or been a senior contributor to an ITGC program through SOX 404 readiness and/or at a public company, with a working command of PCAOB AS 2201, COSO 2013, and how external auditors scope, test, and evaluate technology controls and deficiencies.

  • Have programming skills in Python or at least one systems language such as Go, Rust, or C/C++.

  • Have deep familiarity with developer platform, release engineering, cloud infrastructure, or ERP/financial systems control domains.
