  • Are a strong collaborator and communicator across Finance, Engineering, Internal Audit, and external auditors.

  • Use Claude and other LLMs as daily working tools, and have grounded, specific views on which SOX assurance workflows AI can run today and which it can't yet.

  • Translate SOX and framework language into acceptance criteria engineers can build against, and translate engineering reality back into assurance language auditors and leadership can rely on.

  • Default to getting the requirement designed into the system rather than papering over the gap with procedure.

  • A combination of audit or advisory experience (Big 4 or equivalent, ideally IT audit) with in-house experience at an AI-forward tech company, in either order.

  • Taken a company through a first-year SOX 404(a) and 404(b) assessment, including a first external ITGC audit.

  • Defined or assessed controls over home-built financially significant systems, usage-based billing, or revenue metering pipelines.

  • Defined or assessed controls for AI/ML systems or agents acting in production environments.

  • Stood up continuous controls monitoring or automated evidence programs.

  • Experience with SOC 1 reliance, service organization control mapping, and complementary user entity controls.

  • CISSP, CISA, CPA, or equivalent certification.

You'll deploy resources and capital to create compelling customer stories across formats, and amplify them across both bespoke partnerships and agency-run campaigns. You'll work closely with Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Finance, and Brand, reconciling co-marketing spend each quarter, briefing agencies on which stories we want to tell, and partnering with Marketing Ops and Data Science to build the measurement framework we use to report back to leadership on impact. You'll help shape how a rapidly growing function operates, at a moment when customer proof is one of the most powerful levers we have for building trust in beneficial AI.

  • Own the investment behind our customer co-marketing programs, covering allocation tracking, spend pacing, agency coordination, and quarterly budget reconciliation across a rotating cohort of customer accounts

  • Develop and execute co-marketing plans with participating customers that grow Claude adoption and the customer's own reach, coordinating with Growth Marketing on campaign strategy.

  • Run the always-on scaled co-marketing motion, co-producing high-quality creative assets with a rotating cohort of customers and deploying agency partners to amplify them as paid campaigns on the customer's own channels

  • Partner with Customer Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships to decide which customers we work with and build the criteria that keep those decisions consistent

  • Own the customer marketing intake process and its tooling, keeping it the system of record and building the playbooks that keep it consistent as we scale, partnering with Customer Marketing segment leads who own triage and prioritization for their segments

  • Define how we measure the impact of our customer marketing investments, working with Marketing Ops and Data Science, and use that measurement to shape investment decisions with leadership

  • Report back to participating customers on what their participation returned, measured on the outcomes they care about, like reach, engagement, and new customer acquisition

  • Use Claude as a core part of your operational toolkit — building skills, automating intake and triage, and finding leverage wherever a process can be made faster or smarter for the Customer Marketing team

Minimum qualifications

  • Managed co-marketing growth or partner investment programs and are comfortable with the reconciliation, forecasting, agency coordination, and stakeholder reporting that comes with it

  • Managed agencies as a working partner, developing the brief, directing the work, and holding the quality bar on co-branded creative

  • Built joint marketing plans with partners or customers that served their goals as much as your own

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a world-class research group focused on making fundamental biological discoveries. The team combines cutting-edge AI with hands-on biological research, positioning Anthropic at the forefront of AI-accelerated scientific discovery.

About the role

We're seeking an exceptional Research Scientist to join the team. This role combines deep computational biology expertise with frontier AI capabilities, positioning Anthropic at the forefront of AI-driven scientific discovery.

As one of the first computational members of this Life Sciences research group, you'll work on a high-impact team that operates at the intersection of computational and experimental biology. You'll bring broad computational biology experience to bear across the team's projects, driving discoveries from large-scale computational analysis of biological data through to results our experimental scientists can test, and moving flexibly between problems as the science demands. You'll have substantial access to Claude and you'll help establish how computational biology operates at Anthropic.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how AI transforms biological research. You'll work with some of the world's best AI researchers while tackling problems that matter deeply for scientific understanding and biomedicine. If you're excited about using your computational expertise to make fundamental biological discoveries and guide the development of transformative AI systems, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Build, run, and maintain the analysis pipelines that back the team's experimental programs: sequence analysis at petabyte scale, structural bioinformatics, phylogenetic and comparative genomics, design and analysis of high-throughput functional screens, biological sequence modeling, etc.
  • Partner directly with experimental biologists to design experiments that produce high-quality data, and turn results around fast enough to immediately inform the next experiment
  • Draw on the literature and curated biological knowledge bases alongside primary data to generate and prioritize hypotheses for experimental follow-up
  • Stand up and maintain the team's computational infrastructure: data ingestion, workflow orchestration, internal databases, and the interfaces that make all of it accessible to both researchers and AI agents
  • Use Claude and our internal agent frameworks heavily in your own work, and feed what you learn back to the model-improvement and product teams as evaluations, datasets, and concrete failure cases
  • Pick up analyses across projects as priorities shift; we're looking for breadth and flexibility over a single deep specialty

Minimum qualifications

  • Have a PhD in computational biology, bioinformatics, genomics, biophysics, machine learning, computer science, or a related quantitative or biological field, or equivalent industry research experience
  • Have a track record of computational biology research you have led end to end, from question to result, with evidence of impact (for example publications, preprints, released datasets or tools, or research that changed a program's direction)
  • Have demonstrated breadth across multiple areas of computational biology
  • Are proficient in one or more programming languages used in scientific computing and comfortable working on large datasets in Linux and cloud compute environments
  • Can take an ambiguous biological question, scope the analysis, and produce a result an experimentalist can act on
  • Communicate computational results clearly to both biologists and ML researchers

Preferred qualifications

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and developing solutions in rapidly evolving research environments
  • Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact
  • Hands-on experience in experimental biology, or a track record of designing experiments side by side with experimentalists
  • Experience building tools, pipelines, or agentic systems on top of LLMs, or training models on biological sequence data
  • Deep expertise in one or two areas of computational biology (for example structural biology, metagenomics, single-cell genomics, or protein design) on top of the required breadth

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$300,000—$320,000 USD

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform. We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role. Proficient using Agentic coding and other modern AI technologies to accelerate your work, while remaining accountable for the results. Experience in the following fields an advantage but not strictly required: The JAX ecosystem: Diffrax, Equinox, Optax, Lineax. Plasma, fluid, electromagnetic, or other multiphysics simulation. Having led the design of a scientific codebase used by others. What we offer Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up. Build cutting-edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts. Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life. Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance.

Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. b876581c5992524420d3.description: IT Graduate Development Programme 2027 - SAP At ESB, technology plays a leading role in enabling and realising our purpose to deliver a brighter future for the customers and communities we serve. Today that means we are driven to make a difference – net zero by 2040 – and it’s our people who ensure we succeed. With almost 500 people working across our IT Delivery and CIO functions, together we design, build and support a broad range of technologies and services to deliver on our strategic objectives – decarbonised electricity, resilient infrastructure and empowered customers. To further enhance our capabilities and to transform ESB to a data driven and digital utility, we are looking for Graduates to join our highly motivated and skilled team of IT professionals where you will have the opportunity to deliver results in a fast-paced, innovative team environment. Our IT Graduate Development Programme is structured into six distinct career paths where you will be able to grow your experience, as well as develop the necessary skills to help you on your way to career success. SAP Basis/Hub The SAP Basis Team is the technical team responsible for the build, management, operation and support of ESB's SAP landscape A career path in the SAP Basis/Hub in ESB would include Performing ongoing maintenance, including upgrades, support packs and enhancement packs to keep systems aligned with SAP standards Monitoring system performance and providing technical alerting and health monitoring across SAP environments. Managing technical changes across SAP landscapes and supporting the stability of production systems SAP Functional A career path in the SAP Functional stream in ESB focuses on designing, building and supporting our SAP system solutions for our complex, multifaceted businesses. The SAP footprint in ESB covers HR, Finance, Work Management and Utility Billing. Our SAP Functional roles operate as the gateway between understanding business requirements and their implementation on our IT systems. A combination of business and configuration skills is required in this customer- facing role which comprises of strategic project and support work. What to expect Our bespoke IT Graduate Development Programme includes: Structured Rotations: – Our graduate programme is typically structured into targeted rotations aligned with career paths and capability development where you will build your IT and business knowledge through challenging assignments, a diverse range of business activities, and the potential to work on projects. Learning & Development: – Central to our programme is your learning and development. Structured leadership development, training opportunities, innovation programmes. on-the-job learning and work-shadowing are complemented with personal development programmes and supports designed to help you grow professionally and personally. Performance Orientated: – At the start of each of your rotations, you will agree with your Line Manager the goals of the assignment and put in place the steps to help achieve them. Ongoing one-to-one conversations and management reviews will ensure that you are constantly working towards achieving your professional status and position you for a career with ESB. Supportive Working Environment: – In addition to your immediate support network of Line Manager, Middle Manager, Team Colleagues and Graduate Peers, you will also be assigned a Buddy and a Mentor. Social Networking: – Over the last few years our Graduates have been involved in all sorts of Sports and Social activities. Anything from Tag Rugby, Cricket, Soccer and GAA to language classes, team building challenges, charity work and graduate social events. Our clubs, societies and networks are a great way to build your contacts and of course make new connections. Why work with us? We offer a competitive graduate salary and a comprehensive benefits package built on four pillars of Reward, Career, Community, and Well-being: Progressive, hybrid working model Career development through mentoring and training Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities Sports and Social Clubs Credit Union access Pension Scheme Employee well-being programmes Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion Great team environment with our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Trusted, and Driven Location This position will be based in ESB Head Office, F27, 2 Fitzwilliam Street, Dublin 4. Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business. What We Look For? You should have (or be working towards) a minimum 2.1 Honours Degree in IT, Computer Sciences, Business Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Finance or an equivalent course where IT was a component. Proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced team environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Excellent analytical skills, combined with the ability to learn quickly. Essential Criteria Working towards a 2.1 grade Completed a work placement during your undergraduate degree - either as part of the degree programme itself, or during a summer period Currently completing, or have completed, an undergraduate degree or higher qualification in a field of Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline Your CV should be no longer than 2 pages and clearly outline the following: Title of your Degree, and Masters (if applicable) Your results to date Your final year subjects The title of your Final Year project Any relevant work experience A contact telephone number (please ensure a voicemail function is activated on your phone) Closing Date: 19th October 2026

Process Technician (11-Month Contract) About the Opportunity We are currently hiring Process Technicians for our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility at Pfizer, Grange Castle. This is an 11-month contract position with CPL as the employer, with the role based onsite as part of the Pfizer team. This is an excellent opportunity to begin or grow your career within the biopharmaceutical industry, with comprehensive hands-on training, structured onboarding, and ongoing support from experienced team members . You will gain valuable technical exposure in a highly regulated and innovative manufacturing environment while contributing directly to life-changing medicines. About Pfizer Grange Castle The Pfizer Grange Castle facility comprises of 1.1 million square feet of buildings located on a 90-acre site. Our products are produced across a range of Technologies including large scale mammalian cell culture, protein purification, vaccines conjugation, pegylation and aseptic syringe-filling technologies. About the Role: You will be directly involved in the manufacturing of our products, ensuring that they meet all specifications for safety, potency, and efficacy. You will work within the guidelines of cGMP to ensure conformance with all regulatory requirements and site SOP’s, while assisting in the improvement of all current processes through our Continuous Improvement Program. Assist in maintaining a safety orientated culture, cGMP compliant work environment always. Perform initial troubleshooting of issues identified during routing operations. Assist with the investigation of operational deviations through Quality System, engaging with relevant functions as appropriate. Training and mentoring of colleagues. Provide input into the creation and maintenance of area SOPs and batch records. Use Lean tools as part of daily operations (e.g., Method 1, 5S) to optimise efficiency and drive culture of Continuous Improvement and Zero Defects. Assist in facility start up, installation and validation activities to support the introduction of new products Training & Development At Pfizer, we are committed to your growth and success. In this role, you will benefit from: Hands-on practical training in manufacturing processes and equipment Structured onboarding programme to support your transition into the role Ongoing coaching and mentoring from experienced team members Exposure to industry-leading technologies and best practices Opportunity to build a strong foundation for a long-term career in Biopharmaceutical Industry. Shift Pattern This role operates on a 24/7 shift pattern and includes a shift allowance. ​Shifts on a rotating 4-cycle, 3 Cycle, 2 Cycle schedule (days and nights) Essential Requirements A successful Leaving Certificate (or equivalent) is required as the minimum qualification. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills Good communication and interpersonal skills Flexibility and willingness to work shift patterns. Nice to Have Experience in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing (not essential) Exposure to SOPs, batch records, or manufacturing systems (e.g., DeltaV, Unicorn) Knowledge of Lean tools such as Standard Work, 5S, or Method 1 Why this role could be right for you? Gain hands-on experience in a world-class pharmaceutical manufacturing site Receive full training and structured support Work in a collaborative, high-performing team environment Build valuable experience that can open doors to future opportunities Location Full onsite at Pfizer Grange castle Facility Additional Information In order to be considered for this position in Ireland you need to be legally eligible to work in Ireland. Please note there is no relocation support available for this position ​ How to apply Make a difference today, all suitable candidates should apply with CV below.  We are looking forward to hearing from you! ​ Purpose Breakthroughs that change patients' lives ... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives. Digital Transformation Strategy One bold way we are achieving our purpose is through our company wide digital transformation strategy. We are leading the way in adopting new data, modelling and automated solutions to further digitize and accelerate drug discovery and development with the aim of enhancing health outcomes and the patient experience. Equal Employment Opportunity We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to building a successful business. As an employer, Pfizer is committed to celebrating this, in all its forms – allowing for us to be as diverse as the patients and communities we serve. Together, we continue to build a culture that encourages, supports and empowers our employees. Disability Inclusion Our mission is unleashing the power of all our people and we are proud to be a disability inclusive employer, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all candidates. We encourage you to put your best self forward with the knowledge and trust that we will make any reasonable adjustments to support your application and future career. Your journey with Pfizer starts here! 
Pfizer endeavors to make www.pfizer.com/careers accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com. This is to be used solely for accommodation requests with respect to the accessibility of our website, online application process and/or interviewing. b944045a790145e565dd.description: Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges. At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We  believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation. Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do. Who You’ll Work With We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst to join our dynamic, remote cybersecurity team. The ideal candidate is a critical thinker, self-starter, and driven professional with hands-on experience using Crowdstrike or other EDRs. You will play a critical role in monitoring, triaging, and responding to cyber threats across our primarily Mac and Linux environments, with some Windows systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of fellow SOC analysts, incident responders, threat hunters, and cross-functional partners across IT, engineering, and DevOps to ensure our security posture remains strong. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, excels in high-pressure settings, and is skilled in writing CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL) (or similar) to create effective detections that protect our organization’s assets. What You’ll Do Monitor and triage security alerts. Build, test, and refine detections to enhance threat identification across Mac, Linux, and Windows systems. Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents, including malware, phishing, and advanced persistent threats, leveraging SIEM and EDR capabilities. Perform proactive threat hunting using the SIEM and EDR features. Investigate and respond to incidents swiftly, following established incident response protocols. Document findings clearly and provide actionable remediation recommendations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen security controls and mitigate vulnerabilities. Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends through self-directed learning. Participate in on-call rotation for 24x7x365 SOC coverage, demonstrating reliability and accountability. Escalate confirmed or suspicious incidents and cases to the Incident Response team. 4-5+ years in a SOC and or active participant on incident response teams. Hands-on experience with CrowdStrike (or other EDR), triaging security incidents. Proven ability to write CQL (or similar) queries and build detections for threat monitoring. Experience triaging alerts in a high-volume environment. Experience with threat intelligence feeds, platform and OSINT tools (VirusTotal, etc.) Familiarity with forensic analysis and evidence handling. Skills and Attributes: Exceptional critical thinking and analytical skills to address complex security challenges. Self-starter with a proven ability to take initiative and deliver results independently. Driven mindset, thriving in fast-paced, high-pressure remote work environments. Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat landscapes, and attack vectors. Proficiency in analyzing logs, network traffic, and endpoint data using CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM, particularly for Mac and Linux systems (Windows experience a plus). Solid knowledge of incident response processes and methodologies. Familiarity with operating systems, with primary expertise in Mac and Linux, and secondary knowledge of Windows. High attention to detail and ability to make sound decisions under pressure. Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development in cybersecurity. Nice-to-Have: Write and optimize detections to detect and investigate security events. Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python) for automating SOC workflows. Experience creating playbooks in Crowdstrike Fusion SOAR (or similar SOAR) Knowledge of cloud security (GCP, AWS, and or Azure). Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). #LI-SZ1 Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

b95907605e41c95532fb.description: Als je van uitdagende technische opdrachten binnen het brede Java-spectrum houdt, dan past Centric perfect bij jou. De opdrachten zijn divers: de ene keer werk je aan een geavanceerde webapplicatie voor een boekingssite, het volgende jaar aan een portal voor een zorgverzekeraar. Het kan als Full Stack Developer bij Centric. Daarnaast bieden wij je de kans om jezelf te blijven doorontwikkelen. Maak werk van deze mogelijkheden. Wat jij doet Je duikt in de wereld van Java en ontwikkelt up-2-date applicaties met frameworks zoals Spring, JPA, Hibernate, JavaEE, Angular, React en buildtools als Maven. Hoe je dit doet? Door jouw kennis en ervaring effectief in te zetten bij klanten. Wat doe je nog meer? Inrichten van CI/CD omgevingen met behulp van Jenkins Kwaliteitsverbetering met bijvoorbeeld SonarQube en versiebeheer met Gitlab Testen door middel van Junit, Spring Test of Mockito Gegevensuitwisselingen middels GRPC, SOAP en REST-callsBouwen van oplossingen binnen een cloudgebaseerde microservice-architectuur Als Full Stack Developer treed je in dienst bij Centric en word je ingezet bij één of meerdere opdrachtgevers. De diversiteit in werklocatie, welke maximaal één uur van huis ligt, laat je kennismaken met vele organisaties. Zo blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen binnen jouw vakgebied. Met jouw Field Manager stel je een ontwikkelplan op en samen bepalen jullie welke opleidingen, training en opdrachten passen bij jouw ontwikkelingswensen. Tot slot word je onderdeel van het expertisecentrum, waarin kennisdeling en onderlinge coaching met collega’s centraal staat. Dit krijg je Bij Centric bieden we een dynamische omgeving waarin je jouw vaardigheden kunt benutten voor diverse uitdagende projecten bij boeiende klanten. Hier krijg je de mogelijkheid om voortdurend bij te leren en te groeien in een omgeving die in de voorhoede staat van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. Daarnaastkun je als Full Stack Java Developer rekenen op: Een brutosalaris tot € 5.600,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring Een winstdeling tot wel 50% van het gemiddelde bruto maandsalaris Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag en een mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van huis naar werk reist Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën? Dit breng je mee Wij zorgen voor een werkomgeving waar jij blij kunt zijn en gewaardeerd wordt. Andersom vragen wij van jou als Full Stack Java Developer: Ervaring met Agile/Scrum werkmethodieken Een hbo- of wo diploma in een technische richting Minimaal 3-5 jaar werkervaring met Java Ervaring met frontend (AngularJS, ReactJS of Vue.js) Bij voorkeur kennis van CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, Cloud (bij voorkeur Azure of AWS) Minimaal OCA gecertificeerd In bezit van een rijbewijs Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure. Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric Word jij enthousiast van het omzetten van uitdagende technische opdrachten binnen het brede Java-spectrum? Solliciteer via onze website naar de vacature Full Stack Developer. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met André Menger via +31 610949754, of andre.menger@centric.eu Hier starten jouw kansen Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien. Zodra je onze businessunit Professional Staffing komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met ruim 500 (gedetacheerde) collega’s. Als partner van ministeries, banken, verzekeraars en andere toonaangevende organisaties zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat complexe projecten en veeleisende vraagstukken geen obstakels zijn, maar uitdagingen die met vertrouwen tegemoet getreden worden. Of het nu gaat om korte of lange opdrachten: de professionals van Centric Professional Staffing staan klaar om het verschil voor en bij onze opdrachtgevers te maken! We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands. Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd. #LI-MK1

b962a23ae9beb0cf6741.description: Summary From our Head Office to the shop floor and everywhere in between our primary goal is to create and deliver a fantastic customer journey for everyone who shops at Lidl. With over 7,000 colleagues across our stores, warehouses and offices in Ireland and Northern Ireland we are a big and ambitious team. We know our people are our greatest asset and our success is down to the commitment and dedication of our team. Training and Development At Lidl, your career isn’t just a job- it’s an investment. We’re big on growth, and we give you all the support, structure, and hands-on experience you need to level up both personally and professionally. As the only City & Guilds/ILM Accredited Graduate Programme in Ireland , our 18-month Graduate Management Development Programme is built entirely around you . What makes it different? Tailored To You: Enjoy a bespoke training plan mapped to your unique skills and long-term career goals. Real-World Experience: Get stuck into our stores and distribution centers to learn the heart of our business from the ground up. Blended Learning: Experience dynamic, structured on-the-job training combined with industry-leading modules. We don't just hire graduates- we build future leaders. Ready to launch yours? Controlling & Analytics The Controlling & Analytics department act as a trusted business partner to all areas of the business - from our store colleagues to our Board of Directors - providing timely and accurate reporting on core business KPIs such as Turnover, Margin, Stock Loss and Productivity, as well as detailed analysis and insights into key trends and performance patterns, supporting data-driven decision making at every level of the business. Over the course of 18 months, the Controlling & Analytics graduate will rotate through the three core areas of the department: Business Insights & Analytics, Business Partnering, and Financial Controlling. This structure is designed to allow the individual to build strong analytical and commercial capabilities, while also developing essential soft skills such as effective communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement. What you'll need An expected or attained 2.1 Honours Level 8 degree Strong analytical skills and numeracy skills The ability to work under pressure and adhere to tight deadlines Strong personal and communication skills Motivation and drive Flexibility to travel or relocate within Ireland is required Full driver’s licence is required German is an advantage but not a necessity What you'll receive We offer a competitive and transparent salary system, that ensures pay equality across all positions at Lidl €45,500 per annum pro rata 20 days holidays per annum pro rata Private employee medical insurance Flexible start and finish times City & Guilds/ILM assured programme Initial training and on-going development from an experienced team member Responsibility for and involvement in projects with real business impact Excellent opportunities for career progression Bespoke training plan depending on current skills and career path One-to-one coaching available from a qualified coach in the business A vast array of training and development opportunities from our in-house training catalogue including Leadership Development Programmes Masterclasses with renowned business experts Director and graduate mentorship programme Modern office facility with free parking On-site gym and canteen Up to 2 days remote working per week Mobile and broadband discounts with Three network Unlock a flex pot allowance to spend on a selection of benefits after 6 months of service Lidl is an equal opportunities employer. b9f1bfb3ae4ea7547285.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for a Recruiter to partner with our Communications team. This team tells Anthropic's story across corporate, product, executive, and internal communications. In this role, you will be the team's primary recruiter. You will own searches from intake through offer, and you will advise leaders on where the talent is, what it costs, and how to win it. The best communicators are rarely looking, so finding them is the job. As the team grows, you may also support hiring for Brand and Marketing.

Key responsibilities

  • Have a passion for AI's potential to positively impact the world, and a realistic view of its risks and limitations
  • Have recruited for communications, PR or adjacent roles, and understand what great looks like in that craft
  • Know how to find and engage candidates who are passive through a variety of creative channels
  • Build trust with senior leaders, and have the confidence to push back with data
  • Write clearly and pay close attention to detail, because candidates and comms leaders will notice both
  • Run a tight, high-touch process that respects candidates' time and helps hiring managers decide quickly
  • Turn hiring data into clear recommendations, not just status updates
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and handle executive and confidential searches with discretion

Preferred qualifications

  • Have 10+ years of full-lifecycle recruiting experience, with a track record of closing senior, hard-to-fill roles
  • Experience hiring for a high-growth technology company whose public narrative matters
  • A network across media, agency, and in-house communications talent
  • Experience supporting executive hiring
  • Experience using AI tools in your daily work, and are curious about where they can take recruiting next

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$240,000—$295,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. ba497507a54317abbaee.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic’s Safeguards Enforcement team detects and mitigates misuse of Claude, and much of that work depends on people: a growing human review workforce made up of full-time staff, contractors, vendors and BPO partners. As that workforce scales across a widening range of harm areas, the programs that bring people in, give them the right access, and roll them off cleanly have to keep pace.

As Program Manager for Safeguards Workforce Operations, you’ll own those programs end to end. You’ll run onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning and access provisioning for every worker type we use, working hands-on with the requests themselves while you build the processes that make them repeatable. You’ll partner with Enforcement leads to turn shifting priorities into capacity plans, and carry those plans through with our vendor partners. Because this role supports every Safeguards Enforcement program, you’ll also connect the dots across Anthropic, working with IT, People Operations, Security, Contingent Workforce, Human Data Operations and other teams running scaled human review to streamline practices and keep standards consistent.

This is a role for someone who likes fixing broken things at speed. The landscape moves quickly, priorities change often, and the work is an even mix of direct execution and program building.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the workforce lifecycle for contractor, vendor and BPO reviewers: onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning and access provisioning

  • Triage and execute inbound requests for new or changing vendor, BPO and contractor capacity

  • Turn ad hoc or broken processes into scalable ones, with clear owners, service levels and a system of record

  • Partner with IT and Security on access governance: least-privilege provisioning, timely revocation and regular access reviews

  • Build and maintain capacity plans with Enforcement leads, translating review demand into workforce needs and adjusting as priorities shift

  • Work with Safeguards vendor management to hold partners accountable to capacity and onboarding commitments

  • Align practices with Human Data Operations and other teams running scaled human review, and help them streamline their own workflows

  • Help define the long-term workforce strategy for Safeguards Enforcement

Minimum qualifications

  • Have personally run onboarding, offboarding, access and device provisioning for contractor, vendor or BPO workforces — doing the work, not only overseeing it

  • Have operated scaled human review programs with vendors or BPOs, such as trust & safety, content moderation or data annotation operations

  • Have taken a broken or ad hoc process, made it scalable, and brought other teams along in adopting it

  • Understand the fundamentals of capacity planning: how volume, handle time, quality targets, ramp and attrition turn into workforce needs

  • Exercise sound judgment on access and permissions, and know when to bring in IT or Security

  • Move quickly and stay effective when priorities change and information is incomplete

  • Build alignment through direct partnership with the teams you depend on

Preferred qualifications

  • Owned a vendor or BPO relationship directly, including service levels and business reviews

  • Built formal capacity models for review or operations workforces

  • Supported workforces across more than one enforcement or harm area

  • Hands-on experience with device management and identity and access tooling

  • Worked through a period of hypergrowth where programs had to mature alongside the organization

ba563bc756bbcae9dc52.description: Overview Susquehanna is seeking talented graduates to join their growing Dublin office in August 2027. As a quantitative strategy developer at Susquehanna, you'll be part of a high-performing team that builds some of the most powerful trading systems in the finance industry. This is a computationally intensive role that will allow you to utilize both your data analysis and technology skills. You will have the chance to work on challenging projects related to systems that support both active trading and quantitative analysis. You'll tackle complex problems for our trading strategy development teams in areas such as signal creation and detection, quantitative strategy analysis, and low-latency C++ strategy development. You'll also work desk-side, alongside senior developers who understand the nuances of building complex trading strategies. What We're Looking For Class of 2027: You are a master’s or bachelor’s student in their final year of study, majoring in a quantitative and/or STEM discipline such as computer science, computer engineering, mathematics or data science for example. Clear Communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others. Ambitious: You’re someone that enjoys setting personal goals and giving your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics, or another passion; you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential. Technically Proficient: Strong software development skills in (Python and a compiled language). Experience and comfort working with data using libraries such as Pandas, Polars, or NumPy. You will have exceptional quantitative, logical reasoning, and analytical skills. Problem Solver: When it comes to solving problems, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions. What's In It For You Education: We are renowned for our market-leading education and training programmes. You will start off in a multiweek education program designed to give you a broad understanding of the spaces where quantitative strategy developers add value. Once you complete education, you’ll be placed on a trading team that aligns with your interests and background. This will give you the best preparation possible for a career in quantitative strategy development. Collaboration : You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology. Located in Ireland's Financial Services Centre, in the heart of Dublin's city centre, our office features free onsite catering, a games room, and a fully equipped in-house gym. Throughout the summer, interns enjoy weekly social events. For those joining us from outside Dublin, we also provide accommodation for the duration of the internship. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. Additional Details The interview process for this role will be a series of interviews including coding, mathematics, system design and behavioural interviews. Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us. If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com . Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex data issues. Experience working with master data, data governance, or data quality processes. Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders across multiple business functions. Experience working within a ticketing or workflow management environment. Preferred Skills Have third level qualification in finance, accountancy or a similar discipline. Experience with the following applications: Oracle EBS Financials, Global Field Financials (GFF), ECPL (Dovetail Technologies), RGC Technologies (RGC), ServiceNow. Knowledge of supplier, customer, financial, or organisational master data. Experience supporting business users through system changes, data migrations, and process improvements. bb1467cdaba555ca8bc9.description:
We are seeking passionate and driven individuals with a strong foundation in computer science to join our team. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to design, build, and test software that enhances MongoDB products while solving complex technical challenges. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, balance innovation with delivery, and contribute to features that empower our global community of users. Join us in a supportive and inclusive environment that values your unique perspective and fuels your growth.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What we are looking for in you

  • In the process of receiving or having received a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
  • Recent graduates (including Summer 2026) or professionals with up to 18 months of experience.
  • Have a foundation in computer science theory, with competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design
  • Proficient in one of our commonly used languages which include C++, Go, Ruby, Python, Java, Javascript, Node.js, or comparable high level programming languages
  • Experience writing and testing software whether as part of an internship, in a personal project, in a coding competition, or for research

What you'll find at MongoDB

  • Writing and testing software in commonly used high level programming languages, such as C++, Go, Ruby, Python, Java, Javascript, Node.js
  • Identifying, designing, testing, and supporting new features in MongoDB products, particularly utilizing competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design
  • Leading software projects that help users maintain and understand their MongoDB deployments
  • Solving problems with context in mind, balancing the needs of the team with the desire to get to the bottom of issues
  • Maintaining a balance between delivering software and performing research and development
  • Working closely with cross functional teams to create end user features that deliver quality software to our clients
  • A fun community of fellow New Grads to attend social events, hangouts, and games nights
  • Membership within our Employee Resource Groups where you can gain mentorship and learning opportunities from employees with a shared background or common identity
  • A workplace culture where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work - we believe that Embracing the Power of Differences is the best way to broaden our own perspectives and foster innovation

About Us

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your Early Talent Recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

bb196fe48a629dc99ec2.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Reports to: Manager, Renewals

This is an individual-contributor, tactical role focused on timely, accurate execution rather than strategic decision-making. The Associate Renewals Manager works under the general direction of Senior Renewals Managers and their manager, following specific instructions and frameworks in day-to-day work. Solutions and outputs are reviewed by more senior team members and/or the direct manager.

What You’ll Do  

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer renewals tracking key dates and driving them to on-time closure. 
  • Have real, consultative conversations with customers throughout the renewal cycle to understand how they're actually using the product and where they're headed next.
  • Identify and surface expansion opportunities — additional seats, tiers, or modules — that come out of those conversations.
  • Probe for new use cases and unmet needs within existing accounts, connecting what customers describe to relevant GitLab capabilities they aren't yet using.
  • Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule, structuring them to reflect any expansion identified.
  • Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule.
  • Analyze moderately complex renewal situations (usage trends, contract terms, pricing) by reviewing existing account factors, escalating anything unusual to a senior team member or manager and helping to mitigate any risk identified.
  • Explain moderately complex renewal terms and issues to customers and internal stakeholders, working to build alignment.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to help identify expansion opportunities, resolve blockers and keep renewals moving.
  • Communicate proactively and transparently with customers and internal stakeholders, adapting to GitLab's communication framework.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM/renewals system for forecasting and reporting.
  • Prioritize tasks with guidance from more senior team members to drive quality, timely results.
  • Contribute to team goals by working collaboratively with peer RM’s.

What You’ll Bring 

  • Can execute basic renewal processes independently ("basic knots") and has been introduced to more advanced scenarios ("complex knots") such as multi-year deals, upsell-attached renewals, or non-standard terms.
  • Developing understanding of GitLab's way of working, values, and high-performance culture.
  • Awareness of GitLab's remote work best practices.
  • Growth mindset and sense of ownership — proactively seeks out ways to learn and improve, and takes action rather than waiting for direction.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing many renewals at once.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to follow defined processes and frameworks while flagging exceptions appropriately.
  • Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback and coaching from senior teammates and manager.
  • The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.

About the team

The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. As a Renewal Manager, you'll be part of a quota-carrying team that works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure timely, accurate renewals and strong customer retention across regions in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth.

How GitLab will support you

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental leave 
  • Home office support

bb227e2bea046bf84582.description: Deloitte is the biggest professional services Firm in the world and making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. We’re driven to create positive progress for our clients, community, people, and the planet. This sense of purpose inspires us to work to the highest standards, to tackle the challenges that matter. At Deloitte, we are the world’s largest Professional Services organisation, offering unmatched expertise in Audit and Assurance, Tax and Legal and Consulting Services. With a dynamic global network of 460,000 professionals across 150 countries, including over 3,400 exceptional individuals in Ireland, we are committed to delivering world-class solutions. Our actuarial team is looking for highly motivate graduates with string numerical and analytical backgrounds. At Deloitte your analytical skills meet real-world impact and creative solutions. Applications are encouraged from all numerical and programming disciplines, including mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, engineering, analytics, physics, chemistry, economics, artificial intelligence and machine learning amongst others. Your Graduate Journey (Actuarial career path) Onboarding and technical training. Develop core skills and engage with clients. Build and broaden experience. Develop professional network. Manage day-to-day aspects of projects. Identify areas of specialism/focus. Stepping into team leadership roles, deepening specialist knowledge, building eminence in the market and helping develop our service offerings. Stepping into Firm leadership/management roles, building our market presence and developing our people. Throughout the first 3-6 years of your career, you will receive study leave and materials to support you as you undertake professional exams under the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA) and ultimately qualify as a Fellow of the IFoA. What is Actuarial, Rewards & Analytics? Our Actuarial, Rewards, and Analytics (ARA) practice in Ireland stands as a leader among the country's actuarial service providers. ARA is a team of 40+ actuarial professionals, more than half of which are under 30, drawn from a wide range of academic and cultural backgrounds. Applications are encouraged from all numerical and programming disciplines, including mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, engineering, analytics, physics, chemistry, economics, artificial intelligence and machine learning amongst others. We offer expert advice and insights across the entire business lifecycle. Our clients include a wide range of domestic and international organizations, from life, general, and health insurance companies to banks and public bodies. Role In this role, you will engage in exciting projects from start to finish. You will get hands-on experience across a full spectrum of actuarial services, including: Model Design & Development Claims and Performance Analytics Machine Learning and AI Tool Development Stakeholder Behavior Analysis Product Performance and Process Efficiency Statistical Hypothesis Testing Model, System, and Process Optimization Risk Management Traditional Actuarial Services (e.g., valuation, pricing, Head of Actuarial Function, audit) As part of one of the world’s largest actuarial practices, you will have access to over 800 actuarial professionals globally, ensuring we can deliver the specialized expertise our clients need. What You will Do: Making an Impact from Day One As an analyst in Deloitte’s ARA team, you will hit the ground running with client projects after your initial induction and technical training. You will have direct client exposure as soon as you join the team, engaging with both peer-level clients and senior stakeholders. During your first few years, you will explore a range of specialist areas - such as life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, banking, pensions, modeling, and analytics - before choosing your preferred focus. As we are a combined team, there is scope to continue being involved in projects across a number of areas even after choosing your specialism. Key Responsibilities Deliver Innovative Solutions: Create end-to-end solutions that drive real impact for our clients. Apply Analytical Skills: Use problem-solving and numerical abilities to tackle diverse challenges. Develop Analytical Tools: Utilize programming languages like VBA, R, Python, SAS, SQL, and more to craft advanced tools. Model Complex Systems: Design and build intricate models of long-term risks, asset/liability cashflows, and credit defaults. Collaborate with Senior Clients: Work closely with senior client personnel to shape business strategies, address emerging issues, and prepare for future challenges. Risk Management: Develop and review controls and procedures to mitigate client risks. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure client processes and controls align with regulatory and accounting standards like Solvency II, IFRS17, USGAAP, and IFRS9. Audit Expertise: Audit actuarial liabilities for insurers, pension schemes and banks/credit financiers under various reporting standards. What We Are Looking For Applications are encouraged from all numerical and programming disciplines, including mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, engineering, analytics, physics, chemistry, economics, artificial intelligence and machine learning amongst others. Other requirements include: Achieved or are currently on target for a 2.1 honours degree or higher Achieved an A in Mathematics at Irish Leaving Certificate/Scottish Higher/A-level or equivalent Strong verbal and written communication skills Experience of programming, machine learning or artificial intelligence is an advantage but not essential A proactive approach to work Ability to learn quickly A high level of self-motivation and commitment The ability to analyse and work through complex problems Flexibility, resilience and intellectual curiosity Ability to collaborate and work well within a team environment Demonstrated leadership and creative problem-solving skills Deloitte’s Market-Leading Benefits Flexibility & Time Off: 21 days annual leave (increasing with service) plus 1 ‘Deloitte Day’ , graduation leave, time-out, early finish Fridays in summer, global remote working opportunities, and our hybrid working model, Deloitte Works. We also offer additional leave at key life stages (bereavement, parenthood etc) and the option to purchase additional annual leave. Competitive Compensation: Market-leading salary plus salary increase on completion of each professional (IFoA) exam, immediate access to private health insurance, and a pension scheme with employer matching contributions from day one. Professional Development: Enhanced support for professional education and focused learning and development programs. Deloitte provides competitive study leave for the IFoA exams as well as financial support for tutorials, study materials and exams . Health & Wellbeing: Employer-paid VHI healthcare and a wide range of wellbeing programs. Global Opportunities: Overseas secondments available after completing the graduate program. Location & Flexibility: Hybrid roles based in Dublin. Applications will close at 5pm 21st October 2026. Ready to Launch Your Career? 📍 Location: Hybrid roles based in Dublin 📌 Important: You can apply to only one graduate program—choose wisely! 📲 Follow us on Instagram and TikTok for an inside look at Deloitte Graduate Life! 🚀 What makes our Future Leaders Academy unique? Read more here. If you believe that you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply. Deloitte is an equal opportunities employer and will ensure any reasonable accommodations are implemented as part of the recruitment and selection process. What We Offer Your reward at Deloitte is competitive, supports our purpose and enables our people to never stop growing. Your reward at Deloitte is not just your salary, we believe in investing in our people's personal and professional development and empowering their work-life balance. Our ambition is to achieve gender equality and enable continuous growth. We offer supports and benefits that suit you, wherever you are in life, including health and well-being, pension, savings, training, coaching and enhanced leave options among others. Keep on being you. Bring your full, absolute self to work, every day. Explore, question and collaborate. Stretch your thinking, while building a career that inspires and energises you. And, whatever motivates you, keep growing both professionally and personally – because when you make an impact that matters, we do too.
