bbb08e6df96567d56a94.description: Role Introduction: Established in 1992, Applegreen is a leading convenience roadside retailer in the Republic of Ireland, the UK and the US in both large-scale Motorway Service Areas and Travel Plazas, as well as smaller petrol stations. The business has grown to over €4BN in annual revenue, operating 430 Motorway Service Plazas and forecourt sites internationally and employing over 17,000 people. Applegreen is in a rapid growth phase and to support this ambitious growth, we are seeking to onboard a Junior Food Category Analyst to join our team. This role will form part of the Commercial Food team. The successful candidate will be a confident people person who can fit into Applegreen seamlessly and adopt a hands-on approach to their role. Key Responsibilities: Support the preparation and distribution of weekly and monthly Food performance reports, including sales, margin, waste, availability, stock and promotional performance. Assist the Food team with analysis of product, category and store performance, highlighting key trends and exceptions for further review. Maintain accurate trackers, reports and product information, ensuring data is kept up to date and issues are identified promptly. Provide administrative support across the Food category team, helping Buyers and Category Managers with day-to-day category activities. Support invoice administration and reconciliation, investigating invoice queries and working with internal teams and suppliers to resolve discrepancies. Assist with the management of supplier information, pricing, product set-up, recipe management and other commercial administration. Work closely with the Supply Chain team to monitor stock availability, deliveries and supply issues and help escalate potential risks. Support the coordination of new product launches, range changes and promotional activity, ensuring relevant information is accurate and communicated to key stakeholders. Assist with forecasting and stock management activities, particularly around promotions, new product launches and seasonal activity. Support the monitoring of waste and availability, helping identify products, stores or categories requiring further investigation. Liaise with suppliers and internal departments to obtain information and resolve day-to-day queries. Support category reviews and presentations by gathering and preparing relevant sales, customer and product information. Assist with competitor and market reviews to help the Food team understand emerging products, pricing and Food to Go trends. Maintain organised records, trackers, product files and documentation for the Food team. Support improvements to reporting and administrative processes, identifying opportunities to make routine tasks more efficient and accurate. Provide general analytical and administrative support across the Food team as required. The Candidate should have the following: Qualifications, Experience & Skills Experience in a commercial, retail, food, supply-chain or administrative environment would be beneficial. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, with strong Excel skills. Comfortable working with numbers and analysing data to identify trends or discrepancies. Previous exposure to Power BI or similar reporting tools would be beneficial but is not essential. Experience with SAP or another ERP system would be advantageous but is not essential. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Good organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines. Confident written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable working with colleagues across Commercial, Operations, Finance and Supply Chain. An interest in food, retail and the Food to Go / QSR market. A positive attitude with a strong willingness to learn and develop. Additional key skills & attributes: A dynamic individual who adapts well to change and can thrive in a rapidly growing organisation that continues to evolve. Comfortable working with data, reports and commercial information High level of accuracy, particularly when dealing with invoices, prices, product information and reporting. Able to manage recurring reporting deadlines alongside day-to-day requests from the Food team. Interested in understanding what drives sales, margin, waste and availability. Willing to investigate issues rather than simply report them. Comfortable working across Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance and with external suppliers. Able to respond positively to changing priorities in a fast-paced retail environment. Takes a logical approach to resolving data, invoice, stock and administrative issues. Motivated to build analytical, food and commercial knowledge and take on greater responsibility over time. Willing to travel on an ad hoc basis if required.

Depending on where you land, you might be building the integration contracts product teams plug into so they can launch a paid SKU without becoming billing experts, automating the quote-to-cash lifecycle so enterprise deals don’t bottleneck on manual ops, or building the reconciliation and data foundations that keep every revenue number trustworthy at audit time. This is production-critical infrastructure where correctness is non-negotiable — a rounding error here is a revenue discrepancy somewhere else — and you’ll work closely with Finance, Product, Sales, and Accounting to build systems that scale with the business. What you’ll do Design and ship billing capabilities end to end — pricing primitives, payment flows, contract and entitlement models, revenue data pipelines — depending on the surface area you own. Build for correctness first. Billing data is financial data; you’ll develop the instincts for where idempotency, reconciliation, and audit trails matter and where they don’t. Own the interfaces. Whether it’s the billing API a product team integrates against or the revenue dataset Finance closes the books on, you’ll design contracts that hide the complexity and hold up under change. Make build-vs-buy calls. We lean heavily on third-party billing, payment, and tax platforms, and you’ll decide where to extend them and where to build our own primitives around them. Own the payments stack. Authorization rates and retry logic so a good card doesn’t silently decline, processing cost as a real number you drive down, automated dispute response, and fraud controls that stop bad actors without blocking real customers. Drive down the manual work. Enterprise contract amendments, pricing config changes, billing support escalations — a lot of it is still human-in-the-loop, and closing that gap is a direct line to scale. Operate what you ship. You’ll own SLOs on customer-facing flows, instrument the revenue pipeline so discrepancies surface before month-end close, and be on the hook when it pages. Partner across the company. Growth wants promotional mechanics, Sales wants quote flexibility, Finance wants GAAP-clean data, product teams want it yesterday — you’ll help thread that needle. You may be a good fit if you Have 8+ years building backend or platform systems in production, 3+ years leading large scale, complex projects or teams as an engineer or tech lead Have a track record of shipping in fast-moving environments where the requirements shift under you and you still land something correct and maintainable. Care about correctness and data integrity as first-class design concerns, not afterthoughts — and know how to build systems that are easy to reason about when money is on the line. Enjoy cross-functional work. Billing sits between Product, Finance, Sales, and Legal, and a lot of the job is translating between those worlds. Strong candidates may also have Built billing, payments, subscription, or fintech systems before — and know firsthand how a small pricing change ripples through the whole stack. Direct experience integrating or extending third-party billing and payment platforms, and opinions on where they fall short. Worked on revenue reconciliation, financial reporting pipelines, or systems that had to survive an audit. Experience with enterprise commerce — CPQ, quote-to-cash, contract management, or the operational side of B2B billing. Owned payments optimization in a self-serve or PLG environment — authorization rates, payment cost, fraud, chargebacks — and know what it takes to move those numbers without breaking the good customers. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Accelerating scientific discovery is a core part of Anthropic's mission, and we believe the highest-leverage path to this is enabling researchers externally to use Claude effectively for their work. This involves communicating Claude’s rapidly improving scientific capabilities through outreach and editorial programs, as well as putting Claude in the hands of researchers through grants, ergonomic research tools, and access programs that help scientists do more with AI than was previously possible.

We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to be the bridge between the researchers advancing Claude’s scientific capabilities and the outside scientific community. Embedded with the Discovery team, you’ll conceptualize and run the programs that get Claude into scientists’ hands and shape the Anthropic Science Blog, working with Communications, Editorial, Beneficial Deployments, and external partners such as universities, funders, and scientific societies.

This is a technical role, not a purely operational one. These programs already have strong operational and editorial owners. You bring research taste and a firsthand understanding of how academia works, so we’re looking for someone who has been a researcher themselves, ideally through a postdoc or beyond. You’ll have significant autonomy: once aligned with Discovery’s leads on strategy, you’ll drive decisions on what we fund, what we publish, and how we engage with academic communities

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the interface between research and the outside world. Stay close to the researchers working on Claude's scientific capabilities and translate rapid capability gain into use by external researchers.

  • Help set Anthropic’s external science strategy. Recommend which scientific areas and communities we focus on, and how our programs, collaborations, and communications fit together

  • Guide the scientific direction of the Anthropic Science Blog. Work with researchers and the Editorial team to identify and source stories internal and external stories worth telling, draft and edit posts, and keep a steady cadence of high-quality science writing.

  • Drive forward external science programs. Design, launch, and run grants and access programs such as AI for Science grants and Team plan offerings for research groups, as well as partnerships with scientific foundations and grantmaking organizations. Work with Beneficial Deployments on programs aimed at the highest-impact scientific areas.

  • Gather feedback from scientific communities. Identify usage patterns and gather feedback on how researchers use Claude and what capability gaps exist, and turn it into concrete recommendations for research and product teams.

Minimum qualifications

  • A PhD in a scientific or mathematical field, with a track record of original research

  • Demonstrated writing ability for both scientific domain and general-interest audiences, with enough understanding of how modern AI models are trained to write about them accurately.

  • Experience with the grants process, such as applying for and managing competitive funding, and ideally designing, reviewing, or administering funding programs

  • Deep engagement with frontier AI: you use these tools in your own work, understand where they're strong and where they fail, and take seriously the possibility that AI will transform every face of the scientific process within the next few years

  • Track record of driving multi-stakeholder projects to completion, and of coordinating people who are juggling other high-priority work. You’re resourceful, high-agency, and able to navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities.

  • Credibility with researchers: you can talk to scientists as a peer and understand how academic communities work, including their incentives, norms, and sensitivities

  • Fast learner who builds deep contextual understanding in unfamiliar scientific domains and can contribute meaningfully to discussions with researchers outside your own field. 

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience as a program officer, program director, or fellowship lead at a science funder, research agency, or philanthropy

  • Published science writing in outlets such as Quanta, Scientific American, or Physics Today, or a substantial public writing presence such as a blog or newsletter

  • Research experience that uses AI or ML methods, or that involves building scientific software, tools, or datasets

  • Experience building partnerships with scientific societies, journals, or research institutions

  • Familiarity with AI safety and responsible deployment, including dual-use considerations in fields like biology

  • Experience organizing conferences, workshops, or large coordinated launches

Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

bc0ee348639e81b6637d.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.  About The Exploration Company  At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuelled in orbit, carrying cargo and potentially humans in the long run. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, which is why we develop our own propulsion systems, aiming for the highest level of efficiency and reliability.    Role Summary  We are seeking a  Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer  to join the engine control and monitoring team of Storm, our high-thrust LOX/LCH4 cryogenic rocket engine. Working alongside senior control engineers, you will develop and test control and monitoring algorithms, work with the engine functional models provided by the functional team, contribute to setting up the controller development environment, and help verify the controller through Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop testing and during engine test campaigns. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for a recent graduate with strong control fundamentals who wants to learn on real hardware and progressively grow into full ownership of safety-critical engine control functions.     Key responsibilities:   1. Control & Monitoring Algorithm Development  • Design and implement engine control and monitoring algorithms, following the software team's rules, guidelines and auto-coding practices.  • Contribute to the definition of the engine regulation strategy (thrust and mixture ratio control, chill-down, start-up and shutdown transients) together with functional and system engineers.  • Support the definition of control and monitoring requirements for engine subsystems (valves, pumps, sensors, controller, software).    2. Simulation & Controller Development Environment  • Contribute to setting up the controller development environment: toolchain, model and code configuration management, auto-coding chain, and the MiL/SiL/HiL simulation and test infrastructure.  • Integrate the engine functional models delivered by the functional team (turbopumps, valves, combustion devices, cryogenic feed lines; steady-state, transient and chill-down) into the control design and simulation environment, deriving simplified or linearised models for controller synthesis where needed.  • Run closed-loop simulations to assess controller performance, stability margins and robustness to model uncertainties.  • Feed test results back to the functional team to support model correlation, and flag model limitations that matter for control.    3. Health Monitoring & Fault Management  • Contribute to the engine monitoring strategy that assesses the health status of the engine and its subsystems (combustion chamber, turbopumps, valves…).  • Implement fault detection and sensor validation logic for both real-time protection and post-test analysis.  • Support failure mode analyses (FMEA) and the management of failure modes, paving the way for engine reusability.    4. Validation, Testing & Documentation  • Prepare and run Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop (MiL, SiL, HiL) test campaigns to verify the control and monitoring functions at each step, from Simulink model to embedded code on target hardware.  • Support Storm engine and component cryogenic (LOX/LCH4) test campaigns: test preparation, on-site support, data processing and post-test analysis.  • Produce clear development documentation: specifications, test procedures, test reports and justification files.     What we would love to see from you:   • Master's degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace, Electrical, Control or Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.  • Recent graduate (or graduating within the next months); no professional experience required. A master's thesis, internship or academic project in control, propulsion or embedded systems is a strong plus.  • Solid fundamentals in control theory, both classical and modern (state-space, robustness, digital control).  • Practical use of MATLAB/Simulink and Python through coursework or projects; basic knowledge of C/C++.  • Basic understanding of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics, and a strong interest in cryogenic propulsion and turbomachinery.  • Fluent in English.    Nice to Have:   • Exposure to MiL/SiL/HiL testing or real-time embedded systems.  • Experience with auto-coding from Simulink models.  • Familiarity with safety-critical design practices, reliability engineering or failure mode analysis.  • Interest or experience in data science applied to health monitoring and anomaly detection.  • Knowledge of space standards (ECSS, MIL-STD, NASA-HBK…).  • German and/or French.    Skills & Behaviours:  • Eagerness to learn and to take on increasing ownership under the guidance of senior engineers.  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to draw useful conclusions from partial or contradictory data.  • Clear oral and written communication; comfortable working closely with engine, avionics, software and test teams.  • Organised, able to prioritise tasks and deliver within time constraints.  • Positive, flexible attitude and enthusiasm for space exploration.  • Behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.   Why you should join us!   What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:      We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind     We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them      We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?      We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.     The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.       All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.   If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc. bc8c2d22b45669eda2b6.description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team You will be joining the Celonis Services team. Our team’s mission is to drive product success along three core principles: simplicity, focus, and execution. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to a community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is based on diversity, trust, continuous development, and improvement with people from across the globe. The Galaxy program unites Celonauts across different locations into one dedicated onboarding program which develops recent graduates into  well rounded, skilled Services professionals in 12 months. The Role In this role you have the chance to launch your career in the enterprise software world by joining the Galaxy Graduate Program as an Associate Deployment Engineer. The Galaxy Program will provide you with a structured approach to kick start your career within Celonis, learning and delivering value to our customers, over a period of 12 months. In particular, Galaxy’s cohort structure will develop your expertise across the Celonis value journey with a focus on learning the technology, implementation cycle, approaches to innovation and automation, enablement, support, and customer engagement best practices. The work you’ll do: As an Associate Deployment Engineer (within the Galaxy Program), you will be an integral part of our teams preparing yourself for a career with Celonis. The program will combine learning and hands-on experience, making sure all aspects of the post sale customer experience are represented. As part of this program, you can expect to: Deploy high-value use cases utilizing a combination of data analytics, data science, machine learning, and GenAI Perform complex data transformations with SQL and Python to optimize data for analysis Complete practical assignments across a variety of customer projects Implement and configure the Celonis platform for customers Communicate and collaborate directly with the end customer to gather requirements and showcase deliverables Collaborate with consultants and internal stakeholders to develop-out value driven operational solutions Build-out critical KPIs and integrate them into customer solutions Develop Python scripts utilizing our Machine Learning Workbench (MLWB) to efficiently consume, transform, and transmit data to the Celonis platform Have the opportunity to collaborate with various teams within the Celonis organization, including but not limited to: Business Analytics Business Apps Product and Engineering Solution Architecture Celonis Support Academy and Global Programs The qualifications you need: We are looking for people who enjoy solving problems, think outside the box, and are not afraid to make and learn from their mistakes. In addition you would have: A degree in the field of Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a comparable degree program Have 0-2 years experience in the fields of  (IT-) Consulting, Data Science, or a similar area in the form of an internship or entry-level position You have a strong interest in Big Data, Data Mining, LLMs, and Process Mining and are seeking to continuously improve in these areas. You are successful as an Associate Galaxy Celonaut if you: Enjoy interacting with various customers Understand and are able to interpret business processes Are a person with analytical skills, and have a basic knowledge of SQL or other programming languages (Python, R, Matlab...) Are comfortable with steep learning curves Able to consistently work through challenging problems by applying a combination of critical thinking and resourcefulness Fluency in English Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role. The base salary range below is for the role in the specified location, based on a Full Time Schedule. Total compensation package will include base salary + bonus/commission + equity + benefits (health, dental, life, 401k, and paid time off). Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and that the actual total compensation offer will be determined based on various factors, including, but not limited to, applicant's qualifications, skills, experiences, and location. The base salary range below is for the role in New York, based on a Full Time Schedule. $83,000 — $90,000 USD What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here .

bcc0df8e31354d6d4a39.description: Description Software Development Engineer — AWS Lambda Control Plane (Dublin) When millions of builders ship their Lambda functions, it all just works — in seconds, anywhere in the world. The machinery that makes that possible is the control plane: the systems that validate, orchestrate, and propagate every function's state so the data plane can execute it flawlessly at any scale. As Part Of The Team You'll Design, Build, And Operate The Distributed Systems That Sit Between Customers And The Lambda Data Plane You'll own the full path from API request to running function. The APIs you build are the public surface of Lambda — high-throughput, strictly consistent, globally available — serving customers and CloudFormation alike. Behind those APIs, you'll design the asynchronous workflows that orchestrate a function's lifecycle: taking a customer's intent — a new function, a code deploy, a version publish — and propagating it safely to the systems that actually execute functions. That means solving metadata propagation at global scale: ensuring every configuration change reaches the right compute fleet, in the right region, with the right ordering guarantees, even under partial failures. We operate at the scale of one of the largest services in AWS. Availability is a first-class design constraint, not an afterthought. What we're looking for Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production — the kind where "retry" isn't a strategy, it's a starting point. Comfort with ambiguity: you'll own problems end-to-end, from API contract through data-plane handoff. Strong fundamentals in at least one of: Java, Python, or TypeScript (our stack spans all three). A bias toward simple, operable solutions — systems that are easy to reason about at 3 AM. About The Team We're a Dublin-based engineering team within AWS Lambda. We invest in growing engineers through meaningful ownership, direct mentorship, and exposure to problems that don't have textbook answers. We value diverse perspectives and hire for collaboration — the best systems here are built by teams, not individuals. Basic Qualifications Experience (non-internship) in professional software development Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced IP Counsel to help protect some of the world's fastest-growing technology brands. In this role, you will share ownership of Anthropic's global trademarks and domains practice, spanning clearance, prosecution, portfolio management, and enforcement, partnering closely with other members of our IP team, outside counsel, and business teams.

Anthropic's brands are among its most valuable assets, and you will help protect them at the pace the AI industry moves. Our trademark practice spans a rapidly growing global portfolio, a high-volume enforcement program, and naming decisions for some of the most visible products in technology. This is a hands-on role for an attorney with deep trademark expertise who wants their work to matter and who is aligned with Anthropic's mission of responsible AI development.

Key responsibilities

  • Run trademark clearance for new model, product, and feature names, delivering clear, risk-rated recommendations that let teams move quickly and confidently

  • Manage global trademark prosecution and portfolio strategy in coordination with outside counsel, including filing strategy, office actions, and portfolio maintenance across many jurisdictions

  • Lead trademark and domain enforcement end to end: assess potential infringements, select the right enforcement mechanism, work with outside counsel as necessary, and drive matters to resolution

  • Help oversee our online brand protection program, working with our external vendor and IP Legal Specialist to action infringements and impersonations at scale

  • Manage domain portfolio strategy, including acquisitions, disputes, and recovery

  • Respond to inbound trademark demands and support trademark-related litigation

  • Counsel marketing, product, and go-to-market teams on brand usage and naming, translating IP risk into practical guidance

  • Build the playbooks and processes that let a lean team run a world-class global brand protection practice

Minimum qualifications

  • Hold a law degree (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and meet the local licensing requirements to work as in-house counsel where you'll be based

  • Have substantial trademark and domain practice experience spanning clearance, prosecution, portfolio management, and enforcement

  • Have current, hands-on experience: running clearances, shape filing strategies, and make enforcement calls yourself

  • Have managed global trademark and domain portfolios, including UDRP proceedings and online enforcement

  • Exercise sound judgment about which matters to pursue, and can explain that reasoning clearly to lawyers and non-lawyers alike

  • Work collaboratively with legal colleagues, outside counsel, and business partners, and are motivated by the work itself

Preferred qualifications

  • 10+ years of trademark and domain practice

  • Prior in-house experience at a technology company, with a track record of partnering with business teams to enable speed in a risk-adjusted way

  • Experience protecting brands in AI or other rapidly evolving technology fields

  • Experience building or scaling high-volume enforcement and takedown programs

  • Experience navigating brand disputes with commercial, community, or publicity dimensions

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$335,000—$385,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. bd336e7a67b68d30f571.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. About the role The Exploration Company is developing Huracan, a cryogenic rocket engine. The engine integrates e-pumps, power electronics, valves, embedded software, and control systems. We are seeking a Hardware-in-the-Loop Engineer to develop and operate HIL platforms for verifying the ECU, PDU, Valve Controller, inverter, electric pumps, and associated software. You will connect real hardware to real-time simulations, automate testing and data analysis, and develop emulator hardware for sensors, actuators, interfaces, and subsystem behaviour. You will verify nominal and fault conditions while ensuring test repeatability, traceability, and early fault detection. You will work closely with propulsion, embedded-software, power-electronics, control-systems, and hardware engineers to validate Huracan from simulation through laboratory testing. Key responsibilities Design, build, and maintain the HIL test environment for our engine propulsion system, from engine controller board level up to the integrated propulsion subsystem Define and implement the hardware and software architecture of the propulsion HIL bench, including signal conditioning, load and fault-insertion hardware, and real-time targets Integrate real-time plant models (e.g., feed system, valves, pumps and motors, combustion chamber, thermal behaviour) into NI VeriStand and close the loop with the engine control unit Emulate and simulate the sensors the controller depends on (e.g., pressure transducers, thermocouples and RTDs, flow meters, position and speed feedback) with flight-representative electrical characteristics Emulate or integrate actuators and power electronics, such as valve drivers, motor inverters, igniters, and their control units, as real hardware, electrical loads, or models Develop LabVIEW-based applications for desktop and real-time platforms (e.g., PXI, cRIO), including custom devices and bus interfaces (e.g., CAN, RS-422/485, Ethernet) Implement fault injection at the electrical and model level to verify engine start-up, shutdown, and abort sequences as well as FDIR behaviour Support test execution, data acquisition, logging, and automated reporting during verification campaigns Validate and correlate simulation models against component-level and engine test data together with the propulsion team Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture specifications, interface definitions, model and code documentation, and user guides Debug and troubleshoot across the bench, the models, and the unit under test, and continuously improve the test platform You will be in charge of Delivering a robust and scalable HIL platform whose models, I/O configuration, and test sequences can be reused across engine configurations and projects Running control loops and plant models deterministically at the rates the engine controller requires, using NI hardware, LabVIEW RT, and FPGA where timing demands it Defining test automation workflows using NI TestStand and integrating them into the propulsion and system-level verification process Coordinating closely with propulsion, avionics, and flight software engineers to ensure requirements traceability and test coverage Keeping models, bench hardware, and test software under configuration control so that every test run is reproducible Contributing to the continuous evolution of our HiL infrastructure, with an emphasis on performance, reliability, and maintainability Ensuring all solutions meet space-grade quality and safety standards, aligned with project requirements Must-Have Skills and Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Control Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field Hands-on experience building and operating HIL test benches for closed-loop control systems (e.g., engine, motor, or actuator controllers) Proficiency in LabVIEW, including desktop and real-time application development Hands-on experience with NI VeriStand in real-time test environments, including integration of simulation models (e.g., Simulink, FMU, or C/C++) Experience emulating sensors and actuators at the electrical level (e.g., analog, thermocouple/RTD, frequency and PWM, discrete I/O) and working with motor drives or inverters Familiarity with NI TestStand for test automation and execution management Solid understanding of test platform architectures, hardware/software integration, and real-time systems Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with a structured and methodical approach Ability to write and integrate Python scripts to extend test workflows or support automation tasks Nice-to-Have Experience with LabVIEW FPGA, for example for high-speed sensor emulation or motor and inverter simulation Background in liquid rocket propulsion or in fluid and thermal system modelling Experience with fault-insertion hardware and FDIR verification Familiarity with ECSS standards or equivalent aerospace standards such as DO-178C Experience supporting engine or integrated system test campaigns Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible. You will work closely with EY Partners, engagement teams, and senior client stakeholders to design, build, and deploy AI systems that operate effectively within complex, regulated, and large-scale environments. This role blends deep hands‑on engineering, consulting judgment, and client‑facing delivery ownership. Advanced LLM/RAG engineering: prompt pipelines, embeddings, vector stores (FAISS/Milvus/Pinecone), hybrid retrieval, grounding, hallucination mitigation and evaluation frameworks. LLMOps/MLOps: automated testing, drift monitoring, safety/guardrails, CI/CD for ML, telemetry, lineage and governance. 5+ years of experience with cloud platforms (Azure-preferred, GCP, or AWS) and modern data infrastructure. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and rapidly iterate toward solutions. Domain expertise in verticals like finance, healthcare, government, or manufacturing. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.  Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.  We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.  If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.        The Role   We are looking for Product Owner Technical to own product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.  This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.     What You'll Own     Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.    Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.    Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.    Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.    Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.    Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.    Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.        What We're Looking For     Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner Technical, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.    Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.    Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.    Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.    Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.    High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.    Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.        The Kind of Builder We Want     Starts from user problems, not feature lists.    Can make decisions with incomplete information.    Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.    Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.    Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.        This Role Is Not For     People who only write decks and do not drive execution.    PMs who cannot work deeply with enginee

bdd5afd9df2b3ba4ee39.description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team You will be joining the Celonis Services team. Our team’s mission is to drive product success along three core principles: simplicity, focus, and execution. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to a community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is based on diversity, trust, continuous development, and improvement with people from across the globe. The Galaxy program unites Celonauts across different locations into one dedicated onboarding program which develops recent graduates into  well rounded, skilled Services professionals in 12 months. The Role In this role you have the chance to launch your career in the enterprise software world by joining the Galaxy Graduate Program as an Associate Deployment Engineer. The Galaxy Program will provide you with a structured approach to kick start your career within Celonis, learning and delivering value to our customers, over a period of 12 months. In particular, Galaxy’s cohort structure will develop your expertise across the Celonis value journey with a focus on learning the technology, implementation cycle, approaches to innovation and automation, enablement, support, and customer engagement best practices. The work you’ll do: As an Associate Deployment Engineer (within the Galaxy Program), you will be an integral part of our teams preparing yourself for a career with Celonis. The program will combine learning and hands-on experience, making sure all aspects of the post sale customer experience are represented. As part of this program, you can expect to: Deploy high-value use cases utilizing a combination of data analytics, data science, machine learning, and GenAI Perform complex data transformations with SQL and python to optimize data for analysis Complete practical assignments across a variety of customer projects Implement and configure the Celonis platform for customers Communicate and collaborate directly with the end customer to gather requirements and showcase deliverables Collaborate with consultants and internal stakeholders to develop-out value driven operational solutions Build-out critical KPIs and integrate them into customer solutions Develop Python scripts utilizing our Machine Learning Workbench (MLWB) to efficiently consume, transform, and transmit data to the Celonis platform Have the opportunity to collaborate with various teams within the Celonis organization, including but not limited to: Business Analytics Business Apps Product and Engineering Solution Architecture Celonis Support Academy and Global Programs The qualifications you need: We are looking for people who enjoy solving problems, think outside the box, and are not afraid to make and learn from their mistakes. In addition you would have: A degree in the field of Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a comparable degree program Have 0-2 years experience in the fields of  (IT-) Consulting, Data Science, or a similar area in the form of an internship or entry-level position You have a strong interest in Big Data, Data Mining, LLMs, and Process Mining and are seeking to continuously improve in these areas. You are successful as an Associate Galaxy Celonaut if you: Enjoy interacting with various customers Understand and are able to interpret business processes Are a person with analytical skills, and have a basic knowledge of SQL or other programming languages (Python, R, Matlab...) Are comfortable with steep learning curves Able to consistently work through challenging problems by applying a combination of critical thinking and resourcefulness Fluency in English Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role. What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here .

bdeced13d6f1a7733e51.description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Support Engineer 2 Ireland on Twilio’s Voice, Platform Application & Segment teams (VSPA). 

About the job

This position is needed to support our customers’ use of the Twilio platform, and help customers get the best experience from Twilio’s products. You will function as the voice of Twilio to our customers and partners, and operate as a subject matter expert for Twilio’s APIs and SDKs.

This position also includes rostering. Rosters will be of a 5 day work week, and could include one or both weekend days.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams. 
  • Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve complex problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
  • Leverage your experience with troubleshooting and resolving Quality of Service (QoS) issues.
  • Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack as well as filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs. 
  • Review internal knowledge to stay current on industry shifts and standards. 
  • Assist your manager in process improvements by surfacing customer pain points to assist in process improvement.  
  • This position will also require supporting our customers on holidays to ensure that our customer’s needs are met.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 2+ years of Technical Support Experience or similar relevant experience.
  • Full-Stack Javascript Tech Support experience with capabilities to troubleshoot server-side code (bonus would be either of: Node.js, C# or Java or python) and client-side code (JavaScript). React.js is a bonus.
  • A good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
  • Basic understanding of SQL and query-writing skills. 
  • Good understanding of APIs, HTTP Protocol, and RESTful services.
  • Skills in troubleshooting network connectivity issues, with an understanding of TCP/UDP, and basics of SSL/TLS. 
  • Experience troubleshooting SIP, VoIP, and IP telephony issues.
  • High competency in communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone or email mediums. 
  • Ability to stand in the customer’s shoes and demonstrate dedication to the customer experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  

Desired:

  • Bonus skills: 
    - Serverless (Lambda) experience.
    - Expertise with both native and mobile applications is a great bonus.
    - Having related experience in troubleshooting contact center products.
    - Good knowledge of RESTful technology, previous work with APIs and ability to understand and troubleshoot issues with cloud solutions.
  • Understanding of WebRTC is a plus.
  • Experience working collaboratively with team members in different geographic locations and time zones.
  • Advanced time management skills, ability to work well under pressure, and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures.
  • Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organization.
  • Interest in utilizing customer feedback to identify and drive improvements in our products. 

Location

 This role will be remote, and based in Ireland. 

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 5% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. 

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

bdff72062c30c0c311a4.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.    We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.    Here’s what this particular role covers.      🛠️ About our Map & Route Team   Our Map & Route team sits within Wayve’s Automotive Platforms division in Vehicle Software Engineering, and builds the geospatial foundations behind our AI driver. Working with global-scale data, the team turns road-network and navigation data into reliable products used across Wayve, building geospatial services and data products to support company operations. We work with our model development, experimentation, and evaluation platforms to build an AI driver that uses maps and navigation data like an expert human driver by using map information to enhance training and evaluation of performance. We are a full-stack team owning mapping end to end, getting to touch work that is infrastructure, data engineering, data science, backend and frontend.      🧠 Your day-to-day     Write full-stack services in Python and Typescript, creating novel geospatial services to solve challenging and unique problems we face in building our AI driving products.    Collaborate with internal teams to understand requirements and build solutions with global geospatial data.    Design and build data pipelines with PySpark and Databricks to enrich fleet data with mapping and road-network information at global scale.    Build applications and datasets that support route planning and the preparation of map data for training and simulation.    Integrate with navigation and mapping APIs from providers such as Mapbox, TomTom and Google Maps.    Maintain, support and improve the services the team already runs.    Deploy and operate your services on Azure and Kubernetes, owning them end to end.        🧩 What you’ll be working on     Global-scale geospatial enrichment pipelines that tell us where we’ve driven and what the road network looks like.    Route-planning applications and datasets that help our teams decide where to drive next.    Map data preparation for model training and simulation.    New services you’ll take from idea to production and lead end to end.        🙌 You should apply if     You are a strong, hands-on Python engineer who can deliver high-quality production code at pace.    You are comfortable with an AI-assisted or AI engineering workflow (ideation, planning, implementation and review).    You have built and operated large-scale data pipelines using Spark or PySpark.    You are comfortable writing SQL to query and analyse large datasets.    You have working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and container orchestration, ideally Azure and Kubernetes, and are happy to own deployment, monitoring, and observability of your services.    You enjoy taking ownership of new services and seeing them through end to end.    Experience with geospatial data processing, road-network data or routing engines (e.g. OpenStreetMap, TomTom, HERE or Overture data, PostGIS, navigation APIs) would be a strong advantage.    Experience with Bazel or monorepo build systems is desirable but not mandatory.    Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Flyte or Airflow would be a bonus.       🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.      More about Wayve:   🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.  Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.      How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:   Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.      🔍 The Interview Process:   Our process is clear and respectful of your time:     Initial call / recruiter screen  (30 mins)     Competency interviews : Python Programming (60 mins) and Hiring Manager interview (45 mins)     Deep-dive technical interviews : Systems Design (60 mins) and Domain interview (60 mins)     Final interview : Mission and Values Alignment (45 mins).    We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.      What’s in it for you (Location dependant):   💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more  A quick, honest note before you apply.  Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.    If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.  At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.   For more information visit  Careers at Wayve.  To learn more about what drives us, visit  Values at Wayve   DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.
