c5003403e5084eb522b5.description: About The Team The Privacy Team at OpenAI is committed to building a secure and trustworthy platform. Our area of responsibility encompasses all OpenAI products and systems that process user data. We provide cross-functional partners with the tools needed to ensure that all products adhere to the highest standards of data privacy and legal compliance. Our approach to prioritizing responsible data use is integral to OpenAI's mission of safely introducing Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) that offers widespread benefits. About The Role We’re in search of a Software Engineer with experience building data pipelines and working closely with members of the Legal team. This role is perfect for someone who's passionate about the intersection of systems, privacy, and legal compliance. You will architect, design, and write backend systems responsible for handling some of the most sensitive data at OpenAI. This role is based in Dublin, Ireland. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In This Role, You Will Design, build, and maintain back-end systems and services that power privacy and data compliance functions within our API products and consumer applications. Work closely with legal advisors and other engineers to respond to court orders and other legal processes, all while upholding strict data privacy and legal standards. Identify opportunities for automation and build the tools that enable other teams to automate tasks involving customer data. Develop and implement data handling policies and procedures in compliance with legal and ethical standards, ensuring the integrity and confidentiality of user data. You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have experience building data pipelines, especially for legal processes and investigative workflows. Can translate legal requirements into technical solutions and explain technical solutions to a non-technical audience. Take responsibility for problems from beginning to end, and are prepared to acquire any missing knowledge necessary to get the job done. Create tools to speed up your own and your colleagues’ workflows, particularly when pre-existing solutions are inadequate. Deeply care about user experience and take pride in developing products that meet customer needs while ensuring privacy. Have a background in security investigations or experience working in collaboration with trust and safety, legal, and engineering teams. Compensation, Benefits And Perks This is a position with OpenAI Ireland Ltd., which controls the hiring and management of this position. Total compensation includes an annual salary, generous equity, and benefits. Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family Mental health and wellness support PRSA plan with 6% employer matching Unlimited time off Annual learning & development stipend (€1,400 per year) About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

c5108aa51ca11ad1805e.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:
We are looking for a Client Value Partner, Utilities—a seasoned industry executive who can bridge the gap between energy transition strategy and operational excellence. You will act as the primary accountable lead for one of America's largest strategic energy companies, translating C-level vision into clear, realized value. This role is open to either Hybrid New York Metro, Remote Ohio, or Remote Texas.

As a Client Value Partner, you are a "go-to" strategic advisor within our Energy go-to-market organization. You will move beyond standard customer success to link Celonis capabilities to key outcomes specific to Power Generation, Transmission & Distribution, and Renewable Energy assets.

You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our top-tier customers. You are our customers’ trusted advisor, helping them mobilize resources, achieve their strategic goals, and realize significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform.

In collaboration with our partners, Product, and Engineering teams, you will drive measurable business impact across complex, decentralized operating environments. You will blend deep utility expertise with a proven strategy consulting skill set to spearhead data-driven transformation at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Translate Strategy to Operations: Analyze the client's strategic goals (e.g., Decarbonization, Rate Base Growth, Grid Modernization) and map them to a long-term vision utilizing the Celonis platform.
  • Target High-Impact Areas: Architect the "COO" or "CFO" agenda—optimizing end-to-end value chains such as Capital Projects (EPC), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Meter-to-Cash, and Supply Chain resilience.
  • Build the Business Case: Construct robust, board-level business cases that articulate the financial impact of Process Intelligence (e.g., impact on O&M efficiency, ROE improvement, or Storm Response agility) to C-Suite executives.
  • Build demos and strategic roadmaps, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to embed Celonis as a core pillar of the client's digital utility strategy.
  • Undertake Value Assessments and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executives.

Realize Value

  • Drive Engagement Success: Lead the executive relationship and value workstream for large-scale transformations, ensuring the program effectively delivers on its "digital twin" promise across diverse operating companies.
  • Orchestrate the Ecosystem: Guide customers on organization design and the maturation of Centers of Excellence (CoE), mobilizing global cross-functional teams (Services, Product, Engineering) to ensure seamless delivery across a federated organizational structure.
  • Solve Systemic Challenges: Work cross-functionally to tackle difficult implementation hurdles, helping customers define standards for regulatory reporting (FERC/NERC), work order management, and enterprise-wide change initiatives.
  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement in Operations, Finance, and Procurement.
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives.
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives.

Scale Value

  • Codify Best Practices: Turn our client successes into reusable assets, playbooks, and thought leadership for the broader Energy & Utilities practice.
  • Mentor & Enable: Act as a senior leader for the team, coaching junior members and managers on executive relationship management, utility regulatory nuances, and team performance.
  • Product Feedback: Serve as the "Voice of the Customer" to our Product teams, ensuring our development roadmap aligns with the specific asset-intensive needs of the sector.
  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing.
    Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers, embedding Celonis Process Intelligence Platform as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization.
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases.

The qualifications you need:

  • Deep Industry Experience: 15+ years of relevant experience, ideally combining time at a top-tier Utility, Energy Conglomerate, or Renewables developer with Strategy Consulting. You understand the complexities of regulated vs. unregulated markets.
  • Domain Expertise: You possess granular knowledge of the value chain, specifically in areas such as Asset Lifecycle Management, Capital Project Controls, Supply Chain, and Customer Operations (CIS).
  • Value Realization Skills: You have a track record of driving large-scale transformation programs. You understand how to impact the P&L through capital efficiency, outage reduction, and working capital optimization.
  • Technical Fluency: You understand the modern utility stack (SAP IS-U, Maximo, Oracle Primavera) and how to translate Celonis use cases into the customer's specific business landscape.
  • Stakeholder Management: Extensive experience presenting to and influencing C-Level executives (COO, CFO, CIO). You can navigate complex holding company structures and have the power of persuasion through data, facts, and confidence.
  • Builder Mentality: You are comfortable working with ambiguity and possess an entrepreneurial leadership style that inspires teams.
  • Degree: MBA strongly preferred; Degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, or related field required.

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

The base salary range below is for the role in the specified location, based on a Full Time Schedule.

Total compensation package will include base salary + bonus/commission + equity + benefits (health, dental, life, 401k, and paid time off). Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and that the actual total compensation offer will be determined based on various factors, including, but not limited to, applicant's qualifications, skills, experiences, and location.
The base salary range below is for the role in New York, based on a Full Time Schedule.
$212,000—$270,000 USD

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

c5a1b245b51649981105.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Communications Manager at Anthropic, you will bring The Anthropic Institute's research to the world. The Institute works to advance the public conversation around AI, publishing findings so that policymakers, researchers, journalists, and the public can reckon with what's here and prepare for what's ahead. 

You will provide dedicated communications coverage for the Institute's two largest and fastest growing research engines: 1) Economic Research, which tracks AI's effect on jobs, wages, and the broader economy through the Anthropic Economic Index and labor market analysis, and 2) Societal Impacts, which studies how Claude is actually used, from workplace impacts and personal guidance to Claude's values and frontier agent use. You’ll also support TAI’s other teams, including Special Projects and the Frontier Red Team. 

In this role, you'll drive research tracking, publication strategy, and reactive press across both portfolios, including launches like quarterly Economic Index releases and the rollout of the new Economic Research Fund. You'll partner closely with the Economic Research and Societal Impacts research teams day to day, work alongside the Deputy Communications Lead, and coordinate with Anthropic's broader communications, policy, and editorial teams to keep messaging aligned while maintaining the Institute's distinct voice.

Responsibilities

  • Drive day-to-day communications for the Economic Research and Societal Impacts teams, including research tracking, publication planning, and reactive press
  • Lead communications planning and launch execution for the Anthropic Economic Index, recurring labor market analyses, and new research initiatives like the Economic Research Fund
  • Develop narratives that translate technical and quantitative research for audiences well beyond specialist communities
  • Build and maintain relationships with reporters across economics, labor, technology, research, and general interest outlets, along with academic economists and think tank researchers
  • Draft communications plans, briefing documents, talking points, press materials, and social content
  • Manage reactive press on sensitive findings in partnership with the Communications Lead, Deputy Communications Lead, and policy team
  • Partner with policy and editorial teams on publishing strategy, ensuring research reaches the largest appropriate audience through the Anthropic blog, the Institute's site, microsites, interactive experiences, video, and audio
  • Present researchers for media interviews, podcast appearances, and speaking engagements, and prepare them to succeed in those moments
  • Partner with Institute communications leadership on major announcements and milestone engagements
  • Build repeatable rollout playbooks and processes that allow a lean team to cover a growing research portfolio
  • Track both teams' research agendas to shape findings early and plan publications months in advance

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have deep communications experience, with significant depth in research, science, economics, or policy communications
  • Have a track record of translating complex, technical, or academic research into public narratives that reach audiences well beyond specialist communities
  • Are comfortable reading and interrogating quantitative research, and can engage substantively and credibly with the researchers who produce it
  • Have strong, active media relationships
  • Can move between long-lead strategic messaging and fast-turnaround tactical execution without losing quality, from planning a launch months out to handling an inbound press inquiry the same day
  • Have led multi-channel rollouts spanning strategy, digital, press, and cross-functional approvals
  • Are intellectually curious about AI's impact on the economy, society, and the future of work, and can embrace the unexpected in a field where the unusual is the norm
  • Thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities shift and ambiguity is common
  • Are excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial

Strong candidates may also have

  • Experience at a research institution, think tank, economics publication, or policy organization communicating quantitative findings
  • Familiarity with the AI policy landscape and the debates around AI's labor market and societal impacts
  • Experience standing up communications processes or playbooks on a small, growing team
  • A background working directly with economists, social scientists, or academic researchers on publication strategy
  • Experience managing sensitive or high-scrutiny press moments, including deciding what to say, when, and how
  • Enthusiasm for using AI tools in your own workflows to multiply what a small team can do

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$265,000—$295,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

c61304c3aad5b595cfe8.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a partnerships leader to own the tri-party motion for systems integrator partnerships selling through AWS. Global systems integrators and specialist SIs are how Claude reaches enterprise customers at scale, and AWS is the surface most of that work runs on. You will own the intersection of those two ecosystems.

In this role, you will build the go-to-market motion that turns partner interest into joint pipeline and closed revenue, working across AWS's partner organization and the AWS practices inside the world's largest integrators. You will define how Claude is positioned inside AWS partner programs, design the commercial mechanics that let partners transact and get rewarded, and build the joint plays that partners take to their customers.

This is a build role. The partner ecosystem is early, the programs are still being designed, and you will be operating across three organizations whose incentives on any given deal don’t always line up. You will help shape how frontier AI technology reaches the enterprise through the services ecosystem.

You will report directly to the Head of AWS GTM Partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the GTM strategy for our systems integrator partnerships through AWS, including co-selling motions, joint business plans, events and segment-specific plays
  • Own forecasting, pipeline development, and revenue targets for partner-sourced and partner-influenced business
  • Design the commercial mechanics that make the partner motion work, including deal registration, marketplace program structure, and incentives
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships across AWS's partner organization and across partner AWS practice leadership
  • Work with partners to develop repeatable, industry-specific solutions built on Claude, and help them build the delivery capability to take those solutions to market
  • Partner cross-functionally with Anthropic's alliances, sales, partner marketing, and regional cloud teams to keep the motion consistent globally while regions execute locally
  • Create and implement scalable processes for partnership operations, including escalation management, business reviews, and reporting
  • Provide strategic market intelligence and competitive insights on the partner ecosystem to inform product and commercial strategy
  • Identify where to concentrate investment across the partner portfolio and make the case to stop investing where returns are not there

Minimum qualifications

  • 12+ years of enterprise partnerships, alliances, or business development experience, with meaningful time spent on partner ecosystems
  • Proven track record of building and scaling partnerships with systems integrators, consultancies, or channel partners
  • Experience building a co-sell or channel motion from the ground up, including the commercial mechanics behind it
  • Deep understanding of how cloud and partner field organizations operate, and the incentives that drive seller and partner behavior
  • Track record of carrying and hitting a partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue number, with credible forecasting behind it
  • Strong executive presence and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders where you have no formal authority
  • Excellence in strategic planning, business operations, and program management
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, and a willingness to concentrate effort rather than spread thin
  • Experience working with technical products and translating complex capabilities into business value
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

Preferred qualifications

  • Previous experience working with AWS or another hyperscaler partner organization
  • Working knowledge of systems integrator operating models, including practice structures, delivery economics, and how services revenue drives partner decisions
  • Background in AI/ML technologies or with developer-focused platforms and their partner ecosystems
  • Experience scaling partner programs at a company moving from early traction to significant partner-driven revenue
  • Management consulting experience earlier in your career

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$365,000—$425,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Endeavour is a company that captures the IoT cellular connectivity experience. Our ground-breaking product nSpire is a SaaS platform that has collectors on the edge (on devices) and provides real value-based connectivity insights to our customers. Our vision is to improve the quality of connectivity with a specific focus on Business Critical, Mission Critical and Life Critical connectivity. With deep IoT, telecoms, analytics, and information technology experience, we are expanding our global presence to support customers around the world as the IoT and 5G markets continue to grow. Endeavour Technology turns data from connected devices into actionable intelligence. Our nSpire platform measures real-world connectivity quality from the device’s perspective, helping leading companies in automotive, in-flight connectivity, and telecoms understand and improve the experience their customers get. Software agents running on devices collect large, rich data sets that power guided analytics workflows used by hundreds of business users. These workflows are built on SQL, cloud databases, and Tableau – and our team uses AI tools such as Claude every day to work faster, explore problems more thoroughly, and deliver stronger results. Some of our successful solutions include Connected Cars (Auto OEMS), and Industrial Internet of things (IoT) including 5G Enterprise/MEC, NPN Networks. nSpire ensures that customers have the confidence and assurance that the connectivity delivered is always fit for purpose and enables IoT customers to utilise the QoS data in their IoT products and services. www.endeavourtechnology.com Role Description: We’re looking for an experienced Analytics Engineer who can take a product brief or use case and independently turn it into a robust, scalable analytics solution, with Tableau at the core of what you deliver. AI is part of how we work. You’ll use tools like Claude as a thinking partner – to shape your approach to a problem, speed up SQL and dashboard development, check your logic, and sharpen how insights are communicated. Your analytical judgement stays firmly in charge; AI helps you get to the best answer faster. We’re changing the energy system globally, spearheading the transition to greener, cheaper energy through the installation of in-home technologies.  

We have phenomenal growth plans, and we need enablers to help deliver our aspirations at speed and scale.  It’s a unique culture where people learn, decide and build quicker, where people work with autonomy alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground.  

At Octopus Energy Heating we’re developing a home heating revolution through innovative heat pumps which will significantly reduce reliance on fossil fuels and bring a cleaner more sustainable world.  We are continuing to grow our manufacturing and R&D premises in Portadown and if you want to help us bring this technology to the market at scale and speed, then read on…


We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to join our Octopus Energy Group team in Portadown. 
As a key member of our innovative and growing team, you'll be responsible for designing and optimising the manufacture of world-changing heat pumps and their production at scale. If you're passionate about renewable energy and eager to make a positive impact on the planet, this role is perfect for you! Plan, design, set up, test, modify, optimise and monitor manufacturing processes and equipment Research, propose and implement opportunities for process improvement Ensure equipment and processes meet health, safety, quality and environmental requirements Support the maintenance team to trouble-shoot and repair manufacturing equipment Provide engineering input to the planning and organising of maintenance Proven experience (min 3 years) in providing technical engineering support within a mechanised, volume manufacturing setting A good academic background with a relevant degree in engineering High level of technical expertise and skill, and good knowledge of a range of engineering functions and practices A practical, analytical and logical approach to problem solving Strong interpersonal, presentation and communication skills, plus proven project management skills with the ability to work to tight deadlines Awareness of health, safety and environmental considerations Computer literate and a proficient user of CAD and MS Office applications It would be great if you had knowledge of heat pump or heating equipment manufacturing, however these are not essential Rotational moulding experience would also be desirable but is not essential • 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit! • 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture . An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were recently named the UK's top company to work for , and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2024 . Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you. 🚀 P.S. Our process usually takes up to 4 weeks, but we’ll always do our best to flex around what works for you. Along the way, you’ll chat with our recruitment team and your Recruiter will help you throughout different stages. Got any burning questions before then? Drop us a message at talent@octoenergy.com and we’d love to help! Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic! Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. c7874d3413c002e655e8.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

What you’ll do

As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous engineers in the industry and learn how to ship high-quality work at scale. By contributing to Stripe’s codebase you’ll work across domains that give you insight into how the global economy works. Recent intern projects include expanding Stripe’s Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.

Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. 

Responsibilities

  • Operate as a real member of the team you join; engage in team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.

  • Write software that will be used in production, and has meaningful impact to Stripe’s business and users.

  • Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions

  • Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback.

  • Learn quickly by asking great questions, working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, communicating the status of your work clearly, and building with the latest AI tooling.

Who you are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 

  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

  • A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, math, or a related discipline. 

  • Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.

  • Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders.

  • Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts. 

  • Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

  • At least 1 year of university education, or equivalent work experience.

  • One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. 

  • Experience writing high quality pull requests, with good test coverage, and working knowledge to complete projects with minimal defects.

  • Familiarity with navigating and managing your work in new code bases, with multiple languages.

  • Clear written communication skills, with the ability to write clearly to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a Program Manager to join our Accounting organization and help it run as one global team. Accounting is scaling at an unprecedented pace across multiple hubs, and the goals, rhythms, programs, and people that make up the team need to stay connected as we grow. In this role, you will own that connective tissue: the annual goal-setting cycle, the leadership team’s operating cadence, org-wide events and internal communications, and the programs that make a distributed team feel like one. 

You will partner with Accounting leadership, the People team, Finance Systems, and hub leads. This is a hands-on role with a lot of range: part chief of staff, part program manager, part culture builder.

Responsibilities 

Goals and operating rhythm

  • Run the annual goal setting process and the reporting that tracks progress against those goals.
  • Look at how the org actually operates (meetings, handoffs, planning cycles, decision making) and fix what isn't working.
  • Maintain one org-wide planning calendar that shows close, audit, and team milestones alongside company-wide and team events, so leaders can see the pressure points and plan around them.
  • Build and maintain a simple set of org health metrics (attrition, engagement scores, hiring pipeline, training completion, survey trends) and report on them regularly.

Leadership and org-wide events

  • Run our extended leadership team (XLT) program, including agendas, meetings, follow-ups, and action items.
  • Own planning and agenda for the annual offsite and run the quarterly team all-hands.
  • Write the internal updates: a regular team newsletter, plus talking points when leadership needs to explain a change to the whole org.

People and culture

  • Coordinate projects across the org that support employee experience programs.
  • Partner with the People team to roll out training and development programs for Accounting.
  • Review team survey results, identify the themes, and build action plans to address the feedback. Follow through and report back to the team.
  • Run hub programs, including visit and rotation programs, local hub events, and meeting norms that work across time zones, so we feel like one global team.
  • Run recognition and team rituals: wins, milestones, anniversaries, and peer recognition, especially across hubs.

Team operations

  • Support contractor management, including onboarding, tracking, and coordination with the right partners.
  • Keep the team's knowledge base current: wiki, org charts, role descriptions, and key process docs.
  • Keep the team calendar accurate so everyone knows what's coming.

Preferred qualifications

  • 7+ years in program management, operations, chief of staff, or strategy roles. Experience inside a finance or accounting org is a plus, but not required.
  • A track record of running recurring programs end to end and getting people to follow through without formal authority.
  • Good judgment about what matters and what doesn't. You can handle a lot of moving pieces without dropping them.
  • Clear, direct writing. You can brief a senior leader in a few sentences.
  • Comfort with confidential information and sensitive people topics.
  • Experience supporting distributed or global teams.
  • You're organized, but you also know when a process is getting in the way and should be simplified.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$230,000—$300,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Our partner is looking for an AI Evaluation Engineer based in Ireland. As a founding AI Evaluation Engineer, you will design and build the evaluation, testing, and observability infrastructure that ensures production-grade AI agents perform reliably, safely, and efficiently. You will develop automated testing systems for complex reasoning, multi-turn conversations, and agent interactions involving APIs, databases, and code execution. Working across AI engineering, software testing, and infrastructure, you will create scalable evaluation pipelines that go beyond traditional QA and manual prompt testing. You will establish robust regression testing, statistical evaluation methods, and adversarial scenarios to identify weaknesses before deployment. This is an opportunity to take ownership of an evaluation architecture from the ground up while working with modern AI technologies in a fully remote, globally distributed environment. Your work will directly contribute to the reliability, security, and continuous improvement of advanced AI systems. Accountabilities Design, build, and maintain automated CI/CD testing pipelines to validate AI agent behavior before deployment and throughout the development lifecycle. Develop and maintain golden datasets containing regression prompts, edge cases, and synthetic scenarios to measure agent accuracy, safety, performance, and latency. Implement fast, cost-effective, deterministic evaluation checks before introducing LLM-as-a-judge approaches, including JSON schema validation, regular expressions, API status checks, and embedding similarity. Create comprehensive test suites for multi-turn agent conversations, evaluating context retention, state consistency, reasoning behavior, and safeguards against infinite tool-calling loops. Design and implement adversarial testing scenarios to assess resilience against prompt injection, malformed inputs, unexpected tool responses, and other potential security vulnerabilities. Build statistical evaluation frameworks to measure non-deterministic AI behavior using pass rates across multiple runs, confidence intervals, and other quantitative reliability metrics. Integrate evaluation workflows into GitHub Actions or comparable CI systems using SDK-level execution and automated testing practices. Implement observability and tracing solutions using tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or equivalent platforms to monitor agent execution and diagnose failures. Optimize evaluation efficiency and cost through caching, mocking, and other techniques that reduce unnecessary LLM API calls. Validate structured outputs, including JSON schemas, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads, to ensure agents interact reliably with external systems. Evaluate and improve agent performance under load, accounting for variable response times and non-deterministic endpoint behavior. Independently design and own the evaluation architecture, establishing best practices, testing standards, and scalable processes for ongoing quality assurance. Requirements Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, particularly for API testing, headless execution, asynchronous programming, and automated testing systems. Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation pipelines, AI testing frameworks, or statistical testing systems capable of measuring performance across repeated runs. Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD environments, particularly GitHub Actions or similar platforms, with SDK-level execution. Strong expertise in validating structured data and outputs, including JSON schema, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads. Familiarity with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or custom logging solutions. Ability to independently design, implement, and maintain an evaluation architecture from scratch, with a strong sense of ownership and technical judgment. Experience with code execution sandboxes or AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the RL Teams

Our Reinforcement Learning teams play a critical role in advancing our AI systems. We've contributed to all Claude models, with significant impacts on the autonomy and coding capabilities of our latest Claude models. Our work spans several key areas:

  • Developing systems that enable models to use computers effectively

  • Advancing code generation through reinforcement learning

  • Pioneering fundamental RL research for large language models

  • Building scalable RL infrastructure and training methodologies

  • Enhancing model reasoning capabilities

We collaborate closely with Anthropic's alignment and frontier red teams to ensure our systems are both capable and safe. We partner with the applied production training team to bring research innovations into deployed models, and are dedicated to implement our research at scale. Our Reinforcement Learning teams sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and engineering excellence, with a deep commitment to building high-quality, scalable systems that push the boundaries of what AI can accomplish.

About the Role

We're hiring for the Code RL team within the RL organization. As a Research Engineer, you'll advance our models' ability to write, edit, test, debug, and ship real software — end to end, on real codebases, with real tools — and to do it correctly, fast, and safely.

This role blends research and engineering. You'll design RL environments and coding tasks, build the reward signals and verifiers that capture what "good code" means, run training experiments on frontier models, diagnose why a model does (or doesn't) get better at a class of software-engineering work, and improve the speed and reliability of the pipelines that make all of that iterate fast. Code RL spans several focus areas — from agentic coding behaviors and code correctness, to long-horizon autonomous engineering, to high-performance code for accelerators — and we'll match you to the area where you'll have the most impact.

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have strong software-engineering skills and deep Python expertise, including async/concurrent programming

  • Are comfortable owning systems end to end and debugging across the stack

  • Can balance research exploration with engineering implementation, and engage rigorously in shaping experimental design and interpreting results

  • Care about code quality, testing, and performance

  • Are passionate about the potential impact of AI and are committed to developing safe and beneficial systems

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Experience with reinforcement learning, RLHF, post-training, or LLM finetuning

  • Built coding agents, code-execution sandboxes, eval harnesses, verifiers, or developer tooling

  • Background in program analysis, testing, verification, compilers, or formal methods

  • Experience with PyTorch and large-scale distributed training; performance profiling and optimization of ML systems

  • CUDA / GPU or TPU kernel experience and accelerator-performance intuition

  • Experience with virtualization and sandboxed code execution environments

Related roles

If your background leans toward one of these areas specifically, you may also want to look at these postings:

  • Research Engineer, Performance RL (Reinforcement Learning) — teaching Claude to write correct, fast code for accelerators

  • Research Engineer, Universes — long-horizon, ultra-realistic agentic training environments

  • Research Engineer, Cybersecurity RL (Reinforcement Learning) — RL for security-relevant coding capabilities

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$500,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. ca09817844acbdcae4e3.description: Role:  Robot Learning Engineer  Company:   Humanoid   Location:  London, UK (King’s Cross) – on-site, five days a week  Job Type:  Full-time   About Humanoid   Humanoid is building the world’s most capable, commercially scalable and safe humanoid robots. Its platform, HMND-01, is already deployed in real industrial environments, which makes Humanoid the most serious humanoid robotics company in Europe.    300+ people, 34+ nationalities, flat structure: your decisions ship directly into real robots.    Offices in London (HQ, King’s Cross), Boston, Vancouver and San Diego.    Backed by serious funding, growing fast and deliberately.    Values: Speed, Ambition, Passion, Trust.     About the role   The Manipulation team sits at the center of everything Humanoid does. In their own words, they are the bottleneck: the work is intense, the impact is immediate, and from day one you get access to prototype hardware worth hundreds of thousands of pounds. The team works on whole-body locomotion and manipulation, using imitation learning and RL on real robots.  This is a senior or staff individual contributor role with no management track, and the team is hiring for several openings. It is not a research role: the goal is policies that work on the robot, and results are shared as blog posts, not papers.   What you are expected to do     Post-train manipulation policies with behaviour cloning and RL, and own the full loop from raw data to deployment on a real robot.    Work with the simulation team to set up RL training on a digital twin. Iterate on reward design and simulation quality to get reliable sim-to-real transfer.    Partner with the Data Collection org to drive collection: define what good data looks like, ensure diversity and coverage, iterate on operator instructions.    Design data preprocessing strategies that improve the quality of collected data.    Expand observation and action spaces to support new capabilities, and work with the Teleoperations team to expose them to robot operators.    Work with the Controls teams to improve motion smoothness and the teleoperation experience.    Feed what you learn about current hardware limits back into future hardware design cycles.    Work closely with the pre-training team to take advances from research and make them work reliably in real-world industrial demos.     What you need to succeed     3+ years working on robots in industry or research, with shipped work to show for it: a track record, not just theory.    Hands-on experience with modern manipulation methods, ideally close to production deployment.    Solid understanding of modern teleoperation and low-level robot control stacks.    Experience with neural network post-training: behaviour cloning and RL applied to physical systems.    Familiarity with deep learning infrastructure: streaming datasets, checkpointing, distributed training, PyTorch or JAX. You can profile and debug numerics.    Strong software engineering and coding fundamentals: maintainable research code, clear experiment docs, crisp communication of trade-offs. The process includes a LeetCode-style coding round, so come prepared.    You are driven by getting things to work on the robot, not by writing the perfect algorithm in simulation. When something breaks, your instinct is to debug it, not publish it.    You are proactive: you can take an open problem and drive it without waiting for a spec.    Working English.    Slightly below the experience bar but current on modern manipulation methods? Apply anyway. Strong PhD students close to finishing and postdocs are welcome too. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

You want to build large scale ML systems from the ground up. You care about making safe, steerable, trustworthy systems. As a Research Engineer, you'll touch all parts of our code and infrastructure, whether that's making the cluster more reliable for our big jobs, improving throughput and efficiency, running and designing scientific experiments, or improving our dev tooling. You're excited to write code when you understand the research context and more broadly why it's important.
 
Note: This is an "evergreen" role that we keep open on an ongoing basis. We receive many applications for this position, and you may not hear back from us directly if we do not currently have an open role on any of our teams that matches your skills and experience. We encourage you to apply despite this, as we are continually evaluating for top talent to join our team. You are also welcome to reapply as you gain more experience, but we suggest only reapplying once per year.
 
We may also put up separate, team-specific job postings. In those cases, the teams will give preference to candidates who apply to the team-specific postings, so if you are interested in a specific team please make sure to check for team-specific job postings!

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have significant software engineering experience
  • Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact
  • Pick up slack, even if it goes outside your job description
  • Enjoy pair programming (we love to pair!)
  • Want to learn more about machine learning research
  • Care about the societal impacts of your work

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

  • High performance, large-scale ML systems
  • GPUs, Kubernetes, Pytorch, or OS internals
  • Language modeling with transformers
  • Reinforcement learning
  • Large-scale ETL

Representative projects:

  • Optimizing the throughput of a new attention mechanism
  • Comparing the compute efficiency of two Transformer variants
  • Making a Wikipedia dataset in a format models can easily consume
  • Scaling a distributed training job to thousands of GPUs
  • Writing a design doc for fault tolerance strategies
  • Creating an interactive visualization of attention between tokens in a language model

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$350,000—$500,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Growth at Anthropic is about helping people discover what Claude can do and make it part of how they work, from someone's first session to an entire company rolling out Claude. We're a small design team working across all of Anthropic's products, on problems that often don't have established playbooks, because the products and the capabilities behind them change so quickly.

We drive growth by making the product itself better, favoring foundational changes and new product experiences over small optimizations. Our focus spans whatever most limits Anthropic's growth, and priorities can shift quickly.

As a senior Product Designer on Growth, you'll own how Claude grows with people who use it for their everyday work. You'll dig into why some people make Claude a habit and others don't, find the real bottlenecks, and lead the product changes that move them. You'll set the vision for this area, partner closely with product, engineering, and data science, and raise the quality bar for the designers around you.

We're looking for designers who thrive in ambiguity and pair sharp diagnostic judgment with exceptional craft. You form a clear point of view from messy signals, prototype quickly to test it, and drive alignment across teams to ship it. You use tools like Claude Code to explore ideas and push what's possible.

Key responsibilities

  • Own growth for how people use Claude in their everyday work, end to end, as your full-time focus
  • Diagnose what drives deep, habitual use and what blocks it, combining data, research, and hands-on time in the product
  • Set an opinionated vision for the area and turn it into a roadmap with your PM, engineering, and data science partners
  • Redesign core parts of the product to drive growth, from onboarding and first-run experiences to the everyday workflows people rely on most
  • Shape hypotheses and experiments, and judge results with a nuanced view of how we win, not just the topline metric
  • Deliver exceptionally crafted interactions and set the quality bar for your area
  • Drive alignment with partner teams whose work touches your area, connecting individual use to team and company adoption
  • Mentor other designers, and frame problems clearly enough that others can own them
  • Prototype and test ideas quickly with Claude Code and other AI tools

Minimum qualifications

  • A portfolio of shipped product design work that shows product vision and a high level of craft
  • Experience owning growth for a major product area end to end, including diagnosing problems and setting direction
  • Deep growth design experience in activation, onboarding, retention, engagement, or expansion, on a product at meaningful scale
  • Hands-on experience designing, launching, and interpreting experiments, and using them to make product decisions
  • Fluency with product analytics such as funnels, retention, and engagement
  • Proficiency with design, prototyping, and AI tools, such as Figma and Claude Code, and a habit of learning new tools to push what's possible
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience driving alignment across product, engineering, and data science

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading growth strategy across multiple teams or product areas
  • Experience designing enterprise/B2B SaaS, productivity, or collaboration tools
  • Experience with product-led growth, from a single user to a team to a company-wide rollout
  • Experience mentoring designers or shaping a design practice
  • Comfort querying data yourself with SQL or a similar tool
  • Experience prototyping with front-end code (e.g., HTML/CSS/JS)
  • Experience defining AI-powered workflows for yourself or your team
  • A clear point of view on when a product should ask for attention, and when it should stay out of the way
  • Passion for building safe, beneficial AI that helps people do their best work

Representative projects

  • Diagnose why some people make a product part of their daily work and others drift away, then lead the changes that close the gap
  • Redesign a core part of the product so people return to it more often and get more value each time
  • Set the vision for a product's first-run experience and lead it through experiments to a redesigned, permanent flow
  • Design the path from one person's daily use to their whole team adopting it

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$305,000—$460,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
