edf68a8640a5efb33761.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're looking for a research engineer who believes that visual and spatial reasoning are core to fully unlocking the capabilities of LLMs. On the Vision team, you'll own the end-to-end process of creating training data and RL environments targeting visual knowledge work: identifying long-horizon and vision-heavy tasks, building evals, designing rewards, and scaling data. This is a unique role that combines applied research with hands-on data work. It's also highly collaborative — you'll partner with external vendors, pretraining, RL, and product teams to make sure the environments you build translate into real-world knowledge work capabilities.

What you'll do:

  • Own the data strategy for vision capabilities end-to-end, from building evals and scaling RL environments
  • Manage technical relationships with external data vendors, including writing task specifications, evaluating visual data and annotation quality, and iterating on reward design
  • Develop and improve QA frameworks that catch reward hacking and ensure environment quality at scale
  • Run generalization experiments to measure how data strategy changes improve multimodal capabilities on held-out evaluations
  • Partner with pretraining, RL, and product teams, and do the science that shows we’re all rowing in the same direction

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 7+ years of ML, computer vision, and software engineering experience through industry, academia, or other projects
  • Have experience with reinforcement learning, reward design, or training data curation for large language or vision-language models
  • Are familiar with the architecture, training, and operation of large vision language models
  • Are comfortable managing technical vendor relationships and iterating quickly on feedback
  • Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact
  • Care about the societal impacts of your work

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

  • Designing evals or benchmarks for LLMs or vision language models
  • Large-scale pretraining, SL, and RL on language models
  • Deep learning research on images, video, or other modalities
  • Developing complex agentic systems using LLMs
  • Large-scale ETL and data pipeline development

Representative projects:

  • Writing a vendor-facing specification for a new family of visual RL training tasks, then iterating with the vendor on coverage, quality, and reward design
  • Running experiments to determine ideal training datamixes and parameters for a synthetically generated vision dataset
  • Finetuning Claude to maximize its performance using a particular set of agent tools/skills

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$350,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

At MongoDB, our Account Development team works closely with our partners in both Sales and Marketing to build fanatical customer enthusiasm around MongoDB. ADR reps are responsible for identifying and qualifying new opportunities for our sales organization. 

We view our Account Development program as the best way to turbocharge a long and successful career in sales and view our Account Development Representatives (ADRs) as the next wave of Account Executives at MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Day to Day

  • Identify high-potential businesses that would be a good fit to work with MongoDB for selected strategic accounts in EMEA
  • Work with the Sales team to develop and lead outbound campaigns from idea-generation through to qualified call
  • Develop strong sales and product knowledge
  • Interact with IT and business decision makers via telephone and email
  • Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management
  • Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team
  • Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential
  • Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota
  • Build strong relationships with our partner team, regional ADRs and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business
  • Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success

What You Will Bring to the Table

  • A self-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals
  • Outstanding communication skills in English (native level)
  • Any additional languages; swedish, dutch, french etc. is preferred but not required
  • Time management skills and ability to work either independently or through coaching
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced and high growth environment
  • Passionate about cutting-edge technology with the aptitude to learn new and exciting IT software products, as well as, understand business critical solutions quickly 

Things We Love

  • Strong and progressive academic background: Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Business or any related field
  • Proven track record of success in sales or business development or customer facing roles in a target driven environment, ideally in the tech industry
  • Familiarity with database, web server, and open source technology
  • Working experience with Salesforce.com

Why You Should Apply

  • Great Earning Potential 
  • Welcoming and inclusive workplace Meet MongoDB’s Employee Affinity Groups!
  • Continuous career development
  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Benefits include
    • Sales Bootcamp
    • Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

eed830dedf936e2e9d98.description: 📍 Amsterdam - Hybride (minimaal 50% op kantoor) ⏱️ 36-40 uur per week 🎒 3+ jaar relevante ervaring als Product Designer 💰 € 4100 - €5100 per maand (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) 🌍 Futurewhiz is een B Corp Hoe maak je leren zo leuk dat kinderen verder willen ontdekken? Bij Squla combineer je technologie, spel en kinderpsychologie om digitale leerervaringen te ontwerpen die de wereld van kinderen vergroot. Hun enthousiasme, onverwachte vragen en eerlijke reacties maken kinderen een geweldige doelgroep om voor te werken. We werken aan een totale vernieuwing van Squla. Als Product Designer onderzoek je wat kinderen, ouders en leerkrachten nodig hebben, verken en test je nieuwe concepten en werk je die samen met het team uit. Je grootste kracht ligt in onderzoek en het verkennen en testen van ideeën, en met jouw ontwerpvaardigheden breng je de ideeën tot leven. 🏰 Onze missie Bij Futurewhiz bouwen we digitale leerproducten die kinderen en jongeren helpen groeien. Met merken als Squla en StudyGo ondersteunen we honderdduizenden leerlingen bij hun ontwikkeling. Als B Corp combineren we commerciële groei met maatschappelijke impact. Squla helpt basisschoolkinderen leren door middel van games, quizzen en interactieve oefeningen die aansluiten op het Nederlandse onderwijs. Met onze productvernieuwing bouwen we aan de volgende fase van Squla. Jij helpt ontdekken welke leerervaringen daarin het verschil kunnen maken. 🎮 Wat ga je doen? Bij Squla werk je aan vragen als: Hoe help je een kind na een fout weer op weg? Wat maakt een oefening uitdagend zonder frustrerend te worden? Hoe zorg ik dat de vorm bijdraagt aan het leereffect? Als product designer bij Squla werk je aan het volledige ontwerpproces: van gebruikersonderzoek en conceptvalidatie tot UX- en UI-design en implementatie. Je maakt ideeën tastbaar, werkt interacties en visuele details uit en bouwt samen met het team aan het vernieuwde Squla. 🌟 Jouw rol en impact Jij bent een Product designer die energie krijgt van: Doelgroep begrijpen: Je spreekt kinderen, ouders en leerkrachten, bezoekt scholen en combineert observaties met gedrags- en gebruiksdata. Nieuwe concepten verkennen en testen: Je vertaalt inzichten naar kansen en ideeën. Je maakt aannames expliciet en kiest passende experimenten en prototypes om te onderzoeken of een concept begrijpelijk, aantrekkelijk en waardevol is. Ontwerpen en doorontwikkelen: Je werkt kansrijke ideeën uit tot journeys, flows, interacties en visuele ontwerpen, met aandacht voor gebruiksgemak, toegankelijkheid en consistentie. Bijdragen aan implementatie: Je werkt ontwerpen samen met Engineering uit tot werkende productervaringen. Waar passend kun je zelf vibecoden om wijzigingen in de productcode te maken, met review door Engineering. Leren van resultaten: Je gebruikt feedback, tests en gebruiksdata om te beoordelen of je ontwerp werkt en wat beter kan. Je werkt samen met collega’s uit Product, Engineering, Educatie, Data, Marketing en Design. Je wordt ook onderdeel van de design guild binnen Futurewhiz: een plek om design werk te bespreken, kennis te delen en elkaar te helpen groeien. 🔥 Wie ben jij? Je bent een Product Designer die graag uitzoekt waarom mensen iets nodig hebben en hoe een ontwerp daarop kan aansluiten. Je voelt je prettig wanneer een vraagstuk nog open is en weet onderzoek om te zetten in concrete vervolgstappen. Daarnaast: Je hebt 3+ jaar ervaring als Product Designer, UX Designer of UX/UI Designer en hebt digitale producten ontworpen en opgeleverd in een multidisciplinair team. Je kunt zelfstandig onderzoek doen: onderzoeksvragen formuleren, passende onderzoeksmethoden kiezen, uitvoering en bevindingen vertalen naar ontwerpkeuzes. Je begrijpt het verschil tussen wat gebruikers zeggen, wat ze doen en wat je daaruit kunt concluderen. Je verkent meerdere ideeën voordat je een richting kiest en gebruikt prototypes om snel te leren. Je hebt goede vaardigheden in UI design, visueel ontwerp en prototyping, bij voorkeur met Figma. Je kunt gebruikersbehoeften afwegen tegen leerdoelen, productdoelen en technische mogelijkheden. Je legt je keuzes helder uit, staat open voor feedback en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van je werk. Je kunt vibecoden en gebruikt AI-designtools om concepten, werkende prototypes en productaanpassingen te maken. Je beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch en zorgt samen met Engineering voor kwaliteit en haalbaarheid. Je beheerst Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Je kunt onderzoek uitvoeren met Nederlandstalige kinderen, ouders en leerkrachten en inzichten helder delen met je Engelstalige collega’s. In je portfolio zien we graag hoe je van onderzoek naar inzicht, concept en validatie bent gekomen, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en wat je daarvan hebt geleerd. Ervaring met onderzoek onder kinderen, EdTech, digitale consumentenproducten of spelenderwijs leren is een pré. 💰Wat krijg je van ons? Salaris, € 4100 - €5100 per maand (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) 24 vrije vakantiedagen + 1 ‘spijbeldag’ (vrije dag) + 3 toegewezen vakantiedagen Collectief pensioen en collectieve zorgverzekering Een jaarlijks leerbudget van €600 voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling Onbeperkt toegang tot externe coaches via Inuka Coaching Onbeperkt toegang tot Goodhabitz voor professionele- en persoonlijke groei Daarnaast: Levenslange toegang tot StudyGo en Squla-accounts Kantoor naast station Amsterdam Bijlmer Arena (met een Swapfiets of OV-businesscard als je >7km van het kantoor woont) Een MacBook om mee te werken Een optie tot Payroll Giving om bij te dragen aan een goed doel Gezonde lunches op kantoor, onbeperkt goede koffie, vers fruit en snacks Een Culture Crew die leuke activiteiten organiseert zoals uitjes, pubquizzen en skireizen. 😻 Wie zijn wij? Wij zijn een gepassioneerd en divers team, samengebracht door een gedeelde missie: kinderen helpen om te groeien in hun leerproces en hen te versterken met gepersonaliseerd onderwijs. Onze cultuur is open en authentiek – we geloven dat je het beste werk levert als je jezelf kunt zijn. Of je nu van boekenclubs, maandelijkse borrels, filmavonden, bakwedstrijden, Mario Kart-competities of skireizen houdt, bij Futurewhiz vind je een gemeenschap die als thuis voelt. Onze platforms zijn voor iedereen, en dat geldt ook voor onze werkplek. De kracht zit in onze verschillende achtergronden, ideeën, ervaringen en perspectieven. Deze diversiteit helpt ons om alle kinderen te ondersteunen in hun leerproces, ongeacht wie zij – of wij – zijn. Bij Futurewhiz omarmen we elkaars verschillen en creëren we een authentieke werkomgeving waarin iedereen zichzelf kan zijn. Zo maken we het ook makkelijker voor anderen om dat te doen. We zijn toegewijd aan een diverse en inclusieve cultuur, die begint op ons kantoor en zich uitstrekt over al onze platforms – en iedereen is welkom op deze reis. Word jij onze nieuwe Product Designer? We nodigen je graag uit om te solliciteren, ook als je niet aan alle vereisten voldoet, maar wel enthousiast bent. Tip: wees vooral jezelf. We omarmen de diversiteit van al onze collega’s en zijn oprecht benieuwd naar jouw unieke perspectief Visa sponsorship voor deze rol is niet van toepassing. Alleen kandidaten met een geldige werkvergunning voor Nederland/EU komen in aanmerking voor deze functie. Upload je motivatie en cv via de sollicitatieknop. We nemen dan zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

Back to jobs Technical Program Manager, Apps Platform San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic is investing in shared platform capabilities that power Claude across our consumer and developer products: the common foundation that Claude, Cowork, Claude Code, and future surfaces are built on. We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to be the connective tissue for this effort, someone who ensures we're building the platform the rest of Anthropic's products are built on, and that product teams actually get leverage from it. This is not a single-team TPM role. You'll work across the platform engineering teams and every product team that consumes the platform, driving one cohesive roadmap rather than a collection of disconnected workstreams. Success looks like products at Anthropic shipping more easily, faster, and more reliably because they're built on a common foundation, with developer velocity increasing measurably across the company, not just within one team. Responsibilities Own the cross-Apps platform roadmap end to end: sequencing, dependencies, and tradeoffs across platform teams and the apps teams that depend on them Drive alignment between platform engineering and apps teams so platform investments map to real consumer needs and adoption actually happens (leverage only exists if teams build on the platform) Identify duplication across surfaces and convert it into shared platform capabilities Establish the operating rhythm: planning, status, escalation paths, and launch coordination across orgs Create program documentation including roadmaps, status reports, risk assessments, and communication plans Facilitate technical decision-making by bringing together stakeholders, driving consensus, and ensuring timely resolution of blocking issues You may be a good fit if you Have several years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional programs Have experience with platform engineering efforts (shared services, developer platforms, or common capabilities consumed by multiple product teams) and can engage meaningfully with the engineers building them Have driven platform adoption across consuming teams, where success depended on other teams choosing to build on what you shipped Have experience coordinating across multiple engineering teams and organizations simultaneously Are highly organized and can manage multiple parallel workstreams effectively across distributed teams Thrive in unstructured environments with a knack for bringing order to chaos and creating clarity in ambiguous situations Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority Are passionate about Anthropic's mission and interested in the challenges of bringing AI capabilities to users safely and reliably The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $365,000 - $435,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. efaa6f6c9da43b5dadb8.description: About Glanua Glanua is an industry leader in providing innovative and sustainable engineering solutions to design, build, operate and maintain critical water and wastewater infrastructure across Ireland and the UK. We are a trusted provider to the municipal and industrial sector where our clients include Ireland and the UK’s largest water utilities, Uisce Éireann (formally Irish Water), Thames Water, Yorkshire Water, Affinity Water and Northern Ireland Water. Glanua is passionate about solving today’s environmental challenges and delivering a decarbonised and sustainable world. We know that to build successful creative teams we need a diverse workforce that can deliver new innovative ways of thinking. We provide an environment where you will have the freedom to develop and grow to your full potential. We champion our core values and uphold the highest standards of Safety and Well-being, Innovation, Integrity, Collaboration, Courage, Agility, Accountability, Diversity and Inclusion in everything we do. We have a talented team of 450 people across Ireland and the UK and are rapidly expanding our workforce across several disciplines to meet our ambitious growth plans. The Role: We are seeking a Process Engineer for the Process & Hydraulic Engineering discipline for industrial role in the UK & Ireland. In this role, you will support the development of robust engineering design solutions under the guidance of senior engineers water and wastewater infrastructure projects from concept through to construction, commissioning, and operations. You will support the development of robust engineering design solutions that meet client requirements and contribute to successful project outcomes through to process commissioning. Working as part of a multi-disciplinary engineering team, you will operate within a collaborative “one-team” culture while actively developing your technical skills and gaining early-career engineering experience. While your primary focus will be on Process, Mechanical, and Hydraulic Design, you will also engage with and manage inputs and deliverables from other engineering disciplines, including Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Control & Automation (MEICA), as well as civil and structural engineering. This role offers exposure to a broad range of multi-disciplinary engineering challenges, providing a strong platform for professional growth and career progression. You will also have the opportunity to develop client relationships, lead design discussions, and contribute to integrated, high-quality project delivery across all stages. Main Duties and Responsibilities: Strategic Design Role Assist in developing and maintaining design vision aligned with business objectives and long-term strategic goals. Contribute to design initiatives that enhance project outcomes and organisational capability. Establish and refine consistent, efficient, and high-quality design workflows across all projects. Promote a culture of innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement within the design function. efdb992b235ccb162bf0.description: Full Time, On-Site Working Pattern: Friday–Tuesday St. Margaret’s, Co.Dublin, K67 P7E5 About The Role As an Operations Manager for HelloFresh Ireland, you will work directly with our Senior Operations Manager to oversee, manage, and optimise our Third-Party Logistics (3PL) fulfilment partner. Unlike direct operational management models where you manage shift teams on the floor, this role focuses on driving high-level operational performance, managing key metrics, and influencing our 3PL partner to execute best-in-class processes. We are looking for a results-driven, relationship-builder and collaborative leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You will be responsible for building a strong, trust-based relationship with our 3PL partner, establishing accountability, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring that our customers receive perfect boxes every time. What You Will Be Doing 3PL Oversight & Performance Management Monitor, analyse, and manage site KPIs, including SLA compliance, throughput, cost per box, and production errors. Conduct performance reviews with the 3PL management team to review metrics, address operational bottlenecks, and track corrective actions. Relationship Building & Influence Establish strong, collaborative relationships with 3PL leadership to align operational priorities and drive process changes. Serve as the main bridge between HelloFresh central teams, including Supply Chain, Tech, and FSQA, and the 3PL management team. Quality & Standards Governance Oversee 3PL adherence to HelloFresh food safety, quality, and workplace safety standards through site audits and checks. Ensure effective root-cause analysis and sustainable resolution for any quality or service failures. Continuous Improvement & Cost Efficiency Partner with the 3PL to identify efficiency opportunities, optimise workflows, and apply Lean principles. Lead initiatives aimed at waste reduction, labour optimisation, and peak-season scaling. Who You Are Essential Experience & Skills Vendor/3PL Management Experience: Proven track record in logistics, fulfilment, or supply chain management, specifically managing external 3PL partners or suppliers. Relationship & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a proven ability to negotiate, influence key stakeholders, and build collaborative supplier relationships. Metric & Data-Driven: Strong analytical mindset with experience managing SLAs/KPIs, conducting root-cause analysis, and leveraging data to drive business decisions. Operational Insight: Solid understanding of warehouse operations, fulfilment processes, and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Influence without Direct Authority: Ability to drive change, accountability, and operational excellence in a partner-managed environment where you do not directly manage the floor staff. Adaptability & Resilience: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with a flexible, solution-oriented approach. Advantageous Qualifications & Experience Data analytics proficiency, e.g. SQL, Tableau, Power BI, or advanced Excel. Practical experience or certification in Lean, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement methodologies. Background or qualifications in FMCG, fresh food fulfilment, or food safety standards. What You Will Get In Return 70% off HelloFresh + free shipping Company Pension (matched 1:1 contributions up to 5%) Health insurance Annual Gym membership or Wellness benefit Membership to global leading mindfulness App - Headspace Work from home allowance of up to €300 For every year you are part of the team, you will earn one extra day off to celebrate your anniversary (up to 3 additional days) To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in Ireland, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company. If you are currently a HelloFresh employee, please make sure you have discussed your application with your Line Manager.

f0311763f50c0f6f65cf.description: Back to jobs Staff+ Software Engineer, Experimentation San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic's Infrastructure organization is foundational to our mission of developing AI systems that are reliable, interpretable, and steerable. The systems we build determine how quickly we can train new models, how reliably we can run safety experiments, and how effectively we can scale Claude to millions of users — demonstrating that safe, reliable infrastructure and frontier capabilities can go hand in hand. Developer Productivity owns the end-to-end experience of how engineers and researchers at Anthropic develop, build, test, and ship code at scale. This role focuses on the configuration and experimentation systems that let teams safely roll out changes, run controlled experiments, and make data-driven decisions across our products and infrastructure — from feature flagging and dynamic configuration to A/B testing platforms that support both research and production workloads. Responsibilities Own the technical strategy and roadmap for config and experimentation infrastructure, translating team-level goals into concrete execution plans and partnering with teams focused on deployment, testing, and more Maintain and enhance the architecture for feature flagging, dynamic configuration, and experimentation systems, ensuring the hardest problems get solved — whether by you directly or by working through others Design and build scalable, reliable distributed infrastructure and shared libraries that support high-volume experimentation and config workloads across all engineering teams Own and evolve the platforms and tooling that let engineers and researchers safely ship config changes, run experiments, and measure impact Define standards, tooling, and frameworks for experimentation and configuration management that drive developer productivity across research and production workloads You may be a good fit if you: Have deep experience with configuration management, feature flagging, and/or experimentation platforms in a large-scale environment Have strong proficiency in Python, Rust and/or Go Are obsessed with developer productivity and reducing friction in how teams configure, test, and ship changes Have experience with container orchestration and infrastructure at scale Have excellent communication skills and enjoy supporting internal partners to improve their development experience Are excited about designing foundational systems and are comfortable working independently on ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges Strong candidates may have: Have 15+ years (not including internships or co-ops) of experience in a Software Engineer role, building and operating large-scale developer infrastructure Have 3+ years (not including internships or co-ops) of experience leading large scale, complex projects or teams as an engineer or tech lead Experience with config or experimentation platforms such as Statsig, GrowthBook, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, Unleash, or similar (including building such systems in-house) Experience designing experimentation frameworks — randomization, assignment, metrics pipelines, and statistical analysis for A/B testing at scale Experience with dynamic configuration systems and safe rollout mechanisms (gradual rollouts, kill switches, targeting rules) Experience building CLI tools, developer-facing services, and APIs/automation workflows that integrate config and experimentation into existing CI/CD pipelines Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 - $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. The Server Programmability team is focused on programming velocity and safety in the core MongoDB Server. We own low-level libraries, runtimes, and tools that allow internal MongoDB developers to develop features in C++ and Rust quickly and safely.

We are an agile and small team looking for an experienced engineer to join us. We are looking for someone who is excited about operating systems, development tools, programming languages and low-level C++ libraries. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Candidate Profile

  • 3+ years of experience in Systems programming in C++ or other low-level programming languages
  • Hands-on experience with building production-level code. Experience in C++ is required
  • Passionate about delivering and deploying a product with cross-team stakeholders
  • Solid computer science fundamentals, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design/architecture
  • Passion for learning new things in the domains of software engineering, distributed systems, and performance
  • Solid verbal and written communication skills and highly motivated to collaborate with colleagues

Position Expectations

  • Understand and improve the current functionality of the MongoDB Server’s Programmability features
  • Lead medium sized projects related to the team’s charter
  • Collaborate with colleagues at all stages of project lifecycle (ideation, requirements gathering, design, execution, and delivery)
  • Own our leadership principles, and exemplify them in your work
  • Continue to learn and be curious in growing your career!
  • Write production-ready code in C++
  • Write unit tests and integration tests in C++, Javascript, and Python to demonstrate application correctness
  • Investigate the performance characteristics of the server and write performance regression tests
  • Interview candidates for software engineering positions
  • Handle customer escalations
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and engineering teams across the company to jointly work on large initiatives

Success Measures

  • In the first month, you will have understood the high level architecture of MongoDB and fixed a few bugs
  • In three months, you will have contributed to the development of a project slated for the next major release of MongoDB, and diagnosed and fixed a few customer or testing-reported issues
  • In six months, you will have taken on code review responsibilities and are involved in reviewing the design for new features
  • In twelve months, you will be leading the development of a new feature and helping to mentor new engineers on the team

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Our partner is looking for a DevOps Engineer | Live Entertainment Company based in Ireland. Join a technology team supporting large-scale live entertainment productions and high-traffic ticketing platforms across multiple European markets. As a DevOps Engineer, you will build, secure, and operate cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure, enabling reliable application delivery and seamless digital experiences. You will work with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and infrastructure as code to develop scalable, resilient, and secure platforms. Collaborating closely with platform leadership and product development teams, you will help modernize infrastructure and streamline deployment processes. Your work will span networking, automation, observability, security, and continuous delivery in a complex, business-critical environment. This is an opportunity to take ownership of essential cloud platforms while helping technology teams deliver dependable services in the fast-paced live entertainment industry. Accountabilities Build and maintain cloud infrastructure: Design, provision, and manage Microsoft Azure resources using Terraform, applying modular infrastructure-as-code practices and maintaining consistency across multiple environments. Manage Azure networking: Implement and operate secure hub-and-spoke network architectures, including virtual network peering, subnet design, IP address planning, and private connectivity between services. Operate Kubernetes platforms: Provision, maintain, and optimize Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters and production container workloads, including node pools, autoscaling, ingress controllers, and cluster upgrades. Develop CI/CD pipelines: Build and maintain automated delivery workflows using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps Pipelines to build container images, execute tests, publish artifacts, and deploy infrastructure and applications. Implement GitOps delivery: Support reliable, repeatable application deployments to Kubernetes through GitOps workflows and appropriate configuration management practices. Support application delivery: Help development teams build, containerize, deploy, and troubleshoot applications, particularly PHP and Node.js/React workloads, without requiring primary ownership of application development. Configure routing and edge security: Manage DNS, TLS certificates, ingress, and gateway or web application firewall configurations to ensure secure and reliable application access. Establish monitoring and observability: Implement centralized logging, metrics, dashboards, and proactive alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and related tools. Strengthen cloud security: Establish and maintain identity and access controls, Managed Identities, Azure RBAC, secrets management, and security policies across infrastructure and application environments. Improve operational reliability: Investigate incidents, troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues, identify operational risks, and implement improvements that enhance platform stability and performance. Contribute to technical architecture: Participate in architectural discussions, review technical proposals, document design decisions, maintain operational runbooks, and help establish engineering best practices. Enable developer productivity: Support local development environments, Dockerfiles, Docker Compose configurations, and shared debugging workflows to make application development and deployment more efficient. Requirements Professional experience: At least three years of experience in DevOps or platform engineering, including a minimum of two years supporting Microsoft Azure environments in production. Azure platform expertise: Strong understanding of Azure resource hierarchy, including Management Groups, Subscriptions, and Resource Groups, as well as resource naming and tagging conventions. Identity and access management: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Managed Identities, and secure access management. Core Azure services: Practical knowledge of Storage Accounts, Azure Key Vault, Azure Container Registry (ACR), and Log Analytics. Infrastructure as code: Strong Terraform skills, including modular code development, remote state management, multiple environments, and state locking. Scripting and operating systems: Working knowledge of Linux, Bash, PowerShell, and Git-based version control. Containerization: Experience building, optimizing, and troubleshooting Dockerfiles, along with managing local development environments using Docker Compose. Kubernetes and AKS: Production experience provisioning and operating AKS clusters, managing node pools and autoscaling, configuring ingress controllers, and performing cluster upgrades. Familiarity with Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Helm charts, and troubleshooting with kubectl is essential. Cloud networking: Understanding of hub-and-spoke topologies, virtual network peering, subnet architecture, CIDR planning, Network Security Groups, and NAT Gateways. Private connectivity: Hands-on experience securing Azure platform services through Private Endpoints, Private Link, and Azure Private DNS Zones. Secure administrative access: Familiarity with Azure Bastion and VPN Gateway configurations, including Site-to-Site and Point-to-Site connectivity. CI/CD automation: Experience implementing deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, including container image builds, testing, artifact publishing, and Terraform execution. Monitoring and troubleshooting: Knowledge of Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, basic Kusto Query Language (KQL), Application Insights, and alert configuration. Application delivery knowledge: Familiarity with deploying PHP and Node.js/React applications is a strong advantage, particularly in containerized environments. English proficiency: Upper-intermediate English or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively in technical discussions and cross-functional collaboration. Problem-solving and ownership: A proactive, analytical approach to troubleshooting, risk identification, continuous improvement, and operational reliability. Collaboration and communication: Ability to work effectively with platform engineers, developers, and technical stakeholders, document solutions clearly, and contribute to architectural decisions. The Following Skills And Qualifications Are Considered Advantageous Advanced networking: Experience with Azure Firewall, User-Defined Routes, forced tunneling, Application Security Groups, and Azure DNS Private Resolver. Edge and traffic management: Familiarity with Azure Front Door, Application Gateway, Cloudflare services, content delivery networks, web application firewalls, Zero Trust, and the Cloudflare Terraform Provider. Advanced Kubernetes and GitOps: Knowledge of Argo CD, Flux, Workload Identity, OIDC federation, Azure CNI Overlay, Cilium, Kubernetes Network Policies, cert-manager, external-dns, and KEDA. Security and governance: Experience with Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, container vulnerability scanning tools such as Trivy, and infrastructure-as-code security tools such as TFLint and Checkov. Additional Azure services: Exposure to Azure Container Apps, App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Database for PostgreSQL or MySQL Flexible Server, Azure Managed Redis, and Service Bus. Cloud architecture: Familiarity with Azure Landing Zones, the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Virtual WAN, and ExpressRoute. Relevant certifications: AZ-104, AZ-700, AZ-400, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate. Benefits Full-time, long-term opportunity: A stable engagement focused on building and operating essential cloud infrastructure. European working hours: Work within European time zones to collaborate effectively with distributed teams. Immediate start: An opportunity to join the team as soon as possible. Technical ownership: Take responsibility for production Azure platforms, Kubernetes infrastructure, networking, security, and deployment automation. Complex engineering challenges: Work with modern cloud technologies and high-traffic digital platforms in a demanding, business-critical environment. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with platform leadership and product development teams to improve infrastructure and application delivery. Professional development: Expand your expertise across Azure architecture, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, cloud security, and observability. Meaningful operational impact: Help ensure reliable digital services that support live entertainment productions and ticketing experiences across multiple countries. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic is growing quickly across EMEA, and we need recruiters who can help us hire exceptional people into the teams that keep the company running and bring our work to customers. We’re looking for a Recruiter to join our Talent team based in London to own full-cycle recruiting of our G&A functions (Policy, Finance, Legal, People, and related areas).

This is a full-cycle individual-contributor role for a strong recruiter who can run an excellent process end to end—sourcing, screening, managing stakeholders, and closing. You’ll partner with hiring managers across EMEA to understand what great looks like, build healthy pipelines, and deliver a candidate experience that reflects Anthropic’s values. You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift, and you’ll have real ownership over the roles you run.

We’re open to candidates whose strength is in G&A recruiting in your application, tell us where your experience is deepest across the functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of G&A roles across EMEA—from intake through offer and close

  • Partner with hiring managers to scope roles, calibrate the bar, and build effective sourcing strategies

  • Source and engage high-quality active and passive candidates, building diverse and competitive pipelines

  • Run structured, rigorous, and candidate-centric interview processes that uphold Anthropic’s hiring bar

  • Manage candidates through the process with clear communication and a great experience at every stage

  • Collaborate with the broader Talent team, People Partners, and Compensation to structure offers and guide candidates to close

  • Use data to track pipeline health and share insight that helps hiring managers make good decisions

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in G&A (Policy, Finance, Legal, People) with a focus on Policy hiring

  • Demonstrated ability to recruit in the UK and European market, with familiarity with local talent dynamics and employment norms

  • Track record of strong stakeholder partnership — building trust quickly with hiring managers in fast-moving environments

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity: willing to flex between functions and contribute to building something new rather than running an established playbook

  • Proven ability to maintain quality under volume pressure — owns pipeline health, not just pipeline size

  • Self-starter who can work with significant autonomy while staying tightly aligned with global strategy

  • Genuine connection to Anthropic's mission and an understanding of why it matters in a recruiting context

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience recruiting at a high-growth technology, AI, or machine learning company

  • Experience recruiting across both G&A and GTM functions

  • Experience hiring across multiple EMEA markets, including the UK and Ireland

  • Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms

  • Additional European language skills relevant to hiring across the region

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
£105,000—£145,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. f0ee5cf991dd92021e00.description: We currently have an exciting opening within our Client Experience and Product Development team for a Client Experience and Product Analyst. The Client Experience function at Mediolanum plays a key role in understanding how clients experience our products and then translating this into meaningful business insights, reporting and action. Working across multiple business areas, the role of a Client Experience Analyst combines commercial thinking, technical expertise and stakeholder engagement to support client outcomes, product development and strategic decision making. The successful candidate will work across the full product lifecycle, from initial concepts and product development through to ongoing monitoring, client outcome assessment and management reporting. You will gain exposure to Product, Investments, Finance, Operations, Risk and IT, while building strong relationships across the business and contributing to projects that have a direct impact on clients and business performance. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to accelerate their career through broad exposure to senior stakeholders, cross-functional projects and high-profile reporting. The role offers the chance to own key management information, develop innovative analytical solutions, influence business decisions and help shape the future use of data, automation and AI within the organisation. Duties and responsibilities will include, but not limited to the following: Improve the client experience by understanding client needs, behaviours and pain points, and translating these into practical improvements, insights, tools and solutions. Develop client, product and commercial insights, turning complex data into clear narratives, meaningful KPIs and actionable recommendations that support decision-making. Design, build and maintain dashboards, analytical tools and reporting solutions, combining business knowledge with technical expertise to deliver scalable and accessible solutions. Develop expertise in client performance, client reporting and outcome metrics, supporting business, product, governance and regulatory requirements. Own key management and client reporting, including reports presented to internal committees and information provided as part of Board reporting, ensuring outputs are accurate, clear and appropriate for the audience. Support activities across the product lifecycle, from product development through to ongoing product management, using data and analysis to support product and client outcomes. Work with IT and data owners to support data quality, validation, governance and automation, including transitioning manual processes towards more robust and scalable solutions. Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Product, Investments, Finance, Operations, IT and Risk, working collaboratively across the business to support shared objectives and deliver effective outcomes. Take ownership of projects and analytical workstreams from problem definition and requirements gathering through to delivery and implementation, independently managing priorities, milestones and timelines. Maintain a strong understanding of financial markets, investment products and emerging technologies, proactively identifying opportunities to use data, automation and AI to improve client outcomes and business processes. Skills and Competencies: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, together with a commercial mindset and the ability to turn complex analysis into clear insights and recommendations. Demonstrable technical capability across databases, SQL, Python or other relevant programming languages, and data visualisation tools. Strong stakeholder and project management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and communicate confidently with senior stakeholders. The ability to work autonomously and proactively, take ownership of work and independently manage multiple priorities through to completion. Excellent attention to detail, with a strong focus on data accuracy and the quality of analysis and reporting. Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly to different audiences. Qualifications and Experience: A relevant third-level qualification in finance, economics, computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, data analytics or a related discipline. A postgraduate or relevant professional qualification would be an advantage. A demonstrable interest in financial markets, investment products and client outcomes, with a focus on delivering high-quality products and experiences for clients. A strong combination of commercial, analytical and technical capability, with the ability to understand business problems and translate them into practical data-led solutions. Experience with modern data and cloud technologies. Experience with Snowflake would be a distinct advantage. An understanding of AI technologies and their practical application to analytics, automation and business processes. Experience with AI tools, APIs or endpoints, or AI-assisted development would be an advantage.

As a Research Analyst, you will join the team dedicated to  Scout , our premier platform for alternative data discovery. You will be largely interacting with:    Data buyers, by communicating our findings via research reports and calls, and    Data sellers, to understand their properties and potential use cases of different datasets    Your work will centre on translating complex, non-traditional datasets into actionable intelligence in a highly collaborative and inquisitive role that requires a blend of analytical thinking and clear, authoritative communication. f2529bf4d2926054db8d.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic is building the Forward Deployed Engineering team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Technical Deployment Leads (TDLs) and Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) embed with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. Our delivery model pairs two roles: FDEs own the technical artifact, and TDLs own the engagement end-to-end — from statement of work (SOW) through production deployment.

As a Manager of Technical Deployment for Financial Services, you own engagement portfolio health across your vertical. You set the bar for delivery quality and build the playbooks and evaluation frameworks that let the practice scale. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation across the Fortune 100.

This is a player-coach role. You need to be credible in architecture conversations with a customer's engineering leads and equally comfortable in sales conversations in front of executive sponsors, and you will lead the most complex engagements yourself when the stakes call for it. Most of your impact will come through the people you hire and the standard you hold them to. You won't write production code, but you will pressure-test the technical decisions your TDL team makes with FDEs.

Responsibilities

  • Hire, develop, and retain a team of TDLs embedded in Financial Services engagements. Set a high bar for delivery judgment, technical fluency, and customer presence, and run the interviews that hold it.
  • Manage each TDL directly: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, direct feedback, and a growth plan. Build a bench that runs engagements well without you in the room.
  • Own portfolio health across the vertical. Track which engagements are on track, at risk, or closing out, and intervene early when delivery drifts. Run engagement quality reviews with your team.
  • Own customer outcomes across the portfolio. Hold the executive relationship with customer sponsors, run steering committees, and represent Anthropic's credibility with senior business, risk, and engineering leaders.
  • Make the staffing call for each engagement. Work with FDE managers to match TDLs and engineers to each customer, and adjust as scope changes.
  • Lead the most complex engagements yourself. Take the TDL seat when engagement size, regulatory exposure, or organizational complexity calls for it, from delivery plan through production.
  • Set the bar for delivery excellence — SOW quality, MVP scoping, and value measurement. Ensure every engagement has a defensible impact story.
  • Codify reusable solution patterns, evaluation frameworks, and technical playbooks across the team. Turn what works in the field into delivery infrastructure that lets the practice scale.
  • Partner with Sales to qualify engagements, shape scope, and inform SOWs. Partner with Marketing and Sales on Financial Services–specific go-to-market materials, reference cases, and positioning.
  • Run the team's operating rhythm: engagement reviews, knowledge-sharing, and escalation support, and report into the wider post-sales cadence and dashboards. Set team goals tied to customer outcomes.
  • Bring the field back to Anthropic. Surface delivery lessons and emerging Financial Services use cases to Product and Research, and represent the vertical in leadership discussions.
  • Consistently uphold Anthropic's values as you lead your team. TDLs should be strong representatives of Anthropic's culture as they work within customer environments.
  • Travel to customer sites (25–50% expected). 

You May Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have 8+ years leading enterprise AI/ML delivery, whether you came up as a founder, engineer, data scientist, or researcher who has moved into deployments, with at least 3 years directly managing people who owned delivery outcomes.
  • Have a track record of building and leading technical delivery teams in enterprise environments, ideally including embedded or forward-deployed teams working at client sites.
  • Have delivered AI, ML, or LLM-based agentic solutions into production. You understand solution patterns, integration approaches, and what breaks in real environments.
  • Bring depth in Financial Services. You have delivered technology programs inside banks, insurers, or asset managers, you understand how model risk, security, and compliance review shape what ships, and you can speak credibly with a CIO, a chief risk officer, and a head of engineering.
  • Can navigate architecture discussions with engineering stakeholders, evaluate technical trade-offs, and judge whether a proposed agent design is realistic. You are accountable for the technical direction your team sets alongside FDEs.
  • Have experience with value-based scoping, including TCO/ROI quantification and post-deployment impact measurement.
  • Thrive in ambiguity and bring structure where none exists. You have built a team, practice, or function from an early stage.
  • Have executive presence: polished, credible, and concise with senior leaders in high-stakes settings, and just as effective in a hands-on engagement review with your team.
  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$240,000—$450,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. The Safeguards team is at the forefront of protecting our users from the risks of powerful AIs as well as ethical, technical, and social risks from the use of generative AI. The Safeguards team at Anthropic builds protections for new AI features enabled by the research teams and protects new products and surfaces developed by our product teams. As a Product Manager for the Safeguards team at Anthropic, you will own the ideation, design, development and deployment of Safeguards systems and relevant product UX to ensure we are advancing frontier models safely to users across various cloud platforms. You will work closely with our research and product teams to develop detections, evals, interventions, and tools to measure and mitigate deployment and user risks. 

We are looking for a product manager who is deeply committed to making AI safe and beneficial for humanity.  You are aware of the risks and are committed to working with experts and coming up with ideas for Anthropic to implement. You have deep technical expertise in development, deployment and measurement of Safeguards systems. You thrive in rapidly moving and ambiguous environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Determine how to build in safety by design upstream and leverage downstream defenses for Anthropic’s frontier models, AI products, customers on different surfaces - Claude.ai, 1P API, external Cloud providers. 
  • Ability to write safety evals and communicate externally about safety. 
  • Drive impact via ruthless prioritization by clearly defining problems, solution options forward, clarity on both business & technical tradeoffs and accordingly clear requirements toward MVP vs. ideal state.
  • Align & collaborate with policy, enforcement, research, engineering and cross functional stakeholders. 
  • Understand the AI landscape and ecosystem to plan for mitigation of deployment risks of increasingly powerful models and determined adversaries.
  • Lead the development of metrics to understand the area, performance, blindspots to help inform future project planning.

  • Ability to make technical tradeoff decisions; ideally with experience working across policy experts, AI/ML research engineers and software engineering teams to design and build state of the art safety systems. 
  • Strong user understanding of how our products are used, their Safeguards concerns and how we provide the best solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to build product and engineering strategy across multiple cross-functional teams for a rapidly changing space.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing and building metrics to evaluate risks, system performance, user impact and making crisp tradeoffs
  • Very strong ability to navigate, and prioritize amidst rapidly changing product specs, and to flex into different domains to bring clarity and execute. 
  • Evidence of exercising judgment and decision making in ambiguous situations.
  • Planning, building, launching and measuring new products / systems in a zero to one environment.
  • Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences in written and verbal communication.
  • Think creatively about the risks and benefits of new technologies, and think beyond past checklists and playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years in product management with a focus on fast problem understanding, building roadmaps with tractable progress, ability to get into the details on data, detection & interventions, infrastructure & tools, and/or evals.
