f308745887857648f6cc.description: Company Overview KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. Position Summary KKR is seeking a strong investment professional to join the Client Reporting Team. The Client Reporting Team is responsible for providing fund and strategy support to KKR’s existing clients whilst also assisting with new business pitches for prospective clients. Our goal is to provide a best-in-class client experience through high quality fund performance reporting and data analytics. Based in the Dublin office, this new role is a unique opportunity to become part of a growing and strategic team. The successful candidate will help grow our Real Assets asset class vertical and shape it for future growth. The role is a mix of data analysis and fund performance reporting and will also involve liaising with Senior Portfolio Managers to ensure the client materials we send externally are to a very high standard. Ideal Experience A successful candidate typically will have 2+ years of experience from a consulting or fund performance background with strong analytical skills. Experience in investment banking, corporate finance or transaction services, sales and trading, or capital markets will also be considered. Ideally, the candidate will also have a strong understanding of real asset markets and investment dynamics. Responsibilities Provide fund and strategy support to existing clients. Strong collaboration with Product Teams to understand each strategy and fund, to provide relevant high-quality data to clients. Source all performance data, at asset, fund, and investor level; analyse and review performance information received using appropriate data tools. Monitor pipeline of new investments and funds to ensure all data is captured and included in reporting. Strong collaboration with Investment Deal Teams to understand the nuance of each investment. Produce investment presentations for client meetings and marketing material for new fund launches, as required. Collaborate with various internal divisions to answer client requests (Product Teams, Investment Deal Teams and Portfolio Managers, Operations, Finance, Legal/Compliance, and Risk). Prepare ad-hoc reports and analyse data as required to assist with investor queries or internal projects. Help develop methods of automation to drive efficiencies within the team and improve data quality. CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS Strong IT and Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to consistently deliver high quality work on time; attention to detail and accuracy are fundamental skills. Aptitude for critical and creative thinking across the quantitative and qualitative spectrum, including strong data analysis skills and the ability to clearly communicate insights from data. Proven ability to manage demands of multiple teams and projects in a fast-paced work environment, including the ability to prioritise time efficiently and handle heavy workloads while maintaining consistent attention to detail. Bias for action; enthusiastic, quick learner with strong intellectual curiosity and self-motivation. Good verbal and written communication skills; strong relationship development skills; comfortable working with different teams globally. Team player; able to fit seamlessly into a team of senior and junior professionals all focused on delivering work of exceptional quality. Understanding of and strong interest in financial markets and the practical issues related to private markets a plus. KKR is an equal opportunity employer. f33e1d7dd17c1e021f39.description: The Mechanical Project Manager leads on-site delivery of mechanical packages on Sensori projects. The role owns planning, execution, safety, quality, cost control, subcontractor coordination and final handover, working closely with programme management, engineering, operations and supply-chain partners. It requires strong practical knowledge of mechanical systems, a firm grip on commercial performance and the ability to keep a live site productive while maintaining Sensori's standards. Principal duties and responsibilities Manage design review, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning and handover of mechanical systems for assigned projects. Oversee interfaces between mechanical and electrical scopes; review designs with engineering and client teams to ensure constructability and alignment with site works. Coordinate daily site activity, resolve issues, deploy labour and plant efficiently and maintain productivity. Develop and maintain the site programme in line with the project plan, engineering milestones and client requirements; monitor the critical path and reallocate resources to protect targets. Control all costs within scope, including Sensori mechanical teams, subcontractors, materials, plant, variations and valuations; issue weekly cost reports. Work with the Project Manager, Operations Manager and EHS lead to create, maintain and close the project safety file; ensure statutory compliance and a strong QHSE culture. Set up, maintain and close site QA documentation with the QA lead; enforce quality standards across teams and subcontractors. Manage subcontractor activity, track progress and manpower, chair and minute weekly coordination meetings and ensure subcontractor documentation is current. Produce internal weekly roll-ups (percent complete by WBS, risks, KPIs) and external progress reports; maintain a photographic diary and track material deliveries. Submit direct labour and subcontractor hours for central tracking. Maintain strong client relationships; attend site meetings, project reviews, engineering reviews, planning sessions and handover meetings. Manage change for cost and programme impact; prepare valuations and variation documentation. Deliver the final account, O&M manuals, punch-list completion, safety and QA files and final project documentation with the project team. Selection criteria / person specification Trade qualification and/or relevant third-level engineering or technical qualification. At least five years' project management experience delivering medium-to-large mechanical installation projects; eight or more years for senior appointments. Strong practical understanding of mechanical systems and a good working knowledge of electrical interfaces on site. Experience with integrated design-and-build delivery models and with managing workforce relations on site. Demonstrable knowledge of site health and safety practice and statutory compliance. Proficient with scheduling tools, project reporting systems and standard office software. Clear, concise communicator able to lead meetings, write reports and liaise with clients and stakeholders. Strong commercial awareness across cost control, valuations and variations. Proven ability to meet tight deadlines, manage competing priorities on live sites and drive large-scale programmes to completion; additional European languages are an advantage.

f406f901f7ea437f7c45.description: About Millennium Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors. Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact. Meet the Team The Execution Services team supports trading across products and geographies, with a focus on execution quality, trading efficiency, and the tools that help portfolio managers make informed decisions. Within this group, Central Liquidity Strategies develops and operates trading capabilities that support internal liquidity solutions across the platform. The team works across quantitative research, platform engineering, and production systems to build the compute, storage, and model infrastructure that supports research and live trading. automation, and CI/CD workflows Partner with team members on the direction, design, and architecture of the platform Collaborate closely with researchers and platform engineers to align compute and storage capabilities across the environment What You Bring 6+ years of Python and distributed systems experience in a quantitative finance environment, with a strong track record of building platform abstractions used by others in production Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field Deep working knowledge of one or more distributed compute frameworks such as Ray, Dask, Spark, PySpark, or Slurm, with a clear understanding of their tradeoffs Hands-on experience implementing machine learning and deep learning workflows f41a9707111bd188c9d0.description: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. About The Role Are you passionate about protecting digital assets and eager to launch your career in the world of cybersecurity? Join our team at McKesson, a leading organization in the healthcare industry, where cybersecurity plays a critical role in safeguarding sensitive information and ensuring operational resilience. As an Associate Cybersecurity Engineer, you will serve as a contributing member of McKesson's cybersecurity organization from your first day of employment. Through a structured 24-month rotational program, you will apply your technical skills to solve real business challenges, deliver meaningful cybersecurity outcomes, and gain experience across multiple cybersecurity disciplines. What You’ll Do: Analyze security events, vulnerabilities, and threat intelligence to assess risk and develop recommendations for mitigation and continuous improvement. Evaluate cybersecurity controls, policies, and procedures and contribute to initiatives that enhance enterprise security capabilities. Participate in incident investigations, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews to strengthen organizational resilience. Design, develop, or enhance security automation solutions using scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or JavaScript. Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to identify security risks and implement effective controls. Integrate security best practices throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and support security tooling within CI/CD environments. Analyze identity and access management processes and contribute to the design and improvement of access governance and security controls. Participate in strategic projects across multiple cybersecurity domains, gaining exposure to enterprise security operations, engineering, governance, risk management, and emerging technologies. Own and deliver assigned cybersecurity objectives, work products, and recommendations with guidance from experienced cybersecurity professionals while demonstrating increasing independence throughout the program. What We’re Looking For: A recent graduate within the last 12 months with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical information, identify risks, and develop practical recommendations to address cybersecurity challenges. Ability to exercise sound judgment, manage multiple priorities, and work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams. Preferred certifications: CompTIA Security+ or equivalent. Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, JavaScript, PowerShell, or similar technologies. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Ability to work onsite 2–3 days per week at the assigned McKesson location. Why Join the Cyber Academy? Engage in a program specifically designed for early career talent, providing a supportive environment for new college hires and interns. Contribute to enterprise-scale cybersecurity initiatives that protect critical healthcare systems, applications, and data. Benefit from comprehensive training resources and mentorship opportunities. Network with professionals and peers in the cybersecurity field. Experience a company culture that values diversity, innovation, and teamwork. Join us in our mission to fortify our digital landscape and protect our assets. Apply today to embark on an exciting journey in cybersecurity with McKesson through our Cyber Academy, where your career potential can truly flourish. At McKesson, we care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse employee population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. Our Base Pay Range for this position €34,100 - €56,900 McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind: McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application. McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates. McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: careers.mckesson.com.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Product Manager for the Research team at Anthropic, you will own the ideation and deployment of new models and products as we advance frontier, safe AI technology. You will work closely with our research teams to help productize credible applied research and identify high-potential use cases grounded in customer needs. We are looking for someone passionate about developing safe and beneficial artificial intelligence technologies. You thrive in ambiguous environments and can uncover latent, non-obvious use cases for nascent technologies, bringing these insights back to research. Your curiosity about user needs enables you to connect advanced technology to products that deliver real-world value.

We seek experienced founders and product managers who can bridge research and ambitious product experimentation, with the ability to create and grow entirely new product categories enabled by AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution of frontier technologies that leverage the latest AI capabilities to solve real-world problems
  • Partner with research to define, improve, and ship model capabilities within a research area
  • Identify nascent research that could become transformative products
  • Synthesize user insights into actionable requirements and evaluations
  • Understand the AI landscape and ecosystem, ensuring we have an objective view of market capabilities and our position
  • Work with and influence a diverse set of stakeholders, including research, product engineering, and platform engineering teams

Minimum Qualifications

You might be a good fit if you:

  • Have a deep passion and curiosity for AI and LLMs. Use AI regularly. 
  • Are a first-principles thinker with the ability to navigate and execute amidst ambiguity, flexing into different domains based on the business problem at hand and finding simple, easy-to-understand solutions
  • Possess a deep technical background with a strong grasp of AI/ML concepts and are willing to go deep on technical solutions; have a data-driven mindset with working proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Have strong user empathy and the ability to synthesize vague or contradictory feedback into actionable priorities
  • Have a track record of launching ambitious products that have achieved distribution or commercial success
  • Have intellectual curiosity without ego—comfortable asking questions and learning independently
  • Think creatively about the risks and benefits of new technologies, moving beyond past checklists and playbooks
  • Have a creative, hacker spirit and love solving puzzles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Have 5+ years in product management, with experience launching new products and scaling existing ones (founder background is a plus)

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$305,000—$385,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. About the role Procurement Operations is the front door for buying at Anthropic. We sit inside Finance Operations and own the path from “I need to buy something” to a signed agreement, an accurate purchase order, and clean spend data at month end. We are hiring a Procurement Operations Business Partner to own that path for our technology spend: business applications, SaaS tools, cloud and infrastructure services, and the engineering and developer tools our teams build with. This portfolio is software heavy: new tools evaluated and onboarded regularly, licenses that renew on their own schedule, and vendors billed on seats, usage, or tiered subscription terms rather than a single invoice. You will be the person who makes buying software feel simple to the teams who depend on it and reliable to the Finance stakeholders behind it. This is a high-volume role with an accounting core. You ensure every software purchase in your portfolio is coded, dated, received, and accrued correctly, so spend is right in the books every month. Expect a steady queue of new tool requests, renewals, and license changes, and expect to be the person Accounting trusts on all of it. We use Claude as part of our daily workflow and are looking for someone who wants to help define what an AI-native procurement operations function looks like, including how AI changes intake, contract and security review, vendor coordination, and requester support. Responsibilities Own the purchasing process Manage a high volume of purchase requests, renewals, and license changes each month across the organization, keeping speed and accuracy high at the same time. Serve as the primary procurement partner for the teams buying in your categories, guiding requesters from initial request to signed agreement and issued purchase order. Review every purchase request in your portfolio for the things that matter downstream: the right vendor record and contracting entity, complete commercial documents, correct spend categorization and service dates, and the approvals the purchase actually needs. Determine what else each request requires before it can move, whether that is an order form, a data privacy review, or a third party risk assessment, and route it to the right reviewers the first time. Partner with Security to run a vendor security review on every new tool and at every renewal, and hold the line that nothing goes live without one. Launch and track contract review with Legal, keep it moving, and confirm the executed agreement supports the purchase order before it is issued. Structure purchase orders so they match how the vendor bills (seat-based, usage-based, tiered subscription, or flat annual fee) and how Accounting needs to see the spend, with the right GL account, cost center, and service period on every line. Manage renewals, true ups, and seat count changes over the life of each agreement. Track license counts and renewal dates across your portfolio so nothing auto-renews or lapses by surprise, and flag underused or overlapping tools to budget owners ahead of the next renewal cycle. Financial completeness and accuracy Code every purchase order correctly at creation, including GL account, spend category, cost center, and service period, and understand how each choice lands in the financials (expense versus prepaid, annual versus monthly recognition). Work the hard cases with Accounting: multi year subscriptions paid upfront, mid term seat additions, true ups, credits, and contracts amended mid cycle. Own the open purchase order book: receipts recorded against actual delivery, periodic reviews, stale line cleanup, coding corrections, and timely closures, so PO, receipt, and invoice agree. Serve as the first line reviewer for month-end accruals on your portfolio, gathering estimates from vendors and budget owners for variable spend and confirming or correcting proposed amounts so Accounting can close on time. Partner with Accounts Payable to resolve invoice holds, PO mismatches, and receiving questions so vendors are paid on time and spend lands where it belongs. Support audit and reporting requests that touch your portfolio, including commitment schedules and control evidence, with data you can stand behind. Be the front door Be visible and responsive in your teams' Slack channels and office hours; answer routine purchasing questions quickly and escalate real blockers with context. Apply purchasing policy consistently and explain the why, including approval thresholds, signature authority, and when an exception is and is not available. Translate procurement, legal, security, and finance requirements into plain language for engineers, IT, and business stakeholders, and carry their operating reality back to those teams so controls fit the work. Keep a regular check in with your highest volume teams so upcoming purchases and renewals are visible early and nothing urgent arrives as a surprise. Continuous improvement Maintain the playbooks, intake guidance, and standard operating procedures for your portfolio so the path is repeatable and does not live in one person's head. Identify manual steps, repeat questions, and failure points and fix them, including where Claude and workflow automation with AI can take work off requesters and the team. Minimum qualifications Proven track record of owning a high-volume purchasing portfolio end-to-end in a procure-to-pay and intake platform. Solid working knowledge of accrual accounting as it applies to purchasing: accruals and reversals, service period and cutoff, prepaid versus expense, and GL and cost center coding. You can explain how a purchase order becomes an entry in the general ledger. Experience buying and managing software or SaaS at scale, including seat-based, usage-based, and tiered subscription billing models. Experience owning the tool and vendor lifecycle end to end, from intake through security review, contracting, renewal, and sunset, with the judgment to know when to push a request through and when to slow it down. Preferred qualifications 7+ years of procurement operations, purchasing, or vendor operations, including time supporting IT, engineering, or business systems teams. Background in accounting, accounts payable, or a month-end close process. Direct experience with Zip, Workday Financials, and Ironclad. Prior ownership of month-end accrual review or open PO reconciliation for a large, variable spend portfolio. Experience with software asset management or license optimization, including identifying underused or redundant tools. f4b4189244cc3ef188ff.description: Application Closing Date: 30th October 2026 - Please note we reserve the right to close roles sooner, so Early Application is encouraged. Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. Role description: Our two-year Graduate GROW Programme supports your transition from student to professional, sitting along client work and real projects from day one. Each graduate’s journey is unique, shaped by their chosen specialism and the variety of projects they contribute to. You will build your technical expertise by contributing to meaningful client engagements and project work, whilst business acumen and professional skills will be developed through centrally delivered graduate cohort training. Although there are no formal rotations, graduates are encouraged and supported by their managers to proactively seek opportunities, to broaden their experience and support their development. As an engineer joining GROW, you will be given the opportunity to specialise within your chosen discipline of engineering and we ensure you obtain the appropriate experiences that you need to become a technical expert. Being an Engineer at Arcadis is about applying a human filter to all your technical expertise and training, and making an impact through innovation and creativity. During this two-year programme you will develop core engineering and consulting techniques that can be applied while working with our clients in the UK&I and potentially even some of our international clients around the globe. Role accountabilities: Our Instrument and Controls Engineers work within the life sciences, semiconductor, and other high-tech industries across Ireland and Europe. We thrive on partnering with our clients to deliver best-in-class approaches and innovative solutions powered by strong relationships, so vital drugs, therapies, and products get to market with speed, cost-effectiveness, and safety. As a Graduate Instrumentation and Control (I&C) Engineer, you will support the design, implementation, and maintenance of systems that monitor and control manufacturing processes in pharmaceutical and life sciences facilities. Working under the guidance of experienced engineers, you will help ensure safe, efficient, and compliant operations, contributing to the delivery of high-quality healthcare products. You will work primarily within the Engineer & Design sector, taking projects from Front End Design through to Detail Design and handover to clients, ensuring safety, regulatory compliance (like GMP, FDA), process optimization, product quality, and efficiency. You will gain a variation of work, experience, and challenges within the industry and partner with senior engineers. Accepted degrees: Instrument Engineering, Applied Physics & Instrumentation, Mechatronics Qualifications & Experience: You will be graduating in 2027 or have recently graduated in 2025 or 2026, with at least a 2:2 in a relevant master's or bachelor's degree You will demonstrate typical Arcadian skills including Resilience, Creativity, Analytical Thinking and being a Team Player You will have excellent communication skills and the ability to use your technical knowledge to influence and consult stakeholders. Willing to travel and stay away from home when required (where possible we embrace virtual working) Why Arcadis? We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together. You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together, we can create a lasting legacy. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race. A diverse and skilled workforce is essential to our success. #EarlycareersUK&I #GraduateUK&I #EarlyCareersIreland #GraduateEngineering

f521d87b04592a5c00c6.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. The role / impact As an Internal AI Engineer at ElevenLabs, you'll be embedded at the frontier of how we scale - acting as a forward-deployed engineer across our GTM, Operations, and Finance teams. You won't just build tools; you'll co-design and ship agentic AI workflows that eliminate manual toil and fundamentally reshape how our people operate. Your impact goes beyond the code. You'll own high-stakes automations from discovery to production, acting as a technical partner to internal teams. The patterns, guardrails, and tooling you define will become the blueprint other teams reach for - the standard for how ElevenLabs harnesses AI safely and at speed. The Team / How We Work You'll join a lean, high-velocity team with a shared obsession: turning broken, manual processes into elegant automated systems. We move fast through rapid experimentation, work closely with operators and business owners to uncover the real problem, and ship pragmatic solutions without waiting for perfect specs. What You'll Actually Be Working On Designing and iterating on AI agents and workflow orchestrations using tools like ElevenAgents, Claude, and n8n. Integrating AI systems with our core business stack - Salesforce, Slack, Ashby, and more Building reusable automation services, patterns and shared templates that multiply the output of every team you touch Owning experiments end-to-end: spotting the opportunity, building the solution, and measuring the impact Developing evaluation and monitoring frameworks so our AI-native workflows are reliable, auditable, and safe What we're looking for Proven experience building and shipping automations or applications in production - you know what it takes to go from fuzzy business pain to something real teams depend on AI-First Instincts: Strong familiarity with LLM capabilities, prompting strategies, RAG patterns, and a genuine passion for building agentic workflows. Deep Backend Expertise : Strong Python and SQL and system design patterns (APIs, webhooks, orchestration layers) A systems-thinking mindset : you design with security, auditability, and blast radius in mind from the start Builder and AI-First instincts: you don't wait to be told what to build - you spot the pattern, propose the fix, and ship it. Infra & DevOps Instincts: Hands-on experience operating cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), Kubernetes, Docker, and enterprise authentication flows Location This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. Specific teams may have specific location preferences. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

f54f2b85c4c687706ced.description: A GLOBAL LEADING ASSET MANAGER WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential Financial Inc. (PFI), we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers! If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can! What You Can Expect The People Services & Solutions team supports critical HR operations across payroll, HR systems, data management, and shared services. Within this organization, the Specialist, People Data Operations will play a hands-on role in executing Workday HCM data processes, supporting mass data loads, validating data accuracy, resolving operational issues, and helping ensure people data is processed correctly and on time. This role operates in a hybrid delivery model that includes internal teams and third-party providers. The specialist will partner closely with Global People Services, Compensation, Talent & Learning, HR Technology, and external vendors to coordinate load activity, validate results, troubleshoot issues, document processes, and support consistent execution across a complex HR data environment. Location: This role will be hybrid, 2 days a week in the Letterkenny office . What You Will Do Execute and coordinate Workday mass data loads, including template preparation, validation, error review, troubleshooting, and follow-through to completion. Support complex HR data processes, including compensation-related activities, by coordinating inputs, reviewing dependencies, validating data, and resolving issues with the appropriate teams. Partner with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors to confirm load readiness, review validation results, escalate blockers, and ensure operational timelines are met. Identify data issues, process gaps, and recurring errors; work with partners to correct root causes and reduce repeat manual effort. Maintain clear process documentation, checklists, and operating procedures to support consistency, auditability, and knowledge sharing across the team. Manage multiple operational priorities with attention to accuracy, urgency, risk, and downstream impact. What You Will Bring Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday HCM, including data processing, data validation, reporting, or operational support. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, quality control, and timely execution. Ability to troubleshoot data issues, identify patterns, escalate risks, and drive issues to resolution. Proven ability to coordinate across business, technology, and vendor teams in a deadline-driven environment. Strong Excel and data management skills, with comfort reviewing large data sets, comparing outputs, and identifying discrepancies. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document processes, summarize issues, and provide status updates. Execution-focused mindset with the ability to manage competing priorities, follow through on commitments, and operate with sound judgment. What Will Set You Apart Hands-on Workday HCM data load experience. Experience supporting compensation-related HR data processes. Ability to improve recurring processes through documentation, checklists, root-cause analysis, and stakeholder coordination. Comfort operating in a hybrid delivery model with internal teams and third-party providers. PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. What We Offer You Health Insurance: PGIM Ireland partner with Laya and BUPA to provide health insurance schemes that cover eligible employees day to day medical and hospital expenses. Annual Leave of 23 days at full pay. Pension Scheme: Members of the scheme can contribute up to 8% of salary per annum and PGIM Ireland matches contributions up to 8% of salary. Members can also make voluntary contributions to the scheme. Annual Bonus Programme & Shop LK Vouchers / CleverCards (subject to eligibility): Along with an annual bonus employees are rewarded with Shop LK Vouchers/ CleverCards which are paid tax free. Life Assurance: fully paid by PGIM Ireland, employees are covered from their start date and beneficiaries are provided with a lump sum of four times an employee’s salary. Education Assistance: PGIM Ireland have an Education Assistance Programme that reimburses eligible employees for furthering their education. Prudential Financial, Inc. (PFI) of the United States is not affiliated in any manner with Prudential plc, incorporated in the United Kingdom, or with Prudential Assurance Company, a subsidiary of M&G plc, incorporated in the United Kingdom. PGIM Ireland is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of applicants’ gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, race or membership of the traveler community. PGIM Ireland's aim is to hire the best people for the open roles and all appointments will be made on merit. Any offer of employment made by PGIM Ireland will be contingent on receiving satisfactory references. Applicants should be aware that background checks will be carried out on all candidates offered a position within PGIM Ireland.

f5d3adaf6989ed7a4704.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're seeking a business development lead to own Anthropic's BD partnership footprint with a small number of the world's largest and most consequential technology companies. These are not single-threaded accounts. Each relationship spans many businesses at once — consumer products, devices and operating systems, productivity and collaboration software, cloud and developer platforms, commerce, and enterprise distribution. Your job is to see the whole board, decide where Anthropic should lean in and where it shouldn't, and turn that judgment into signed deals.

The center of gravity for this role is product and distribution partnerships: co-developing opportunities with partners, and structuring the commercial, technical, and go-to-market terms that make those partnerships durable. You'll typically be running several deal streams inside the same partner in parallel — at different stages, with different counterparts, and with terms that interact with one another — and you'll be the person responsible for keeping them coherent.

This is an individual contributor role for a seasoned dealmaker who is comfortable as the primary counterpart to senior executives at very large companies, who brings strong judgment to ambiguous, high-stakes situations, and who can carry a complex, multi-party negotiation from first conversation through signature and into execution.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage a small number of large, multi-faceted partner relationships end to end: set the strategy for each relationship, decide which opportunities to pursue and in what order, and stay accountable for the overall health and commercial output of the partnership across every surface it touches
  • Lead product partnerships: identify and structure opportunities to embed Claude in partners' consumer and enterprise products, co-develop new products and features, and define the product, technical, data, and brand terms that come with them, working closely with Anthropic's product and engineering leaders
  • Run multiple deal streams in parallel: manage several concurrent negotiations within the same partner — product integrations, distribution and go-to-market, commercial and consumption agreements, and infrastructure — and sequence and connect them so terms in one stream reinforce rather than undercut the others
  • Negotiate complex, first-of-kind agreements: lead end-to-end negotiations involving novel commercial structures, revenue and economics sharing, product and roadmap commitments, exclusivity and competitive provisions, data terms, and multi-year, multi-component value exchanges
  • Act as an executive counterpart: build and manage relationships with senior executives and their teams on the partner side, serve as Anthropic's primary voice into the partnership, and prepare and steer Anthropic's own executives through partner-level engagements
  • Exercise judgment on behalf of Anthropic: weigh commercial upside against strategic, competitive, product, and mission considerations; know when to say no; and make clear, well-reasoned recommendations to Anthropic leadership on trade-offs that don't have a playbook
  • Drive cross-functional execution: coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Policy across the life of a partnership, from initial structuring through negotiation, launch, and ongoing governance, ensuring what we sign is something Anthropic can deliver

Minimum qualifications

  • Direct experience owning a large, multi-business partner relationship, where you were responsible for the whole relationship rather than a single deal or product line
  • Track record of structuring and closing product partnerships — embedding technology into partner products, co-developed products, distribution through partner surfaces, or similar — in addition to conventional commercial agreements
  • Experience personally leading complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations with senior executives, including deals with interlocking terms, competitive sensitivities, and multi-year commitments
  • Demonstrated ability to manage several significant negotiations at the same time without losing the thread on any of them
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional execution (e.g., Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance) to bring a complex agreement from structuring through signature and delivery

Preferred qualifications

  • 10+ years in strategic business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development at technology companies, with meaningful time spent managing relationships with very large technology partners
  • Experience on either side of a partnership between a foundation model or AI platform provider and a large technology company

Je bent geen gewone data engineer, je bent een visionair, een probleemoplosser en een pionier in data-intelligentie. Bij Centric krijg je de kans om je talenten te benutten, te groeien en te werken aan inspirerende projecten voor diverse toonaangevende organisaties. Wat doe je nog meer? Ontwerpen en implementeren van data-oplossingen en -architecturen Extraheren, transformeren en laden van gegevens (ETL) uit verschillende bronnen Werken met moderne (Cloud-)technologie in het datawerkveld Optimaliseren van gegevensprocessen voor prestaties en schaalbaarheid Samenwerken met multidisciplinaire teams om de behoeften van de klant te begrijpen en te vertalen naar technische oplossingen Onderhouden en monitoren van gegevensstromen en systemen Als Data Engineer treed je in dienst bij Centric en word je ingezet bij één of meerdere opdrachtgevers. De diversiteit in werklocatie, welke maximaal één uur van huis ligt, laat je kennismaken met vele organisaties. Zo blijf je je ontwikkelen binnen jouw vakgebied. Met jouw Field Manager stel je een ontwikkelplan op en samen bepalen jullie welke opleidingen, trainingen en /opdrachten passen bij jouw ontwikkelingswensen. Tot slot word je onderdeel van de vakgroep (EC), waarin kennisdeling en onderlinge coaching met collega’s centraal staat. Dit krijg je Bij Centric bieden we een dynamische omgeving waarin je jouw vaardigheden kunt benutten voor diverse uitdagende projecten bij boeiende klanten. Hier krijg je de mogelijkheid om voortdurend bij te leren en te groeien in een omgeving die in de voorhoede staat van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. Daarnaast krijg je als Data Engineer bij Centric: Een brutosalaris tot € 6.000,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag Mobiliteitsbudget, omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van werk naar huis reist Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën? Dit breng je mee Wij zorgen voor een werkomgeving waar jij blij kunt zijn en gewaardeerd wordt. Andersom vragen wij van jou als Data Engineer: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-studie Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie Aantoonbare ervaring met Azure-dataservices zoals Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, etc Kennis van programmeertalen en querytalen zoals SQL, Python, Scala, etc. Vaardigheid om oplossingen te ontwerpen die voldoen aan veiligheids- en compliance-vereisten Sterk analytisch denkvermogen en uitstekende probleemoplossende vaardigheden Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief in teamverband te werken Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric Word jij enthousiast van het omzetten van ruwe gegevens naar betekenisvolle inzichten? Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. f733137adbe67aa26dd1.description: Powering the world’s payments ecosystem ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. As a Data Scientist in Limerick, Ireland you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem! The purpose of the Data Scientist is: We are hiring a Data Scientist to join a modern, full-stack data science function at the heart of our fintech and payments business. This team owns the complete lifecycle of its models — from problem framing and data engineering through to model development, deployment and monitoring in production — with a direct mandate to strengthen how we detect and prevent financial crime across a global payments network. This is a genuinely exciting opportunity for a postgraduate-level data scientist to apply advanced statistical and machine learning methods to high-volume, real-world payments data, working alongside colleagues across multiple regions on problems that carry real financial and regulatory weight. You will work with a modern technology stack, including GPU-accelerated deep learning, and will be encouraged to bring research-driven thinking into a production engineering environment. A typical day at ACI for a Data Scientist is: - Design and build statistical and machine learning models to detect, predict and prevent financial crime, fraud and anomalous payment behaviour, alongside broader AI applications across payments such as intelligent payment routing and foundation model development for payments intelligence. - Contribute to the full data science lifecycle — data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment and ongoing monitoring — within a full-stack data science team. - Develop deep learning solutions using PyTorch, leveraging GPU/CUDA acceleration where appropriate to train and optimise models at scale. - Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders, including risk, compliance and product teams. - Collaborate across a global team of data scientists, engineers and subject-matter experts spanning multiple time zones and markets. - Apply rigorous statistical methods to ensure models are robust, explainable and fit for a regulated financial environment. - Contribute to the team’s engineering practices, including code quality, version control, testing and reproducibility of experiments. - Stay current with advances in machine learning, deep learning and financial crime typologies, bringing new techniques into the team. Knowledge, Skills and Experience and Experience needed to succeed in this role: - Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Engineering or another quantitative field. This role is well suited to a postgraduate student or recent graduate looking to apply their research skills in an applied, industry setting - Statistics – strong foundation in statistical theory and methods (hypothesis testing, probability, regression, experimental design) and their application to real-world data. - Python – strong hands-on proficiency, including standard data science libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). - PyTorch – practical experience building and training neural network models. - CUDA / GPU computing – experience accelerating model training using CUDA is favorable, though not essential. - Communication – excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. - Machine learning fundamentals – solid understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, and model evaluation and validation techniques. - Data wrangling – comfort working with large, messy, real-world datasets, including SQL for data extraction and manipulation. - Analytical mindset – a curious, rigorous approach to problem-solving, with sound commercial and risk judgement. - Collaboration – proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams. We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together: - Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments. - Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. - Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions. - Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. - Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. - Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in Ireland on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future. I n return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment. Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally. Important Notice About Recruitment Scams Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment. #Req Number 19933

f7513d3c972bf2b51f1b.description: BIM Project Manager - Dublin Dornan Engineering Group is a leading international engineering contractor delivering high-value projects across Europe, UK & Ireland. Based in our Dublin Office, this is an exciting opportunity to join our growing Digital Construction team as a BIM Project Manager, supporting the delivery of our projects which cover a wide variety. Your day will include: Design & BIM Programme Management – Develop and manage the design activity schedule (TIDP), track deliverables, progress, % complete, and report weekly on performance and lookahead. Design Coordination & Compliance – Coordinate multi-disciplinary design teams (process, mechanical, electrical, BIM) ensuring compliance with company standards, procedures, and qualified technical review. BIM Resource & Supply Chain Management – Manage internal and external BIM resources, review scope and costs, track performance, and ensure supply chain compliance. Risk, Change & Commercial Support – Identify, manage, and record design risks, assumptions, deviations, and change; compile evidence and reports to support commercial recovery. Stakeholder & Client Interface – Lead coordination with clients, contractors, and external parties; represent the business in workshops and meetings, producing accurate records and minutes. Quality, H&S & Buildability – Promote best-value, robust design solutions with strong H&S focus, supporting buildability, prefabrication strategies, and safe operations and maintenance. Information & Documentation Control – Oversee interface schedules, builders work processes, O&M documentation, redline drawings, and structured information flow across the project lifecycle. Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Sharing – Drive innovation, post-project reviews, lessons learned, performance improvement, and contribute to company standards, methods, and procedures. About You Role Model & Ambassador – Exemplifies company values of integrity, safety, quality, pride, and dependability in all actions. Positive, Driven Leader – Brings a determined, “can-do” mindset, creating energy, urgency, and momentum even under pressure. People Developer – Coaches, inspires, and recognises achievement while building trust and strong working relationships. Accountable & Self-Aware – Takes full responsibility, demonstrates sound judgement, and is committed to continuous personal development. High Standards & Resilience – Sets demanding standards for self and others while remaining calm, balanced, and effective in challenging situations. For a confidential discussion or to learn more about the role, please email darren.okeeffe@dornangroup.com Women @ Dornan: Our W@D Network through mentorship, development, and advocacy empowers women and promotes a more forward thinking construction industry. Dornan Strava Club: employees can take part in fitness challenges, build connections across the business, and contribute to monthly charitable giving initiatives. Be Yourself: We want everyone at Dornan to feel welcome, valued, and supported. By embracing different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, we create an environment where people can be themselves, grow their careers, and thrive.

f767cce01af56b632a46.description: The Office of Public Works (OPW) invites applications from eligible candidates for the position of Heritage Digitalisation Manager in the Heritage – Visitor Services (Business Unit) of the OPW. This position will be based in Georges Quay Dublin. Competition Reference: 2026/079 Essential Eligibility Criteria (at the closing date) Have significant relevant experience in digital transformation and project management; ICT project management and systems integration; Have proven experience in the management of staff. A clear copy of their Employment Permit, if applicable (a non-EEA national, unless exempted, requires an employment permit to work in Ireland).*3 Note: Eligible candidates must be: A citizen of the European Economic Area (EEA). The EEA consists of the Member States of the European Union, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway; or A citizen of the United Kingdom (UK); or A citizen of Switzerland pursuant to the agreement between the EU and Switzerland on the free movement of persons; or A non-EEA citizen who has a stamp 41 or a Stamp 5 visa; Please note that a 50 TEU visa, which is a replacement for Stamp 4EUFAM after Brexit, is acceptable as a Stamp 4 equivalent. To qualify candidates must be eligible by the date of any job offer. All non-EU/EEA citizens must hold a valid work permit prior to and for the duration of their contract. The work permit must allow you to work full time for the Office of Public Works. It is the responsibility of individual employees to ensure that you have a valid work permit. If at any stage during your contract you cease to hold a valid work permit you must immediately advise the Office of Public Works and your employment will cease with immediate effect. Desirable Qualifications and Skills Hold a qualification at level 7 on the National Framework of Qualifications (minimum 2nd class honours) in an appropriate subject, preferably but not limited to Business Development, Project Management, Marketing, Arts, IT,E-Commerce, Digital Communications etc.; * or equivalent) *. ** Irish or Foreign qualification (deemed in a similar field of study) recognised as equivalent to the above qualification on the Irish National Framework of Qualifications Experience with public procurement directives and financial guidelines Full Clean Irish Driving Licence, Category B&W. Principal Responsibilities and Duties of the Digitalisation Manager The successful applicant will be expected to possess and demonstrate strong managerial, analytical and leadership skills, drive and commitment, ICT use and application and excellent interpersonal and communication skills. The following list of responsibilities, which is not exhaustive, sets out the broad range of duties that may be required to be undertaken by the Digitalisation Manager. Work in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to plan, deliver, maintain, and improve digital applications and services in the Visitor Services division, including but not limited to: the online booking system; the people counters project; website content/performance and e-commerce applications; cross-platform integrations; CRM management and performance reporting; Identify solutions to enhance and improve the visitor’s digital journey and support efficient processes at site level in relation to visitor engagement; Responsible for developing the project plan of assigned projects. The role holder will be responsible for establishing clear budgets, risks, resources, milestones, deliverables, and delivering the timelines of assigned digital transformation projects. Manage end-to-end digital projects/ integrations from initial scoping through to discovery, design and delivery; Ensure overall project governance, providing regular, comprehensive reporting of project progress, milestones, budgets, risks, and resource utilisation; Responsible for developing and executing corrective action plans to realign projects that deviate from the established timeline or goals; Support the production of materials for monthly and weekly project meetings, coordinating evaluation surveys, and maintaining project status dashboards; Work in close cohesion with OPW ICT colleagues to review, and where necessary propose, relevant changes to business processes to ensure the right fit/build of new software; Manage of third party relationships Work with OPW’s ICT Unit, in selecting and managing appropriate technology solutions, such as cloud services, web platforms, data management systems, and digital tools, considering cost, security, scalability, usability, and compatibility; Represent heritage services in relation to corporate ICT and digital projects participating in working groups, project teams as required Ensure that the digitalisation approach and execution complies with the relevant policies and standards, such as data protection, accessibility etc.; Maintain a change management process for digital enhancements and phased implementation; Monitor and report on project progress, identifying learnings and recommendations for future improvements; Develop strategies that encourage visitors to OPW heritage sites to engage with digital services and products e.g. virtual tours, digital storytelling etc.; Provide system training to ensure all users are confident in their use and that processes are correctly followed; Responsible for leading assigned Visitor Services staff; The online booking project will evolve from a system integration project to an ongoing management function of centralised processes, customer service, and day to management of a system across all heritage sites. The role holder’s responsibilities will also evolve as the system become embedded in the overall digitalisation of Heritage Services; Manage and comply fully with the requirements of the Disciplinary Procedure, the Grievance Procedure, the Dignity at Work Policy, all HR requirements in close liaison with HR Division and all OPW policy requirements; Work with colleagues in Heritage and across other business units in the OPW towards the effective delivery of the OPW Strategic Plan and Mission Statement;

What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges. At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We  believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do. f84de730cfe983317f68.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role We're looking for a People Specialist to join our International People Team with a particular focus on supporting performance management related activities throughout the EMEA (UK, Ireland, Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland and Italy) and APAC (Japan, India, South Korea, Australia and New Zealand) regions.  You'll support People Partners and cross functional teams on the work that helps our managers do their jobs well: performance cases, org changes, developing manager resources, and the operational processes underneath all of it. Some weeks you'll be deep in a sensitive performance case coaching a manager. Other weeks you're cleaning up a process, rebuilding a tracker, or helping prep a leader for a hard conversation. We need someone who takes both kinds of work seriously and holds the same quality bar for each. A lot of the work is sensitive. You'll be close to performance management, org restructures, and situations that touch ER or Employment Legal. An understanding of the nuances which exist in relation to performance management and employee relations in different legal and cultural contexts will be critical.  Good judgment about what to share, with whom, and in what form is paramount. Responsibilities Manage performance casework regionally: building documentation, tracking timelines, prepping talking points, and keeping details from falling through the cracks while owning the process end to end. Own and improve operational processes that managers and People Partners depend on, including outside business activity requests and reorg processing Build, maintain, and improve manager resources and documentation so they're useful and current Partner with Leadership Design on manager enablement programs like the performance cycle: logistics, content, delivery, and the unglamorous operational work that makes programs run Help pull and compile reports and data for sensitive personnel matters Maintain tracking systems for casework and manager enablement initiatives; make them better than you found them Minimum Qualifications You have experience working on performance management or employee relations across Europe and ideally APAC You've supported complex or sensitive casework before and can work with partial information, messy handoffs, and tight timelines You're detail-oriented: you catch things, close loops, and remember where to find crucial information Ability to operationalise and scale your work, ensuring that you are able to build over time processes, frameworks and supporting documentation to help us scale Strong written communication. You'll be drafting things leaders use in hard conversations, and you're not precious when they get edited (you used Claude as a guide but not as a final editor) Good judgment on need-to-know. You think about what to share, with whom, and what goes in writing versus what stays verbal You'll push back when something's off. You have a point of view and you're comfortable raising concerns with people more senior than you Comfortable with range. You don't check out on the tedious work or treat it as beneath you Ability to operate in the grey - this is a fast-paced organisation, where we are building as we scale fast; not everything will be clear-cut and you should be able to operate in this environment with confidence Preferred Qualifications 7+ years in an HR- role: people operations, HR coordination, employee relations, HRBP, or something similar Experience at a high-growth tech company where process was being built while you used it Direct experience supporting HRBPs, Managers and Employees through challenging and sensitive matters. Working knowledge of HR compliance requirements in Europe and APAC Interest in AI safety Claude power user in your current role The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £175,000 — £220,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Known as “The Abnormal Beauty Company”, DECIEM is the parent company of The Ordinary, NIOD, Avestan, and other beauty brands, and is an industry disruptor with an innovation-focused approach. It was Co-Founded in 2013 by the late Brandon Truaxe, a visionary who set out to change the beauty industry through authenticity and transparency. He developed the company with creativity and innovation alongside Co-Founder and CEO, Nicola Kilner. We are growing very rapidly and need someone who shares this vision and wants to grow with us!
