fcb9ae78efb9ed996bb0.description: Junior Food Category Analyst Role Introduction: Established in 1992, Applegreen is a leading convenience roadside retailer in the Republic of Ireland, the UK and the US in both large-scale Motorway Service Areas and Travel Plazas, as well as smaller petrol stations. The business has grown to over €4BN in annual revenue, operating 430 Motorway Service Plazas and forecourt sites internationally and employing over 17,000 people. Applegreen is in a rapid growth phase and to support this ambitious growth, we are seeking to onboard a Junior Food Category Analyst to join our team. This role will form part of the Commercial Food team. The successful candidate will be a confident people person who can fit into Applegreen seamlessly and adopt a hands-on approach to their role. Key Responsibilities: Support the preparation and distribution of weekly and monthly Food performance reports, including sales, margin, waste, availability, stock and promotional performance. Assist the Food team with analysis of product, category and store performance, highlighting key trends and exceptions for further review. Maintain accurate trackers, reports and product information, ensuring data is kept up to date and issues are identified promptly. Provide administrative support across the Food category team, helping Buyers and Category Managers with day-to-day category activities. Support invoice administration and reconciliation, investigating invoice queries and working with internal teams and suppliers to resolve discrepancies. Assist with the management of supplier information, pricing, product set-up, recipe management and other commercial administration. Work closely with the Supply Chain team to monitor stock availability, deliveries and supply issues and help escalate potential risks. Support the coordination of new product launches, range changes and promotional activity, ensuring relevant information is accurate and communicated to key stakeholders. Assist with forecasting and stock management activities, particularly around promotions, new product launches and seasonal activity. Support the monitoring of waste and availability, helping identify products, stores or categories requiring further investigation. Liaise with suppliers and internal departments to obtain information and resolve day-to-day queries. Support category reviews and presentations by gathering and preparing relevant sales, customer and product information. Assist with competitor and market reviews to help the Food team understand emerging products, pricing and Food to Go trends. Maintain organised records, trackers, product files and documentation for the Food team. Support improvements to reporting and administrative processes, identifying opportunities to make routine tasks more efficient and accurate. Provide general analytical and administrative support across the Food team as required. The Candidate should have the following: Qualifications, experience & skills Experience in a commercial, retail, food, supply-chain or administrative environment would be beneficial. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, with strong Excel skills. Comfortable working with numbers and analysing data to identify trends or discrepancies. Previous exposure to Power BI or similar reporting tools would be beneficial but is not essential. Experience with SAP or another ERP system would be advantageous but is not essential. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Good organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines. Confident written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable working with colleagues across Commercial, Operations, Finance and Supply Chain. An interest in food, retail and the Food to Go / QSR market. A positive attitude with a strong willingness to learn and develop. Additional key skills & attributes: A dynamic individual who adapts well to change and can thrive in a rapidly growing organisation that continues to evolve. Comfortable working with data, reports and commercial information High level of accuracy, particularly when dealing with invoices, prices, product information and reporting. Able to manage recurring reporting deadlines alongside day-to-day requests from the Food team. Interested in understanding what drives sales, margin, waste and availability. Willing to investigate issues rather than simply report them. Comfortable working across Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance and with external suppliers. Able to respond positively to changing priorities in a fast-paced retail environment. Takes a logical approach to resolving data, invoice, stock and administrative issues. Motivated to build analytical, food and commercial knowledge and take on greater responsibility over time. Willing to travel on an ad hoc basis if required. Further information about Applegreen can be found here https://applegreenstores.com/about-us/

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Account Executive, a pivotal member of our enterprise sales team, is dedicated to driving growth by acquiring new clients across the region. This role is solely focused on expanding our footprint in the CPG space. Leveraging top-tier products and effective sales strategies, the Account Executive collaborates closely with Value Engineers, Business Development Representatives, and other cross-functional teams to identify and capture high-value new business opportunities.

The Role:

The primary objective is to build and expand market presence by capitalizing on untapped opportunities in the region. As an Account Executive specializing in new business sales, this role is integral to our strategy for expanding market share through targeted client acquisitions. Key responsibilities include

The work you’ll do:

  • Drive New Business: Identify and develop new opportunities within a defined territory, targeting enterprise accounts to secure new logos. 
  • Own the Sales Cycle: Manage the entire sales process—from prospecting and qualification to closing six-figure deals
  • Engage Strategic Stakeholders: Build relationships across multiple lines of business, engaging with C-level executives, operational leaders, and key decision-makers.
  • Deliver Tailored Solutions: Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and demonstrate how Celonis’ solutions can solve their strategic and operational challenges.
  • Showcase Value: Present use-case-specific pitches and demos, independently or in collaboration with Value Engineers, to highlight the measurable impact of Celonis solutions.
  • Collaborate with Partners: Work closely with Big 4 consulting firms, SaaS providers, and industry partners to enhance the value proposition for your prospects. 
  • Leverage Team Support: Partner with your virtual team, including business development representatives, pre- sales, customer success, marketing managers, and partner managers, to drive success.
  • This role will be expected to spend the majority of their time in the field meeting with clients

The qualifications you need:

  • Proven SaaS Sales Experience: A strong track record of success in enterprise SaaS sales, with a focus on securing new business and consistently achieving revenue targets. 
  • Expertise in Complex Sales: Experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles within large enterprise accounts.
  • Track record of selling enterprise-level software applications to C-level stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen with a solid understanding of business processes and KPIs (e.g. in CPG)
  • Strong Communication Skills: Exceptional presentation and storytelling abilities to confidently influence senior stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Collaborative Mindset: A team-oriented approach, leveraging internal and external resources to achieve shared goals. 
This role will be expected to spend the majority of their time in the field meeting with clients.

Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

fd511fa3c700e4fe3877.description: Overview Are you an experienced ERP Resource Planning and Workforce Management professional looking to play a key role in a major business transformation programme? PM Group is undertaking a significant enterprise-wide transformation through the implementation of a new Group ERP platform. As part of this strategic initiative, we are seeking an experienced ERP Resource Planning & Resource Management Workstream Lead to drive the design, implementation and optimisation of resource planning capabilities across the organisation. This role will be responsible for ensuring that the ERP solution enables effective resource allocation, workforce planning, capacity management, utilisation tracking and forecasting across PM Group's project delivery organisation. The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Project Delivery, Finance, HR/HCM and implementation partners to establish future-state resource management processes, governance structures and reporting frameworks that support business growth and operational excellence. This is a 12-month contract role and can be based in either our Dublin or Cork office, operating under a hybrid working model. Responsibilities ERP Resource Planning & System Implementation: Lead the Resource Planning and Resource Management workstream throughout the ERP implementation lifecycle, from design and configuration through testing, deployment and business adoption. Act as the primary business lead for resource planning, resource allocation, workforce management and capacity planning requirements within the ERP programme. Partner with business stakeholders, functional leads, SMEs and implementation partners to define and validate resource management requirements and future-state processes. Review solution designs, system configurations and evolving ERP builds to ensure alignment with business resource planning needs and operating model objectives. Identify, assess and manage gaps between business requirements and standard ERP functionality, recommending appropriate configuration, process changes or system enhancements. Define and validate reporting, analytics and dashboard requirements supporting resource planning, capacity forecasting, utilisation reporting and workforce demand management. Support testing, training, change management and business readiness activities to ensure successful adoption of ERP resource planning capabilities. Resource Management & Workforce Planning: Design and implement resource planning processes that provide visibility of resource capacity, availability, skills, utilisation and future demand across the business. Establish effective resource allocation and prioritisation processes that enable optimal deployment of project delivery resources. Develop workforce planning frameworks that align organisational capability with current and future project demand. Save Report this job About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About The Role We're looking for an experienced Analytics Engineer to join our Data team as one of its first hires. You will own the transformation layer between raw data and business decisions: modelling our data in dbt, defining the certified metrics the company runs on, and setting the standards that every analyst and data scientist at ElevenLabs builds. Drive the implementation of a world-class metric layer for the company: modelling conventions, project structure, testing, CI, and documentation. Design and maintain the certified KPI layer for product (activation, adoption, retention, usage), finance (billing, ARR, revenue), and company-wide topics, built to withstand audit scrutiny. Partner with Data Engineering on evolving the data warehouse architecture, and with stakeholders to turn ambiguous questions into trusted, reusable data products, including data served through AI agents. Requirements Demonstrated experience building and scaling a dbt project and metrics layer, ideally as one of the first analytics engineers on a growing team. Expert knowledge of dbt and advanced SQL (required); strong grasp of dimensional modelling, grain, and incremental patterns. Proficiency across the modern data stack (BigQuery or similar warehouse, Python, BI tools such as Looker). Rigour around data quality: you test, document, and reconcile by default, and you spot a model that runs cleanly but is quietly wrong. Strong ability to understand varied stakeholder requirements, push back where needed, and translate them into generalised, well-documented models. Bonus: Experience modelling billing, subscription and ARR data (Stripe, Salesforce) or product event data at scale. Experience serving data to LLM-based agents or building semantic / metrics layers consumed by AI tools. Experience with CI for data (Slim CI, data contracts, PII policy tags) and infrastructure-as-code for warehouse access. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. Back to jobs Marketing Analytics Lead, Enterprise Marketing San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Marketing Analytics Lead at Anthropic, you will own how we measure marketing. You'll build and run a single measurement framework that shows how marketing activity turns into pipeline, revenue, and product usage, and you'll make that framework something marketers and executives actually use to make decisions. As our marketing programs grow across enterprise and product-led motions, your work will determine whether we invest in what works. In this role, you'll own the marketing measurement framework end to end: the metric definitions, the data models behind them, the dashboards that surface them, and the insights they produce. This is a hands-on individual contributor role; data science and data engineering will support you, but you'll do the core work yourself. You'll partner closely with field marketing, partner marketing, campaign marketing, finance, sales strategy, sales development, data science, and data engineering to align on definitions and keep the whole organization working from one view of the funnel. Key responsibilities Own the marketing measurement framework that connects marketing activity to pipeline, revenue, and product usage Set the direction for the framework and extend it to programs it doesn't cover yet Define marketing metrics clearly and get cross-functional teams to agree on definitions early Build and maintain the data models that power marketing reporting Develop dashboards that marketers and executives rely on in their weekly reviews Teach marketers and executives how the metrics work, and keep teaching as the metrics evolve Lead adoption of the framework so that both marketing and executive teams use it as their shared source of truth Partner with finance, sales strategy, and sales development to connect marketing measurement to the broader revenue picture Find and share the insights nobody asked for, turning analysis into recommendations that change what we do Write analytical SQL on large datasets to answer questions about funnel performance and attribution Track framework gaps and data quality issues, and work with data engineering to resolve them Present findings to marketing leadership and executives in clear, decision-ready formats Minimum qualifications Have deep experience with marketing analytics, including lead funnels, attribution to enterprise pipeline, and product usage measurement Have designed metrics from scratch and know what makes a metric trusted and useful Can write analytical SQL on large datasets with confidence Have built data models in tools like dbt and dashboards that many people use daily Are comfortable setting direction without waiting for a plan to be handed to you Can turn vague questions into clear, measurable definitions Work well across functions and know how to get teams aligned on definitions before problems surface Enjoy teaching others how metrics work and helping non-technical audiences build data fluency Finish what you start, from first definition to adopted dashboard Are motions Familiarity with marketing attribution models and their practical tradeoffs Experience presenting metrics and insights directly to executives and shaping how leadership reviews performance A background in data science, analytics engineering, or marketing operations Experience working with CRM and marketing automation data, such as Salesforce and related tooling Experience standing up a measurement practice where one didn't exist before Familiarity with how finance and sales strategy teams think about pipeline and forecasting The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $255,000 - $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building toward a fundamentally different kind of GRC: one that directs Claude, with the right humans in the loop, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits.

Within Security GRC, Compliance and Audit Programs (CAP) runs the integrated audit across our frameworks and maintains the Common Control Framework the program hangs off. This role sits in Compliance & Audit Programs and works one regime family, US public sector, from requirements through authorization and ongoing compliance, working alongside the public sector engineering pods rather than downstream of them.

About the role

You'll help drive the compliance programs that keep Anthropic's US government authorizations current: federal civilian (FedRAMP, including FedRAMP 20x for Claude Enterprise), Department of War (DoD impact levels, CMMC, NIST SP 800-171), and state and local (StateRAMP, TX-RAMP and agency requirements). You'll own the recurring cycles those authorizations run on (continuous monitoring, POA&M, annual assessments, significant changes), help build new authorizations as we add them, and keep every frontier model's authorizations current.

You'll turn government requirements into specific, testable requirements that engineering teams build against, review the evidence that comes back, and say so when a launch is not ready for a government boundary. You'll map US government requirements onto our Common Control Framework so the public sector view and the integrated audit view of the same control stay one framework. Building with Claude is a normal part of the job: mapping, evidence collection and reporting, with you deciding where human judgment stays in the loop.

This is an individual contributor role, working closely with a peer on US public sector compliance, for someone who works well independently, writes clearly, and gets satisfaction from a government authorization that holds up as the product changes underneath it.

Key responsibilities

  • Run the recurring compliance cycles for our US government authorizations (continuous monitoring, POA&M, annual assessments, SSP updates, significant changes and incident notifications), starting with C4G on Palantir FedStart and the NIST SP 800-171 assessment with Schellman
  • Co-own FedRAMP 20x work for Claude Enterprise, and help build new authorizations (first-party FedRAMP High, DoW impact levels, StateRAMP and TX-RAMP) with requirements and evidence work
  • Support model authorizations in GovCloud and Vertex for every model launch, as the GRC member of the Inference and model delivery pod
  • Translate government obligations into partner team requirements, for example vulnerability SLAs in our internal vulnerability reporting platform, and review the evidence
  • Answer public sector customer and deal questions (what a boundary allows, CUI, IRS Publication 1075, CJIS, ITAR), and handle questionnaires and RFIs until they move to Customer Trust
  • Map US government requirements onto the Common Control Framework with the Controls Assurance Lead and keep one source of truth for status
  • Build with Claude: automate mapping, evidence collection and reporting, and verify machine-drafted language before it becomes the record

Minimum qualifications

  • Several years in security compliance or IT audit with hands-on US government compliance for a cloud service (FedRAMP, DoD impact levels, CMMC or NIST SP 800-171, or StateRAMP), including the ongoing compliance cycle after authorization
  • Working command of the NIST SP 800-53 Moderate baseline and the mechanics of authorization: boundary definition, control implementation statements, assessment, continuous monitoring, POA&M and significant change
  • Experience writing requirements for engineering teams from a control baseline and reviewing the evidence that came back
  • Working knowledge of how a GovCloud or Vertex style government region differs from commercial, and what changes when a model, feature or region is added to an authorized boundary
  • Enough technical fluency to read a runbook, configuration or pipeline definition and judge whether it enforces the written control
  • Clear writing, because implementation statements and status reports are what assessors, engineers and leadership work from
  • Ability to get partner teams to prioritize and close compliance work without authority over them

Preferred qualifications

  • Have taken a service through FedRAMP High or DoD IL4 or IL5, or supported a service on classified networks
  • Have worked on a FedRAMP 20x pilot or built machine-readable evidence or reporting for an assessor
  • Have applied LLMs to compliance work such as control mapping, evidence testing or continuous evidence collection
  • Hold or are eligible for a US security clearance
  • Experience with state and local requirements such as StateRAMP, TX-RAMP, IRS Publication 1075 or CJIS

You don't need to

  • Have done everything on this list or worked every regime. The scarce combination is running a government authorization on its recurring cycle plus the judgment to tell whether a control actually works
  • Write production code. The bar is fluency sufficient to read, query and challenge
  • Hold every certification. CISSP, CISA, CGRC or similar are welcome and not required
  • Have prior AI industry experience

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$255,000—$270,000 USD

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Who We Are Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. Job Description What the Project Is About Data centres are becoming some of Europe's most consequential and fastest-growing electricity users, yet most still appear to the grid as large, opaque, and largely grid-agnostic loads. AIRCAS, short for AI-driven Resource & Cooling forCASting and control for data centres , gives you the opportunity to change this through advanced AI control in a live data-centre environment. You will help build a digital twin, forecasting, and safety-constrained control system that coordinates electricity demand, cooling, heat recovery, and water use. At HPE Labs Ireland, the role will involve live telemetry processing, research, training, evaluation, and deployment of reinforcement-learning controllers across two MODPODs in the Customer Innovation Centre (CIC) data centre. You will validate control policies through replay, hardware-in-the-loop, shadow-mode, and controlled live trials. This is an applied research role spanning physical-system modelling, software engineering, machine learning, and operational deployment. You will collaborate with our international project partners: the University of Porto, CNRS, Savery Tech, RWTH Aachen, Swerim, TerraBarrier, and Daikin Applied. The Opportunity Hewlett Packard Labs is seeking a highly qualified, self-motivated machine-learning and AI researcher to join its growing AI research team in Ireland. The role will accelerate research on digital twins that incorporate machine learning, with a focus on the AIRCAS programme. You will develop and deploy advanced reinforcement-learning control for a live data-centre environment. The work spans research, software engineering, and experimental validation: from data collection and physical-system modelling through forecasting, control-policy training, hardware-in-the-loop testing, shadow operation, and bounded live trials. What You Will Do Build the CIC data and workload pipeline, including controlled workload generation, telemetry ingestion, time-series data management, data-quality checks, and baseline datasets. Develop modular digital-twin software that combines site telemetry with physical models, empirical performance maps, cooling and storage models, and operational constraints. Develop probabilistic forecasts for IT load, cooling demand, and relevant water and heat signals using CIC operational data. Research, implement, train, and evaluate objective-shifting multi-objective reinforcement-learning policies that balance flexibility, cost, carbon, water use, and durability within hard safety limits. Implement a price-response interface that produces feasible, auditable flexibility commitments with uncertainty information. Validate the control stack through replay, hardware-in-the-loop testing, shadow mode, and controlled actuation windows on the CIC MODPODs. Produce reproducible evidence for flexibility, reliability, sustainability, and durability performance, including measurement-and-verification workflows and KPI analysis. Collaborate with HPE Labs researchers and the AIRCAS partners to integrate laboratory cooling results, sustainability signals, and physical operating guardrails into the control system. About Hewlett Packard Labs And AIRL Hewlett Packard Labs is HPE's central research organisation. Its purpose is to deliver breakthrough technologies that create a competitive advantage for HPE, investing in fundamental areas of strategic interest and preparing resulting technologies for adoption. The AI Research Lab (AIRL) focuses on applied machine-learning research and applications relevant to HPE and its customers. Its work includes reinforcement learning for sustainability, digital twins, complex scientific applications such as fusion energy, large language models, trustworthy and responsible AI, and data foundations for AI. The team brings together diverse skills and expertise to explore ambitious research and technology opportunities. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a machine-learning research engineer with experience in machine learning, time-series analysis, reinforcement learning, and digital twins. The role requires strong engineering judgement and an aptitude for modelling physical systems. The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, comfortable with system-level analysis and design, and motivated to turn research ideas into deployed technology. We expect team members to provide technical leadership, take innovative ideas from conception through design, development, implementation, evaluation, and technology transfer, and collaborate effectively with HPE Labs teams, external partners, and HPE's wider innovation community. Education And Experience PhD degree, or Master's degree with equivalent research and innovation experience, in a relevant discipline such as computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mathematics, physics, statistics, or mechanical engineering. Proven record of innovation in deep learning, scientific computing, engineering computation, or machine-learning applications. Demonstrated experience developing proofs of concept, first-of-a-kind solutions, or technologies for transfer into practice. Evidence of independent research leadership, for example through publications in leading conferences or journals. Required Technical Skills Strong software-development skills in Python and PyTorch. Strong experience applying machine learning to physical systems. Knowledge of digital twins, machine learning with digital twins, and sustainability applications. Strong science or engineering background, including system-level analysis and modelling. Sound understanding of machine-learning algorithms, data structures, and modern AI/ML platforms. Ability to develop integrated software algorithms; work with large-scale computing, data-analysis, and modelling environments; and translate technical specifications into robust code. Excellent research, development, written, and verbal communication skills in English. Preferred Skills Research publications in machine learning, applied statistics, or AI. Experience designing, implementing, and operating AI/ML systems. Experience with reinforcement learning, probabilistic time-series forecasting, optimisation, or control. Experience with experimental systems, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or production software for research prototypes. fea177762b59157edf46.description: Capco France recherche des Data Engineers pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de plateformes et solutions data modernes, robustes et évolutives. Au sein de notre Practice Data & Analytics , vous interviendrez sur des projets de transformation à fort impact, de la conception des architectures et pipelines de données jusqu’à leur mise en production et leur optimisation. Une expérience des technologies et architectures data modernes, ainsi que d’au moins un environnement Cloud tel qu’AWS, Azure ou GCP. Une bonne compréhension des problématiques de modélisation, transformation, qualité et gouvernance des données. Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements complexes, réglementés et internationaux, avec une excellente communication en français et en anglais. fecc0a46daaf7c944d08.description: Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges. At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation. Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do. Who You'll Work With Arista Networks is looking for Graduate Engineers interested in learning world leading product development in C/C++, Go, Java, and other languages. Join us at Arista Networks advancing the Software Defined Networking (SDN) revolution. What You’ll Do Writing Linux user space and kernel code to allow 32-bit drivers to DMA 64-bit virtual memory spaces using both Intel and AMD IOMMU controller. Working on the hardware/software boundary for chips and the kernel. Where an x86 chip might have tens of registers, you will routinely work on ASICs with thousands of registers, tables, and special TCAM memories. You will program networking chips to provide latency analysis and keep accurate counts of events happening billions of times per second. You will write Python to bootstrap new hardware. You will build software agents that mediate and translate between the requirements of switching ASICs, high capacity custom FPGAs, media adapters, and PCIe bridges. You might tune lasers and measure and correct error rates measured in parts per billion. Implementing communications protocols between routers and switches at layer 2 (such as LLDP, 802.1x, BFD, etc), and layer 3 (such as BGP, OSPF, ISIS). Updating the forwarding state of the hardware, using platform-independent abstractions. Reconciling the linux kernel routing model with the switch's forwarding state. Implementing a policy language used for filtering and manipulating routing data received and advertised to peers Accessing ASIC registers over SPI bus, SMbus, PCIe and I2C, to implement high resolution timers (sub-100ns accuracy) and read ASIC hardware specifications to gather near-real-time information on large numbers of packet flows and to generate network congestion statistics. Developing configuration management services using Go and Python to support YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF and RESTCONF over gRPC, ssh and ssl for standardised switch configuration, combined with tools such as git, gerrit, Jenkins, Slack and Trello. Developing routing protocol agents (for BGP, OSPF, ISIS) in C/C++ within a Fedora Linux embedded environment. Coding of fault-tolerant, concurrent agents capable of handling the demands of future data centres where high performance and high availability are basic requirements. Fully automated, developer owned, Python based, continuous test harness with 100s of devices under test at any one moment. #LI-EO1 Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related fields (Bachelor’s, Master’s, PhD) Any of the following:- C, C++, Java, Python, Go, react.js, redux.js, node.js Networking, Linux Embedded Systems, Algorithms, Programming, Software Development. Strong analytical skills Ability to communicate effectively in a collaborative and highly technical team environment Intellectual curiosity and passion for solving challenging problems using technology The working hours will be agreed in advance with the team manager.

Back to jobs Financial Data and Controls Lead, Billing Platform San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY Apply About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is seeking a Financial Data and Controls Lead to join our Billing Platform team. Billing Platform builds the systems customers use to transact with Anthropic: subscriptions, usage billing, quote to cash, invoicing, and payments. You'll be the dedicated owner of billing accuracy, reconciliation, and financial controls across those systems, making sure the right checks run, the right controls are in place, and the audit evidence exists. Our billing systems and pricing change often, and each flow needs to meet SOX requirements. Accurate billing is what lets us launch products and pricing quickly and still close the books on time. The hard problems today include validating negotiated pricing from contract to invoice, handling the many forms of credits, app store billing, and keeping controls current while the systems under them are replaced. This is a foundational role and the first hire of its kind on the team. You'll lead a working group of the reconciliation and controls owners from each billing engineering team, and you'll set the approach they follow. You'll work closely with Finance Systems, Accounting, Internal Audit, and Data Engineering. The role sits in Engineering and works with Finance every day. Our Data organization builds the pipelines and owns the warehouse, and you'll use that data and partner with that team. We're looking for an engineer or data practitioner with strong accounting domain knowledge, who can talk to engineers about systems and to Finance and auditors about risk and materiality. Key responsibilities Own reconciliation and accuracy checks for critical billing data (quantity, price, discounts, and invoices) across our product platform, third-party billing and payment providers, app stores, cloud marketplaces, and in-house systems Design and run detective controls that catch billing errors before they reach the accounting books Partner with billing engineering teams to turn repeat checks into automated verifiers Review billing changes that have financial impact, flag the ones that touch SOX or IT application controls (ITACs), and make sure functional test evidence is in place Make SOX review a standard, lightweight step in how billing changes ship, treated like a security review, so launches are not delayed by it Own the end-to-end test strategy and audit evidence for those changes, working with Finance Systems, Data Engineering, Accounting, and Internal Audit Triage billing errors, prioritize backfills and fixes with the owning teams, and track materiality over time Define and maintain the data contracts between billing and finance systems, so downstream teams can find and trust the data they need Lead the working group of reconciliation and controls owners across billing engineering teams, through influence and not reporting lines Act as the Billing owner, alongside Accounting and Finance Systems, for translating the product and pricing roadmap into financial impact, test strategy, and process updates Minimum qualifications Experience building or owning a financial ledger, billing reconciliation, or cash reconciliation system end to end, one that Accounting relied on to close the books Hands-on SQL skills strong enough to take two messy datasets (for example usage events and invoices), match them, find the breaks, and explain the root cause Accounting domain knowledge (order to cash, month-end close, and materiality) sufficient to tell which billing changes have financial impact Experience working with SOX and Internal Audit teams on IT application controls, detective controls, transaction monitoring, functional test evidence, and auditor walkthroughs Experience defining data contracts between billing or product systems and finance systems such as the ERP, general ledger, or revenue recognition Track record of driving work across Engineering, Finance, Accounting, and Audit without direct authority Ability to explain technical issues to Finance and auditors in their terms, and financial risk to engineers in theirs Interest in AI and a commitment to Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI systems ff28545268ebca9634bf.description: Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow. In a nutshell Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed). Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale. Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics. Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression. Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events. About Kaizo At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing. The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in. What you'll focus on Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably. Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics. Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume. Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable. Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions. Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality). Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product. What you'll grow into Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time. Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation. A solid understanding of how LLMs work and hands-on experience prompting them for accuracy (coursework, thesis, internships, or side projects all count; production experience is a bonus). Good applied statistics: experiment design, classifier evaluation, precision/recall trade-offs, and working with heavily imbalanced data. Strong Python skills and fluency with the standard data toolkit (Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter). SQL is a plus. An analytical, evidence-first mindset: you'd rather measure than assume. Product sense and empathy for end users. You'll be building for QA managers and support agents, not just for benchmarks. Excellent written and verbal communication. You'll present findings to the team and join customer conversations. 0 to 2 years of industry experience. Recent graduates with strong relevant work are encouraged to apply. A team player who's comfortable wearing multiple hats. We're an early-stage company and things move fast. Bonus points for: Experience with LangSmith or similar LLMOps/evaluation tooling Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Docker, or Kubernetes Speech/audio processing or ASR evaluation Fine-tuning or building synthetic datasets for LLMs Who you'll work with You'll join our AI team (two data scientists, an AI engineer, and an ML engineer) and collaborate closely with our data engineers, frontend engineers, designer, product manager, and CX teams. You'll have mentorship from day one and real ownership fast. What's in it for you? An office in the heart of Amsterdam, with the flexibility of hybrid working Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates Great office gear: MacBook, tools, desk, chair, whatever you need Flexible working schedule and an open holiday policy Fun workations and team events A clear growth path into Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer roles

Traditional automotive software methods can't keep pace with consumer expectations shaped by the mobile industry—where features evolve rapidly, update seamlessly, and improve continuously. That's why leading OEMs trust Sonatus to accelerate this shift. Our technology is already in production across more than 9 million vehicles on the road today and rapidly expanding. Headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA, with 250+ employees worldwide, Sonatus combines the agility of a fast-growing company with the scale and impact of an established partner. Backed by strong funding and proven by global deployment, we're solving some of the most interesting and complex challenges in the industry. Join us and help redefine what's possible as we shape the future of mobility. Role Summary Sonatus is looking for a Software Developer to join our Vehicle Applications team in Dublin, Ireland. In this role, you'll design and build high-performance, data-driven applications that run on edge computing platforms inside vehicles. You'll collaborate across teams to deliver robust software solutions that drive the future of connected and software-defined vehicles. This is a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge automotive technology in a fast-paced, innovative environment. Job Responsibilities Develop robust, high-performance data applications for edge computing systems in vehicles. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable C++ code. Implement and maintain unit and integration tests to ensure code quality. Produce and maintain technical documentation for internal and external stakeholders. Debug, diagnose, and resolve complex issues. Collaborate closely with other developers, QA, DevOps, and engineering teams of our customers and partners throughout the development lifecycle. Qualifications Required Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field. 3+ years of experience contributing to production-grade software systems. Independent proficiency in modern C++ (C++11 or newer), with evidence of knowledge in multi-threading, concurrent programming & unit / integration testing. Exposure to software development on Linux platforms. Familiarity with build systems such as CMake, Bazel, or equivalents. Operational knowledge with operating systems, data structures, and algorithms. Strong debugging and problem solving skills. Experience with Python and shell scripting for automation or tooling. A collaborative mindset. Motivated by delivering high-quality software and validating it in a real-world automotive environment. Preferred Experience with automotive software development on Linux or Android platforms. Understanding of automotive communication protocols like CAN, Ethernet, MQTT, and TCP/IP. Exposure to edge computing, connected vehicle platforms, or real-time systems. Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins. Benefits Offered: Competitive compensation and stock option offerings Time off (national holidays and statutory annual leave provisions apply) Health care plan (Medical, dental) Income protection and Life insurance benefits Pension plan Fitness Allowance Phone & internet reimbursement IT Equipment allowance Snack and drinks in office

fffaf724e494d1233016.description: Powering the world’s payments ecosystem ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. As a Data Scientist in Limerick, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem! This purpose of this Data Scientist is: Designs, develops and programs methods, processes, and systems to consolidate and analyse unstructured, diverse “big data” sources to generate actionable insights and solutions for client services and product enhancement. Interacts with product and service teams to identify questions and issues for data analysis and experiments. Develops and codes software programs, algorithms and automated processes to cleanse, integrate and evaluate large datasets from multiple disparate sources. Identifies meaningful insights from large data and metadata sources; interprets and communicates insights and findings from analysis and experiments to product, service, and business managers. A typical day at ACI for a Data Scientist is: - Develops predictive models for customers utilizing a variety of statistical and machine learning algorithms. - Holds responsibility for projects of a moderate degree of complexity. - Executes all stages of model development and delivery including data definition, sampling, preprocessing, feature selection, model generation, and validation and support or production model release. - Validates and prepares data for model development, performs exploratory data analysis and data cleaning on large datasets and queries and visualizes data with a variety of tools. - Works with a team of scientists and engineers responsible for the development and deployment of the state-of-the-art predictive models for a variety of financial applications. This includes the design, development and deployment of statistical predictive models. - Understands and complies with Risk Management program requirements including Identification of risks, key controls, and control testing as applicable to their responsibilities. - Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics. Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed to succeed in this role: - Bachelor’s degree required, PhD preferred in Statistical Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Computational Chemistry or related field. - 2+ years industry or related field experience. - Proficient in managing RAG pipelines and development of Agentic Process in a save and secure manner. - Prior experience in working with agentic based development is favorable Core Capabilities: We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together: - Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments. - Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances. - Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions. - Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. - Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. - Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the Ireland on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future. I n return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment. Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com Job ID (Requisition #19859) ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.
